text: Nauna na nga gin-anunsyo sang Department of Budget and Management (DBM) nga ila na na-release sa Department of Transportation (DoTr) ang P7-billion para sa implementasyon sang amo nga programa.
english: Earlier, the Department of Budget and Management (DBM) announced that it has released to the Department of Transportation (DoTr) the P7-billion for the implementation of the program.

text: Sa idalom sang service contracting program, ang operators kag drivers nga magapartisipar sa Libre Sakay program ang makabaton sang one-time payout nga P4,000 kag weekly payments base sa kilometro sang ila nga byahe sa sulod sang isa ka semana.
english: Under the service contracting program, operators and drivers who participate in the Libre Sakay program will receive a one-time payout of P4,000 and weekly payments based on the kilometers of their trips within a week.

text: Ginalantaw man sang transport department nga madamo sa mga drivers ang magapartisipar sa amo nga programa bangud man sa madinaglag-on sini nga resulta sang 2020 kag 2021.
english: The transport department also expects many drivers to participate in the program due to its successful results in 2020 and 2021.

text: Ginabanta nga nagdangat man sa 44 million ang mga pasahero nga nakabenipisyo sa amo nga servicing program.
english: An estimated 44 million passengers also benefited from the servicing program.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – Nag-angkon sang pagdayaw ang Iloilo City kadungan sang pag-host sang 44th Executive Committee Meeting sang CityNet – ang pinakadako nga Asia-Pacific network sang urban stakeholders nga nakatutok sa sustainable development.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – Iloilo City received praise while hosting the 44th Executive Committee Meeting of CityNet – the largest Asia-Pacific network of stakeholders focused on sustainable urban development.

text:
Bwas, pormal na nga magatakop ang tatlo ka adlaw nga kahiwatan sa Iloilo City Convention Center sa diin tema ang “Living the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs): A Shared Future for All.”

Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Makati City Mayor Abigail Binay, iya ginpahayag nga magluwas sa best practices sa Iloilo City, nag-enjoy man sila sa mga manumit nga pagkaon sa Iloilo City kaangay sang batchoy, seafoods, pancit molo, siopao kag inasal nga manok nga nagapamatuod nga ang syudad ang UNESCO Creative City for Gastronomy.
english:
Tomorrow, the three-day event will formally end at the Iloilo City Convention Center with the theme “Living the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs): A Shared Future for All.”

In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Makati City Mayor Abigail Binay said that besides the best practices in Iloilo City, they also enjoyed the delicious foods in Iloilo City such as batchoy, seafoods, pancit molo, siopao and inasal chicken which proves that the city is the UNESCO Creative City for Gastronomy.

text: Plano man sang  alkalde nga ipatuman sa ila lugar ang progressive urban initiative sa Iloilo partikular ang matinlo nga palibot, smoke-free policies, kag ang kilala na Iloilo River Esplanade.
english: The mayor also plans to implement in his area the progressive urban initiative in Iloilo particularly the clean environment, smoke-free policies, and the well-known Iloilo River Esplanade.

text: Magluwas diri, ginpakigbahin man ni Binay ang mga innovations sa Makati City bilang naga-isahanon nga syudad sa Pilipinas kag Southeast Asia nga kinilala bilang Resilience Hub.
english: Besides, Binay also shared the innovations in Makati City as the only city in the Philippines and Southeast Asia known as a Resilience Hub.

text: Nahibaluan nga nalakip si Binay sa 100 nga mga urban leaders kag stakeholders halin sa Asia-Pacific region nga nagtambong sa kahiwatan.
english: Binay was among 100 urban leaders and stakeholders from the Asia-Pacific region who attended the event.

text: Nagluntad ang daku nga gamo sa central Thailand matapos nakaguwa ang 200 ka mga amo kag nag-“riot” sa lugar.
english: There was a huge riot in central Thailand after 200 employers came out and rioted in the area.

text: Natabo ini sa Pho Khao Ton Monkey Nursery sa Muang district sa munisipalidad sang Lop Buri.
english: It happened at Pho Khao Ton Monkey Nursery in Muang district in Lop Buri municipality.

text: Ginkinahanglan pa nga butangan sang barikada ang Tha Hin police station agud nga maproteksyunan sang mga pulis ang ila estasyon kag ang importante nga mga dokumento.
english: The Tha Hin police station had to be barricaded so that the police could protect their station and important documents.

text: Suno kay police captain Somchai Seedee, ginsiraduhan man nila ang mga puertahan kag mga bintana para nga wala sang makasulod.
english: Police captain Somchai Seedee said they also locked the doors and windows to prevent anyone from entering.

text: Gintawag man ang on-duty nga mga pulis kag officers para nga maka-augment sang nagsaka na ang mga amo sa atop sang police station kag sa kaiping nga mga balay sang mga tawo.
english: On-duty police and officers were also called to augment when the bosses climbed onto the roof of the police station and neighboring houses.

text: Nagbuligay man ang lokal nga otoridad para nga mapalayo ang mga sapat sa residential areas paagi sa paghatag sa ila sang pagkaon sa malayo nga mga lugar.
english: Local authorities also worked together to keep animals away from residential areas by providing them with food in remote areas.

text: Ginkaayo man ang cage kag nagpadala ang Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation (DNP) sang dugang nga workers agud madakop ang iban nga mga amo kag mabalik sa paghinakop sang ahensya.
english: The cage was also repaired and the Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation (DNP) sent additional workers to catch the other owners and return them to the agency's conclusion.

text: Nahibaluan nga madugay na nga nagasuprer ang mga tawo sa Lop Buri sa nagadamo pa gid kag agresibo nga populasyon sang mga amo kag may yara na sang special enclosures agud nga ma-contain ini nga grupo sang mga sapat.
english: It is known that the people of Lop Buri have been suffering from the increasing and aggressive population of bosses for a long time and there are already special enclosures to contain this group of animals.

text: Lakip sa gina-reklamo bangud sa kadamuon kag co-existence sang amo sa mga tawo amo ang vandalism, mobfights, kag pagpang-agaw sang mga pagkaon.
english: Among the complaints due to the abundance and co-existence of the boss with the people are vandalism, mobfights, and looting of food.

text: May espesyal na nga lugar ang mga amo sa tagipusuon sang mga Thai nga naangot man sa ila tradisyon kag mga pagpati.
english: There is already a special place for bosses in the hearts of Thais which is also linked to their tradition and beliefs.

text: Ginbaton sang mga mataas nga opisyal sang syudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo ang mga pagpasidungog sa Kalayaan Hall sa Malacañang kasunod sang kadalag-an sa Parada ng Kalayaan 2025.
english: Senior officials of Iloilo City and Province received the awards at the Kalayaan Hall in Malacañang following the victory in the Parada ng Kalayaan 2025.

text: Lakip sa nagkadto sa seremonya nga ginpangunahan ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: Among those who attended the ceremony led by President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: kag First Lady Liza Marcos amo sanday Gov.
english: and First Lady Liza Marcos are Gov.

text: Arthur Defensor Jr., Vice Governor Lee Ann Debuqe, Maasin Mayor Francis Amboy, Santa Barbara Mayor Dennis Superficial kag Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas.
english: Arthur Defensor Jr., Vice Governor Lee Ann Debuqe, Maasin Mayor Francis Amboy, Santa Barbara Mayor Dennis Superficial and Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas.

text: Matandaaan nga nagkampyon ang probinsya sa Festival Performance Competition paagi sa Tultugan Festival sang Maasin.
english: It can be recalled that the province won the Festival Performance Competition through the Tultugan Festival of Maasin.

text: Sa amo nga kumpetisyon, nagpangaduha ang Dinagyang Festival sang syudad nga gintiglawas naman sang Tribu Pan-ay.
english: In the competition, the city's Dinagyang Festival, represented by Tribu Pan-ay, came second.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nagpangaduha naman ang Cry of Santa Barbara float sa Historical Float Competition.
english: Meanwhile, the Cry of Santa Barbara float came second in the Historical Float Competition.

text:
Ini nga mga kumpetisyon ang nalakip sa highlights sang “Parada ng Kalayaan 2025” sang ginselebrar ang 127th Independence Day sang Pilipinas sang Hunyo.#

PPA pool photo by Yummie Dingding
english:
These competitions were among the highlights of the “Parada ng Kalayaan 2025” when the 127th Independence Day of the Philippines was celebrated in June.

PPA pool photo by Yummie Dingding

text: ILOILO CITY- Positibo ang Panay Railways Incorporated nga madayon na gid man ang madugay na nga plano nga pag-rehabilitate sang nasambit nga railway system nga magakonekta sa Iloilo kag iban nga probinsya sa Panay.
english: ILOILO CITY – Panay Railways Incorporated is positive that the long-planned rehabilitation of the said railway system that will connect Iloilo and other provinces in Panay will go ahead.

text: Ini kasunod sang pagpirma ni Presidente Duterte sang amended Public Service Act nga nagahatag sang kahigayunan sa mga foreign investors nga makapanag-iya sang kutob sa 100% sang mga public services kaangay sang telecommunications, railways, expressways, airports, kag shipping industries sa pungsod.
english: This follows President Duterte's signing of the amended Public Service Act that allows foreign investors to own up to 100% of public services such as telecommunications, railways, expressways, airports, and shipping industries in the country.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Capt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Capt.

text: Cesar Capellan, Chief Operating Officer (COO) sang Panay Railways Incorporated, iya ginpahayag nga sa pagkamatuod, may yara sang masobra lima ka mga kompaniya sa China ang madugay na nga interesado sa pagrehabilitate sang Panay Railway.
english: Cesar Capellan, Chief Operating Officer (COO) of Panay Railways Incorporated, said that in fact, there are more than five companies in China that have long been interested in rehabilitating the Panay Railway.

text: Suno kay Capellan, may yara man sila sadto sang ginpirmahan nga Memorandum of Understanding(MOU) sa sini nga mga Chinese firms apang napaslawan man ang mga ini nga malab-ot ang requirements nga nagalakip sang pagpasa sang feasibility study kag financial schemes sa proyekto.
english: According to Capellan, they also had a signed Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with these Chinese firms but they also failed to meet the requirements that include submitting a feasibility study and financial schemes for the project.

text: Pila sa mga Chinese firms amo ang Shandong Dongyue International Trade and Economic Cooperation Co., Ltd.,China First Highway Engineering Co., Ltd., China Railways International Ltd., kag TRUCK Pacific Development Corp., kag may yara pa sang iban.
english: Some of the Chinese firms are Shandong Dongyue International Trade and Economic Cooperation Co., Ltd.,China First Highway Engineering Co., Ltd., China Railways International Ltd., and TRUCK Pacific Development Corp., among others.

text: Pahayag ni Capellan, sa subong, padayon ang pagbaton sang ila opisina sang dugang nga firms nga interesado sa proyekto nga ginalauman nga gastuhan sang masobra sa P16 billion.
english: Capellan said his office is currently receiving more firms interested in the project which is expected to cost more than P16 billion.

text: Ang Phase 1 amo ang Iloilo City to Roxas City kag ang Phase 2 amo ang Roxas City to Caticlan, Aklan.
english: Phase 1 is Iloilo City to Roxas City and Phase 2 is Roxas City to Caticlan, Aklan.

text: Buka ang windshield sang isa ka unit sang modernized jeepney sang Metro Iloilo Transport Service Cooperative (MITSCOOP) matapos nga ginlampusan sang ila anay katapo nga Public Assistant Officer ukon konduktor.
english: The windshield of a unit of the modernized jeepney of the Metro Iloilo Transport Service Cooperative (MITSCOOP) was open after being beaten by their former member Public Assistant Officer or conductor.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Juvy Barreto, Vice Chairman sang Metro Iloilo Transport Service Cooperative, iya ginpahayag nga Enero 31 sang nag-resign ang amo nga konduktor apisar nga wala naghatag sang iya rason sa paghalin.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Juvy Barreto, Vice Chairman of the Metro Iloilo Transport Service Cooperative, said the conductor resigned on January 31 despite not giving a reason for his departure.

text: Suno kay Barreto, malapit isa ka tuig nga nagserbisyo sa ila ang konduktor antes natabo ang insidente.
english: According to Barreto, the conductor had been serving them for nearly a year before the incident.

text: Apisar sini, gintuad sang natungdan nga ginpolpog sang konduktor sang basiyo sang soft drinks ang right side nga windshield sang modernized jeepney rason man nga nabuka.
english: However, the concerned admitted that the conductor threw a bottle of soft drinks at the right side windshield of the modernized jeepney causing it to break.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga wala sang komosyon nga natabo sa tunga sang driver kag sang amo nga konduktor, antes paman nagluntad ang insidente.
english: He also clarified that there was no commotion between the driver and the conductor, even before the incident occurred.

text: Nagpa-blotter naman ang driver sang modern jeep agud nga kon hinali nga magliwat ang insidente, indi na madalahig pa ang mga pasahero.
english: The driver of the modern jeep filed a complaint so that if the incident happens again, the passengers will not be involved.

text: Ginaalegar nga may dumot ang koonduktor sa driver rason nga nahimo sini ang amo nga akto.
english: The conductor allegedly had a grudge against the driver and committed the act.

text: Ipatawag kag ipabayad naman sa resigned Public Assistant Officer ang mga naguba sini.
english: The resigned Public Assistant Officer will be summoned and paid for the damage.

text: Ginahulat naman sang Iloilo City Police Station (ICPS) 9 nga makompleto sang tagreklamo ang mga requirements agud nga mapasaka ang kaso batok sa konduktor.
english: The Iloilo City Police Station (ICPS) 9 is waiting for the complainant to complete the requirements to file a case against the conductor.

text: Suno kay PCPT Gimel Acuesta, hepe sang Iloilo City Police Station (ICPS) 9, naguwa nga ginpamahog sang konduktor ang driver pamaagi sa mga tinaga antes ginlampos ang bitbit sini nga botelya sa wind shield.
english: According to PCPT Gimel Acuesta, chief of Iloilo City Police Station (ICPS) 9, it turned out that the conductor threatened the driver with words before hitting the bottle he was carrying on the wind shield.

text: Gilayon naman nga nagpalagyo ang konduktor matapos nga na-damage ang P20,000 nga balor sang wind shield.
english: The conductor immediately fled the scene after the P20,000 worth of wind shield was damaged.

text: Ginahulat na lang sang talatapan nga magbalik ang driver sang MITSCOOP agud nga matigayon proseso ang ipasaka nga kaso malicious mischief kag grave threat.
english: The office is waiting for the driver of the MITSCOOP to return so that the case of malicious mischief and grave threat can be processed.

text: Kalmado ang hunk actor nga si Derek Ramsay samtang gina-atubang ang wala-tuo nga pang-bash sa iya sang mga tawo sa social media.
english: Hunk actor Derek Ramsay is calm as he deals with the left-wing bash he receives from people on social media.

text: Ini ang may kaangtanan gihapon sa iya break-up sa anay nobya nga si Andrea Torres isa ka bulan na ang nakaligad.
english: This is still related to his break-up with ex-girlfriend Andrea Torres a month ago.

text: Wala nagauntat ang mga netizens sa pagpakalain sa 44 anyos nga actor-athlete kag lakip na diri ang pag-comment sa iya nga Instagram post kun sa diin nakalab-ot na sa punto nga ginkwestyon ang sexual orientation ni Derek.
english: Netizens have been criticizing the 44-year-old actor-athlete and including commenting on his Instagram post where Derek's sexual orientation has been questioned.

text: Sa isa ka laragway kun sa diin kaupod ni Derek ang isa ka topless nga lalaki nga nakasukok sang kalo kag swim shorts, may mga nagbilin sang komento nga may malisya apang sa una nga mga komento, ginsugid pa ni Derek nga hinablos niya ang iya nga kaupod sa picture.
english: In a picture where Derek was with a topless man wearing a hat and swim shorts, some people left comments with malice but in the first comments, Derek even told that his nephew was with him in the picture.

text: Ang pinakamalala nga komento amo ang pahayag sang netizen nga ginatilawan lang ni Derek ang mga babaye bangud lalaki gid ang iya matuod nga gusto.
english: The worst comment was the netizen's statement that Derek was just trying women because he really wanted men.

text: Apat naman ka clapping emojis ang reply ni Derek sa amo nga basher.
english: Derek responded with four clapping emojis to the basher.

text: Gin-ako naman sang aktor nga nagakasakitan man siya sa sini nga mga pahayag bangud nagakadalahig na ang iya nga mga pamilya.
english: The actor admitted that he is also hurt by these statements because his family is already involved.

text: Nagalain man ang buot ni Derek bangud gina-link siya sa kay bisan sin-o lang nga artista kag suno sa iya, kun basehan lang ang mga istorya, daw kaangay nga napabusong na niya ang bug-os nga Pilipinas.
english: Derek is also upset because he is being linked to any artist and according to him, based on the stories, it seems that he has made the whole Philippines pregnant.

text: Gilayon nga nag-akto ang Land Transportation Office Region VI (LTO-6) paagi sa pagpaguwa sang show-cause order para kay alyas Mark agud mahibaluan kun ngaa indi siya dapat pasakaan sang administrative nga silot ukon suspendihon ang iya lisensya.
english: The Land Transportation Office Region VI (LTO-6) immediately acted by issuing a show-cause order for alias Mark to find out why he should not be charged with administrative penalties or suspend his license.

text: Ginkumpirmar sang LTO-6 nga nagakooperar sila sa Iloilo Provincial Police Office sa pagkuha sang CCTV footage, pahayag sang mga testigo, kag pagpahamtang sang hustisya.
english: LTO-6 confirmed that they are cooperating with the Iloilo Provincial Police Office in obtaining CCTV footage, witness statements, and bringing justice.

text: Posible nga magsunod ang suspension sang lisensya depende sa resulta sang imbestigasyon.
english: A license suspension is likely to follow depending on the outcome of the investigation.

text: Ginpahanumdom man sang LTO-6 ang mga motorista nga maghatag sang 1.5 metros nga distansiya sa bike lane ukon side walk para malikawan ang disgrasya.
english: The LTO-6 also reminded motorists to maintain a distance of 1.5 meters in the bike lane or side walk to avoid accidents.

text: Ginbuyagyag sa hearing sang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee subong nga adlaw nga nagalab-ot sa P1 billion ang kwarta nga ginpadala sa penthouse ni Ako Bicol Rep.
english: It was revealed in the hearing of the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee today that P1 billion was sent to the penthouse of Ako Bicol Rep.

text: Elizaldy Co sa Shangri-La Hotel, Taguig.
english: Elizaldy Co at Shangri-La Hotel, Taguig.

text: Suno kay anay Bulacan 1st District Engineer Brice Hernandez, masobra sa 20 ka maleta sang kwarta ang ginkarga sa anom tubtob pito ka van pakadto sa penthouse sang kongresista.
english: According to former Bulacan 1st District Engineer Brice Hernandez, more than 20 suitcases of money were loaded in six to seven vans to the congressman's penthouse.

text: Diri niya gintumod ang isa ka alyas “Paul” nga aide ni Co.
english: He referred to an alias “Paul” who was an aide of Co.

text: Suno sa iya, indi direkta nga nakigkita si Hernandez kay Co apang nakita niya ini samtang nagasugilanon kay anay DPWH-Bulacan district engineer Henry Alcantara nga iya nga anay boss.
english: He said Hernandez did not meet Co directly but saw him while talking to former DPWH-Bulacan district engineer Henry Alcantara, his former boss.

text: Kaangot sini, ginkumpirma naman ni Jaypee Mendoza, anay assistant engineer, ang mga detalye sang pagdul-ong sang kwarta.
english: Meanwhile, Jaypee Mendoza, former assistant engineer, confirmed the details of the money delivery.

text: Suno sa iya, sa mga una nga tuig, sa Shangri-La Hotel ginapatigayon ang mga transaksyon, samtang sa mga nagsunod nga tuig, ginsaylo ini sa Valle Verde 6, nga balay sang kongresista sa Pasig.
english: He said that in the early years, transactions were conducted at the Shangri-La Hotel, while in the following years, they were moved to Valle Verde 6, the congressman's house in Pasig.

text: Matandaan nga si Rep.
english: It can be recalled that Rep.

text: Co ang former chair sang House Appropriations Committee kag kalakip sa mga mamalidha nga ginambestigaran kaangot sa anomalya sa flood control projects sang DPWH.
english: Co is the former chair of the House Appropriations Committee and among the lawmakers being investigated in connection with anomalies in the flood control projects of the DPWH.

text: Nalakip ang isyu sa Spratly Islands sa mga na-istoryahan nanday Chinese President Xi Jin Ping kag outgoing president Joe Biden sa ila katapusan nga presidential meeting sa Lima, Peru.
english: The Spratly Islands issue was among those discussed between Chinese President Xi Jinping and outgoing president Joe Biden during their last presidential meeting in Lima, Peru.

text: Ini nga isyu amo ang subject sang indi paghangpanay sa tunga sang China kag Pilipinas sa sulod na sang malawig nga mga tinuig.
english: This issue has been the subject of disagreement between China and the Philippines for many years.

text: Matandaan nga wala gid ginakilala sang Beijing ang 2016 ruling sang Permanent Court of Arbitration sa The Hague kun sa diin ginsaad nga wala sang legal nga basehan ang expansive maritime claims sang China sa West Philippine Sea.
english: It can be recalled that Beijing does not recognize the 2016 ruling of the Permanent Court of Arbitration in The Hague which promised that China's expansive maritime claims in the West Philippine Sea have no legal basis.

text: Sa ila naman nga meeting sa sidelines sang Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum, ginsal-ot ni Xi nga indi dapat maghilabot ang US sa sini nga isyu apisar kaalyado sini ang Pilipinas.
english: In their meeting on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum, Xi stressed that the US should not interfere in this issue despite the Philippines being its ally.

text: Suno sa Chinese leader, makaangkon sang progreso ang ila relasyon kun kabigon nila ang isa kag isa bilang partner kag abyan sa baylo nga kumpetisyon.
english: According to the Chinese leader, their relationship will progress if they consider each other as partners and friends rather than competition.

text: “When the two countries treat each other as partner and friend, seek common ground while shelving differences and help each other succeed, our relationship would make considerable progress,” kabahin sang nangin statement ni Xi paagi sa interpreter.
english: "When the two countries treat each other as partner and friend, seek common ground while shelving differences and help each other succeed, our relationship would make considerable progress," Xi said in a statement through an interpreter.

text:
“But if we take each other as rivals or adversary, pursue vicious competition, and seek to hurt each other, we would roil the relationship or even set it back.”

Duha ka oras ang nangin meeting sang duha kun sa diin ginpahayag nga naistoryahan man ang kumplikto sa cybercrime, negosyo, isyu sa Taiwan, kag ang Russia.
english:
“But if we take each other as rivals or adversary, pursue vicious competition, and seek to hurt each other, we would roil the relationship or even set it back.”

The two met for two hours and reportedly discussed the conflict over cybercrime, trade, Taiwan issues, and Russia.

text: Nagpasalig man si Xi nga mag-trabaho sang maayo kaupod kay president-elect Donald Trump nga magabalik sa White House sa Enero.
english: Xi also pledged to work closely with president-elect Donald Trump, who will return to the White House in January.

text: “China’s goal of a stable, healthy and sustainable China-US relationship remains unchanged”, suno kay Xi apang gin-ako man sini nga may “ups and downs” matuod ang ila relasyon sa USA.
english: "China's goal of a stable, healthy and sustainable China-US relationship remains unchanged," Xi said but also acknowledged that there are "ups and downs" in their relationship with the USA.

text:
“China is ready to work with the new US administration to maintain communication, expand cooperation and manage differences.”

Sa isyu sa Taiwan, naghingyo si Biden nga tapuson na ang “destabilizing” military activity sang China sa palibot sang isla.
english:
“China is ready to work with the new US administration to maintain communication, expand cooperation and manage differences.”

On the Taiwan issue, Biden called for an end to China’s “destabilizing” military activity around the island.

text: Gin-insister naman ni Xi nga ang “separatist activities” ni Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te ang incompatible sa kalinong sang teritoryo.
english: Xi insisted that Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te's "separatist activities" are incompatible with territorial peace.

text: Nagaguwa sa reports sang Reuters nga nagaplano si Lai nga magbisita sa US state sang Hawaii kag sa Guam sa masunod nga semana nga ginalantaw magapasingkal pa gid sang kaakig sang China.
english: According to Reuters reports, Lai plans to visit the US state of Hawaii and Guam next week, which is expected to further anger China.

text: Gina-panindugan sang China nga ila teritoryo ang Taiwan apang ginabasura sang Taipei ini nga sovereignty claims.
english: China insists that Taiwan is its territory but Taipei rejects these sovereignty claims.

text: Ang US amo ang pinaka-importante nga international backer kag arms supplier sang Taiwan apisar nga may kakulangan sa formal diplomatic recognition.#
english: The US is Taiwan’s most important international backer and arms supplier despite a lack of formal diplomatic recognition.#

text: Handa si President Marcos nga mag-atubang sa imbestigaayon sa mga campaign donations nga nabaton niya halin sa public works contractors sang 2022 nga eleksyon.
english: President Marcos is ready to face an investigation into the campaign donations he received from public works contractors during the 2022 elections.

text: May kaangtanan ini sa statement sang Philippine Center for Investigative Journalism (PCIJ) nga ang mga kontraktor nga may existing contracts sa gobyerno ang nagdonar para sa kampanya ni Marcos sang eleksyon.
english: This is in connection with the statement of the Philippine Center for Investigative Journalism (PCIJ) that contractors with existing contracts with the government donated for Marcos' election campaign.

text: Suno kay Presidential Communications Undersecretary Claire Castro, itugyan nila sa Commission on Elections ang pag-imbestigar.
english: Presidential Communications Undersecretary Claire Castro said they will leave the investigation to the Commission on Elections.

text: Pahayag ni Castro, handa man si Marcos nga magsabat sa imbestigasyon sang Independent Commission for Infrastructure.
english: Castro said Marcos is also ready to respond to the investigation of the Independent Commission for Infrastructure.

text: Nahibaluan nga base sa impormasyon, nagbaton si Marcos sang P20 million halin sa tycoon nga si Rodulfo Hilot Jr., tag-iya sang Zamboanga del Sur-based ngaRudhil Construction & Enterprises Inc.
english: Marcos reportedly received P20 million from tycoon Rodulfo Hilot Jr., owner of Zamboanga del Sur-based Rudhil Construction & Enterprises Inc.

text: Gin-report man nga nagdonar si Jonathan Quirante, tag-iya sang Cebu-based Quirante Construction Corp., sang P1 million para kay Marcos.
english: Jonathan Quirante, owner of Cebu-based Quirante Construction Corp., also reportedly donated P1 million for Marcos.

text: Ginpagwa na sang Department of Budget and Management (DBM) ang P7 billion para sa cash subsidies sang public utility drivers nga apektado sa pagsaka sa presyo sang produktong petrolyo.
english: The Department of Budget and Management (DBM) has released P7 billion for cash subsidies to public utility drivers affected by the increase in the price of petroleum products.

text: Suno sa DBM, ang amo nga amount ang ginhatag sang Department of Transportation (DOTr) para sa implemetasyon sang Service Contracting Program (SCP).
english: According to the DBM, the amount was provided by the Department of Transportation (DOTr) for the implementation of the Service Contracting Program (SCP).

text: Sa idalom sang amo nga programa, ang PUV operators ang mapaidalom sa kontrata pinaagi sa Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRD) sa diin ang PUV drivers ang makabaton sang regular performance-based subsidies base sa numero sang ila byahe sa sulod sang isa ka semana.
english: Under the program, PUV operators will be contracted through the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRD) where PUV drivers will receive regular performance-based subsidies based on the number of trips they make in a week.

text: Ang LTFRB ang magakoordinar sa priority local government units agud nga ma-engage ang public transport cooperatives, asssosasyon ukon kooperatiba nga naga-operate sa ila nga jurisdiksyon.
english: The LTFRB will coordinate with priority local government units to engage public transport cooperatives, associations or cooperatives operating in their jurisdictions.

text: Nahibaluan nga wala gin-aprubahan sang gobyerno ang pag suspende sang fuel excise taxes apisar sang padayon nga pagsaka sa presyo sang gatong sa baylo nga magahatag sang subsidy agud nga mahagan hagan ang impact sini sa transport sector.
english: It is known that the government did not approve the suspension of fuel excise taxes despite the continuous increase in fuel prices instead of providing subsidies to mitigate its impact on the transport sector.

text: Naghatag sang suhestyon si Pope Francis kun mahimo maka-conduct sang international study agud matumod kun may genocide nga ginahimo ang military campaign sang Israel sa Gaza.
english: Pope Francis has suggested that an international study be conducted to determine whether Israel's military campaign in Gaza is committing genocide.

text:
Base sa excerpts halin sa Italian daily nga La Stampa, ginpahayag sang Santo Papa nga may international experts nga nagapahayag nga ginakomiter na ang genocide sa amo nga teritoryo sang Palestine — ukon ang ginatawag nga “deliberate and systematic destruction” sa grupo sang mga tawo bangud sa ila “ethnicity, nationality, religion, or race.”

“We should investigate carefully to assess whether this fits into the technical definition [of genocide] formulated by international jurists and organizations,” suno naman sa Pope.
english:
Based on excerpts from the Italian daily La Stampa, the Pope said there are international experts who claim that genocide is already being committed in the Palestinian territory — or the so-called “deliberate and systematic destruction” of groups of people because of their “ethnicity, nationality, religion, or race.”

“We should investigate carefully to assess whether this fits into the technical definition [of genocide] formulated by international jurists and organizations,” the Pope said.

text: Makapila ka beses na nga ginpanginwala sang Israel ang akusasyon sa genocide.
english: Israel has repeatedly denied the genocide accusation.

text: Sang Disyembre, matandaan nga nag-file ang South Africa sang kaso sa International Court of Justice batok sa Israel bangud sa gin-alegar nga paglapas sa Genocide Convention.
english: In December, South Africa filed a case with the International Court of Justice against Israel for alleged violations of the Genocide Convention.

text: Sang Enero, ang huwes sa amo nga korte ang nagmandu sa Israel nga dapat siguruhon nga wala naga-komiter sang genocidal acts ang ila nga tropa.
english: In January, a judge in the court ordered Israel to ensure that its troops do not commit genocidal acts.

text: Sa subong wala pa sang ruling sa kaso kun may genocide gid man bala sa Gaza.
english: There is currently no ruling on whether there was genocide in Gaza.

text: Si Pope Francis, lider sang 1.4-billion-member Catholic Church, ang nakapakigkita man sang nagligad nga semana sa delegasyon sang anay mga bihag sang Hamas sa Gaza.
english: Pope Francis, leader of the 1.4-billion-member Catholic Church, also met last week with a delegation of former Hamas hostages in Gaza.

text: Ini nga delegasyon nga nagpadulong sa Vatican ang nagapanawagan sa paghilway sa pila pa ka mga miyembro sang ila pamilya nga yara pa gihapon sa kamot sang militante nga grupo tubtub subong.
english: The delegation, which went to the Vatican, called for the release of several other members of their families who are still in the hands of the militant group.

text: Nagapati si anay Ilocos Sur Governor Luis “Chavit” Singson nga dapat anay nga unahon nga pangitaon ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: Former Ilocos Sur Governor Luis “Chavit” Singson believes that President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: ang P500 bilyon nga ghost projects bag-o siya kasuhan sang sedition.
english: the P500 billion ghost projects before he was charged with sedition.

english: This is the response of former Ilocos Sur Governor Luis “Chavit” Singson following the plan to file a sedition case by the Department of Justice (DOJ) over his call for a “revolution” against corruption.

text: Una na ginsiling Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro sang Presidential Communications Office nga makabig nga desisyon ang panawagan ni Singson nga anti-corruption protests kun sa diin gin-engganyo man sang anay gobernador nga indi anay magsulod sa eskwelahan ang mga estudyante kag a baylo, mag-upod sa protesta.
english: Earlier, Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro of the Presidential Communications Office said Singson's call for anti-corruption protests is a decision where the former governor also urged students not to enter schools and instead, join the protest.

text: Apang ginsiling ni Singson, nga dapat atenderon sang presidente ang mga ghost projects nga ginapangunahan sang pamilya Discaya.
english: But Singson said the president should attend to the ghost projects led by the Discaya family.

text: Handa nga makig-partner kag makig-abyan liwat ang China sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: China is ready to partner and befriend the United States of America again.

text: Suno ini kay Chinese ambassador to Washington Xie Feng sa iya speech sa Hong Kong kun sa diin gina-address ang Chinese officials kag ang US ambassador to China.
english: This was stated by Chinese ambassador to Washington Xie Feng in his speech in Hong Kong where he addressed Chinese officials and the US ambassador to China.

text: Pahayag sini, wala sang plano ang China nga lapawan ukon islan ang Estados Unidos sa estado sini subong.
english: He said China has no plans to surpass or replace the United States in its current state.

text: Kabahin ini sang mga inisyal nga statement sang Beijing binulan antes ang pagbalik ni President-elect Donald Trump sa White House.
english: It was part of Beijing’s initial statements months before President-elect Donald Trump’s return to the White House.

text: Gindugang sini nga maayo man ang Sino-US partnership ilabi na bangud maka-trabaho sila sa areas lakip na sa trade, agriculture, energy, artificial intelligence kag public health.
english: He added that the Sino-US partnership is also good especially because they can work in areas including trade, agriculture, energy, artificial intelligence and public health.

text: Nagpabati-bati man ini nga kinahanglan ang dayalogo para nga makaprangkahanay kag makapangita sang solusyon samtang nagaatubangay.
english: He also stressed the need for dialogue in order to be frank and find solutions while facing each other.

text: Gin-ako man sang Chinese envoy nga ang Taiwan amo gid ang biggest “flashpoint” sa kumplikto sa tunga sang Beijing kag Washington bangud gina-claim sang China nga ila ang Taiwan apang nagapanindugan naman sang Taipei nga may kaugalingon sila nga gobyerno kag indi kontrolado sang mainland China.
english: The Chinese envoy also acknowledged that Taiwan is the biggest flashpoint in the conflict between Beijing and Washington because China claims Taiwan as its own but Taipei insists that it has its own government and is not controlled by mainland China.

text: Sini nga weekend, natalana naman nga mag-istoryahanay (sa posible katapusan nga tion) sanday outgoing US President Joe Biden kag Chinese leader Xi Jin Ping.
english: This weekend, outgoing US President Joe Biden and Chinese leader Xi Jinping are scheduled to hold talks (for possibly the last time).

text: Matabo ini sa sidelines sang Asia-Pacific summit sa Peru.#
english: This will take place on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific summit in Peru.

text: Nagalala ang kondisyon ni Philippine track and field legend Lydia De Vega-Mercado bangud sa gina-suprer nga kanser.
english: Philippine track and field legend Lydia De Vega-Mercado is in critical condition due to cancer.

text: Ang anak sini nga volleyball player nga si Paneng Mercado-de Koenigswarter ang nagkumpirma nga naga-suprer ang iya iloy sang breast cancer halin sang 2018.
english: Her daughter, volleyball player Paneng Mercado-de Koenigswarter, confirmed that her mother has been suffering from breast cancer since 2018.

text: Suno sa anak, nakapaidalom na ang iya nga iloy sa lain-lain nga procdures lakip sa brain surgery apang gulpi man nga naglala ang iya nga ginabatyag.
english: According to the son, his mother had undergone various procdures including brain surgery but her condition suddenly worsened.

text: Nagapanawagan man ang pamilya sang bulig-pinansyal.
english: The family is also appealing for financial assistance.

text: Kilala si De Vega-Mercado bilang “Asia’s fastest woman” sa iya prime years sang 1980s.
english: De Vega-Mercado was known as “Asia’s fastest woman” during her prime years in the 1980s.

text: Naghatag man ini sang kadalag-an sa Pilipinas paagi sa pagtiglawas sang pungsod sa Asian Athletics Championships, Asian Games kag Southeast Asian Games.
english: It also brought success to the Philippines by representing the country in the Asian Athletics Championships, Asian Games and Southeast Asian Games.

text: Sa SEA Games, siyam gid ka gold medals ang ginauyatan ni De Vega-Mercado.
english: In the SEA Games, De Vega-Mercado has nine gold medals.

text: May duha man siya ka gold medals sa Asian Games.
english: He also has two gold medals in the Asian Games.

text: Tubtub sang 2020, siya ang nagadala sang national record sang Pilipinas sa women’s 100-meter dash sa iya napagkit nga time nga 11.28 seconds.
english: Until 2020, she holds the Philippine national record in the women's 100-meter dash with her time of 11.28 seconds.

text: Sa opening ceremonies sang 2019 SEA Games sa Manila, isa man siya sa nangin flag bearers sang Pilipinas.
english: At the opening ceremonies of the 2019 SEA Games in Manila, he was also one of the flag bearers of the Philippines.

text: “Biggest fan”.
english: “Biggest fan”.

text: Ini ang pagkabig sang actress-comedian Maine Mendoza sa iya kaugalingon matapos ginkilala bilang Best Actor ang iya nobyo nga si Arjo Atayde sa Asian Academy Creative Awards 2020.
english: This is how actress-comedian Maine Mendoza considers herself after her boyfriend Arjo Atayde was recognized as Best Actor at the Asian Academy Creative Awards 2020.

text: Si Arjo ang labing una nga Filipino nga nagdaog sa grand finals awards sang Asian Academy Creative Awards matapos ang tatlo ka tuig nga lunsay national level ang mga awards nga nadag-an sang Pilipinas.
english: Arjo is the first Filipino to win the grand finals awards of the Asian Academy Creative Awards after three years of winning the awards at the national level.

text: Santu sa tweet ni Maine, well-deserved sang iya nobyo ang nasambit nga award.
english: According to Maine's tweet, her boyfriend well-deserved the award.

text: Sa instagram post naman sini, ginpahayag sang aktres nga wala na siya nakibot pa nga ginkilala si Arjo bilang Best Actor.
english: In her Instagram post, the actress said she was not surprised that Arjo was recognized as Best Actor.

text: Gin-repost naman sang aktor ang post ni Maine kag ginpahayag nga ang award ang para sa aktres bangud iya ini nga inspirasyon.
english: The actor reposted Maine's post and said the award was for the actress because she was his inspiration.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang relasyon nanday Arjo kag Maine ang nag-umpisa sang Disyembre 2018.
english: Arjo and Maine's relationship began in December 2018.

text: Wala ginpahanugotan sang mayorya sang 12th Iloilo City Council ang proposal ni Vice Mayor Lady Julie Grace “Love” Baronda nga magpatigayon sang ‘pre-session’ kada Miyerkules antes sang regular session nga ginahiwat kada alas-10 sa aga.
english: The majority of the 12th Iloilo City Council rejected the proposal of Vice Mayor Lady Julie Grace “Love” Baronda to hold a pre-session every Wednesday before the regular session held every 10 am.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Majority Floor Leader Atty. Rex Marcus Sarabia, iya ginpahayag nga indi na kinahangalan sang mandatory pre-session kung indi lang man mainit ukon komplikado ang mga pagaistoryahan sa tion sang regular session.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Majority Floor Leader Atty. Rex Marcus Sarabia, he said that there is no need for a mandatory pre-session if the issues to be discussed during the regular session are not hot or complicated.

text: Suno kay Sarabia, ini tanan ang ginkasugtan nga desisyon sang mayorya kag ginarespeto niya ini.
english: Sarabia said these were all unanimous decisions of the majority and he respects them.

text: Nagpasalig man ini nga inkaso ipatawag gidman sila sang bise alkalde para sa diskusyon maka-attend ini sila apang indi makapasalig nga kumpleto bangud ang iban naga-preparar sa regular session nga alas-10.
english: He also assured that if the vice mayor calls them for discussion, they will be able to attend but he cannot guarantee that they will be complete because others are preparing for the regular session at 10 o'clock.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Alyas “May-may”, iya ginpahayag nga antes paman siya nakitgbulag kay Ronald, Septyembre pa lang nakapa-blotter na ini sa ila barangay.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Alyas “May-may” said that even before she broke up with Ronald, she had filed a complaint with their barangay in September.

text: Suno kay May-may, ginpakilala pa sang suspek ang biktima sa mga kabataan niya nga si Rodito na ang ila mangin bag-o nga amay.
english: According to May-may, the suspect even introduced the victim to his children as Rodito as their new father.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga Enero sang nagkitaay ang banas si Ronald kag si Rodito kon sa diin, nagsapolay pa ang duha sa ila puluy-an.
english: He also explained that in January, Ronald and Rodito met on the road where the two even met at their house.

text: Ginpahayag man ni May-may nga Septyembre pa lang, may ideya na si Ronald nga magabulag na siya bangud man sa ginpa-blotter sini sa ila barangay bangud man sa indi pag-intindihanay kon sa diin, ginpabutyag man sini nga nabaton na sang suspek nga kinahanglan na niya magbulag.
english: May-may also said that as early as September, Ronald had an idea that he was going to separate because of the blotter he filed in their barangay and because of the misunderstanding where, she also expressed that the suspect has accepted that he needs to separate.

text: Ginsaysay man sini nga ang nagdesisyon nga mag-istar sa ila puluy-an si Rodito, amo si Ronald.
english: He also explained that Ronald decided to stay at Rodito's house.

text: Ginklaro man sang natungdan nga naga-istoryahanay man sila sang anay asawa sang iya bag-o karelasyon nga si Rodito antes pa man natabo ang insidente.
english: He also clarified that he was also talking to the ex-wife of his new boyfriend, Rodito, before the incident.

text: Una naman nga ginbuyagyag ni Alyas May-may nga indi nangin maayo ang pagtratar ni Ronald sa ila nga kabataan.
english: May-may earlier revealed that Ronald did not treat their children well.

text: Nagpanawagan naman si Maymay kay Ronald nga magsungka na agud atubangon ang iya nga kasal-anan sa ngalan sang ila nga mga kabataan.
english: Maymay called on Ronald to surrender to face his guilt on behalf of their children.

text: Nagpanguna si North Korean leader Kim Jong Un sa pag-test sang suicide drones kag nagmandu man sang mass production sini nga aerial weapon nga kilala man nga loitering munitions.
english: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un took the lead in testing suicide drones and ordered mass production of this aerial weapon also known as loitering munitions.

text: “(Kim) underscored the need to build a serial production system as early as possible and go into full-scale mass production,” suno sa state news agency nga KCNA.
english: “(Kim) underscored the need to build a serial production system as early as possible and go into full-scale mass production,” according to state news agency KCNA.

text: Antes sini, nauna na nga nag-supervise si Kim sa pag-test sini nga drones kag labi nga nagatunog ang pamangkot kun nagabaton bala siya sang bulig sang Russia sa pagdevelop sini.
english: Kim has previously supervised the testing of these drones and the question of whether he is receiving Russian help in developing them is increasingly being asked.

text: Ini nga weapons ang ginagamit man sa gyera sa Ukraine amo man sa Middle East.
english: These weapons are also used in the war in Ukraine as well as in the Middle East.

text: Pahayag sang North Korean president, mas naga-todo pa ang kumpetisyon sa paggamit sang drones para sa military sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: The North Korean president said the competition for the use of drones for the military is getting fiercer around the world.

text: “Such objective change urgently calls for updating many parts of military theory, practice and education,” pag-quote sang KCNA sa pahayag ni Kim.
english: “Such objective change urgently calls for updating many parts of military theory, practice and education,” KCNA quoted Kim as saying.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang damlag lang, gin-ratipikahan sang Pyongyang kag Moscow ang comprehensive strategic partnership nga una na nga ginpirmahan nanday Kim kag Russian President Vladimir Putin sang Hunyo lakip na ang mutual defense pact.
english: Pyongyang and Moscow recently ratified the comprehensive strategic partnership that Kim and Russian President Vladimir Putin signed in June, including a mutual defense pact.

english: Top trending this year on YouTube is the video of “America’s Got Talent” where singer Marcelito Pomoy sings the song “The Prayer”.

text: Ginpaguwa sang YouTube ang top 10 viral videos sa diin may yara sang 45 million views si Marcelito sa video nga gin upload sang Enero.
english: YouTube released the top 10 viral videos where Marcelito has 45 million views in the video uploaded in January.

english: Vlogger Ivana Alawi has the most videos in the Top 10.
