english: The controversial congressman Ako Bicol party-list Rep.

text: Zaldy Co.
english: Zaldy Co.

text: Sandig sa U.S. Customs and Border Protection, nag-abot sa New York ang amo nga mamalidha sang Agosto 26, 2025 paagi sa paggamit sang tourist visa.
english: According to U.S. Customs and Border Protection, the lawmaker arrived in New York on August 26, 2025 using a tourist visa.

text: Ginpasugtan siya nga magpabilin sa US tubtob Pebrero 25, 2026.
english: He was allowed to remain in the US until February 25, 2026.

text: Apang 19 ka adlaw pa lang siya sa amo nga pungsod, naghalin ini sa New York kag wala sang record kon diin nagkadto.
english: But he had only been in the country for 19 days, he left New York and there is no record of where he went.

text: Matandaan nga sang Sabado, gin-revoke ni House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III ang travel clearance ni Co kag ginhatagan ini sang 10 ka adlaw agud nga makapauli sa Pilipinas agud atubangon ang mga isyu sa iya.
english: On Saturday, House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III revoked Co's travel clearance and gave him 10 days to return to the Philippines to face his issues.

text:
Ginpahayag nga yara sa US si Co bangud sa “medical treatment.”

Si Co amo anay ang chairman sang House appropriations committee sang nagligad nga Congress kag ginatudlo nga isa sa mga utok sa gin-alegar insertions sa 2025 national budget kag amo man ang naghatag ligwa sa mga iregularidad sa flood control projects.
english:
Co was reportedly in the US for medical treatment.

Co was the former chairman of the House appropriations committee in the last Congress and is pointed out as one of the masterminds behind the alleged insertions in the 2025 national budget and also facilitated irregularities in flood control projects.

text: Una na niya nga gin-deny ini nga mga akusasyon, apang wala sang ginhatag nga kumpirmasyon kun san-o siya magabalik sa Pilipinas.#
english: He has previously denied the accusations, but has not given confirmation on when he will return to the Philippines.

text: Posible nga mabuyagyag sang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee ang panibag-o nga mga ebidensya halin sa anay engineer sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) sa Bulacan nga si Brice Hernandez.
english: The Senate Blue Ribbon Committee is likely to reveal new evidence from former Bulacan Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) engineer Brice Hernandez.

text: Kadungan ini sang pagpadayon sang imbestigasyon sa mga kwestyonable nga proyekto sa flood control subong nga Martes, Setyembre 23.
english: This comes as the investigation into questionable flood control projects continues this Tuesday, September 23.

text: Suno kay Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo “Ping” Lacson nga amo man ang nagapanguna sa blue ribbon panel, ang ebidensya ni Hernandez ang indi lamang limitado sa alegasyon sang “kickback” batok kanday Senator Jinggoy Estrada kag Senator Joel Villanueva.
english: According to Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo “Ping” Lacson, who also chairs the blue ribbon panel, Hernandez’s evidence is not limited to the “kickback” allegation against Senator Jinggoy Estrada and Senator Joel Villanueva.

text: Suno kay Lacson, kinahanglan nga siguruhon anay ang “integridad sang chain of custody” sang ebidensya.
english: According to Lacson, it is necessary to ensure the “integrity of the chain of custody” of the evidence.

text: Suno sa iya, ini ang makabulig sa piskal sa pagpasaka sang kaso.
english: He said this would help the prosecutor file charges.

text: Gina-alegar ni Hernandez nga may transaksyon nga natabo sa tunga nila sang duha ka senador may kaangtanan sa mga anomalya nga flood control projects.
english: Hernandez alleged that there was a transaction between him and the two senators regarding anomalous flood control projects.

text: Suno kay Lacson, indi pa cleared ang duha ka senador, bangud posible nga may koneksyon sila sa alegasyon nga insertion sang P355 milyon sa 2025 nga budget kag P600 milyon sa 2023 nga budget.
english: Lacson said the two senators are not yet cleared, because they may have a connection to the alleged insertion of P355 million in the 2025 budget and P600 million in the 2023 budget.

text: Ini ang ikalima nga hearing sang komite kaangot sa nasambit nga imbestigasyon kag ikaduha nga tion nga pangunahan ni Lacson bilang chairman sang amo nga Senate panel.
english: This is the fifth hearing of the committee on the said investigation and the second time that Lacson will lead it as chairman of the Senate panel.

text: Nakabaton sang pagpakamalaot ang actor-comedian nga si Dennis Padilla bangud sa role sini sa isa ka pelikula tuhoy sa Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Queer (LGBTQ) Community.
english: Actor-comedian Dennis Padilla has received criticism for his role in a film about the Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Queer (LGBTQ) Community.

text: Apang suno kay Dennis, mataas ang iya respeto sa mga myembro sang LGBTQ Community ilabi na nga ang iya anak nga babaye ang nagpakasal sa kaangay man sini nga babaye.
english: But Dennis said he has high respect for members of the LGBTQ community especially since his daughter married a woman like him.

text: Gani pahayag niya, wala sang rason nga maakig ukon ma-offend ang mga myembro sang LGBTQ sa iya.
english: So he said, there is no reason for LGBTQ members to be angry or offended with him.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginkasal ang anak ni Dennis nga si Dianne, 30 anyos, sa Estados Unidos.
english: Dennis' daughter Dianne, 30, is married in the United States.

text: Depensa sang aktor, indi niya masarangan nga bastuson ang LGBTQ bangud palangga niya ang iya anak nga legal nga kasado sa California.
english: The actor defended himself by saying he can't be rude to LGBTQ people because he loves his daughter who is legally married in California.

text: Gintuad sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) nga may gina-monitor ang talatapan nga armed group sa probinsya sang Iloilo nga mahimo makatuga sang huol sa palaabuton nga 2025 midterm elections.
english: The Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) has admitted that the office is monitoring an armed group in Iloilo province that could cause trouble in the upcoming 2025 midterm elections.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Colonel Bayani Razalan, Director sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO), iya ginpahayag nga nagabantay sila subong sa mga boundaries sang Iloilo lakip na ang boundary sang Capiz kag Iloilo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Colonel Bayani Razalan, Director of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO), said they are now guarding the boundaries of Iloilo including the boundary of Capiz and Iloilo.

text: Suno kay Razalan, military focused operation ang igapatuman lakip na diri ang bulig sang kapulisan.
english: Razalan said a military focused operation will be implemented including the assistance of the police.

text: Ginlaragway sini nga isa ka ‘private armed group’ ang ginasundan sang IPPO, kon sa diin ginalauman makapanggamo kon indi mabantayan.
english: He described the IPPO as a private armed group, which is expected to cause trouble if left unchecked.

text: Wala naman ini ginpangalanan ni Razalan apang ginbuyagyag sini nga yara sa first and second district sang Iloilo.
english: Razalan did not name the suspect but revealed that he is in the first and second districts of Iloilo.

text: Nagpasalig man ang natungdan nga mabaskog ang ila koordinasyon sa Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) agud nga mas masangkad ang pagpatuman sang on the ground operation.
english: He also assured that they have strong coordination with the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) to better implement the on the ground operation.

text: Nahibaluan nga indi magnubo sa pulo ka mga kandidato ang nagkuha sang PNP security agud nga maprotektahan ang ila banwa sa ano man nga pagpamahog sa palaabuton nga eleksyon.
english: At least ten candidates have hired PNP security to protect their town from any threat in the upcoming elections.

text: Desidido ang Taiwan nga magmato-mato sa pagpabaskog sang ila kapasidad sa militar ilabi na samtang nagahilapit ang pagbalik ni US President-elect Donald Trump sa pwesto sa White House.
english: Taiwan is determined to strengthen its military capacity especially as US President-elect Donald Trump's return to the White House approaches.

text: Talalupangdon ang pagpabaskog sang depensa sa Taiwan sa naglinigad nga tinuig bangud sa pamahog sang China apang may isa pa gid ka rason nga naga-pressure sa ila nga pabakuron pa ang defense capabilities.
english: Taiwan's defense strengthening in recent years has been remarkable due to the Chinese threat but there is another reason that is pressuring them to strengthen their defense capabilities.

text: Sang kandidato pa lamang si Trump, ginpamangkot ini kun depensahan sini ang Taiwan nga gina-claim sang China nga parte pa sang ila teritoryo.
english: When Trump was a candidate, he was asked if he would defend Taiwan, which China claims is still part of its territory.

text: Sabat ni Trump, kilala sini kag gina-respeto ang mga tawo, apang ginsiling sini nga ginkuha sang Taiwan ang 100% sang chip business sang US.
english: Trump replied that he knew and respected the people, but said that Taiwan had taken 100% of the US chip business.

text: Gindugang man sini nga dapat magbayad ang Taiwan sa sini nga depensa nga ginahatag sang Amerika.
english: He also added that Taiwan should pay for this American defense.

text: Daw kaangay suno kay Trump nga isa ka insurance company ang Estados Unidos kag wala man sang ginahatag nga bisan ano ang Taiwan sa ila.
english: Trump said the United States is like an insurance company and Taiwan doesn't give them anything.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang US amo ang daku nga partner sang Taiwan kag isa man ka major provider sang kinahanglanon sini nga mga hinganiban.
english: The US is Taiwan's largest partner and a major provider of its weapons needs.

text: Kun matandaan, sang damlag lang, nagpasar ang Washington sang multi-billion-dollar military aid package para mabuligan ang Taiwan nga batuan ang tension dala sang China sa amo nga region.
english: Recently, Washington passed a multi-billion-dollar military aid package to help Taiwan cope with tensions brought about by China in the region.

text: Isa man ka major powerhouse ang Taiwan sa semiconductor industry nga naga-produce sang majority sang advanced microchips nga kinahanglan agud i-power ang global economy.
english: Taiwan is also a major powerhouse in the semiconductor industry producing the majority of the advanced microchips needed to power the global economy.

text: Kasunod sini, nagsabat si Taiwanese Premier Cho Jung-tai nga may ginahimo man nga mga tikang ang Taipei agud nga mapataas ang ila defense budget sa sulod na sang pila ka tuig.
english: Taiwanese Premier Cho Jung-tai responded that Taipei has been taking steps to increase its defense budget for several years.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga mapag-on ang relasyon sang Taiwan kag Estados Unidos sa sulod na sang tinuig kag ginakabig suno sa iya nga common responsibility kag goal ang pagpabilin sang kalinong kag stability sa Taiwan Strait kag Indo-Pacific region.
english: He also explained that the relationship between Taiwan and the United States has been strong for years and he considers it a common responsibility and goal to maintain peace and stability in the Taiwan Strait and the Indo-Pacific region.

text: “Our commitment to strengthening our own defense capabilities will only be higher, not lower,” suno naman sa senior national security official sang Taiwan.
english: "Our commitment to strengthening our own defense capabilities will only be higher, not lower," Taiwan's senior national security official said.

text: “While we do not have any list (of planned weapon acquisitions) with Trump’s team, new progress or discussions… Taiwan is very willing to have further discussions with like-minded partners, especially the US, on how to enhance Taiwan’s self-defense capabilities,” dugang sang official.
english: “While we do not have any list (of planned weapon acquisitions) with Trump’s team, new progress or discussions… Taiwan is very willing to have further discussions with like-minded partners, especially the US, on how to enhance Taiwan’s self-defense capabilities,” the official added.

text: Sang nagdaog si Trump, nagpanginbulahan man ang Taiwan kaupod sa iban nga world leaders.#
english: When Trump won, Taiwan congratulated him along with other world leaders.

text: Nagkabos si Alex Eala nga makaabante pa sa masunod nga round sang Hong Kong Open nga amo ang katapusan sini nga tournament subong nga tuig.
english: Alex Eala is poor enough to advance to the next round of the Hong Kong Open, which is the last tournament this year.

text: Ginlutos siya sa Round of 16 sang Canadian player nga si Victoria Mboko, 3-6, 6-3, 6-4.
english: She was defeated in the Round of 16 by Canadian player Victoria Mboko, 3-6, 6-3, 6-4.

text: Naka-abante ang Pinay tennis player sa Round of 16 bangud wala naghampang si Katie Boulter kasunod sang injury.
english: The Filipino tennis player advanced to the Round of 16 because Katie Boulter did not play following an injury.

text: Sa doubles draw, nalutos man si Eala kag ang partner sini nga si Hao-Ching Chan batok kanday Kamilla Rakhimova sang Russia kag Aliaksandra Sasnovich sa una nga round sang Lunes.
english: In the doubles draw, Eala and her partner Hao-Ching Chan also lost to Kamilla Rakhimova of Russia and Aliaksandra Sasnovich in the first round on Monday.

text: Apisar sini, maragtason sa gihapon ang kabug-usan nga 2025 season para kay Eala kun sa diin nakasulod siya sa world’s top 100, ginpanglutos sini ang Grand Slam champions, nangin una nga Pinoy nga nakadaog sa Grand Slam main-draw match sa US Open, kag nahakwat man ang iya una nga WTA 125 title sa Guadalajara sa Mexico.
english: Despite this, the overall 2025 season is still historic for Eala where she entered the world's top 100, beat the Grand Slam champions, became the first Filipino to win a Grand Slam main-draw match at the US Open, and also lifted her first WTA 125 title in Guadalajara, Mexico.

text: Kun amo sini nga mga tion nga malapit na lang i-selebrar ang Valentine’s Day, feel na feel mo gid kun in love ikaw.
english: When it's time to celebrate Valentine's Day, you feel like you're in love.

text: Tyempo man ini nga feel na feel mo gid ang heartbreak kun binayaan ikaw ukon nag-break kamo sang imo nga karelasyon.
english: It's also a time when you feel the heartbreak of being abandoned or breaking up with your relationship.

text: Amo gid sini ang nabatyagan sang 32-anyos nga si Dawn Cuenzo Salmo rason nga nanghagad siya sang iya mga abyan kag nagkadto sa campsite sa Tanay, Rizal.
english: That's how 32-year-old Dawn Cuenzo Salmo felt, so she invited her friends and went to the campsite in Tanay, Rizal.

text: Samtang yara didto, ginsulit na lang sini ang iya bayad kag ginpaguwa ang ya kaugot paagi sa pagsinggit sa kabukiran.
english: While there, he repeated his payment and vented his anger by shouting to the mountains.

text: Wala siya naghaum nga ang amo nga pagpautwas amo pa gid ang magadul-ong sa iya sang isa pa gid ka sakit.
english: He did not expect that such an expression would lead to another illness.

text: Nagguwa ang isa ka lalaki nga campsite staffer, ginhambalan sila nga maghimos kag maghalin, kag ginkumpronta man si Salmo kun ngaa nagsinggit ini kag nagpamuyayaw.
english: A male campsite staffer came out, told them to get ready and leave, and also confronted Salmo about why he was shouting and swearing.

text: Sang nagsabat siya nga ang bukid ang iya ginbuyayaw, hinali siya nga gintapungol sa nawong.
english: When he replied that he had mocked the mountain, he was suddenly struck in the face.

text: Nagsinggitan ang mga abyan ni Salmo, ginkwestyon ini sa iya pagpanakit, tubtub nga na-umpawan na si Salmo, nagbalos sa pagsumbag sa staffer, kag nagsinggitanay.
english: Salmo's friends shouted, questioned him for hurting him, until Salmo was relieved, retaliated by hitting the staffer, and shouted at each other.

text: Nagapanindugan gid si Salmo nga ang bukid lang ang iya ginbuyayaw.
english: The Psalmist is adamant that he only mocked the mountain.

text: Nag-explain man ini nga nagbayad man siya para nga makatinir sa campsite pero ginsakit pa siya sang staffer.
english: He also explained that he paid to stay at the campsite but the staffer still hurt him.

text: Nagrason naman ang staffer sa pulis nga alas sais pa lang sa aga sang amo nga tion kag madamo pa nga campers ang nagakatulog kag nagaka-disturbo sa ginhimo ni Salmo.
english: The staffer argued to the police that it was only 6 am at the time and many campers were still asleep and disturbed by Salmo's actions.

text: Arestado na ang staffer, naka-detain sa Tanay Police Station, kag mangatubang sang reklamo nga slight physical injury.
english: The staffer has been arrested, detained at the Tanay Police Station, and will face a complaint of slight physical injury.

text: Nagpangayo naman sang pasaylo ang management sang campsite, kag nagpasalig nga magahimo sila sang tikang agud nga indi na masulit pa ang amo nga insidente.#
english: The management of the campsite apologized, and assured that they will take steps to prevent the incident from happening again.

text: Ginrespondehan sang Medics ang veteran actress nga si Maricel Soriano bangud indi sini mapakalma ang kaugalingon matapos ang emotional scene kaupod si Jodi Sta.
english: Medics responded to veteran actress Maricel Soriano because she could not calm down after an emotional scene with Jodi Sta.

text: Maria.
english: Mary.

text: Suno sa director nga si FM Reyes, matapos ang komprontasyon sa tunga sang duha ka mga aktres sa pelikula, padayon sa gihapon ang ila pagkurog kag hilibion.
english: According to director FM Reyes, after the confrontation between the two actresses in the film, they continued to tremble and cry.

text: Pahayag niya, nasobrahan ukon tuman ka dalom ang emosyon ukon hugot nga ginkuhaan nanday Maricel kag Jodi.
english: He said Maricel and Jodi were too emotional or too tight.

text: Gin-ako man sang direktor nga nagsala na siya bangud wala siya nakahibalo kun sin-o ang unahon niya nga kadtoan apang nakita na lang niya ang medics nga nagaresponde na kay Maricel.
english: The director also admitted that he made a mistake because he did not know who to go to first but he saw the medics responding to Maricel.

text: Ginkasuhan na sang International Criminal Court (ICC) prosecutors si former president Rodrigo Duterte sang three counts of murder.
english: International Criminal Court (ICC) prosecutors have charged former president Rodrigo Duterte with three counts of murder.

text: Kaangot ini sa ginaalegar nga crimes against humanity nga nahimo sini sang siya pa ang Davao City mayor kag sang siya na ang nangin president sang Pilipinas.
english: This is in connection with the alleged crimes against humanity he committed when he was Davao City mayor and when he became president of the Philippines.

text: Ginsapubliko man sang korte ang “Document Containing the Charges” nga napetsahan July 4, 2025 apang may mga parte nga redacted.
english: The court also made public the “Document Containing the Charges” dated July 4, 2025 but with parts redacted.

text: Gin-release ini Septyembre 22 oras sa The Hague nga amo kuntani ang adlaw antes ang confirmation of charges kay Duterte, apang na-postpone bangud ginapanindugan sang kampo sang anay presidente nga indi na maayo ang ikaayong lawas sini kag malipaton na.
english: It was released on September 22 at The Hague, the day before the confirmation of charges against Duterte, but was postponed because the former president's camp insisted that he was in poor health and forgetful.

text: Sa Count 1, nalakip ang murder as a crime against humanity sa Davao City sa 19 victims sang siyam ka mga incidents lakip ang sa 2013 kag sang 2016, sang mayor pa si Duterte.
english: In Count 1, murder as a crime against humanity in Davao City is included in the 19 victims of nine incidents including in 2013 and 2016, when Duterte was mayor.

text: Ang Count 2, nagalakip sang murder as a crime against humanity sang ‘high-value targets’ sa nagkalain-lain nga lokasyon sa Pilipinas kun sa diin may 14 victims sang five incidents sang si Duterte ang President sa tunga-tunga sang 2016 and 2017.
english: Count 2 includes the murder as a crime against humanity of high-value targets in various locations in the Philippines where there were 14 victims in five incidents when Duterte was President between 2016 and 2017.

text: Ang Count 3 naga-involve naman sang murder kag attempted murder bilang crimes against humanity sa barangay clearance operations sa lain-lain nga lokasyon sa Pilipinas kun sa diin may 45 victims sang si Duterte ang president sa tunga-tunga sang 2016 tubtub sang 2018.
english: Count 3 involves murder and attempted murder as crimes against humanity in barangay clearance operations in various locations in the Philippines where there were 45 victims when Duterte was president between 2016 and 2018.

text: Ang 15-ka-pahina nga dokumento nga ginpasaka sa Pre-Trial Chamber ang pirmado ni ICC Deputy Prosecutor Mame Mandiaye Niang.#
english: The 15-page document filed in the Pre-Trial Chamber was signed by ICC Deputy Prosecutor Mame Mandiaye Niang.#

text: Ginkilala ni Senator Win Gatchalian ang Iloilo bilang modelo sa lokal kag partisipatibo sa pagdumala sang edukasyon, matapos niya obserbahan ang “Proof of Concept” ukon POC sang Devolution of Basic Education initiative sa probinsya.
english: Senator Win Gatchalian identified Iloilo as a model in local and participatory education management, after observing the “Proof of Concept” or POC of the Devolution of Basic Education initiative in the province.

text: Si Gatchalian, nga Co-Chair sang Second Congressional Commission on Education ukon EDCOM II, ang guest of honor sa education forum sang Hulyo 8 sa Iloilo City, ginpatigayon sang Synergeia Foundation upod ang Education Core Group sang probinsya.
english: Gatchalian, Co-Chair of the Second Congressional Commission on Education or EDCOM II, was the guest of honor at the education forum on July 8 in Iloilo City, organized by the Synergeia Foundation with the province's Education Core Group.

text: Suno sa senador, Iloilo lang ang probinsya sa pungsod nga may inisyatibo nga ginalakipan sang mga alkalde bilang aktibo nga kabahin sang education reform.
english: According to the senator, Iloilo is the only province in the country that has an initiative that includes mayors as an active part of education reform.

text: Ang POC ginpatuman sa pila ka pilot municipalities, lakip ang Igbaras, Guimbal, Leganes, Pavia, Maasin, kag iban pa, nga may tuyo nga mapaayo ang pagbasa sang Grade 3 learners paagi sa localized strategies.
english: The POC was implemented in several pilot municipalities, including Igbaras, Guimbal, Leganes, Pavia, Maasin, among others, with the aim of improving the reading of Grade 3 learners through localized strategies.

text: Base sa datos ni Board Member Jason Gonzales, nagtaas ang average reading scores sang mga estudyante halin sa pre-test pakadto sa post-test.
english: Based on data from Board Member Jason Gonzales, the average reading scores of students increased from pre-test to post-test.

text: Ginasuportahan ni Gatchalian nga mahimo ini nga modelo para sa bug-os nga pungsod, kag posible man nga magagikan sang legislasyon agud pormal nga ipasulod ang papel sang local chief executives sa edukasyon.
english: Gatchalian supports that this could be a model for the whole country, and it is also likely to generate legislation to formally introduce the role of local chief executives in education.

text: Nagbisita si President-elect Donald Trump sa White House sa una nga tion halin sang nagdaog ini sa November 5, 2024 presidential election batok kay Vice President Kamala Harris.
english: President-elect Donald Trump visited the White House for the first time since winning the November 5, 2024 presidential election over Vice President Kamala Harris.

text: May motorcade nga ginpatigayon padulong sa White House kun sa diin nagahulat ang iya longtime political rival nga si outgoing President Joe Biden.
english: A motorcade was held to the White House where his longtime political rival, outgoing President Joe Biden, was waiting.

text: Ginpasulod ang media sa Oval Office sa sulod lamang sang isa ka minuto kun sa diin nabatian si Trump nga nagpahayag nga mabudlay ang pulitika.
english: The media was allowed into the Oval Office for just one minute where Trump was heard saying that politics is difficult.

text: Ginpasalamatan man sini ang Democrat sa matalunsay nga transition sang power kag nagkamustahanay ang duha samtang pareho nga nagayuhom.
english: He also thanked the Democrat for the smooth transition of power and the two greeted each other while both smiled.

text: Antes sini, makapila ka beses nga ginsiling sang 81-anyos nga si Biden nga isa ka pamahog sa demokrasya si Trump samtang nagsiling naman ang 78-anyos nga Republican nga incompetent ang Democrat president.
english: Earlier, the 81-year-old Biden repeatedly said Trump was a threat to democracy while the 78-year-old Republican said the Democrat president was incompetent.

text: “It was a substantive meeting,” suno kay White House spokesperson Karine Jean-Pierre.
english: “It was a substantive meeting,” according to White House spokesperson Karine Jean-Pierre.

text: “They discussed important national security and domestic policy issues facing the nation and the world.”#
english: “They discussed important national security and domestic policy issues facing the nation and the world.”#

text: Kapin sa 35 ka mga tawo ang patay sa car attack sa southern China, kag ginapatihan nga pinakamakamamatay nga akto sang public violence sa pungsod sa sulod sang pila ka dekada.
english: More than 35 people have been killed in a car attack in southern China, and it is believed to be the deadliest act of public violence in the country in decades.

text: Base sa imbestigaston, hungod nga ginpangbungguan sang lalaki sakay sa ila kotse ang mga tawo sa isa ka stadium samtang naga-ehersisyo ang mga ini.
english: According to the investigation, the man deliberately hit people in a stadium while they were exercising.

text: Magluwas sa mga napatay, 45 pa ang pilason.
english: In addition to the dead, 45 others were injured.

text: Nakilala ang driver nga si Mr Fan, 62, kag ginaalegar nga bag- o lang ini halin sa isa ka divorce settlement.
english: The driver was identified as Mr Fan, 62, and is alleged to have recently returned from a divorce settlement.

text: Siya ang naaresto samtang nagatuyo nga magpalagyo apang na-comatose man ini bangud sa self-inflicted nga mga kapilasan.
english: He was arrested while trying to escape but was also comatose due to self-inflicted injuries.

text: Ang insidente nagpaibwal naman sang mga tawo sa China kag nagpromisa si President Xi Jinping sang “severe punishment” para sa responsable sa insidente.
english: The incident has sparked outrage in China and President Xi Jinping has promised "severe punishment" for those responsible for the incident.

text: Gindayaw ni Miss Universe 2015 Pia Wurtzbach si Miss Universe Philippines 2020 Rabiya Mateo bangud yara ini sa insakto nga direksyon kun prepasyon para sa Miss Universe 2020 pageant ang pagahambalan.
english: Miss Universe 2015 Pia Wurtzbach praised Miss Universe Philippines 2020 Rabiya Mateo for being in the right direction when it comes to preparation for the Miss Universe 2020 pageant.

text: Nag-umpisa na ang training sang Ilongga beauty queen kag una nga iya ginhimo amo ang pag-exercise agud makaangkon sang abs.
english: The Ilongga beauty queen has started training and the first thing she did was exercise to get abs.

text: Nangin diretso man ang mga sabat ni Rabiya sa mga pamangkot sa may kaangtanan sa mga kritiko kag mga isyu nga ginahaboy sa iya kag bangud sini, mas napabilip pa si Pia kay Rabiya.
english: Rabiya's answers to questions related to critics and issues thrown at her were also straightforward and because of this, Pia was even more impressed with Rabiya.

text: Nagpabilin ang madalom nga imbestigasyon sa kaso sang pagkasapwan-patay ni Police Staff Sergeant Richard Velez, 36 anyos, pamilyado kag may tatlo ka kabataan kag residente sang Brgy.
english: Police Staff Sergeant Richard Velez, 36, married with three children and resident of Brgy.

text: Acuit, Barotac Nuevo, Iloilo.
english: Acuit, Barotac Nuevo, Iloilo.

text: Nasapwan-patay ang biktam sa ika-tatlo nga panalgan sang Barotac Nuevo Municipal Police Station kaina sang aga, Hulyo 9, 2025.
english: The victim was found dead on the third floor of the Barotac Nuevo Municipal Police Station this morning, July 9, 2025.

text: Na-assign sa Barotac Nuevo Municipal Police Station si PSSg.
english: PSSg. was assigned to Barotac Nuevo Municipal Police Station.

text: Velez humalin pa sang 2022.
english: Velez since 2022.

text: Siya man ang Chief sang Finance Section kag naka-duty halin alas-10 sang gab-i tubtob alas-6 sang kaagahon.
english: He is also the Chief of the Finance Section and is on duty from 10 pm to 6 am.

text: Ginpahayag nga naka-duty siya sa oras sang insidente.
english: He was reportedly on duty at the time of the incident.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PMAJ Rolando Araño, spokesperson sang Iloilo Provincial Police Office (IPPO), ginpahayag sini nga ginporma na sang Office of the Provincial Director ang Special Investigation Task Group agud mapadasig kag mapaimpit ang imbestigasyon sa insidente.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, PMAJ Rolando Araño, spokesperson of the Iloilo Provincial Police Office (IPPO), said the Office of the Provincial Director has already formed the Special Investigation Task Group to expedite and narrow the investigation into the incident.

text: Samtang, ipa-idalom man sa autopsy ang bangkay sang biktima agud mahibaluan ang eksaktong hinungdan sang iya kamatayon kag makahatag sang dugang nga kasanag sa ginapatigayon nga imbestigasyon.
english: Meanwhile, the victim's body will also be subjected to an autopsy to determine the exact cause of his death and shed more light on the ongoing investigation.

text: Una na nga ginkumpirmar nga may pilas sang pagkaluthang si Velez sa tuo nga parte sang iya ulo, sa ibabaw sang dulunggan.
english: Earlier, it was confirmed that Velez sustained a gunshot wound to the right side of his head, above the ear.

text: Narecover man sa iya kilid ang iya service firearm nga Taurus TS9 pistol (9mm) kag may isa ka basiyo sang bala.
english: His service firearm, a Taurus TS9 pistol (9mm) and one round of ammunition, were also recovered from his side.

text: Ginkuhanan sang SOCO sang fingerprint ang mga ebidensya sa lugar kag ginpaidalom sa paraffin test ang mga kaupdanan sang biktima nga yara man sa istasyon sang tion sang insidente.
english: The SOCO took fingerprints from the evidence at the scene and subjected the victim's companions who were also at the station at the time of the incident to a paraffin test.

text: Padayon pa nga ginatipon sang otoridad ang mga ebidensya kag impormasyon nga makabulig mahibaloan ang matuod-tuod nga rason sa likod sang kamatayon sang nasambit nga pulis.
english: Authorities are still gathering evidence and information that will help determine the true cause behind the death of the policeman.

text: Naghina pa ang Super Typhoon Nando kag nagahana na nga magguwa sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR).
english: Super Typhoon Nando has weakened and is about to leave the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR).

text:
Base sa alas singko sa aga nga weather bulletin, ulihi nga nakit-an ang sentro sang mata sang bagyo sa 265 km nakatundan ang Calayan, Cagayan.Dala sini ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga 185 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 230 km/h.

May mga lugar sa gihapon sa Luzon nga napaidalom sa mga wind signal.
english:
Based on the 5 am weather bulletin, the center of the eye of the typhoon was last seen at 265 km west of Calayan, Cagayan. It brought winds of 185 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 230 km/h.

There are still areas in Luzon that are under wind signals.

The typhoon is forecast to move west northwest until it exits the PAR this morning.

text: Kun makaguwa na sa PAR, magaliso ini pa-nakatundan buwas pakadto sa direksyon sang southern China.
english: Once out of the PAR, it will turn west tomorrow towards southern China.

text: Ginalantaw sang weather bureau nga magahina ang bagyo sa bilog nga forecast period samtang nga yara ini sa West Philippine Sea.
english: The weather bureau expects the typhoon to weaken throughout the forecast period while it is in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, may yara sang gina-monitor nga LPA sa guwa sang PAR kag may mataas nga tyansa nga mahimo nga bagyo sa masunod nga 24 oras.
english: Meanwhile, there is a monitored LPA outside the PAR and there is a high chance that it will become a typhoon in the next 24 hours.

text: Ulihi ini nga nakit-an sa kalayuon nga 1,220 km nasidlangan sang Eastern Visayas.
english: It was last seen 1,220 km east of Eastern Visayas.

text: Magpadayon sa pagbantay sa weather updates halin diri sa Bombo Radyo Iloilo.
english: Stay tuned for weather updates from Bombo Radyo Iloilo.

text: Liwat nga ginpahayag ni Vice Pres.
english: Vice Pres.

text: Sara Duterte ang pagkabig niya sa pag-aresto kag pag-turn over sa iya amay nga si anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte sa International Criminal Court (ICC) bilang pangidnap.
english: He considers Sara Duterte guilty of arresting and turning over his father, former President Rodrigo Duterte, to the International Criminal Court (ICC) as a kidnapper.

text: Ginsiling sini sang Bise sa iya speechsa atubang sang mga tagasuporta sa Nagoya, Japan.
english: The Vice said this in his speech in front of supporters in Nagoya, Japan.

text: “Kapag ikaw ay may warrant of arrest, dinadala ka sa huwes.
english: “When you have a warrant of arrest, you are taken to the judge.

text: Ang ginawa niya kay dating pangulong Rodrigo Duterte ay may warrant of arrest, sapilitan nilang kinuha sa ating bansa at dinala sa The Hague.
english: What he did to former President Rodrigo Duterte was with a warrant of arrest, they forcibly took him from our country and brought him to The Hague.

text: Hindi siya dinala sa korte doon sa Pilipinas,” suno kay VP Sara.
english: He was not brought to court in the Philippines,” VP Sara said.

text: Matandaan nga gingamit sang ICC prosecution ang pahayag nga ini sang bise para pamatukan ang petisyon sang Duterte camp para sa interim release.
english: The ICC prosecution used the vice's statement to oppose the Duterte camp's petition for interim release.

text: Gin-buyagyag ni Queen Mother Karala Estrda nga napreparahan na niya ang bwas damlag sang iya subang nga anak nga si Daniel Padilla.
english: Queen Mother Karala Estrda revealed that she is already preparing for the future of her youngest son Daniel Padilla.

text: Suno kay Karla, paglab-ot ni Daniel sa edad nga 35-anyos mahimo na ini mag-untat sa pagtrabaho.
english: According to Karla, when Daniel reaches the age of 35, he can stop working.

text: Tubtob sa mangin apo ni Karla pahayag niya, may yara na sang natalana nga savings bangud siya mismo ang nagakapyot sang kwarta sang aktor.
english: As far as Karla's grandchildren, he said, there are already planned savings because he himself holds the actor's money.

text: Apisar nga indi pala-pangayo si Daniel sa iya sang kwarta, kun kaisa “No” sa gihapon ang sabat sang iloy sini kun magpabakal sang mga malahalon nga salakyan.
english: Although Daniel doesn't ask him for money, sometimes his mother still answers “No” when it comes to buying expensive cars.

text: Isang pulis ang natagpuang duguan at wala nang buhay sa ikatlong palapag ng Barotac Nuevo Police Station, Iloilo.
english: A policeman was found bleeding and dead on the third floor of the Barotac Nuevo Police Station, Iloilo.

text: Ayon sa inisyal na ulat, ang biktima ay kinilalang chief ng Finance Section ng nasabing istasyon.
english: According to initial reports, the victim was identified as the chief of the Finance Section of the said station.

text: Nakita sa tabi ng biktima ang isang 9mm na baril na hinihinalang ginamit sa insidente.
english: A 9mm pistol suspected of being used in the incident was found next to the victim.

text: Natukoy din na may tama ito ng bala sa ulo.
english: It was also determined that he had a gunshot wound to the head.

text: Ikinuwento ng ilang residente malapit sa himpilan na bandang alas-4 ng madaling araw, may narinig silang putok ng baril mula sa lugar.
english: Some residents near the himpilan said that around 4 am, they heard gunshots from the area.

text: Patuloy pa ang imbestigasyon ng mga otoridad upang matukoy kung may foul play sa insidente o ito ay kaso ng pagpapakamatay.
english: Authorities are still investigating to determine if there was foul play in the incident or if it was a case of suicide.

text: Magalunsar ang International Criminal Court (ICC) sang external investigation batok sa chief prosecutor sini nga si Karim Khan bangud sa ginaalegar nga sexual misconduct.
english: The International Criminal Court (ICC) will launch an external investigation against its chief prosecutor Karim Khan for alleged sexual misconduct.

text:
Suno sa korte, magaagi ini sa maid-id nga pagpangusisa bilang kabahin sang “fully independent, impartial and fair process.”

Nagpanawagan man ini sa tanan nga mga partido nga involved nga mag-kooperar gid sa korte.
english:
The court said it would undergo a thorough investigation as part of a “fully independent, impartial and fair process.”

He also called on all parties involved to fully cooperate with the court.

text: Nagpaguwa man sang statement si Prosecutor Khan nga magapabilin siya sa iya obligasyon sa pagpanguna sa mga imbestigasyon sa ginaalegar nga war crimes lakip na sa Israel-Gaza conflict.
english: Prosecutor Khan also issued a statement saying he will remain committed to leading investigations into alleged war crimes including the Israel-Gaza conflict.

text: Ang tanan naman nga mga isyu kaangot sa imbestigasyon sa iya ang pangunahan naman sang deputy prosecutors.
english: All issues related to the investigation against him will be led by deputy prosecutors.

text: Una na nga ginpanginwala ni Khan ang tanan nga alegasyon sa misconduct nga gin-report sa governing body sang ICC sang nagligad nga bulan.
english: Khan had earlier denied all allegations of misconduct reported to the ICC’s governing body last month.

text: Sang amo nga tion, nag-hingyo man si Khan sa internal oversight body sang korte nga imbestigaran man ini nga mga alegasyon.
english: At the time, Khan also requested the court’s internal oversight body to investigate these allegations as well.

text: Gin-insister man sini nga ang misconduct allegations batok sa iya ang kabahin lamang sang misinformation campaign batok sa iya opisina.
english: He also insisted that the misconduct allegations against him are only part of a misinformation campaign against his office.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Khan ang nag-request sang Mayo para dagdagan sang arrest warrants sanday Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu, iya defense chief kag pila ka Hamas leaders.
english: Khan requested in May for additional arrest warrants for Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu, his defense chief and several Hamas leaders.

text: Ang ICC amo ang permanent court nga naka-base sa The Hague nga maka-prosecute sang mga indibidwal sa war crimes, crimes against humanity, genocide kag crime of aggression sa member states ukon ila nationals.#
english: The ICC is the permanent court based in The Hague that can prosecute individuals for war crimes, crimes against humanity, genocide and crime of aggression against member states or their nationals.#

text: Nagpositibo sa ginpatigayon nga drug test ang dismissed Police Officer nga nadakpan sa drug buy bust operation sa Brgy.
english: The dismissed police officer who was arrested in a drug buy bust operation in Brgy.

text: Maribong, Lambunao, Iloilo.
english: Maribong, Lambunao, Iloilo.

text: Ang subject amo si Jonathan Digno Limas, 54-anyos, residente sang Barangay Cubay sa amo nga banwa.
english: The subject was identified as Jonathan Digno Limas, 54, resident of Barangay Cubay in the same town.

text: Suno kay Police Major Dadje Delima, head sang Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit (PDEU) sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office, sa pagpangusisa nila, naggwa nga may contact si Limas sa Metro Manila kun sa diin siya nagakuha sang supply sang illegal drugs.
english: Police Major Dadje Delima, head of the Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit (PDEU) of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office, said their investigation revealed that Limas had contacts in Metro Manila where he obtained supplies of illegal drugs.

text: Sakop naman sang iya operasyon ang Lambunao, Dueñas, Calinog kag Passi City.
english: Its operations cover Lambunao, Dueñas, Calinog and Passi City.

text: Napasaka na ang kaso batok kay Limas.
english: A case has been filed against Limas.

text: Matandaan nga nakuha sa posisyon sang anay pulis ang 120 gramos nga ginapahayag shabu nga may standard drug price nga P816,000.00.
english: It can be recalled that 120 grams of suspected shabu with a standard drug price of P816,000.00 were recovered from the possession of the former policeman.

text: Nahibaluan nga gin-dismiss ini sa serbisyo matapos matukiban nga ginpeke sini ang iya nga eligibility sa Civil Service.
english: He was dismissed from service after it was discovered that he had faked his eligibility for the Civil Service.

text:
ILOILO CITY- Eksperyensiya ang bentaha sang Pinoy boxer nga four-division world champion Donnie “Ahas” Nietes batok sa iya kasumpong nga si World Boxing Organization (WBO) world super flyweight king Kazuto Ioka sa ila away nga patigayunon sa Ota City General Gymnasium sa Tokyo, Japan subong nga gab-i.

Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Edwin Espejo, isa ka boxing analyst, iya ginpahayag nga kun basehan ang record, si Nietes ang may yara sang 43 wins nga may 23 knockouts, 1 defeat kag 6 draws samtang si Ioka naman ang may yara pa lang sang 28 wins, 2 defeats kag 15 knockouts.
english:
ILOILO CITY – Experience the advantage of Filipino boxer four-division world champion Donnie “Ahas” Nietes against his opponent World Boxing Organization (WBO) world super flyweight king Kazuto Ioka in their fight to be held at the Ota City General Gymnasium in Tokyo, Japan tonight.

In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Edwin Espejo, a boxing analyst, said that based on the record, Nietes has 43 wins with 23 knockouts, 1 defeat and 6 draws while Ioka has only 28 wins, 2 defeats and 15 knockouts.

text: Apang suno kay Espejo, mangin disbentaha para kay Nietes ang iya edad nga 40 kun ipaanggid sa 33-anyos nga si Ioka apang gin-athag niya nga indi man ini garantiya para mas mangibabaw ang Japanese boxer.
english: However, Espejo said that Nietes' age of 40 will be a disadvantage for Nietes compared to 33-year-old Ioka but he explained that this is not a guarantee for the Japanese boxer to dominate.

text: Sa pihak sini, nagalaum si Espejo nga mas maganahan si Nietes nga pierdehun si Ioka agud itimalos ang kapaslawan ni Mark Magsayo sang damlag lang batok kay Rey Vargas sang Mexico nga nangin rason kun ngaa wala na subong sang ginauyatan nga world title ang Pilipinas sa labing una nga tion sa sulod sang masobra isa ka dekada.
english: Meanwhile, Espejo hopes that Nietes will be more likely to defeat Ioka to avenge Mark Magsayo's recent failure against Mexico's Rey Vargas that left the Philippines without a world title for the first time in more than a decade.

text: Ginpasiguro ni House Speaker “Bojie” Dy III nga naka-focus subong ang kamara nga mapasa on time ang 2026 national budget.
english: House Speaker “Bojie” Dy III assured that the chamber is now focused on passing the 2026 national budget on time.

text: Suno kay Dy nga sa idalom sang iya pagpamuno, siguraduhon sang kamara nga ang national spending plan para sa masunod nga tuig ang mangin malimpyo kag transparent.
english: Dy said that under his leadership, the chamber will ensure that the national spending plan for next year is clean and transparent.

text: Kumpyansa si Dy nga on time mapasa ang amo nga budget.
english: Dy is confident that the budget will be passed on time.

text: Pahayag man niya nga ginkakas na ang mga dalagkuan nga pondo para sa mga flood control projects.
english: He also said that large funds for flood control projects have been withdrawn.

text: Natumba ang isa ka poste sang kuryente matapos nga masagaidan sang cargo truck sa Lopez Jaena St., Barangay 31, Bacolod City.
english: An electricity pole fell after being hit by a cargo truck in Lopez Jaena St., Barangay 31, Bacolod City.

text: Sa amo nga insidente, isa ang nalipong kag isa ang napilasan.
english: In that incident, one person fainted and another was injured.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Bacolod kay Barangay Kagawad Shella Mae Togle Diaz sang Barangay 31, pasado alas 3:00 ang takna sa hapon sang nasagaidan sang nasambit nga truck ang poste sang kuryente.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Bacolod, Barangay Kagawad Shella Mae Togle Diaz of Barangay 31 said it was around 3:00 pm when the truck hit the electricity pole.

text: Suno kay Diaz, ang nalipong kag ang napilasan ang nagapungko sa ila ginabaligyaan sang fried chicken.
english: According to Diaz, the fainted and the injured were sitting at their fried chicken shop.

text: Suno diri, naglabay ang cargo truck nasagaid sini ang nagaluy-loy nga kable sang kuryente nga nagresulta sa pagkatumba sang poste.
english: According to him, a cargo truck was passing by and hit a loose electrical cable which resulted in the pole falling.

text: Gilayon man nga gin-secure sang personnel sang Negros Electric and Power Corporation ang area agud masiguro nga wala sang open wires.
english: Negros Electric and Power Corporation personnel immediately secured the area to ensure that there were no open wires.

text: Panawagan sini sa Negros Power nga himuan sang tikang ang mga kable nga nagaluyloy agud nga malikawan na nga may matabo nga kaangay nga insidente.
english: He called on Negros Power to take action against the loose cables to avoid such incidents.

text: Naubos ni President-elect Donald Trump ang pito ka battleground states sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika sa ginpatigayon nga presidential election sang Nobyembre 5.
english: President-elect Donald Trump lost seven battleground states in the United States of America in the November 5 presidential election.

text: Natabo ini sang nakuha man sini ang southwest state sang Arizona nga amo ang katapusan nga nagdeklarar sang resulta matapos ang pila ka adlaw nga isipay sang boto.
english: This happened when it also took the southwest state of Arizona which was the last to declare the results after several days of vote counting.

text: Bangud sa 11 electoral college votes halin sa state, nagsaka sa 312 ang nakuha ni Trump ikumpara sa 226 ni Vice President Kamala Harris.
english: With 11 electoral college votes from the state, Trump got 312 compared to Vice President Kamala Harris' 226.

text: Antes pa man sini, klaro na ang kadalag-an ni Trump matapos una na-secure ang 270 electoral college votes nga amo lamang ang kinahanglanon para makabalik siya sa White House.
english: Even before that, Trump's victory was clear after first securing the 270 electoral college votes that were all he needed to return to the White House.

text: Isa anay ka Republican stronghold ang Arizona nga nagboto sa pula sa masobra 20 ka tuig apang nagbaliskad ini sang 2020 sang nalutos si Trump sa amo nga state sa kamot ni outgoing President Joe Biden.
english: Arizona was once a Republican stronghold that voted red for more than 20 years but that flipped in 2020 when Trump lost the state to outgoing President Joe Biden.

text: Sang amo nga tion, 10,000 votes ang nagseparar sa duha ka mga kandidato.
english: At the time, 10,000 votes separated the two candidates.

text: Nahimo ni Trump ang sweep subong nga 2024 matapos nadag-an ang presidential race sa anum ka iban pa nga swing states nga amo ang Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Michigan, North Carolina, Nevada kag Georgia.
english: Trump made the sweep this 2024 after winning the presidential race in six other swing states namely Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Michigan, North Carolina, Nevada and Georgia.

text: Wala sang reaksyon ang aktres nga si Sunshine Cruz sa mga nagguwa nga pictures sang anak ni anay Miss Earth nga si Sandra Seifert kaupod ang aktor nga si Cesar Montano.
english: Actress Sunshine Cruz has no reaction to the pictures of former Miss Earth's daughter Sandra Seifert with actor Cesar Montano.

text: Suno kay Sunshine, madugay na sila nga bulagay ni Cesar kag nakahibalo mismo ang iya mga anak tuhoy sa mga kabataan sang ila amay sa iban nga babaye.
english: According to Sunshine, she and Cesar have been separated for a long time and her children themselves know about their father's children with other women.

text: Pahayag sang aktres, mas maayo na nga magguwa ang kamatuoran bangud makaluluoy ang mga kabataan nga ginatago.
english: The actress said it is better for the truth to come out because the children who are being hidden are pitiful.

text: Sa subong, malipayon si Sunshine kaupod ang iya tatlo ka mga kabataan.
english: Today, Sunshine is happy with her three children.

text: Matapos ang ‘Trillion Peso March’ laban sa korapsyon nitong Setyembre 21, 2025, binigyang-diin ni constitutional law expert Atty. Michael Henry Yusingco na hindi sapat ang protesta kung hindi susundan ng kongkretong hakbang tulad ng pagpapalit ng mga lider mula sa political dynasty at pananagutin ang mga tiwaling opisyal at kontratista na sangkot sa flood control scandal.
english: After the 'Trillion Peso March' against corruption on September 21, 2025, constitutional law expert Atty. Michael Henry Yusingco said that the protest is not enough if it is not followed by concrete steps such as the replacement of leaders from the political dynasty and holding corrupt officials and contractors involved in the flood control scandal accountable.

text: Sa panayam ng Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Michael Henry Yusingco, ipinaliwanag niya na ang ugat ng problema ay nakaugat mismo sa mga halal na opisyal na paulit-ulit umanong nagnanakaw sa kaban ng bayan, nagsasagawa ng budget insertions, at nagtataguyod ng ghost projects.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Michael Henry Yusingco, he explained that the root of the problem is rooted in the elected officials who repeatedly allegedly steal from the public coffers, conduct budget insertions, and promote ghost projects.

text: Aniya, mahalaga na pumili ng mga kinatawan na tunay na galing sa komunidad at hindi kabilang sa mga political dynasty upang magkaroon ng makabuluhang pagbabago.
english: He said it is important to elect representatives who are truly from the community and not part of political dynasties in order to bring about meaningful change.

text: Dagdag pa niya, kung nais ng mamamayan na magkaroon ng pananagutan, kinakailangang makulong hindi lamang ang mga mambabatas na nasasangkot kundi pati ang mga tiwaling bureaucrats at mga kontratista.
english: He added that if the people want to have accountability, they need to imprison not only the lawmakers involved but also the corrupt bureaucrats and contractors.

text: Bukod dito, iginiit niya na dapat mabawi ang pondong ninakaw at maibalik sa kaban ng bayan.
english: In addition, he insisted that the stolen funds should be recovered and returned to the public coffers.

text: Tinukoy rin niya na sa lahat ng imbestigasyon hinggil sa flood control scandal at iba pang katiwalian, iisang ahensiya lamang ang may kapangyarihan na magdesisyon, ang Ombudsman, na dapat magsagawa ng masusing pangangalap ng ebidensiya at impormasyon upang mapanagot ang mga sangkot.
english: He also pointed out that in all investigations into the flood control scandal and other corruption, only one agency has the power to decide, the Ombudsman, which must conduct a thorough collection of evidence and information to hold those involved accountable.

text: Ipinaliwanag din ni Yusingco na bagama’t mahalaga ang pagtitipon ng mga mamamayan, hindi ito awtomatikong nakapagtatapos ng problema.
english: Yusingco also explained that although it is important to gather the people, it does not automatically solve the problem.

text: Batay sa kanyang pagsusuri, ang naganap na A Trillion March ay hindi maituturing na nagkakaisang pagkilos dahil may sari-sariling political agenda ang bawat grupo, mula sa anti-corruption at pro-Duterte hanggang sa anti-Marcos at anti-Duterte.
english: According to his analysis, the A Trillion March cannot be considered a unified movement because each group has its own political agenda, from anti-corruption and pro-Duterte to anti-Marcos and anti-Duterte.

text: Dahil dito, hindi ito maihahalintulad sa mga nagtagumpay na kilusang bayan sa Indonesia at Nepal.
english: Because of this, it cannot be compared to the successful people's movements in Indonesia and Nepal.

text: Ayon pa sa kanya, ang tunay na epektibong mass action ay yaong may pagkakaisa at sustained o tuluy-tuloy na pagkilos, gaya ng karanasan ng bansa sa EDSA People Power 1 at 2.
english: According to him, the truly effective mass action is one that is united and sustained, like the country's experience in EDSA People Power 1 and 2.

text: Sa ganitong pagkakataon lamang, aniya, matatakot ang mga opisyal ng pamahalaan at mapipilitang magbago.
english: Only this time, he said, will government officials be afraid and forced to change.

text: Ngunit kung hati-hati ang mga layunin, hindi matitinag ang mga nasa kapangyarihan at sa halip ay mas lalo pang mauuwi sa hidwaan.//JDS
english: But if the goals are divided, those in power will not be shaken and instead will be further reduced to the hidwaan.//JDS

text: Mananatiling suspendido ang klase sa sampung barangay sa bayan ng Sibalom, Antique habang nagpapatuloy ang imbestigasyon kaugnay ng pagkalat ng hindi pa matukoy na mabahong amoy na nagdulot ng mass hospitalization sa humigit-kumulang 300 mag-aaral.
english: Classes in ten barangays in Sibalom, Antique remain suspended while investigations continue into the spread of an unidentified foul smell that led to mass hospitalization of more than 300 students.

text: Ayon kay Mr. Hernani Escullar Jr., tagapagsalita ng Department of Education (DepEd) Region 6, ang klase ay pansamantalang isasagawa sa pamamagitan ng distance modular learning upang matiyak ang kaligtasan ng mga mag-aaral habang isinasagawa ang decontamination at safety assessment sa lugar.
english: According to Mr. Hernani Escullar Jr., spokesperson of the Department of Education (DepEd) Region 6, the classes will be temporarily conducted through distance modular learning to ensure the safety of the students while conducting decontamination and safety assessment in the area.

text: Sinabi rin ni Escullar na personal na bumisita sa lugar si DepEd Regional Director Dr. Cristito Eco kasama ang ilang opisyal ng ahensiya upang tiyakin na ang mga apektadong mag-aaral ay nakatatanggap ng sapat na tulong medikal at suporta mula sa pamahalaan.
english: Escullar also said that DepEd Regional Director Dr. Cristito Eco along with several agency officials to ensure that the affected students are receiving adequate medical assistance and support from the government.

text: Kaugnay nito, inihahanda na rin ang mga psychosocial support services para sa mga estudyante at kanilang mga pamilya bilang tugon sa epekto ng traumatic na karanasan.
english: In this regard, psychosocial support services are also being prepared for students and their families in response to the impact of traumatic experiences.

text: Pinuri ng DepEd ang mabilis at koordinadong aksyon ng mga guro, healthcare workers, emergency responders, at mga lokal na opisyal sa agarang pagresponde sa insidente.
english: DepEd praised the quick and coordinated action of teachers, healthcare workers, emergency responders, and local officials in responding to the incident.

text: Matatandaang naglabas ng Executive Order si Sibalom Mayor Gian Carlo F. Occeña noong Hulyo 2 upang pansamantalang suspendihin ang klase mula preschool hanggang senior high school sa mga barangay ng Pis-anan, Mabini, Nagdayao, Bontol, Panlagangan, Igcococ, Initan, Tulatula, Calooy, at Catmon.
english: Sibalom Mayor Gian Carlo F. Occeña issued an Executive Order on July 2 to temporarily suspend classes from preschool to senior high school in the barangays of Pis-anan, Mabini, Nagdayao, Bontol, Panlagangan, Igcococ, Initan, Tulatula, Calooy, and Catmon.

text: Batay sa ulat, isang “mass casualty incident” ang naiulat sa Pis-anan National High School at Pis-anan Central Elementary School noong Hulyo 3, matapos magreklamo ang mga estudyante tungkol sa isang kakaiba at matapang na amoy na mistulang sirang bayabas.
english: According to the report, a mass casualty incident was reported at Pis-anan National High School and Pis-anan Central Elementary School on July 3, after students complained about a strange and strong smell that resembled guava.

text: Kalaunan, nakaranas ang mga mag-aaral ng iba’t ibang sintomas tulad ng sakit ng ulo, pananakit ng tiyan at dibdib, pagsusuka, pagkahilo, hirap sa paghinga, at may ilang nawalan pa ng malay.
english: In the morning, the students experienced various symptoms such as headache, abdominal and chest pain, vomiting, dizziness, difficulty breathing, and some even lost consciousness.

text: Tinatayang nasa 300 mag-aaral ang apektado sa naturang insidente.
english: An estimated 300 students were affected by the incident.

text: Sinimulan na ng Department of Health (DOH) Region 6 ang masusing imbestigasyon upang matukoy ang posibleng kemikal o sangkap na naging sanhi ng masamang amoy at pagkakasakit ng mga mag-aaral.
english: The Department of Health (DOH) Region 6 has launched a thorough investigation to determine the possible chemical or ingredient that caused the bad smell and illness of the students.

text: Ayon sa mga eksperto, maaaring umabot ng isang linggo bago matukoy ang eksaktong sangkap na nalanghap.
english: According to experts, it may take a week to determine the exact substance inhaled.

text: Magsasagawa rin ng ocular inspection at sample collection ang DOH para sa karagdagang pagsusuri.
english: The DOH will also conduct ocular inspection and sample collection for further testing.

text: Habang patuloy ang containment at verification efforts, nananatiling nakaalerto ang mga komunidad upang matiyak ang kaligtasan ng mga residente, lalo na ng mga kabataang mag-aaral.
english: While containment and verification efforts continue, communities remain alert to ensure the safety of residents, especially students.

text: Ginpromisa ni United States President Joe Biden ang matawhay nga transfer of power kay president-elect Donald Trump.
english: United States President Joe Biden has promised a peaceful transfer of power to president-elect Donald Trump.

text: Kabahin ini sang kaundan sang labing-una nga speech ni Biden matapos nga nalutos ang ila kandidato sa Democratic party nga si Vice President Kamala Harris sa kamot ni Trump nga amo man ang 45th president sang Estados Unidos.
english: This is part of the content of Biden's first speech after their Democratic candidate, Vice President Kamala Harris, was defeated by Trump, who is also the 45th president of the United States.

text: “Yesterday, I spoke with President-elect Trump to congratulate him on his victory.
english: “Yesterday, I spoke with President-elect Trump to congratulate him on his victory.

text: I assured him that I would direct my entire administration to work with his team to ensure a peaceful and orderly transition.
english: I assured him that I would direct my entire administration to work with his team to ensure a peaceful and orderly transition.

text: That’s what the American people deserve,” suno sa current president.
english: That’s what the American people deserve,” according to the current president.

text: Gin-iimbitahan man sang 81-anyos nga presidente si Trump nga magbisita sa White House — isa ka courtesy nga wala ginhimo ni Trump sang ginlutos siya sang Democrat leader sang 2020.
english: The 81-year-old president is also inviting Trump to visit the White House — a courtesy Trump didn’t do when the Democrat leader defeated him in 2020.

text: Ginpakalma man ni Biden ang iban nga Americans nga wala nalipay sa resulta sang eleksyon.
english: Biden also soothed some Americans who were unhappy with the election results.

text: Sa iya speech sa White House Rose Garden, ginsiling sini nga dapat respetuhon kun ano ang ginpili sang bilog nga nasyon.
english: In his speech at the White House Rose Garden, he said that the choice of the entire nation should be respected.

text: Diri man kag nagpanawagan siya sa pag-isa sang Amerika kag indi na magpahulom pa sa partisan election.
english: He also called for American unity and not to bow to partisan elections.

text: “Something I hope we can do no matter who you voted for is see each other not as adversaries but as fellow Americans, bring down the temperature,” kabahin sang speech.
english: “Something I hope we can do no matter who you voted for is see each other not as adversaries but as fellow Americans, bring down the temperature,” part of the speech.

text: “I also hope we can lay to rest the question about the integrity of the American electoral system.
english: “I also hope we can lay to rest the question about the integrity of the American electoral system.

text: It is honest, it is fair, and it is transparent.
english: It is honest, it is fair, and it is transparent.

text:
And it can be trusted, win or lose.”

May mga kritiko nga nagabasol kay Biden bangud magapa-reelect kuntani ini subong nga tuig, apang ulihi na nag-atras kasunod sang matunog nga panawagan sang Democrats.
english:
And it can be trusted, win or lose.”

Some critics blame Biden because he was supposed to seek reelection this year, but backed out too late following resounding calls from Democrats.

text: Naatrasar man ang kampanya ni Harris, apang apisar sini, gindayaw ni Biden ang pagkampanya sang bise-presidente kag ang batasan sini bilang isa ka lider.
english: Harris’ campaign was also delayed, but despite that, Biden praised the vice president’s campaigning and her demeanor as a leader.

text: “A defeat does not mean we are defeated.
english: “A defeat does not mean we are defeated.

text: We lost this battle.
english: We lost this battle.

text: The America of your dreams is calling for you to get back up.
english: The America of your dreams is calling for you to get back up.

text: That’s the story of America for over 240 years and counting,” suno kay Biden.
english: That’s the story of America for over 240 years and counting,” Biden said.

text: Kahapon pa sang nag-concede si Harris.
english: Harris conceded yesterday.

text: Gin-deliver ang iya concession speech sa iya alma mater nga Howard University sa Washington DC kag una naman nagkomiter sang matawhay nga transfer of power sa masunod nga administrasyon.#
english: He delivered his concession speech at his alma mater Howard University in Washington DC and first committed to a peaceful transfer of power to the next administration.

text:
Matakos ang abilidad sang Philippine national women s football team sa pag-atubang sini sa Thailand sa katapusan nga elimination game sa Group A sang 2022 ASEAN Football Federation Women s Championship sa Rizal Memorial Football Stadium karon sa gab-i.

May apat na ka sunod-sunod nga daog ang Filipinas kag amo subong ang nagauyat sang top semifinal berth sa Group A.

Magapamuno naman sa Thais si Ploychompoo Somnonk, isa sa best scorers sang team nga nagbitbit sa ila sa finals kag silver-medal finish sa 31st Southeast Asian Games duha ka bulan na ang nagligad.
english:
The Philippine national women s football team's skills will be measured when they face Thailand in the final elimination game in Group A of the 2022 ASEAN Football Federation Women s Championship at the Rizal Memorial Football Stadium tonight.

The Philippines has won four straight and currently holds the top semifinal berth in Group A.

The Thais will be led by Ploychompo Somnonk, one of the best scorers of the team that carried them to the finals and silver-medal finish at the 31st Southeast Asian Games two months ago.

text: Ang duha ka iban pa nga Thai scorers nga sanday Alisa Rukpinij kag Tipkrita Onsamai amo ang ginakabig man nga daku nga pamahog sa Filipinas sa ila handum nga maangkon ang lima ka asud-asud nga kadalag-an.
english: Two other Thai scorers, Alisa Rukpinij and Tipkrita Onsamai, are also considered a major threat to the Philippines in their quest for five consecutive victories.

text: Matandaan nga sang Domingo, ginpyerde sang Thailand ang Malaysia, 4-0, kag rason nga naka-secure sang second semifinal berth nga may rekord nga 3-1-0 win-draw-loss.
english: On Sunday, Thailand defeated Malaysia, 4-0, securing a second semifinal berth with a 3-1-0 win-draw-loss record.

text: Target naman sang Pilipinas nga makatimalos bangud kun madumduman, ang Thailand man ang nagpyerde sa Pilipinas, 3-0, sa semis sa Southeast Asian Games.
english: The Philippines is targeting revenge because Thailand also lost to the Philippines, 3-0, in the semis of the Southeast Asian Games.

text: in-ulan sang malain nga mga komento si former Miss Earth Philippines Imelda Schweighart bangud sa iya pahayag nga wala siya nanamian sa K-Pop.
english: former Miss Earth Philippines Imelda Schweighart received a rain of negative comments for her statement that she does not like K-Pop.

text: Matandaan nga sa iya sunod-sunod nga Facebook post, ginpahayag sang beauty queen turned singer nga nagakadula ang identity sang mga Pinoy bangud ginatinguhaan nila nga ilugon ang mga Koreans.
english: In her series of Facebook posts, the beauty queen turned singer said that Filipinos are losing their identity because they are trying to imitate Koreans.

text: Suno pa kay Imelda, mas maayo man mag-english ang mga Pinoy ipaanggid sa Koreans kag daw kaangay nga ginasakop na sang Korea ang Pilipinas bangud sa pag-patronize sang mga Pinoy sa K-Pop.
english: According to Imelda, Filipinos are better at English than Koreans and it seems that Korea is already occupying the Philippines because of the patronization of Filipinos in K-Pop.

text: Bangud sini, nangin trending si Imelda.
english: Because of this, Imelda became trending.

text: Wala naman ginpalampas sang mga netizens ang iya komento.
english: Netizens did not ignore his comment.

text:
May yara pa sang nagpangita sang Instagram story ni Imelda kun sa diin una na niya ginpakita ang iya ginakaon nga mga Korean food kag may caption pa ang post nga: “I love Korean food so much.”

Deactivated naman subong ang Facebook account sang nasambit nga Filipino-Austrian beauty queen.
english:
There are those who searched for Imelda's Instagram story where she first showed her Korean food and the post was captioned: “I love Korean food so much.”

The Filipino-Austrian beauty queen's Facebook account has now been deactivated.

text: Nagnubo sa masobra 2 million ang numero sang mga unemployed ukon wala sang trabaho nga mga Pilipino sa bulan sang Enero base sa data sang Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA).
english: The number of unemployed Filipinos fell to more than 2 million in January based on data from the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA).

text: Suno kay PSA chief kag National Statistician Claire Dennis Mapa, ang numero sang mga unemployed adults, ukon mga naga-edad sang 15 anyos pasaka ang nagdangat sa 2.93 million sang Enero subong nga tuig.
english: According to PSA chief and National Statistician Claire Dennis Mapa, the number of unemployed adults, or those aged 15 years and above, reached 2.93 million in January this year.

text: Base sa amo nga numero, ang unemployment rate sang pungsod ang yara subong sa 6.4%.
english: Based on that figure, the country's unemployment rate is currently at 6.4%.

text: Ini ang mas manubo sa 6.6% unemployment rate nga narekord sang Disyembre 2021.
english: This is down from the 6.6% unemployment rate recorded in December 2021.

text: Kapin 340,000 naman ang nakakas sa 3.27 million nga mga unemployed nga narekord sang Disyembre sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: More than 340,000 of the 3.27 million unemployed recorded in December last year were laid off.

text: Ginpahayag ni Interior Secretary Juanito Victor “Jonvic” Remulla nga ginapatihan may plano ang pila ka bayolente nga pamatan-on nga sunugon ang Malacañang, matapos nga ginsindihan nila ang isa ka barricade truck kag ginpanghaboy sang bato ang mga kapulisan.
english: Interior Secretary Juanito Victor “Jonvic” Remulla said it is believed that some violent youths had a plan to burn down Malacañang, after they set fire to a barricade truck and threw stones at the police.

text: Suno kay Remulla, kalabanan sa mga nadakpan amo ang mga menor de edad kag ginapatihan nga miyembro sang isa ka street gang.
english: According to Remulla, most of those arrested were minors and believed to be members of a street gang.

text: Sa pihak sang kinagamo kag kadamge nga ila nga natuga, ginpasiguro sang tiglikom nga ang mga na-aresto ipaidalom sa kustodiya sang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) para sa imbestigasyon kag pagproseso sang nagakaigo nga mga tikang.
english: Despite the chaos and panic they caused, the secretary assured that those arrested will be placed under the custody of the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) for investigation and processing of appropriate measures.

text: Sa ginpatigayon nga protesta kahapon, gin-atake sang mga naka-maskara nga grupo ang mga kapulisan sa Ayala Bridge.
english: During the protest held yesterday, masked groups attacked the police at the Ayala Bridge.

text: Ginsunog nila ang isa ka shipping van nga ginagamit bilang barikada malapit sa mga gate sang Palasyo.
english: They set fire to a shipping van that was being used as a barricade near the Palace gates.

text: Ginpanghaboy man sang grupo ang mga pulis sang bato, botelya, kag iban pa nga matig-a nga bagay.
english: The group also threw stones, bottles, and other hard objects at the police.

text: Naglapta ang kinagamo tubtob sa Mendiola Bridge, rason nga napilitan ang kapulisan nga maggamit sang water cannon agud mapugngan ang grupo nga nagapangkakas sang security lines.
english: The riots spread to the Mendiola Bridge, forcing the police to use water cannons to stop the group from breaking through the security lines.

text: Indi magnubo sa 26 ka mga pulis ang napilasan sa amo nga insidente, samtang may pila man ka miyembro sang media nga nadalahig sa kinagamo.
english: At least 26 police officers were injured in the incident, while several members of the media were also involved in the violence.

text: Ginpahayag ni Remulla nga samtang ginakilala sang administrasyon ang katungdanan sang katawhan nga magpabutyag sang ila mga sentiment, responsabilidad man niya bilang hepe sang DILG nga siguruhon ang seguridad sang Palasyo.
english: Remulla said that while the administration recognizes the duty of the people to express their sentiments, it is also his responsibility as DILG chief to ensure the security of the Palace.

text: Dugang niya, ginatutukan man sang Presidente ang mga nagakatabo nga protesta, ilabi na ang mga may kaangtanan sa isyu sang anti-korapsyon sa bug-os nga pungsod.
english: He added that the President is also focusing on the ongoing protests, especially those related to the issue of anti-corruption nationwide.

text: Ginkumpirma ni “Asia’s Next Top Model” winner Maureen Wroblewitz nga nagpositibo ini sa COVID-19 matapos nga ginhilanat sa sulod sang pila ka adlaw.
english: “Asia’s Next Top Model” winner Maureen Wroblewitz confirmed that she tested positive for COVID-19 after having a fever for several days.

text: Sa instagram post ni Maureen, iya ginakabig nga makahaladlok ang iya na-eksperyensyahan sa diin naglab-ot sa punto nga nakaapekto na ini sa iya nga mental health.
english: In an Instagram post, Maureen said she considered the experience to be frightening and to the point that it affected her mental health.

text: Apang sa subong pahayag niya, mas maayo na ang iya kondisyon kag bangud sa natabo, madamo siya sang natun-an.
english: But now, he said, he is in better condition and because of what happened, he learned a lot.

text: Lakip na diri amo ang pagsalig sa iya nga “gut instincts” kag sa iya kaugalingon.
english: That includes trusting his “gut instincts” and himself.

text: Suno sa model, indi kinahanglan nga mag-salig sa iban nga tawo agud nga mangin safe.
english: According to the model, it is not necessary to depend on other people in order to be safe.

text: Gin-remind man ni Maureen ang mga netizens nga magsuksok gid sang mask kag face shield sa diin man magkadto, i-obserba ang physical distancing kag pasangkaron ang immune system.
english: Maureen also reminded netizens to wear masks and face shields wherever they go, observe physical distancing and boost their immune system.

text: Ginakabig man sang model nga isa siya sa mga maswerte nga tawo bangud may yara lang ini sang mild symptoms.
english: The model also considers herself one of the lucky people as she only has mild symptoms.

text: Gani iya ginpangabay ang tanan nga mangin responsable sa diin unahon ang pagprotekta sa kaugalingon agud ma protektahan man ang iban nga tawo.
english: He therefore urged everyone to be responsible by prioritizing self-protection in order to protect others.

text: Indi makahampang sa FIBA Asia Cup sa Indonesia ang isa sa best players sang Gilas Pilipinas.
english: One of the best players of Gilas Pilipinas will not play in the FIBA ​​Asia Cup in Indonesia.

text: Suno sa Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas (SBP), indi makaupod si Dwight Ramos sa continental showpiece bangud sa medial tibial stress syndrome ukon shin splints.
english: According to the Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas (SBP), Dwight Ramos will not be able to participate in the continental showpiece due to medial tibial stress syndrome or shin splints.

text: Wala man ini nakaupod sa practice sang squad.
english: He also missed the squad's practice.

text: Buslan ni Rhenz Abando si Ramos agud nga kumpleto sa gihapon ang 12-man lineup sang team.
english: Rhenz Abando will replace Ramos to keep the team's 12-man lineup complete.

text: Duha ka tuig na ang nakaligad umpisa sang nag-upod si Ramos sa Gilas Pilipinas.
english: It's been two years since Ramos joined Gilas Pilipinas.

text: Sa apat ka hampang sang team sa FIBA World Cup Asian Qualifiers, nag-average si Ramos sang 15.5 points, 7 rebounds, 2.8 assists, kag 2.5 steals.
english: In the team’s four games at the FIBA ​​World Cup Asian Qualifiers, Ramos averaged 15.5 points, 7 rebounds, 2.8 assists, and 2.5 steals.

text: Magaumpisa ang Gilas Pilipinas sa Asia Cup campaign sa Group D batok sa Lebanon sa Myerkules, Hulyo 13, antes sini atubangon ang India kag New Zealand sa Hulyo 15 kag 17.
english: Gilas Pilipinas will begin their Asia Cup campaign in Group D against Lebanon on Wednesday, July 13, before facing India and New Zealand on July 15 and 17 respectively.

text: Maga-bangko man ang team sang Gilas kanday Thirdy Ravena, Poy Erram, Bobby Ray Parks Jr., Kiefer Ravena, Carl Tamayo, SJ Belangel, RJ Abarrientos, William Navarro, Francis Lopez, Geo Chiu, kag Kevin Quiambao.
english: The Gilas will also bench Thirdy Ravena, Poy Erram, Bobby Ray Parks Jr., Kiefer Ravena, Carl Tamayo, SJ Belangel, RJ Abarrientos, William Navarro, Francis Lopez, Geo Chiu, and Kevin Quiambao.

english: The victim was identified as Rodito Celis Jr., resident of Omambog, Sta.

english: Barbara; The suspect was identified as Ronald Susvilla, 45, resident of Brgy.
