text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Manay Davila, nakakita sa krimen, iya ginpahayag nga nagasakay sa motorsiklo ang biktima samtang ginapaarakan lupok sang suspek.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Manay Davila, who witnessed the crime, said the victim was riding a motorcycle when the suspect opened fire.

text: Suno kay Davila, gilayon nga natumba ang biktima lakip na ang ginamaneho sini nga motor, nagbangon, kag nagtuyo pa nga magpanginluwas.
english: Suno kay Davila, gilayon nga natumba ang biktima lakip na ang ginamaneho sini nga motor, nagbangon, kag nagtuyo pa nga magpanginluwas.

text: Natumba man ang suspek tubtob nga sila ang naglagsanay duha sang biktima.
english: The suspect also fell until they were stabbed by the victim.

text: Nag-agum sang igo sang bala ang biktima sa ilok, sa iya liog, samtang tatlo naman ka igo sa tiyan, isa sa iya alatrasan kag amo man sa likod sang iya lawas.
english: The victim sustained gunshot wounds in the nose, neck, three gunshot wounds in the stomach, one in the back and one in the back of his body.

text: Masobra 20 ka mga domestic flights ang ginkansela sa nagkalain-lain nga paluparan sa pungsod bangud sa Bagyo Marce subong nga Huwebes.
english: More than 20 domestic flights were canceled at various airports in the country due to Typhoon Marce this Thursday.

text: Suno sa  Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP), anom ka domestic flights padulong kag pabalik sa Tuguegarao Airport ang ginkansela.
english: According to the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP), six domestic flights to and from Tuguegarao Airport were cancelled.

text: Sa Laoag International Airport naman, may 4 ka domestic flights ang ginkansela.
english: At Laoag International Airport, 4 domestic flights were cancelled.

text: Samtang sa Basco Airport, ginkansela ang duha ka domestic flights.
english: Meanwhile, at Basco Airport, two domestic flights were cancelled.

text: May kinansela man nga flights sa Cauayan Airport kag Palanan Airport.
english: Flights at Cauayan Airport and Palanan Airport were also cancelled.

text: Sa pihak sang mabaskog nga pagbubo sang ulan, indi ini nangin hupang sa ginpatigayon nga hublag-protesta sa nagkalain-lain nga bahin sang pungsod batok sa korapsyon sa pondo sang mga flood control projects.
english: Despite the heavy rains, it did not stop the protests in various parts of the country against corruption in the funding of flood control projects.

text: Sa Baguio City, ang grupo nga “Baguio kag Benguet Batok sa Korapsyon” nagmartsa kag nagpanawagan nga pasabton ang mga opisyal kag indibidwal nga may kaangtanan sa mga “ghost” flood projects.
english: In Baguio City, the group “Baguio and Benguet Against Corruption” marched and called for the accountability of officials and individuals involved in “ghost” flood projects.

text: Sa Jaro, Iloilo City, nagpatigayon sang rally ang mga nagprotesta padulong sa provincial capitol samtang nagapangamuyo sang rosaryo.
english: In Jaro, Iloilo City, protesters held a rally towards the provincial capitol while praying the rosary.

text: Sa Bacolod, naglibot ang mga raliyista sa public plaza agud ipahayag ang ila kaakig batok sa mga substandard kag peke nga flood control projects.
english: In Bacolod, rallyists marched around the public plaza to express their anger against substandard and fake flood control projects.

text: Sa Aklan, nagpatigayon sang pangamuyo ang mga tawo samtang may gina-uyatan nga payong bilang simbolo sang ila pagla-om.
english: In Aklan, people held a prayer while holding umbrellas as a symbol of their hope.

text: Sa Cagayan de Oro, may yara sang motorcade kag martsa nga ginpatigayon sa Plaza Divisoria.
english: In Cagayan de Oro, there was a motorcade and march held at Plaza Divisoria.

text:
Samtang, ginpanunahan naman sang mga kabataan ang isa ka mainit nga rally sa First Rizal Monument, sa Daet, Camarines Norte

Ang mga protesta kabahin sang padayon nga panawagan para sa hustisya sa mga flood control projects nga subong padayon nga gina-imbistigaran sang Senado kag Kongreso.
english:
Meanwhile, children led a hot rally at the First Rizal Monument, in Daet, Camarines Norte

The protests are part of an ongoing call for justice over flood control projects that are currently under scrutiny by the Senate and Congress.

text: Plano nga ipatuman sang Philippine government ang 4-day workweek kag pagpalawig sang remote work set-up bangud man sa nagapadayon nga pagsaka sa presyo sang produktong petrolyo.
english: The Philippine government plans to implement a 4-day workweek and extend the remote work set-up due to the continuous rise in the price of petroleum products.

text: Ini suno kay Socioeconomic Planning Secretary Karl Chua ang pila sa mga rekomendasyon agud nga makabangon ang ekonomiya sang pungsod.
english: Socioeconomic Planning Secretary Karl Chua said these are some of the recommendations to revive the country's economy.

text: Sa 4-day workweek, kinahanglan nga 10 ka oras ang trabaho sang mga empleyado.
english: In a 4-day workweek, employees are required to work 10 hours.

text: Suno naman kay Energy Secretary Alfonso Cusi, kinahanglan man nga palawigon ang work-from-home arrangements apisar nga ginpahalugan na ang COVID-19 restrictions.
english: Energy Secretary Alfonso Cusi said work-from-home arrangements should also be extended despite the easing of COVID-19 restrictions.

text: Nagpanugyan man si Cusi sa Publiko nga maghagan hagan sa consumption sang produktong petrolyo bangud sa padayon nga pagsaka sa presyo sini.
english: Cusi also advised the public to reduce the consumption of petroleum products due to the continuous increase in prices.

text: Base naman sa pahayag ni acting Palace spokesperson Martin Andanar, ang amo nga mga rekomendasyon ang ginatun-an na ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Acting Palace spokesperson Martin Andanar said the recommendations are being studied by President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Samtang, suno sa National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA), madamo na ang nagapanawagan nga pataasan ang minimum wage kag fare hike nga sa gihapon ginadiskusyonan bangud sa posible impact sini sa eknomiya.
english: Meanwhile, according to the National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA), many are already calling for an increase in the minimum wage and fare hike which is still being discussed due to its possible impact on the economy.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Inflation rate sang pungsod ang nagapabilin nga yara sa 3 percent apisar sang nagapadayon nga kinagamo sa Russia kag Ukraine.
english: The country's inflation rate remains at 3 percent despite the ongoing conflict in Russia and Ukraine.

text: Masobra 100,000 ka tawo ang nagtambong sa dako nga hublag-protesta sa Luneta Park kag EDSA People Power Monument sang Setyembre 21 agud ipabutyag ang ila kaakig sa nagapadayon nga imbestigasyon sa korapsyon nga nagalakip sang bilyones nga pondo para sa flood control projects.
english: More than 100,000 people attended a massive protest rally at Luneta Park and the EDSA People Power Monument on September 21 to express their anger over the ongoing corruption investigation involving billions of dollars in funds for flood control projects.

text: Suno sa report ginabulubanta 50,000 ka tawo ang nagtambong sa “Baha sa Luneta, Aksyon sa Korapsyon” nga gin-organisar sang mga progresibo nga grupo, base sa data sang Manila Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office.
english: According to the report, an estimated 50,000 people attended the “Flood in Luneta, Action on Corruption” organized by progressive groups, based on data from the Manila Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office.

text: Sa EDSA kag White Plains Avenue naman, masobra sa 70,000 ang mga raliyista nga nagpadulong sa lugar.
english: On EDSA and White Plains Avenue, more than 70,000 rallyists gathered.

text: Nagpatigayon man sang rally kontra korapsyon sa Cebu City, Bacolod, kag Iloilo nga ginpangunahan sang pila ka mga katapo sang simbahang katolika.
english: Anti-corruption rallies were also held in Cebu City, Bacolod, and Iloilo led by several members of the Catholic Church.

text: Suno kay Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro, malinong ang mga protesta, magluwas lang sa Mendiola kun sa diin may mga nagkasamaran kag gin-aresto matapos magluntad ang kinagamo sa diin nagpanghaboy ang mga ini sang bato kag ginsunog ang mga goma sang truck.
english: According to Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro, the protests were peaceful, except in Mendiola where some were injured and arrested after a riot broke out where they threw stones and burned truck tires.

text: Gin-report sang National Capital Region Police Office nga 39 ka pulis ang nasamaran kag 17 ang gin-aresto.
english: The National Capital Region Police Office reported that 39 police officers were injured and 17 arrested.

text: Ginpahayag man nga mga menor de edad ang pila sa mga nagpanguna sang gamo.
english: Some of the leaders of the riots were also said to be minors.

text: Sa tunga sang protesta nasiplatan nga nagtambong sanday ML Rep.

text: Nakuha sang Serbian tennis star nga si Novak Djokovic ang iya ika-pito nga Wimbledon men’s singles title (apat diri ang sunod-sunod nga titulo) kag ang iya ika-21 nga grand slam title overall matapos ginlutos ang Australian maverick nga si Nick Kyrgios sa Centre Court sa London, 4-6, 6-3, 6-4, 6-6.
english: Serbian tennis star Novak Djokovic captured his seventh Wimbledon men’s singles title (four of which were consecutive titles) and his 21st grand slam title overall after defeating Australian maverick Nick Kyrgios on Center Court in London, 4-6, 3-4, 6-6.

text: Ang amo nga Wimbledon match amo ang una nga Grand Slam final sang 27-anyos nga si Kyrgios kag ika-32 naman para sa 35-anyos nga si Djokovic.
english: The Wimbledon match was the first Grand Slam final for 27-year-old Kyrgios and the 32nd for 35-year-old Djokovic.

text: Sa handum ni Kyrgios nga mangin labing-una nga male Grand slam champion sang Australia sa sulod na sang 20 ka tuig, nagpakitang-gilas ini kag nadag-an ang first set sa sulod lang sang 31 ka minutos.
english: In his desire to become Australia's first male Grand Slam champion in 20 years, Kyrgios showed his strength and won the first set in just 31 minutes.

text: Wala man nagpasugot si Djokovic kag gingamit naman sini ang iya eksperyensya kag disiplina agud nga mabasahan ang hulag ni Kyrgios kag madominar ang second set, 6-3, nga amo ang nangin turning point sa hampang.
english: Djokovic did not agree and used his experience and discipline to read Kyrgios' moves and dominate the second set, 6-3, which became the turning point in the match.

text: Si Djokovic amo man ang winner sa amo nga prestihiyoso nga tennis tournament sang 2018, 2019 kag 2021 (wala natigayon ang 2020 tournament bangud sa Covid-19 pandemic).
english: Djokovic was also the winner at that prestigious tennis tournament in 2018, 2019 and 2021 (the 2020 tournament was not held due to the Covid-19 pandemic).

text: Bangud sini, isa na lang ka grand slam title ang abanse sang men’s all-time record holder nga si Rafael Nadal sang Espanya.
english: As a result, men's all-time record holder Rafael Nadal of Spain is only one grand slam title ahead.

text: Ginakabig sang mga Pinoy nga nagsuporta kay President-elect Donald Trump nga kadalag-an sang kaayuhan kontra sa kalainan ang natabo nga resulta sang eleksyon sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: Filipinos who supported President-elect Donald Trump consider the election results in the United States of America as a victory of good over evil.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent John Tacapan direkta sa California, pro- God kag pro-people ang gin-elihir sang mga pumuluyo bangud sa mas positibo nga panindugan ni Trump sa pila ka isyu kun ipaanggid sa panindugan ni Harris.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent John Tacapan directly in California, pro-God and pro-people were elected by the people because of Trump's more positive stance on some issues compared to Harris's.

text: Pahayag ni Tacapan vocal proponent sang reproductive rights kag abortion si Kamala samtang may mga reservations naman si Trump sa amo nga isyu.
english: Tacapan said Kamala is a vocal proponent of reproductive rights and abortion while Trump has reservations on the issue.

text: Suno kay Tacapan, dismayado man ang mga pumuluyo sa malala nga economic inflation bangud sa Joe Biden-Harris policies may kaangtanan sa paggasto sang binilyon nga dolyares para suportahan ang giyera sang Ukraine batok sa Russia.
english: According to Tacapan, the people are also disappointed with the severe economic inflation due to Joe Biden-Harris policies related to spending billions of dollars to support Ukraine's war against Russia.

text: Pahayag ni Tacapan, kaangay nga naga-overspend ang US government sa butang nga wala man sang direkta nga maayo nga epekto sa mga pumuluyo.
english: Tacapan said the US government seems to be overspending on things that have no direct positive impact on the people.

text: Dugang niya, indi man kumbinsido ang mga tawo sa diversity ,equity, kag inclusion policy ni Harris bangud naga-promote ini sang employment sa mga incompetent nga mga mamumugon.
english: He added that people are not convinced of Harris' diversity, equity, and inclusion policy because it promotes employment of incompetent workers.

text: Isa man sa gintumod ni Tacapan nga negatibo nga butang sa kampanya ni Harris amo ang pag-endorso sa iya sang mga kilala nga celebrities nga apisar may yara sang ginaduso nga mga adbokasiya para sa women empowerment, nagapabulag-bulag naman sa isyu sang pag-exploit sa mga kababainhan.
english: Tacapan also pointed out that one of the negative things in Harris' campaign is the endorsement of her by well-known celebrities who, despite their advocacy for women empowerment, turn a blind eye to the issue of exploitation of women.

english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Punong Barangay Francisco Sudaria said the suspect first complained to him that May-may brought a man to their house despite the fact that they have children.

english: He also revealed that they are scheduled to appear on Sunday, this week, to resolve the case.

text: ILOILO CITY- Aprubado na sang House Committee on Energy ang amendments sa Downstream Oil Industry Deregulation Act of 1998 sa tunga sang padayon nga pagtimbuok sang presyo sang gatong.
english: ILOILO CITY – The House Committee on Energy has approved amendments to the Downstream Oil Industry Deregulation Act of 1998 amid the continuous rise in fuel prices.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Bayan Muna Rep.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Bayan Muna Rep.

text: Carlos Zarate, iya ginpahayag nga sa amo nga ginaduso nga hagna, i- require ang mga oil companies nga mag- maintain sang Minimum Inventory Requirement sa per company, per depot, kag per product basis.
english: Carlos Zarate, he said that in the proposed bill, oil companies will be required to maintain a Minimum Inventory Requirement on a per company, per depot, and per product basis.

text:
Suno kay Zarate, sa idalom sang proposal, gina-require man ang tanan nga refiners, importers kag distributors nga mag-maintain sang 30 ka adlaw nga balor sang supplies kag kinahanglan nga magpasa man ang mga oil companies sang retail prices sa Department of Energy nga may yara sang masunod nga mga detalye:

1.landed cost of crude oil sa tion nga ini ang ginbakal2.additional costs nga nagalakip sang port charges, refining costs, storage costs, marketing costs kag iban pa

Ginaduso man ni Zarate ang dalayon na nga pagkakas sang excise tax sa fuel.
english:
According to Zarate, under the proposal, all refiners, importers and distributors are also required to maintain 30 days worth of supplies and oil companies are also required to submit retail prices to the Department of Energy with the following details:

1.landed cost of crude oil at the time it is purchased2.additional costs which include port charges, refining costs, storage costs, marketing costs etc

Zarate also pushed for the immediate abolition of the excise tax on fuel.

text: Suno pa sa opisyal, sa sulod sang masobra duha ka dekada, nakit-an niya kun ano ang malain nga epekto sang nasambit nga layi sa ekonomiya kag pumuluyo kag paagi sa ginaduso nga hagna, mahatagan gahum ang gobyerno nga mabusisi ang mga libro sang oil companies kag malantaw kun sila ang nagapamentaha sa fuel crisis agud makaginansya.
english: The official said that for more than two decades, he has seen the negative impact of the said law on the economy and the people and through the proposed bill, the government will be empowered to check the books of oil companies and see if they are exploiting the fuel crisis to make a profit.

text: Ini nga proposed amendments sa oil deregulation law ang kinahanglan pa nga mag-agi sa pila ka proseso antes madala sa plenaryo kag mapirmahan agud mangin laye.
english: These proposed amendments to the oil deregulation law still need to go through several processes before being brought to the plenary and signed into law.

text: Apang sa subong, ginahulat pa sang mga mamalidha kun magapatawag sang special session si Presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english: However, lawmakers are still waiting for President Rodrigo Duterte to call a special session.

text: Nahibaluan nga yara subong sa three-month election campaign break ang kongreso.
english: Congress is currently on a three-month election campaign break.

text: Nagtanyag ang National Commission for Culture and the Arts (NCCA) nga ila pintahan kag panamion ang mga commercial sites sa City Proper agud makaganyat sang mas madamo nga mga turista kag mapasanyog pa gid ang heritage tourism sang syudad.
english: The National Commission for Culture and the Arts (NCCA) has offered to paint and beautify commercial sites in the City Proper to attract more tourists and further promote the city's heritage tourism.

text: Suno kay Mayor Raisa Treñas, ini isa ka maayo nga oportunidad para sa syudad kag nagapasalamat ini nga siya ang nagapungko nga alkalde sang gintanyag ini sang commission.
english: According to Mayor Raisa Treñas, this is a good opportunity for the city and she is grateful that she was the incumbent mayor when the commission offered it.

text: Natalana nga magpadulong sa Iloilo City sa Hulyo 13 ang mga tiglawas sang NCCA para mahitso ang memorandum of agreement kaupod ang city government.
english: NCCA representatives are scheduled to visit Iloilo City on July 13 to sign a memorandum of agreement with the city government.

text: Suno sa alkalde, sa subong, nagapadayon ang pagtakos sa mga buildings nga pintahan agud matumod kun ano kadamo nga pinta ang kinahanglanon.
english: The mayor said the measurement of the buildings to be painted is ongoing to determine how much paint is needed.

text: Nagpanawagan man ini sa mga engineers kag architects nga luyag magbulig.
english: He also appealed to engineers and architects who want to help.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginakabig nga heritage zone ang bilog nga JM Basa Street nga kilala man bilang Calle Real bangud sa mga heritage buildings nga napreserba sang mayo.
english: The entire JM Basa Street, also known as Calle Real, is considered a heritage zone because of the heritage buildings that have been preserved.

text: Lauman nga may matabo nga bigtime rollback sa presyo sang produktong petrolyo sa masunod nga semana.
english: A bigtime rollback in petroleum product prices is expected next week.

text: Ini matapos man ang 11 ka sunod sunod nga semana nga pagsaka sa presyo sini.
english: This also comes after 11 consecutive weeks of increases in its price.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa pinakaulihi nga trading sa world market, nagnubo ang presyo sang langis.
english: It is known that in the latest trading in the world market, the price of oil fell.

text: Suno kay Jetti Petroleum President Leo Bellas, mahimo nga maglab-ot sa P10 ang rollback sa presyo sang diesel kag P4 naman sa gasolina.
english: According to Jetti Petroleum President Leo Bellas, the rollback in the price of diesel could reach P10 and P4 in the price of gasoline.

text: Nahibaluan nga subong lang nga Martes, nagpatuman ang halos tanan nga oil company sa pungsod sang P13.15 nga pagsaka sa presyo sa kada litro sang diesel kag P7.10 sa kada litro sang gasolina.
english: On Tuesday, almost all oil companies in the country implemented a P13.15 price increase per liter of diesel and P7.10 per liter of gasoline.

text: Dako ang gintungdan nga papel sang panindugan nanday president-elect Donald Trump sang Republican Party kag Kamala Harris sang Democratic Party sa desisyon sang mga botante sa America.
english: The positions of president-elect Donald Trump of the Republican Party and Kamala Harris of the Democratic Party played a big role in the decision of American voters.

text: Si Trump ang kilala nga nagapamatok sa pagsulod sang illegal immigrants sa US samtang si Harris naman ang pabor diri.
english: Trump is known to oppose illegal immigrants entering the US while Harris is in favor of it.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Rufino Pinoy Gonzales direkta sa Texas, wala nagustuhan sang Latino Community, Black Americans, kag mangin sang mga Pinoy ang polisa sang subong nga administrasyon nga nagatolerar sang illegal immigrants.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Rufino Pinoy Gonzales directly in Texas, the Latino community, Black Americans, and even Filipinos do not like the policy of the current administration that tolerates illegal immigrants.

text: Pahayag pa ni Gonzales, yara sa 20 million ang mga illegal immigrants nga ginapasulod sa Estados Unidos kag dako ang epekto sini sa ekonomiya.
english: Gonzales said there are about 20 million illegal immigrants entering the United States and this has a huge impact on the economy.

text: Nahibaluan nga lunsay nangibabaw si Trump kay Harris sa popular vote kag electoral votes.
english: Trump beat Harris in both the popular vote and electoral votes.

text: Nakakuha si Trump sang 295 electoral votes samtang 226 naman ang kay Harris.
english: Trump received 295 electoral votes while Harris received 226.

text: 270 lang ang kinahanglan agud magdaug.
english: Only 270 is needed to win.

text: Base naman sa popular votes, nakakuha si Trump sang masobra 72 million samtang 67 million ang nakuha ni Harris.
english: Based on popular votes, Trump got more than 72 million while Harris got 67 million.

text: KON ANO na lang ang luyag naman ipamangkot sa aton sang aton abyan nga si Pedro.
english: WHAT question does our friend Peter want to ask us?

text:
Siling niya: “Ngaa daw sa wala lang gamalisya ang doktor nga lalake samtang nagatatap sa wala panapot nga dalaga nga pasyente?”

Ambot sa imo Pedro a!
english:
He said: “Why does the male doctor seem to be doing nothing wrong while attending to the naked young patient?”

I don't know about you Peter!

text: Man, kon suod niya nga himata ukon abyan, natural indi niya mahimo mag-malisya sa pasyente nga ina.
english: Man, if it is his close relative or friend, naturally he cannot be malicious towards that patient.

text: Pero kon indi niya ini suod nga himata ukon abyan, basi.
english: But if it’s not his close relative or friend, maybe.

text: Kag ina kon pasugtan niya ang iya dutan-on nga balatyagon sa opposite sex.
english: And that’s if he indulges his earthly feelings for the opposite sex.

text: In other words, madaug sang pensar sang tawo ang dutan-on nga balatyagon sa opposite sex bisan ano pa nga tentasyon kon luyagon niya.
english: In other words, the human mind can overcome earthly feelings for the opposite sex no matter what temptation if it wants to.

text: Mind over feelings ang rule, hambalon pa.
english: Mind over feelings is the rule, so to speak.

text: Ina nga disiplina kabahin sang tinun-an kag mental training sang doktor.
english: That discipline is part of the doctor's education and mental training.

text: Pang-siyensya na lang ang amo nga talan-awon nga indi dapat malisyahan.
english: The scene is scientific and should not be taken lightly.

text: Nonetheless, may tion man nga mapukaw ang balatyagon sang tawo sa opposite sex tungod sa madamo nga tentasyon halin sa iya kaugalingon kag sa palibut kon pasugtan sang iyo pensar, nga masami nagakatabo sa mga nagahingurosgan nga mga kabataan tungod indi pa gid nila lubos ma-kontrol ang ila dutan-on nga kaluyag sa opposite sex.
english: Nonetheless, there are times when a person's feelings for the opposite sex are aroused because of many temptations from himself and the environment if your mind allows it, which often happens to children who are struggling because they cannot fully control their earthly desires for the opposite sex.

text: Kag sapwan na lang sang ila ginikanan nga gabusong na si inday.
english: And their parents find out that their mother is pregnant.

text: Of course, lain man kon abnormal ang mental kag sexual behaviour sang isa ka tawo.
english: Of course, it's different if a person's mental and sexual behavior is abnormal.

text: Kasubong sang may sexual addiction nga ginapasugtan lang ang iya compulsive sex desire pareho sang maniac nga luyag mang-biktima sa wala hinalong-ong ukon wala sing makabulig nga mabiktima niya.
english: Like a sexual addict who just allows his compulsive sex desire like a maniac who wants to victimize the unconscious or helpless victim.

text: Lakip na diri ang may sakit sing Oedipus complex nga may sexual desire sa iya iloy.
english: This includes the Oedipus complex sufferer who has a sexual desire for his mother.

text: Ukon may balatian nga necrophilia nga luyag makig-sex sa patay.
english: Or a necrophilia sufferer who wants to have sex with the dead.

text: Kag kasubong nga sexual aberration.
english: And such a sexual aberration.

text: Amo gid ina bala?
english: Is that really it?

text:
***

Nalipay kita sang ginahimo sang gobyerno sa mga labing kubos (very poor) naton nga mga kautoran, katulad sang 4Ps nga programa para sa ila agud mabuligan mapatapos sang ginikanan ang ila kabataan kag maka-kurso agud makabulig sing maayo sa ila pamilya.
english:
***

We are happy with what the government is doing for our very poor brothers and sisters, such as the 4Ps program for them to help parents finish their children and get a course to help their families.

text: Subong man ang libre nga edukasyon kag healthcare sa government hospitals para sa imol.
english: As well as free education and healthcare in government hospitals for the poor.

text: Nahangpan ini sang mga may ikasarang kag manggaran naton nga mga pumuluyo nga luyag pa gani magbulig agud makahatag sing trabaho sa wala ubra sa ila mga negosyo ukon sa kon ano pa nga mapaubra nila.
english: This is understood by our capable and wealthy citizens who even want to help provide jobs for the unemployed in their businesses or in whatever else they can do.

text: Lakip na ang dugang nga bulig nila paagi sa mga charity foundation kag NGOs nga nagatatap sa mga street children kag kulang-palad sa nagakalain-lain nila nga private welfare programs.
english: This includes their additional assistance through charity foundations and NGOs that take care of street children and the less fortunate in their various private welfare programs.

text: Ugaling daw wala naton matagaan sing bagay nga atensyon ang aton mga “low income but not poor” tubtub sa “middle class” income, nga samtang may ikasarang sabton ang basic kag essential needs sang pamilya mawagtang naman sa emergency expenses.
english: However, it seems that we have not given enough attention to our “low income but not poor” to “middle class” income, who while able to meet the basic and essential needs of the family are lost in emergency expenses.

text: Naga-income lang sila kada bulan, sunu sa Philippine Institute for Development Studies (PIDS) report sadtong 2018, sang masunod: Low income but not poor – P10,957 to P21, 954; Lower middle – P21,954 to P43, 828; kag Middle – P43,828 to P76,669, nga kon may savings indi gid makatumbas kon iguon sang emergency katulad sang pagpa-ospital sa pribado nga ospital.
english: Their monthly income, according to the Philippine Institute for Development Studies (PIDS) report in 2018, is as follows: Low income but not poor – P10,957 to P21,954; Lower middle – P21,954 to P43, 828; and Middle – P43,828 to P76,669, which if there are savings can not be enough in the event of an emergency such as hospitalization in a private hospital.

text: Ejemplo lang sang na-ospital ang isa ka senior citizen nga na-belong sa “lower middle class”.
english: For example, a senior citizen who belongs to the lower middle class was hospitalized.

text: Naospital ang asawa sing apat ka adlaw sa isa ka pribado nga ospital.
english: The wife was hospitalized for four days at a private hospital.

text: Sang maggwa sa ospital, ang ginbayran nila – akomodasyon sa ospital, espesyalista nga mga doktor, kag bulong – nagdangat tanan sa P104,000!
english: When they left the hospital, what they paid – hospital accommodation, specialist doctors, and medicine – totaled P104,000!

text: Sa ila income (pension) nga wala pa P20,000 kada bulan, wala na gani sila seguro sang bisan diutay nga savings.
english: With their income (pension) of less than P20,000 per month, they probably don't even have the slightest savings.

text: Basi may utang pa.
english: Maybe there's more debt.

text: Ti paano ini nila mabayaran, nga daan bulag na sa ila ang ila kabataan kag kabulig lang ang upod nila nga gina-suwelduhan pa?
english: How can they pay for it, when their children are already separated from them and their companions are only paid helpers?

text: Maayo lang kay may sobra pa sa ila pangabuhi ang ila kabataan nga may kaugalingon na nga mga pamilya.
english: Fortunately, their children have more than enough to live on and have families of their own.

text: Kon pigado man abe, ano na lang?
english: If you're poor, what's the point?

text: Ang iban gani ginapalagyuhan na lang nila ang ospital.
english: Some even run away from the hospital.

text:
***

Tungod sini, kinahanglan seguro nga ma-subsidize sang gobyerno ang mga pribado nga mga ospital agud makabulig sa mga “low income but not poor” tubtub “middle income” nga mga pasyente.
english:
***

Because of this, the government should probably subsidize private hospitals to help low income but not poor to middle income patients.

text: Kag kon pwede, nga makapatindug ang gobyerno, nasyonal ukon mga LGU, sang “economy hospital”para sa ila, nga samtang indi man libre manubo ang pagpanukot.
english: And if possible, that the government, national or LGUs, can build an “economy hospital” for them, which while not free, low fees.

text: Katulad bala sa “economy class” sa eroplano kag pagbaligya sang mas barato nga NFA rice./PN
english: Is it like economy class on a plane and selling cheaper NFA rice./PN

text:
(Paalala, may paksa tungkol sa depresyon.)

Naglabas ng damdamin ang aktres na si Claudine Barretto matapos maospital dahil sa depresyon, kasabay ng panawagang unawain ang mga taong dumaranas nito.
english:
(Note, there is a topic about depression.)

Actress Claudine Barretto has expressed her feelings after being hospitalized for depression, along with a call to understand the people who are experiencing it.

text: Sa isang Instagram post, ibinahagi ni Claudine ang ilang larawan habang nasa ospital, kalakip ang pahayag na ang kaniyang kalagayan ay patunay na ang depresyon ay hindi basta-basta nakikita sa panlabas na anyo.
english: In an Instagram post, Claudine shared a picture of them while in the hospital, including a statement that her condition is proof that depression is not just visible on the outside.

text: Nanawagan siyang huwag agad husgahan ang may pinagdaraanan, at iginiit ang pangangailangan ng mas malawak na pag-unawa at malasakit.
english: He called for a lack of judgment, and stressed the need for broader understanding and compassion.

text: Nagpaabot naman ng suporta ang ilang personalidad gaya nina Vilma Santos at Vina Morales.
english: Some personalities such as Vilma Santos and Vina Morales expressed their support.

text: Ayon sa kanila, naroon sila upang ipadama ang pagmamahal at panalangin para sa aktres.
english: According to them, they are here to express their love and prayers for the actress.

text: Ang depresyon ay isang malubhang kondisyon sa kalusugan ng isip na may malalim na epekto sa pag-iisip, emosyon, at kilos ng isang indibidwal.
english: Depression is a serious mental health condition that has a profound effect on an individual's thinking, emotions, and behavior.

text: Maaari itong magdulot ng matinding lungkot at mawalan ng gana o interes sa mga bagay na dati’y nagbibigay saya o kasiyahan sa kaniya.
english: It can cause intense sadness and loss of appetite or interest in things that used to give him joy or satisfaction.

text: Kung ikaw o may kilala kang nangangailangan ng makakausap, maaaring tumawag sa crisis hotline ng Philippine National Center for Mental Health sa mga numerong 0917-899-8726 para sa Globe o TM, 0908-639-2672 para sa Smart, Sun, o TNT, o 1553 na maaaring tawagan ng libre saan mang panig ng bansa.
english: If you or someone you know needs someone to talk to, you can call the crisis hotline of the Philippine National Center for Mental Health at 0917-899-8726 for Globe or TM, 0908-639-2672 for Smart, Sun, or TNT, or 1553 for free.

english:

A Grade 12 student committed suicide in front of his classmates and teachers in their classroom in Lian, Batangas.

text: Ang biktima amo si alyas BJ, 17-anyos, kag estudyante sang Lian Institute, Inc.
english: The victim was identified as BJ, 17, a student of the Lian Institute, Inc.

text: School sa amo nga lugar.
english: School in the area.

text: Suno sa gwardiya sang eskwelahan, nakit-an niya ang amo nga estudyante nga may dala nga pusil gani iya ini ginsita kag ginhambalan nga isurrender ini.
english: According to the school guard, he saw the student with a gun and stopped him and told him to surrender.

text: Apang hinali lang nagpalupok si alyas BJ sang duha ka beses.
english: But suddenly alias BJ fired twice.

text: Sa ikatatlo nga lupok, didto na natumba ang biktima kag naglapta ang dugo sa salog.
english: In the third shot, the victim fell down and blood spread on the floor.

text: Gindala pa ini sa ospital apang wala na natabangan pa.
english: He was rushed to the hospital but was not helped.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sa insidente.
english: The investigation into the incident is ongoing.
