text: Hambal nila, ang eleksyon daw hampang lang gid nga indi mo mapaktan kun sin-o ang madaug tubtob matapos ang hampang.
english: They say that elections are like a game where you can't predict who will win until the game is over.

text: Halimbawa diri amo ang natabo sa Russia kun sa diin isa ka alkalde nga nagpadalagan para sa reelection ang napierde sang iya kasumpong nga asawa sang iya personal nga driver.
english: An example of this is what happened in Russia where a mayor who ran for reelection was defeated by his opponent, the wife of his personal driver.

text: Ini amo si Yevgeny Pistsov, ang mayor sang Berezovsky, isa ka satellite city sang Yekaterinburg, sa Sverdlovsk region.
english: This is Yevgeny Pistsov, the mayor of Berezovsky, a satellite city of Yekaterinburg, in the Sverdlovsk region.

text: Ang reelection kuntani ni Pistsov, nga nagahandom nga magpungko sa ikapaat nga consecutive term bilang mayor, ang isa ka formality na gid lang kuntani bangud nagpadalagan siya batok sa kaangay nga member man sang United Russia political party ni of Vladimir Putin.
english: The reelection of Pistsov, who aspires to serve a fourth consecutive term as mayor, was supposed to be a formality because he ran against a fellow member of Vladimir Putin's United Russia political party.

text: Ang iya kasumpong amo si Yulia Maslakova nga wala man naglaum nga magdaug banugd isa lamang siya ka puppet candidate.
english: His opponent is Yulia Maslakova who did not expect to win because she is only a puppet candidate.

text: Apang sa kakibot sang tanan, siya ang nagdaug.
english: But to everyone's surprise, he won.

text: Sa Berezovsky, ang mayor ang wala gina- elect direkta sang mga tawo kundi sang mga deputies base sa proposal sang isa ka selection committee.
english: In Berezovsky, the mayor is not elected directly by the people but by deputies based on the proposal of a selection committee.

text: Ang deputies ang masami nga representatives sang mga local kag regional authorities.
english: The deputies are usually representatives of local and regional authorities.

text: Subong nga tuig, ginsiling nga ginhingyo sang deputies ang selection committee nga tugutan nga mas madamo ang kandidato nga pilian apang sang ulihi sanday Mayor Pistsov kag si Yulia Maslakova lamang ang nagpadalagan.
english: This year, deputies were said to have asked the selection committee to allow more candidates to be selected but in the end only Mayor Pistsov and Yulia Maslakova ran.

text: Sa adlaw sang election gikan sa 23 deputies, 17 ang nagboto pabor kay Maslakova kag anom lang kay Pitsov.
english: On election day out of 23 deputies, 17 voted in favor of Maslakova and only six for Pitsov.

text: Ginpahayag nga gintuyo pa ni Maslakova nga mag-withdraw apang imposible na bangud nagdaug na siya.
english: Maslakova reportedly tried to withdraw but it was impossible because she had already won.

text: May yara siya subong sang duha ka semana nga mag-take sang oath apang wala siya sang plano nga dayunon ini.
english: He now has two weeks to take the oath but has no plans to follow through.

text: Kun indi magpanumpa si Maslakova, kinahanglan nila nga magpatigayon na lang liwat sang eleksyon.
english: If Maslakova does not take the oath, they will have to hold another election.

text: Nagalaum si Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas nga magbuyloganay ang iya anak nga si Raisa Treñas-Chu kag si Vice Mayor-Elect Love love Baronda.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas hopes that his daughter Raisa Treñas-Chu and Vice Mayor-Elect Love love Baronda will work together.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga bilang isa ka bise-alkalde na si Baronda, tion na agud nga mag-reconcile sa ngalan sang serbisyo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Treñas said that as a vice-mayor, it is time for Baronda to reconcile in the name of service.

text: Suno kay Treñas, kinahanglan nga maglab-otanay ang duha ka kamot agud nga maka-extend sang bulig sa isa kag isa.
english: According to Treñas, both hands need to reach out in order to extend help to each other.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga kon indi man magbaton ang kampo sang Baronda sa ginlaragway sini nga ‘friendship’ padayunon sa gihapon nila ang pag-alagad sa pumuluyo.
english: He also explained that even if the Baronda camp does not accept what he described as 'friendship', they will continue to serve the people.

text: Dugang sang alkalde nga indi man mapilit kon indi pa handa ang ila kampo para sa tinutuyo sini.
english: The mayor added that he will not be forced if their camp is not ready for its purpose.

text: Ginpun-an sang pag-intindi, maayo nga pamatasan kag pagpalangga sang duha ka mga iloy nga taga- San Enrique, Iloilo ang ila puluy-an rason nga nangin maayo ang pagpadako sang mga ini sa ila nga mga kabataan.
english: The two mothers from San Enrique, Iloilo filled their home with understanding, good manners and love, which made them raise their children well.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Josephine Paborada, iloy sang 13 ka kabataan iya ginpahayag nga wala ginkalimtan sang iya mga kabataan ang pamatasan nga ila natun-an sa ila puluy-an bangud nagbunga ini sang maayo nga resulta.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Josephine Paborada, mother of 13 children, said her children have not forgotten the behavior they learned at home because it yielded good results.

text: Iya man ginpahayag nga sa tyempo sa karon tuman ka importante ang pagpa-eskwela sa mga kabataan agud maagom sang mga ini ang mayo nga buwas damlag.
english: He also said that in the present time it is very important to educate the children so that they can have a better tomorrow.

text: Bilang isa ka kagawad sang una suno pa sa iya nga importante nga mangin inspirasyon sa iban indi lamang sa kaugalingon sini nga mga kabataan kundi pati man sa komunidad.
english: As a former kagawad, he said it is important to be an inspiration to others not only to his own children but also to the community.

text: Samtang, suno naman kay Melinda Aneversario, iloy sang walo ka mga kabataan, iya ginpahayag nga ginpadako sini ang iya mga kabataan nga may disiplina kag may ara sang husto nga paminatasan.
english: Meanwhile, Melinda Aneversario, mother of eight children, said she raised her children with discipline and good manners.

text: Ginpunto man sini nga apisar indi perpekto ang isa ka pamilya, dapat mangin ehemplo gihapon ang ginikanan sa iya mga kabataan nga unahon permi ang pamilya.
english: He also pointed out that even if a family is not perfect, parents should still be an example to their children to always put the family first.

text: Nagpabutyag man ini sang iya pangabay sa gobyerno nga maghatag sang dugang nga mga programa sa pangabuhian ukon livelihood para sa kababainhan agud mangin malapad pa ang ila mga kinamatarong.
english: She also expressed her request to the government to provide more livelihood programs for women to expand their rights.

text: Suno sa iya, importante nga may suporta ang gobyerno agud mapasangkad ang papel sang kababainhan sa pamilya kag komunidad.
english: She said it was important to have government support to expand the role of women in the family and community.

text: Nagnubo ang unemployment kag underemployment rate sa Pilipinas sang Nobyembre 2025 kumpara sang bulan sang Oktubre, suno sa Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA).
english: The unemployment and underemployment rate in the Philippines decreased in November 2025 compared to the month of October, according to the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA).

text: Ini nagakahulugan nga mas madamo nga pumuluyo ang nakakita sang obra kag nagnubo man ang mga indibdiwal nga nagapangita pa sang dugang nga kita.
english: This means that more residents have found work and the number of individuals who are still looking for additional income has decreased.

text: Apisar sini, mas mataas sa gihapon ang unemployment rate sang tug 2025 kun ikumpara sang Nobyembre tuig 2024.
english: Despite this, the unemployment rate in 2025 will still be higher compared to November 2024.

text: Paathag sang PSA nga dako ang naging epekto sang mabaskog nga mga bagyo nga Tino kag Uwan nga nakaapekto sa sektor pareho sang hotel, kalan-an, kag komersyo, nga nagresulta sa madamo ka indibidwal ang nadulaan sang madamo nga obra.
english: The PSA explained that the strong typhoons Tino and Uwan had a huge impact on sectors such as hotels, restaurants, and commerce, resulting in many individuals losing their jobs.

text: Panibag-o nga bulawan nga medalya ang nakuha ni Pinoy pole-vaulter EJ Obiena sa Jump and Fly Meet sa Germany.
english: Pinoy pole-vaulter EJ Obiena won a new gold medal at the Jump and Fly Meet in Germany.

text: Nalampasan sini ang 5.80 meters kag gin-dominar ang three-player field.
english: It cleared 5.80 meters and dominated the three-player field.

text: Ini na ang iya nga ikaduha nga gold medal sa sulod lang sang isa ka semana kag ika-anum naman nga gold medal subong lang nga tuig.
english: This is his second gold medal in just one week and his sixth gold medal this year.

text: Ang isa niya ka gold (subong nga semana) ang nadag-an niya sa Taby Stavhoppsgala sa Sweden sang Hunyo 29.
english: Her one gold (this week) was won by her at the Taby Stavhoppsgala in Sweden on June 29th.

text: Sa Germany, na-clear ni Obiena ang 5.20m, 5.40m, kag 5.60m, kag tatlo ka beses nga nag-attempt antes na-clear ang 5.80m.
english: In Germany, Obiena cleared 5.20m, 5.40m, and 5.60m, and took three attempts before clearing 5.80m.

text: Gintinguhaan man sang 26-anyos nga atleta nga gub-on ang Asian record nga 5.93m (record nga siya man mismo ang nagauyat) apang tatlo ka beses man siya nga napaslawan nga ma-clear ang 5.94m.
english: The 26-year-old also tried to break the Asian record of 5.93m (a record he also holds himself) but he also failed three times to clear 5.94m.

text: China ang nakakuha sang silver medal samtang Germany naman ang nakabulsa sang bronze.
english: China won the silver medal while Germany pocketed the bronze.

text: ILOILO CITY – Tuman ang kalipay sang Ilonggo singer nga si JM Bales matapos nag-trending ang iya ambahanon nga ‘Magandang Dilag’.
english: ILOILO CITY – Ilonggo singer JM Bales is very happy after his song 'Magandang Dilag' became trending.

text: Ang nasambit nga ambahanon amo ang official nga soundtrack sa swimsuit competition sang Miss Universe Philippines 2020.
english: The song is the official soundtrack of the swimsuit competition of Miss Universe Philippines 2020.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Bales nga tumandok sang Barotac Nuevo, Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga tatlo ka tuig pa lang, nagtuon na siya sa pagkanta sa diin ang iya amay amo ang nagserbe niya nga voice coach.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Bales, a native of Barotac Nuevo, Iloilo, said he learned to sing when he was three years old and his father served as his voice coach.

text: Suno kay Bales, ginakabig niya nga dako nga break ang paghatag sa iya sang kahigayunan nga magkanta sa Miss Universe Philippines 2020.
english: According to Bales, she considers it a big break to be given the opportunity to sing at Miss Universe Philippines 2020.

text: Ginpahayag ni Bales nga madugay na niya nga ginapangamuyo nga mahatagan sang kahigayunan nga makaangkon sang isa ka ambahanon nga mangin bantog.
english: Bales said he had been praying for a long time to be given the opportunity to have a song that would become famous.

text: Ginkalipay man ni Bales nga kadungan man sang iya pagtrending sang iya ambahanon nga ‘Magandang Dilag’ amo man ang pagdaog sang iya kaangay niya nga Ilonggo nga si Rabiya Mateo nga tumandok sang Balasan, Iloilo bilang Miss Universe Philippines 2020.
english: Bales was also pleased that at the same time as her song 'Magandang Dilag' was trending, her fellow Ilonggo Rabiya Mateo, a native of Balasan, Iloilo, won Miss Universe Philippines 2020.

text: Ginakabig man sang natungdan nga double victory ang natabo para sa mga Ilonggo.
english: He also considered what happened as a double victory for the Ilonggos.

text: ILOILO CITY– Mas madamo pa nga negosyo nga ginatukod sa syudad sang Iloilo subong nga naga amat-amat pa lamang recover ang syudad nagikan sa epekto sang COVID-19.
english: ILOILO CITY – More businesses are being established in Iloilo City as the city is slowly recovering from the impact of COVID-19.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo City mayor Jerry Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga isa sa madamo nga negosyo sa syudad amo ang BPO companies.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas said that one of the many businesses in the city are BPO companies.

text: Suno sa alkalde, barato kag estable ang suplay sang kuryente subong kun ikumpara sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: The mayor said the electricity supply is cheap and stable now compared to last year.

text: Dugangan pa nga ‘safe’ ang syudad para sa mga negosyo.
english: He added that the city is safe for businesses.

text: Madamo man suno sa alkalde sang mga graduates ang syudad nga nabudlayan nga magpadulong sa gwa sang pungsod, gani nagatrabaho bilang mga call center agents.
english: The mayor said there are also many graduates in the city who find it difficult to travel abroad, so they work as call center agents.

text: Magluwas sa mga BPO companies, madamo man sang mga real estate projects nga ginatukod.
english: Apart from BPO companies, there are also many real estate projects under construction.

text: Ang mga estudyante nga naga eskwela diri ang nagatinir sa mga condominium units.
english: The students who attend here live in condominium units.

text: Sa pihak sang epekto sang COVID-19, sa sulod sang tatlo ka tuig, wala nagpasaka ang syudad sang real estate tax kag lauman nga malawig pa ini sa masunod pagid nga tatlo ka tuig.
english: Despite the impact of COVID-19, for three years, the city has not increased the real estate tax and is expected to increase it for the next three years.

text: Ginkalipay sang alkalde ang maayo nga fiscal management nga nagresulta sang masobra sa P400M nga surplus sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: The mayor welcomed the good fiscal management that resulted in more than P400M surplus last year.

text: Nagtawag na si Vice President Kamala Harris kay former President Donald Trump agud magpanginbulahan sa kadalag-an sini sa 2024 US presidential election.
english: Vice President Kamala Harris has called former President Donald Trump to congratulate him on his victory in the 2024 US presidential election.

text: Sa amo man nga tawag naplastar ni Harris ang matawhay nga transfer of power kag ginhingyo nga mangin presidente si Trump sa tanan nga mga Amerikano.
english: In the same call, Harris laid out the peaceful transfer of power and asked all Americans to make Trump president.

text: “[Harris] called President-elect Trump to congratulate him on winning the 2024 presidential election.
english: “[Harris] called President-elect Trump to congratulate him on winning the 2024 presidential election.

text: She discussed the importance of a peaceful transfer of power and being a president for all Americans,” suno sa senior aide sang bise-presidente.
english: She discussed the importance of a peaceful transfer of power and being a president for all Americans,” according to the vice-president’s senior aide.

text: Ginalauman naman nga magahatag sang mensahe si Harris sa Howard University sa Washington, D.C. ginabanta alas kuwatro sa hapon (Nobyembre 6, oras sa district).
english: Harris is expected to deliver a message at Howard University in Washington, D.C. approximately 4 pm (November 6, district time).

text: Maragtason ang pagbalik ni Trump, 78, sa pinakamataas nga posisyon sa Estados Unidos Unidos matapos ini nalutos sa 2020 election sa kamot ni current President Joe Biden.
english: Trump, 78, returned to the highest office in the United States after being defeated in the 2020 election by current President Joe Biden.

text: Natabo man ini nga comeback apisar sang iya tuyo nga baliskadon anay ang resulta sang nagligad nga eleksyon, may ginapangatubang nga duha ka presidential impeachments, kay may yara sang criminal conviction kag iban pa nga criminal charges.
english: This comeback also happened despite his intention to overturn the results of the last election, facing two presidential impeachments, because there are criminal convictions and other criminal charges.

text: Nakuha sini ang kadalag-an matapos nalab-ot ang 270 Electoral College votes nga kinahanglan para maangkon ang ikaduha sini nga presidency.
english: He won after reaching the 270 Electoral College votes needed to win his second presidency.

text: Daog na bilang presumptive president sang Amerika si  Republican presidential nominee Donald Trump.
english: Republican presidential nominee Donald Trump has won the presidency of the United States.

text: Nahibaluan nga kinahanglan sang 270 ka electoral votes antes magdaog sa eleksyon.
english: It is known that 270 electoral votes are needed to win the election.

text: Apang ini ang nalapawan pa ni Trump sa diin nakakuha ini sang 277 ka electoral votes.
english: But Trump surpassed it with 277 electoral votes.

text: Ginlutos naman ni Trump si Democratic presidential nominee U.S. Vice President Kamala Harris.
english: Trump defeated Democratic presidential nominee U.S. Vice President Kamala Harris.

text: Nakakuha lang si Harris sang 226 ka electoral votes.
english: Harris only got 226 electoral votes.

text: Sa pagdaog ni Trump, automatic nga magapungko bilang vice president ang running mate sini nga si Senator JD Vance.
english: If Trump wins, his running mate, Senator JD Vance, will automatically become vice president.

text: Matandaan nga nangin presidente na si Trump sang United States humalin sang 2017 tubtob 2021.
english: Trump served as president of the United States from 2017 to 2021.

text: MANILA – Patok sa netizens ang Halloween costumes sang pila ka celebrity Kids may kaangtanan sa pagsaulog sang Tigkalalag.
english: MANILA – The Halloween costumes of some celebrity kids in connection with the celebration of Tigkalalag are against netizens.

text: Ang anak nanday Marian Rivera kag Ding Dong Dantes nga si Zia ang nag-ala Princess Jasmine paagi sa pagsuksok sang matching harem pants kag top nga may gold trimmings.
english: Marian Rivera and Ding Dong Dantes’ daughter Zia went Princess Jasmine-style by wearing matching harem pants and a top with gold trimmings.

text:
Ang buhok naman ni Zia ang kasubong gid kay Princess Jasmine sa pelikula nga “Aladdin.”

Isa man sa mga nagpa-wow amo si Scarlet Snow Belo nga anak sang celebrity doctor nga sanday Hayden Kho kag Vicky Bello.
english:
Zia's hair looks like Princess Jasmine in the movie "Aladdin."

Also among those who wowed was Scarlet Snow Belo, daughter of celebrity doctor Hayden Kho and Vicky Bello.

text: Si Scarlet ang nangin isa ka Queen of Hearts kasubong sa live-action remake sang “Alice in Wonderland samtang ang iya naman nga ginikanan ang nagserbe nga Knave of Hearts kag Mad Hatter.
english: Scarlet became a Queen of Hearts as in the live-action remake of “Alice in Wonderland” while her parents served as the Knave of Hearts and Mad Hatter.

text: Nag-ala Disney princess Belle naman ang anak nanday Pauleen Luna kag Vic Sotto nga si Tali.
english: Pauleen Luna and Vic Sotto's daughter Tali played Disney princess Belle.

text: Ang first-time parents nga sanday Billy Crawford kag Coleen Garcia ang nagsuksok sang adult-size Piglet and Tigger costume samtang ang ila anak nga si Amari ang nagsusok naman sang Winnie the Pooh onesie.
english: First-time parents Billy Crawford and Coleen Garcia wore an adult-size Piglet and Tigger costume while their daughter Amari wore a Winnie the Pooh onesie.

text: Wala man nagpaulihi si Mariel Rodriguez nga nagpatigayon sang intimate Halloween party para sa anak nga sanday Isabella kag Gabriela nga nagsuksok sang pineapple kag dwarf planet Pluto nga costume.
english: Mariel Rodriguez also held an intimate Halloween party for daughters Isabella and Gabriela dressed in pineapple and dwarf planet Pluto costumes.

text: ILOILO CITY- Padayon sa pagnubo ang stocks sang frozen pork sa pungsod sa ikatatlo na nga sunod-sunod nga semana.
english: ILOILO CITY – Stocks of frozen pork in the country continue to decline for the third consecutive week.

text: Suno kay Chester Warren Tan, presidente sang National Federation of Hog Farmers Inc., may yara sila sang repopulation efforts agud madugangan ang supplies sang local nga karne sang baboy.
english: Chester Warren Tan, president of the National Federation of Hog Farmers Inc., said they have repopulation efforts to increase supplies of local pork.

text: Base sa latest data gikan sa National Meat Inspection Service, ang inventory sang frozen pork as of March 7 ang yara sa 51,121.42 metric tons (MT) gikan sa 54,464.07 ukon 6.1 percent nga pagnubo.
english: Based on the latest data from the National Meat Inspection Service, the inventory of frozen pork as of March 7 stood at 51,121.42 metric tons (MT) from 54,464.07 or 6.1 percent decline.

text: Apang ini nga figure ang mas mataas sang 150.4 percent gikan sa 20,419.77 MT sa pareho man nga period sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: However, this figure was 150.4 per cent higher from 20,419.77 MT in the same period last year.

text: Ang imported nga karne sang baboy sa accredited commercial kag in-house cold storages ang nagabug-os sang mayorya sang frozen pork stocks nga yara sa 50,145.13 MT,samtang ang locally produced pork ang yara lang sa 976.29 MT.
english: Imported pork in accredited commercial and in-house cold storages accounted for the majority of frozen pork stocks at 50,145.13 MT, while locally produced pork was only at 976.29 MT.

text: ILOILO CITY- Amat-amat na nga mabatyagan sang mga konsumidor sang Iloilo Electric Cooperative (ILECO) II ang epekto sang padayon nga pagtaas sang presyo sang produktong petrolyo.
english: ILOILO CITY – Consumers of the Iloilo Electric Cooperative (ILECO) II are slowly feeling the impact of the continuous increase in the price of petroleum products.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Engr.

text: Jose Redmond Roquios, general manager sang Iloilo Electric Cooperative (ILECO) II, iya ginpahayag nga nagataas ang ila generation cost bangud 50% sang ila gina-source out nga power supply ang nagahalin sa coal plant.
english: Jose Redmond Roquios, general manager of Iloilo Electric Cooperative (ILECO) II, said their generation cost is increasing because 50% of their sourced power supply comes from coal plants.

text: Suno kay Roquios, epekto ini sang pagmahal man sang presyo sang gina-import nga coal nga ginagamit sang mga planta nga naglab-ot na sa 400 dollars per metric ton.
english: According to Roquios, this is the effect of the increase in the price of imported coal used by the plants which has reached 400 dollars per metric ton.

text: Pahayag ni Roquios, bangud sini, posible nga sa bulan sang Abril, madugangan sang 50 centavos tubtob 1 pesos per kilowatt hour ang electric bill sang mga konsumidor.
english: Roquios said that because of this, it is possible that in April, the electricity bill of consumers will increase by 50 centavos to 1 pesos per kilowatt hour.

text: Gin-athag naman sang natungdan nga magluwas sa generation cost, wala na sang iban nga adjustment nga makaapekto sa balayran sang mga konsumidor sang ILECO II.
english: He explained that apart from the generation cost, there are no other adjustments that will affect the bills of ILECO II consumers.

text: May nakit-an nga 𝙊𝙥𝙝𝙞𝙤𝙥𝙝𝙖𝙜𝙪𝙨 𝙝𝙖𝙣𝙣𝙖 sa Miagao, Iloilo.
english: There is a found in Miagao, Iloilo.

text: Ang 𝙊𝙥𝙝𝙞𝙤𝙥𝙝𝙖𝙜𝙪𝙨 𝙝𝙖𝙣𝙣𝙖 ang mas kilala sa komon nga tawag nga 𝙆𝙞𝙣𝙜 𝘾𝙤𝙗𝙧𝙖.
english: 𝙊𝙥𝙝𝙞𝙤𝙥𝙝𝙖𝙜𝙪𝙨 𝙝𝙖𝙣𝙣𝙖 is better known by the common name 𝙆𝙞𝙣𝙜 𝙆𝗾𝙜𝗙.

text: Nakit-an ini sa premises sang University of the Philippines Visayas- Miagao Campus.
english: It was found on the premises of the University of the Philippines Visayas- Miagao Campus.

text: Ang nasambit nga man-og ang ginabanta nagalaba sang 3 meters.
english: The snake is estimated to be 3 meters long.

text: Si UPV wildlife expert, Mr. Marlon Ong ang nag-handle sa amo nga man-og.
english: UPV wildlife expert, Mr. Marlon Ong handled the snake.

text: Paagi naman kay Forester Isidro C. Mosura, Jr.
english: Through Forester Isidro C. Mosura, Jr.

text: sang MENRO Miagao, ginturn-over ang King Cobra sa CENRO Guimbal bilang kabahin sang insakto nga protocol.
english: of MENRO Miagao, turned over the King Cobra to CENRO Guimbal as part of the proper protocol.

text: Mas nagbaskog pa ang Severe Tropical Storm Nando samtang nagahulag ini pa-naaminhan nakatundan sa Philippine Sea.
english: Severe Tropical Storm Nando intensified as it moved northwest into the Philippine Sea.

text: Santo sa alas singko sa kaagahon nga weather bulletin sang PAGASA, ulihi nga nakit-an ang sentro sini 780 km nasidlangan sang Casiguran, Aurora.
english: According to the 5:00 am weather bulletin of PAGASA, the epicenter was last seen 780 km east of Casiguran, Aurora.

text:
Dala sang bagyo ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga 100 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 125 km/h.

Wala pa sang wind signal nga napaguwa ang weather bureau subong, apang dugang sa bulletin, mahimo ipasaka ang Signal Number 1 sa Northern Luzon subong nga adlaw.
english:
The typhoon brought winds of 100 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 125 km/h.

The weather bureau has not yet issued a wind signal, but in addition to the bulletin, Signal Number 1 may be raised in Northern Luzon today.

text: Ang pinakamataas nga Wind Signal nga mahimo ma-isyu amo ang No.
english: The highest Wind Signal that can be issued is No.

text: Base sa track forecast, magahulag ang bagyo pa-naaminhan-nakatundan sa masunod nga 24 oras antes ini magliso pa-nakatundan naaminhan-nakatundan padulong sa Extreme Northern Luzon.
english: Based on the track forecast, the typhoon will move northwest in the next 24 hours before turning west northwest towards Extreme Northern Luzon.

text: Magalabay ang bagyo malapit —ukon mahimo gid mag-landfall — sa Batanes ukon sa Babuyan Islands sa tunga-tunga sang Lunes sang hapon tubtub sa gab-i. Samtang nagapalapit naman sa kadutaan, mahimo pabaskugon sang bagyo ang Habagat ukon ang Southwest Monsoon sa lain-lain nga bahin sang pungsod lakip na diri sa Visayas.
english: The typhoon will pass near — or may make landfall — in Batanes or the Babuyan Islands between Monday afternoon and evening. As it approaches land, the typhoon may strengthen the Habagat or Southwest Monsoon in various parts of the country including here in the Visayas.

text: Gindugang pa sa bulletin nga magalab-ot si Nando sa typhoon category sa masunod nga 12 oras kag super typhoon nga kategorya naman sa Lunes, Septyembre 22.
english: The bulletin added that Nando will reach the typhoon category in the next 12 hours and the super typhoon category on Monday, September 22.

text: Base pa sa PAGASA, mahimo magguwa ang bagyo sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) sa Martes, Septyembre 23, sa aga ukon sa udto.#
english: According to PAGASA, the typhoon may exit the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) on Tuesday, September 23, morning or noon.

text: Liwat nga nabawi sang Republicans ang US Senate kag nalab-ot ang ginakabig pinakamahapos nga handom para sa partido sa subong nga tuig nga eleksyon.
english: Republicans once again took back the US Senate and achieved what was considered the easiest goal for the party in this year’s election.

text: Nauyatan liwat sang GOP ang kontrol matapos nangin maathag nga napierde ang Democrats sa ila one-seat majority sa 100-member upper chamber sang kongreso.
english: The GOP regained control after it became clear that Democrats lost their one-seat majority in the 100-member upper chamber of Congress.

text: Nakuha sang Republicans ang duha ka Senate seats matapos ginpierde sang Trump-backed businessperson nga si Bernie Moreno si three-term Democratic senator Sherrod Brown sa Ohio, kag Trump loyalist Jim Justice nga nakuha ang seat nga nauyatan sadto ni Joe Manchin sa West Virginia.
english: Republicans captured both Senate seats after Trump-backed businessperson Bernie Moreno defeated three-term Democratic senator Sherrod Brown in Ohio, and Trump loyalist Jim Justice captured the seat previously held by Joe Manchin in West Virginia.

text: Ginpierde man sang Republican incumbents ang ila Democratic challengers sa Texas kag Florida.
english: Republican incumbents also defeated their Democratic challengers in Texas and Florida.

text: Ini nga result nagabutang sa Republican party sa pole position sa confirmation process para sa senior officials nga gin- appoint sang bag-o nga incoming administration, kag para sa potential new justices sa US supreme court kun may bakante nga magabukas.
english: This result puts the Republican party in pole position in the confirmation process for senior officials appointed by the new incoming administration, and for potential new justices on the US supreme court if a vacancy opens.

text: Indi magnubo sa duha ka veteran conservative justices nga sanday Clarence Thomas kag Samuel Alito ang ginalauman nga magretiro sa masunod nga pila ka tuig.
english: At least two veteran conservative justices Clarence Thomas and Samuel Alito are expected to retire in the next few years.

text: Ang transfer sang Senate control pabalik sa Republicans ang magapa-excite pa sa race agud mag- succeed kay Mitch McConnell, ang GOP leader sa chamber nga una na nag-anunsyo nga magaretiro ini matapos ang eleksyon.
english: The transfer of Senate control back to Republicans will further excite the race to succeed Mitch McConnell, the GOP leader in the chamber who earlier announced he would retire after the election.

text: Ang mga leading contenders nga magabulos sa iya amo sanday John Thune sang South Dakota, Texas senator John Cornyn kag Rick Scott sang Florida, sa diin ang magadaug ang maga- assume sang gamhanan nga posisyon sang Senate majority leader.
english: The leading contenders to succeed him are John Thune of South Dakota, Texas senator John Cornyn and Rick Scott of Florida, with the winner assuming the powerful position of Senate majority leader.

text: Arestado ang Top 3 Most Wanted Person sa Western Visayas kasunod sang ginpatigayon nga manhunt operation sa Brgy.
english: The Top 3 Most Wanted Person in Western Visayas was arrested following a manhunt operation in Brgy.

text: Purok 4, Pavia, Iloilo.
english: Purok 4, Pavia, Iloilo.

text: Ang nadakpan amo si Alyas “Juny”, 44-anyos, kag residente sang Brgy.
english: The suspect was identified as Juny, 44, resident of Brgy.

text: Ungka I, Pavia, Iloilo.
english: Ungka I, Pavia, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Gabriel Manguera, Deputy Chief of Police sang Pavia Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga naaresto ang suspek paagi sa warrant of arrest sa kaso nga murder ginpaguwa sang Regional Trial Court, Sixth Judicial Region, Iloilo City.
english: Police Lieutenant Gabriel Manguera, Deputy Chief of Police of the Pavia Municipal Police Station, said the suspect was arrested on a warrant of arrest for murder issued by the Regional Trial Court, Sixth Judicial Region, Iloilo City.

text: Suno kay Manguera, non-bailable ukon wala sang pyansa ang kaso nga gindagdag sa suspek.
english: According to Manguera, the case against the suspect is non-bailable.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang suspek ang ginatudlo nagpatay sa 56-anyos nga indibidwal sa Brgy.
english: The suspect allegedly killed a 56-year-old man in Brgy.

text: Ungka II, Pavia, Iloilo, sang Abril 2024.
english: Ungka II, Pavia, Iloilo, in April 2024.

text: Preso subong si Alyas Juny sa Pavia Municipal Police Station samtang nakatalana nga ipasa sa korte ang legal nga proseso sang kaso sini.
english: Juny is currently detained at the Pavia Municipal Police Station while the legal process of his case is scheduled to be submitted to the court.

text: 15 ka mga estado sa Amerika ang nag-deploy sang National Guard personnel para sa Election Day.
english: 15 American states have deployed National Guard personnel for Election Day.

text: Ini amo ang Alabama, Arizona, Delaware, Hawaii, Illinois, Iowa, New Mexico, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, Washington, Wisconsin kag West Virginia.
english: These are Alabama, Arizona, Delaware, Hawaii, Illinois, Iowa, New Mexico, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, Washington, Wisconsin and West Virginia.

text: Ini nga mga tropa ang naga-assist sa cybersecurity missions samtang ang iban ang nagahatag sang suporta base sa local requests.
english: These troops assist in cybersecurity missions while others provide support based on local requests.

text: Suno sa National Guard Bureau, may yara man sang 85 members nga naka- standby sa Colorado; Washington, DC; Florida kag Nevada.
english: According to the National Guard Bureau, there are also 85 members on standby in Colorado; Washington, DC; Florida and Nevada.

text: Sang weekend, antes ang potensyal nga ginamo sang mga sibilyan angot sa presidential election, ginsiling sang National Guard nga naka- standby ini bilang precautionary measures sa pila ka estado,kalakip ang Washington kag Oregon, kun sa diin nareport nga ginatos nga mga balota ang na-damage ukon naguba matapos ginsiling sang mga officials nga indi magnubo sa tatlo ka ballot drop boxes ang ginpangsunog.
english: Over the weekend, ahead of potential civil unrest over the presidential election, the National Guard said it was on standby as precautionary measures in several states, including Washington and Oregon, where hundreds of ballots were reportedly damaged or destroyed after officials said at least three ballot drop boxes were burned.

text: Ginhimuslan ang 7 anyos nga babayi sa Brgy Granada, Bacolod City sang isa ka lalaki nga pangayaw lamang sa lugar.
english: A 7-year-old girl was raped in Brgy Granada, Bacolod City by a man who was a stranger in the area.

text: Suno kay Punong Brgy Armando Vito, sang Hunyo 29, kapin alas- 4:00 sang hapon, gindala sang 9- anyos nga magulang ang iya 7- anyos nga manghod agud magsag-ob sang tubig.
english: According to Punong Brgy Armando Vito, on June 29, around 4:00 pm, the 9-year-old elder brother took his 7-year-old brother to fetch water.

text: Apang ginpapungko sang magulang ang iya manghod sa bato samtang siya naman nagsag-ob sang tubig.
english: But the older brother sat his younger brother on the rock while he fetched water.

text: Naglabay ang suspek kag nakita sini ang 7- anyos nga iya ginbutong kag gindala sa isa ka payag.
english: The suspect passed by and saw the 7-year-old whom he picked up and took to a hut.

text: Didto na sini ginhimo ang pagpanghimulos sa biktima.
english: He then raped the victim.

text: Wala na nakapangayo sang bulig ang bata bangod nakita sini nga may dala nga espading kag kutsilyo ang suspek.
english: The child was unable to call for help because he saw the suspect carrying a sword and a knife.

text: Naghibi na lamang ang bata sang nagdugo na ang iya kinatawo samtang nalagyo naman ang suspek sa wala nahibaluan nga direksyon.
english: The child cried when he started bleeding from his genitals while the suspect fled in an unknown direction.

text: Suno kay Vito, una nga nanugid ang bata sa iya tiya kag bangod naglapta na sa lugar ang isturya, natigayon nga nakapalagyo ang suspek samtang ulihi naman napalab-ot sa brgy.
english: According to Vito, the child first told his aunt and because the story spread in the area, the suspect managed to escape while later reached brgy.

text: hall ang natabo.
english: hall happened.

text: Naghambal man ang bata nga masami siya ginahatagan sang kwarta kag ginapahulam sang cellphone sang suspek.
english: The child also said that the suspect often gave him money and lent him a cellphone.

text: Nahibaluan naman nga ang duha lang ka mag-utod ang magka-upod sa ila balay bangod ang ila amay nagabyahe kag gab-i na kun magpauli samtang ang ila naman nga iloy may yara na sang bag-o nga pamilya.
english: It was learned that only the two brothers were together in their house because their father was traveling and came home late while their mother had a new family.

text: Nahibaluan man nga ang suspek ang may himata lamang sa lugar kag nagapangayaw lamang didto kag may yara sang kaso sa pagpanghimulos.
english: It was also learned that the suspect has only relatives in the area and only visits there and has a case of rape.

text: Pahayag ni Vito, tuman ang iya kasubo sa naagyan sang bata kag nagpasalig nga kun indi magpasaka sang kaso ang amay, sila mismo sa brgy mahatag sang hustisya para sa 7- anyos nga biktima.
english: Vito said he is very sad about the child's experience and assured that if the father does not file a case, they themselves in the brgy will provide justice for the 7-year-old victim.

text: Maga-upod ang civic group nga Jalaur River for the People Movement sa daku nga protesta nga patigayunon sang nanuhay-tuhay nga mga sektor sa Domingo, Septyembre 21, sa tuyo nga manawagan batok sa lapnagon nga kurapsyon.
english: The civic group Jalaur River for the People Movement will join the massive protest to be held by various sectors on Sunday, September 21, with the aim of calling out against rampant corruption.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo sa coordinator sang grupo nga si John Ian Alenciaga, iya gintawag ang Jalaur River Multipurpose Project Phase II sa Calinog, Iloilo nga amo ang “pinadaku nga flood control scam” sa isla sang Panay.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, the group's coordinator, John Ian Alenciaga, called the Jalaur River Multipurpose Project Phase II in Calinog, Iloilo the “biggest flood control scam” on the island of Panay.

text: Nagpahayag ini sang pagkaalarma bangud nag-doble suno sa ila ang pondo sa proyekto nga lab-ot na sa P20.09 billion halin sa inisyal nga P11.2 billion sang ini ang gin-proponer.
english: He expressed alarm because the fund for the project has doubled to P20.09 billion from the initial P11.2 billion when it was proposed.

text: Ginbulgar man sang grupo ang ila ginpahayag nga ila natukiban nga sang 2024, nagbaton ang proyekto sang P7.088 billion nga unprogrammed funds ukon kabahin sang insertions sang Kongreso.
english: The group also revealed what they said they discovered that in 2024, the project received P7.088 billion in unprogrammed funds or part of Congress' insertions.

text: “Kun may ara man kita sang ginapangita nga daku nga scam sa halambalanon sa flood control, dapat ma-imbestigaran, dapat mabusisian ang ini nga Jalaur Mega Dam Project,” suno kay Alenciaga.
english: “If we are looking for a big scam in the flood control issue, it should be investigated, this Jalaur Mega Dam Project should be investigated,” Alenciaga said.

text: Matandaan nga sang 2024, mismo si President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: It can be recalled that in 2024, President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: ang nagpanguna sa inagurasyon sang phase 2 sang Jalaur dam project nga amo ang una nga large-scale water reservoir sa guwa sang Luzon.
english: presided over the inauguration of phase 2 of the Jalaur dam project which is the first large-scale water reservoir off Luzon.

text:
‘FALSE, INCOMPLETE, AND MALICIOUS STATEMENTS’

Nagpaguwa naman sang statement ang National Irrigation Administration (NIA) nga nagapaandam batok sa mga sala nga impormasyon kaangot sa proyekto.
english:
‘FALSE, INCOMPLETE, AND MALICIOUS STATEMENTS’

The National Irrigation Administration (NIA) issued a statement warning against misinformation regarding the project.

text: Wala ini sang gintumod nga grupo nga amo ang ginhalinan sang statement, apang pahayag sini, nagalapta ini online kag sa mga unibersidad sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: He did not identify the group that originated the statement, but said it was spreading online and in universities in Iloilo City.

text: “The public is hereby cautioned to be deliberate and to exercise due diligence about these false, incomplete and malicious statements of certain groups and individuals,” suno sa NIA.
english: “The public is hereby cautioned to be deliberate and to exercise due diligence about these false, incomplete and malicious statements of certain groups and individuals,” according to the NIA.

text: Gindugang sini nga ini nga mga claims sang pila ka mga grupo ang ginahungod gid agud nga mapatalang ang publiko.
english: He added that these claims of some groups are being fabricated to mislead the public.

text: “The inaccurate and unsubstantiated claims of these groups were purposely meant to distort facts and mislead public.
english: “The inaccurate and unsubstantiated claims of these groups were purposely meant to distort facts and mislead public.

text: All these claims and accusations should have been properly addressed had these group/s/individuals exercised due diligence in its inquiry with the office.
english: All these claims and accusations should have been properly addressed had these group/s/individuals exercised due diligence in its inquiry with the office.

text: Its accusations are not only bereft of any factual basis but may have been derived from unreliable source thus, resulting to inaccurate conclusions,” dugang sa Facebook post sang ahensya.
english: Its accusations are not only bereft of any factual basis but may have been derived from unreliable source thus, resulting to inaccurate conclusions,” the agency added in a Facebook post.

text: Pahayag sang NIA, ang National Economic Development Authority (NEDA) Board nga ginapangunahan mismo ni President Marcos ang nag-apruba sang Restructuring Request sang amo nga Jalaur project sang Hulyo 19, 2023.
english: According to the NIA, the National Economic Development Authority (NEDA) Board headed by President Marcos himself approved the Restructuring Request of the said Jalaur project on July 19, 2023.

text:
Ginpahayag nga nagalakip ini sang pagsaka sang budget nga lab-ot sa P 8.487 billion apang ini tanan ang nag-agi sa husto nga procedures kag guidelines paagi sa Investment Coordination Committee, kag gin-deliberate kag gin-aprubahan sang nagakaigo nga mga ahensya sang gobyerno.#

(Photo: Bongbong Marcos/FB)
english:
This reportedly includes a budget increase of P 8.487 billion but it all went through proper procedures and guidelines through the Investment Coordination Committee, and was deliberated and approved by the relevant government agencies.

(Photo: Bongbong Marcos/FB)

text: ILOILO CITY- Bugalon si Presidential Spokesperson Harry Roque bangud kasimanwa sang iya iloy ang ginkoronahan nga Miss Universe Philippines 2020 Rabiya Mateo.
english: ILOILO CITY- Presidential Spokesperson Harry Roque is proud that the crowned Miss Universe Philippines 2020 Rabiya Mateo is from his mother's country.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Roque, iya ginpadayaw nga indi magpapierde ang katahum sang mga Ilongga.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Roque, he praised the beauty of the Ilonggas.

text: Suno kay Roque nga nagpungko man bilang isa sa mga hurado, run-away winner si Rabiya sa swimsuit kutob sa interview portion.
english: According to Roque, who also sat as one of the judges, Rabiya was the run-away winner in the swimsuit from the interview portion.

text: Wala naman sang isyu para kay Roque ang nangin sabat ni Rabiya sa final QandA round sang ginmitlang sini si anay Senator Miriam Defensor Santiago bilang “the best president that we never had.”
english: Rabiya's response to the final QandA round was no issue for Roque when she referred to former Senator Miriam Defensor Santiago as “the best president that we never had.”

text: Nagbaskog pa kag nangin severe tropical storm ang Bagyo Nando.
english: Typhoon Nando strengthened into a severe tropical storm.

text: Base sa datus sang Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), ang sentro sang bagyo ang nahamtang sa 840-kilometer nasidlangan sang Central Luzon.
english: Based on data from the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), the epicenter of the typhoon was located 840-kilometers east of Central Luzon.

text: May kabaskugon ini sang hangin nga nagalab-ot sa 95 kilometros per ora kag pagmadlos nga nagalab-ot sa 115 kph.
english: It has winds of up to 95 kilometers per hour and gusts of up to 115 kph.

text: Ginalauman nga yara na sa Extreme Northern Luzon ang Bagyo Nando subong nga adlaw.
english: Typhoon Nando is expected to be in Extreme Northern Luzon today.

text: May posibilidad nga maga-landfall ini sa Lunes, Setyembre 22, sa isla sang Babuyan.
english: It is likely to make landfall on Monday, September 22, on Babuyan Island.

text: Nagpaandam man ang PAG-ASA nga delikado sa gihapon ang paglayag sa kadagatan nga possible matabunan sang bagyo.
english: PAG-ASA also warned that it is still dangerous to sail in seas that may be covered by typhoons.

text: Nakahanda ang Jhelord Taxi Management nga maggasto sang mga bills sa mga biktima lakip na ang duha ka mga napatay sa nagluntad nga insidente sa Barangay Bolong Este, Sta.
english: Jhelord Taxi Management is ready to pay the bills of the victims including the two who died in the incident in Barangay Bolong Este, Sta.

text: Barbara, Iloilo.
english: Barbara, Iloilo.

text: Ini kasunod sang pagbunggo sang taxi sa isa ka bus (CBL) nga nagatuyo magliko sa U-turn slot.
english: This follows the collision of a taxi with a bus (CBL) that was attempting to take a U-turn slot.

text: Ang mga biktima amo sanday Jomar Senerado, 39-anyos, sang Barangay Nadsadan, San Joaquin, Iloilo, driver sang Jhelord Taxi.
english: The victims were identified as Jomar Senerado, 39, of Barangay Nadsadan, San Joaquin, Iloilo, driver of Jhelord Taxi.

text: Nadalasa man sa aksidente ang nagakabit sa jeep nga Jeric Hualde Huyo, 29-anyos sang Barangay Ito Sur, Cabatuan.
english: Jeric Hualde Huyo, 29, of Barangay Ito Sur, Cabatuan, was also injured in the accident.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rodrigo Muyco Baculado, Operation Manager sang Jhelord Taxi corporation, iya ginpahayag nga ginahulat sang ila talatapan nga maguwa ang police report agud nga matumod ang balor sang danyos nga ila ibulig sa mga biktima.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Rodrigo Muyco Baculado, Operation Manager of Jhelord Taxi Corporation, said his office is waiting for the police report to be released to determine the value of the damage they will help the victims.

text: Suno kay Baculado, indi pa sila kongkreto nga makapaguwa sang presumptions nahanungod sa insidente bangud mahimo makatuga ini sang dugang pa nga problema.
english: Baculado said they cannot concretely issue presumptions regarding the incident because it could cause more problems.

text: Ginalantaw naman sang natungdan nga ‘pure accident’ ang natabo kag indi man sini mabasol ang driver bangud isa man ini sa mga nagpatay kasunod sang insidente.
english: He said the incident was a pure accident and he could not blame the driver because he was one of the killers following the incident.

text: Gintuad man ni Baculado nga naka-first trip pa ang driver sang taxi kag nagapati ini nga yara ini sa insakto nga panghuna-huna.
english: Baculado also admitted that the taxi driver was on his first trip and believes he is in his right mind.

text: Nahibaluan nga wasak gid ang taxi lakip na ang unahan nga bahin sang bus matapos nakabunggo sa de-pampasahero nga jeep sang Janiuay kon sa diin, nahapit sini ang nagakabit nga pasahero kag nadalasa.
english: It was learned that the taxi and the front of the bus were badly damaged after it collided with a passenger jeep in Janiuay where it hit the passenger and was hit.

text: Tatlong miyembro ng isang pamilya ang nasawi habang isang senior citizen ang sugatan matapos sumiklab ang apoy sa kanilang ancestral house sa Barangay Ampid 1, madaling araw ng Linggo.
english: Three members of a family were killed while a senior citizen was injured after a fire broke out in their ancestral house in Barangay Ampid 1, early Sunday.

text: Kinilala ang mga nasawi bilang isang 60-anyos na ginang, ang kanyang 30-anyos na anak na babae, at ang 28-anyos na asawa nito.
english: The victims were identified as a 60-year-old woman, her 30-year-old daughter, and her 28-year-old husband.

text: Lahat sila ay naninirahan sa nasunog na bahay.
english: They all live in the burned house.

text: Nakaligtas ngunit nagtamo ng malubhang first-degree burns ang 64-anyos na ama ng pamilya, na nakatakas matapos tumalon mula sa ikalawang palapag ng kanilang bahay.
english: The 64-year-old father of the family, who escaped after jumping from the second floor of their house, survived but sustained serious first-degree burns.

text: Siya ay kasalukuyang ginagamot sa East Avenue Medical Center at kinakailangang lagyan ng tubo dahil sa hirap sa paghinga sanhi ng nalanghap na usok.
english: He is currently being treated at East Avenue Medical Center and requires a tube insertion due to difficulty breathing caused by the smoke.

text: Ayon sa ulat ng Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP), nagsimula ang sunog bandang alas-2:00 ng madaling araw at idineklarang first alarm.
english: According to the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP), the fire started around 2:00 am and was declared first alarm.

text: Nilabanan ng mga bombero ang apoy at naideklarang fire-out bandang alas-2:59 ng madaling araw.
english: Firefighters fought the fire and declared it fire-out at 2:59 am.

text: Sa pahayag ni Cecilio Ebunga, deputy chief ng Barangay Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office ng Ampid 1, natagpuan ang mag-asawa na patay sa loob ng comfort room.
english: According to Cecilio Ebunga, deputy chief of the Barangay Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office of Ampid 1, the couple were found dead inside the comfort room.

text: Pinili umano nilang pumasok dito upang makaiwas sa apoy ngunit na-trap at hindi makalabas.
english: They chose to enter here to avoid the fire but were trapped and could not get out.

text: Ang senior citizen naman ay natagpuan sa ground floor nang bumagsak ang flooring ng ikalawang palapag kung saan siya naharang ng apoy.
english: The senior citizen was found on the ground floor when the flooring of the second floor collapsed and he was blocked by fire.

text: Sa kabila nito, nagawang tumalon ng lalaki sa terrace ng bahay upang makatakas.
english: However, the man managed to jump from the terrace of the house to escape.

text: Ayon sa mga kapitbahay, hindi agad nagising ang mga biktima sa pagkalat ng apoy kaya’t napalaganap ito sa kanilang bahay pati na rin sa isang sasakyan na nakaparada sa loob ng compound.
english: According to the neighbors, the victims did not immediately wake up to the spread of the fire so it spread to their house as well as to a vehicle parked inside the compound.

text: Sinubukan nilang gisingin ang pamilya at kahit bumato sa bahay upang maabala ang mga ito ngunit hindi naging matagumpay.
english: They tried to wake up the family and even broke into the house to disturb the children but were unsuccessful.

text: Patuloy na iniimbestigahan ng mga arson investigator ang sanhi ng sunog pati na ang halaga ng nasirang ari-arian.
english: Arson investigators are still investigating the cause of the fire as well as the value of the damaged property.

text: May pila naman ka mga tuyo nga magtuga sang gamo kadungan sang Election Day sa lain-lain nga states sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: There are also several attempts to cause trouble during Election Day in various states in the United States of America.

text: Sa Michigan, arestado ang isa ka lalaki matapos nagpamahog nga magahimo sang pagpang-atake pananglitan magdaog sa pagkapresidente si Republican candidate Donald Trump.
english: In Michigan, a man was arrested after threatening to carry out an attack if Republican candidate Donald Trump wins the presidency.

text: Suno sa Department of Justice, ang gindakop amo si Isaac Sissel, 25, residente sang Ann Arbor sa amo nga state nga nagpadala sang alleged threat sa FBI National Threat Operations Center sang Nobyembre 2.
english: According to the Department of Justice, the arrested person was Isaac Sissel, 25, a resident of Ann Arbor in that state who sent the alleged threat to the FBI National Threat Operations Center on Nov. 2.

text: Natabo naman ang pag-aresto sa iya sang FBI sa adlaw mismo sang eleksyon.
english: He was arrested by the FBI on election day.

text: Sa Fowler, New York, dakop man ang isa ka lalaki matapos nagpamahog nga sunugon sini ang polling site samtang nagapadayon ang election.
english: In Fowler, New York, a man was also arrested after threatening to burn down a polling site during the election.

text: Suno sa New York State Police, na-convict anay ang lalaki bangud sa felony, kag ginpaathag sa iya nga indi siya pwede makaboto ilabi na bangud wala siya nakaparehistro liwat matapos nakaguwa sa presuhan.
english: According to the New York State Police, the man was previously convicted of a felony, and explained to him that he could not vote especially since he had not re-registered after being released from prison.

text: Nagpangakig ini kag didto na nagpamahog nga sunugon ang lugar ukon magbalik nga may dala nga armas.
english: He became angry and threatened to burn the place or return with a gun.

text: Nalagyo ini sang ulihi apang nadakpan sang state police, gindala sa estasyon, kag mahimo pasakaan sang kaso.
english: He later fled but was caught by state police, taken to the station, and could face charges.

text: Samtang, sa Washington, DC, arestado man ang isa ka lalaki nga may dala nga sulu kag flare gun sang nagtuyo ini nga magsulod sa Capitol Visitor Center.
english: Meanwhile, in Washington, DC, a man was arrested with a torch and a flare gun when he tried to enter the Capitol Visitor Center.

text: Wala sang session ang U.S. House of Representatives kag ang U.S. Senate sang natabo ang insidente.
english: The U.S. House of Representatives and the U.S. Senate were not in session when the incident occurred.

text: Sandig sa post sang department, nadakpan ang lalaki sa screen process sang na-notisyaran sang officers nga nagapanimaho ini sang fuel.
english: According to the department's post, the man was arrested during the screen process when officers noticed that he smelled fuel.

text: Sang gin-check, didto na nakit-an ang sulu kag ang flare gun.
english: When checked, the light and the flare gun were found.

text: Bangud sini, temporaryo nga gin-untat ang tours sa center kag gina-imbestigaran pa ang motibo sang lalaki.
english: As a result, tours of the center were temporarily suspended and the man's motive is still being investigated.

text: Ginpasaka na ang security precautions sa bilog nga district lakip ang gintukod nga temporary fencing sa palibot sang White House, Eisenhower Executive Office Building sa Capitol complex kag sa Naval Observatory nga amo ang ginapuy-an sang vice president.
english: Security precautions have been raised throughout the district including temporary fencing around the White House, the Eisenhower Executive Office Building in the Capitol complex and the Naval Observatory where the vice president lives.

text: Samtang, gina-imbestigaran sang United States intelligence officials ang email account nga nagagamit sang Russian internet domain bilang potensyal nga ginhalinan sang ginaalegar bomb threats kadungan sang election day sa state sang Georgia.
english: Meanwhile, United States intelligence officials are investigating an email account using a Russian internet domain as a potential source of alleged bomb threats on election day in the state of Georgia.

text: Wala naman sang kumpirmasyon ang American officials kun halin gid man sa Russia ang ginpang-email nga threats.
english: American officials have not confirmed whether the emailed threats came from Russia.

text: Ginalantaw sang mga imbestigador ang history sang mga aktibidad sang email account agud matumod kun sin-o ang yara sa likod sini.
english: Investigators are looking at the email account's activity history to determine who is behind it.

text: Ini nga non-credible threats ang nag-resulta sa temporary closure sang polling places sa Union City sa guwa sang Atlanta suno sa Fulton County police.
english: These non-credible threats resulted in the temporary closure of polling places in Union City outside of Atlanta according to Fulton County police.

text: BALASAN, ILOILO – Mabuot kag mainabyanon.
english: BALASAN, ILOILO – Kind and friendly.

text: Ini ang pagkilala sang iya mga himata kay Miss Universe Philippines 2020 Rabiya Mateo.
english: This is how her relatives recognized Miss Universe Philippines 2020 Rabiya Mateo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jun Mateo, tiyo ni Rabiya, iya ginpahayag nga nagdako si Rabiya nga may maayo nga paminatasan apisar sang pagbiya sa amay nga isa ka Indian national.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jun Mateo, Rabiya's uncle, said Rabiya grew up with good manners despite leaving her father, who is an Indian national.

text: Suno kay Mateo, makabig nga Lola’s girl si Rabiya kun sa diin ang iya Lola amo ang nagbulig sa iya iloy sa pagpadako kag pagpaeskwela tubtub nakatapos bilang Cum Laude kag nangin licensed Physical Therapist.
english: According to Mateo, Rabiya is considered a grandmother's girl where her grandmother helped her mother raise and educate her until she graduated as Cum Laude and became a licensed Physical Therapist.

text: Ginpahayag ni Mateo nga apisar sang mga pagpanghangkat sa kabuhi, nagapabilin sa gihapon nga positibo si Rabiya nga nagahandum nga makapadulong sa Estados Unidos agud makita ang iya biological father nga isa na ka American citizen.
english: Mateo said that despite the challenges in life, Rabiya remains positive and dreams of going to the United States to see her biological father who is now an American citizen.

text: Humalin sang Elementary, nakitaan na nga daan sang kaalam si Rabiya.
english: Since Elementary, Rabiya has already seen wisdom.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Charito Gabana, Elementary teacher ni Rabiya, iya ginpahayag nga maayo sa reasoning ang Ilongga-Indian beauty.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Charito Gabana, Rabiya's elementary teacher, said the Ilongga-Indian beauty is good at reasoning.

text: Sa pagkamatuod suno kay Gabana, ginhuna-huna niya nga mangin isa ka abogada si Rabiya apang mas sobra pa diri ang iya nalab-ot.
english: In fact, Gabana said, he thought Rabiya would become a lawyer but she achieved more than that.

text: Sa subong, ginpahayag sang natungdan nga tuman nga kalipay ang iya nabatyagan bilang anay manunudlo sang 23 anyos nga Miss Universe Philippines.
english: For now, she said she feels very happy as the former teacher of the 23-year-old Miss Universe Philippines.

text: Gindala sang Pilipinas ang walo ka mga medalya — lakip na ang duha ka gold — sa bag-o lang nagtakop nga 2022 Extreme Euro Open nga ginpatigayon sa Hodonice, Czech Republic.
english: The Philippines took home eight medals — including two golds — at the recently concluded 2022 Extreme Euro Open held in Hodonice, Czech Republic.

text: Gold medalist ang 2017 junior world shoot champion nga si Kahlil Adrian Viray sa standard division matapos nakakuha sang 2649 match points.
english: 2017 junior world shoot champion Kahlil Adrian Viray was a gold medalist in the standard division after scoring 2649 match points.

text: Ginpierde sini si Josef Rakusan nga amo ang 2018 European champion, amo man ang Latin American champion nga si Gaston Vallerga.
english: He defeated Josef Rakusan who was the 2018 European champion, as well as Latin American champion Gaston Vallerga.

text: Nakadaog man sang bulawan nga medalya si Alfredo Catalan Jr.
english: Alfredo Catalan Jr. also won the gold medal.

text: matapos nga gin-dominar ang classic division nga may 2481 match points.
english: after dominating the classic division with 2481 match points.

text: May yara sang 1,032 participants sa amo nga event nagikan sa 52 ka mga pungsod.
english: There were 1,032 participants in the event from 52 countries.

text: Election day na subong sa America kun sa diin minilyon ka mga Americans ang magapili sang masunod nga presidente sa tunga nanday Vice President Kamala Harris kag former President Donald Trump nga kada isa nagakinahanglan sang 270 electoral votes para magdaug.
english: It's election day in America where millions of Americans will choose the next president between Vice President Kamala Harris and former President Donald Trump who each need 270 electoral votes to win.

text: 244 million ka mga Americans ang eligible nga magboto kun sa diin 82 million ang una na nga nakaboto.
english: 244 million Americans are eligible to vote of which 82 million have already voted.

text: Handom ni Harris nga mangin pinakaunan nga babaye, Black, kag Asian-American nga magapamuno sa pungsod.
english: Harris dreams of becoming the first female, Black, and Asian-American to lead the country.

text: Ginapakilala niya ang iya opponent nga si Trump bilang pamahog sa demokrasya, samtang gina- emphasize ang commitment sa pagprotekta sa reproductive rights kag pagbuhin sang housing kag healthcare costs.
english: He characterizes his opponent Trump as a threat to democracy, while emphasizing a commitment to protecting reproductive rights and reducing housing and healthcare costs.

text: Siya ang nangin replacement candidate sang Democrats sang nag-atras si US President Joe Biden.
english: He became the replacement candidate of the Democrats when US President Joe Biden withdrew.

text: Si Trump naman nga handom ang isa ka political comeback, ang naga-capitalize sa polls nga nagapakita nga pabor ang mga Americans sa iya economic leadership kontra kay Harris.
english: Trump, who is hoping for a political comeback, is capitalizing on polls showing that Americans favor his economic leadership over Harris.

text: Nanumpa man ini sang iya hugot nga panindugan sa immigration, kag ginpromisa ang mass deportations kag pagpatuman sang tax cuts.
english: He also vowed his tough stance on immigration, and promised mass deportations and the implementation of tax cuts.

text: Kun magdaug, si Trump ang mangin una nga incoming president nga na- indict kag na-convict sang felony.
english: If he wins, Trump will become the first incoming president to be indicted and convicted of a felony.

text: Ginpadayaw sang Republican presidential candidate nga si former president Donald Trump nga wala ini sang ano man nga paghinulsol sa dalagan sang iya kampanya.
english: Republican presidential candidate former president Donald Trump has boasted that he has no regrets about the course of his campaign.

text: Ini kadungan sang iya pagboto sa Palm Beach, Florida.
english: This coincides with his vote in Palm Beach, Florida.

text: Suno kay Trump, ini ang pinakamaayo niya nga kampanya kun ipaanggid sang nagligad nga duha ka eleksyon kun sa diin una siya nangin presidente sang 2016 batok kay Hillary Clinton apang napierde sang 2020 batok kay President Joe Biden.
english: According to Trump, this is his best campaign compared to the last two elections where he first became president in 2016 against Hillary Clinton but lost in 2020 against President Joe Biden.

text: Pananglitan naman nga malutos, iya ginsiling nga batunon niya kag respetuhon ng resulta sang eleksyon.
english: If he loses, he said he will accept and respect the results of the election.

text: Nagboto naman si Republican vice presidential nominee JD Vance sa Cincinnati, Ohio.
english: Republican vice presidential nominee JD Vance voted in Cincinnati, Ohio.

text: Matapos nagboto, ginsiling ni Vance nga ginboto niya si Trump kag naghatag sang Election Day endorsement para kay Bernie Moreno sa U.S. Senate race batok kay incumbent Democrat Sherrod Brown.
english: After voting, Vance said he voted for Trump and gave an Election Day endorsement for Bernie Moreno in the U.S. Senate race against incumbent Democrat Sherrod Brown.

text: Sa bahin naman ni Harris, temprano pa ini nga nagboto antes pa man ang election day pinaagi sa mail.
english: Harris, on the other hand, voted early before election day by mail.

text: Samtang ang iya running mate naman nga si Governor Tim Walz ang nag-early vote sang October 23 sa Minnesota.
english: His running mate, Governor Tim Walz, voted early on October 23 in Minnesota.

text: Indi na magdugang ang Gilas Pilipinas sang ika-12 nga player para sa third window sang 2023 FIBA World Cup Asian Qualifiers.
english: Gilas Pilipinas will not add a 12th player for the third window of the 2023 FIBA ​​World Cup Asian Qualifiers.

text: Ini apisar indi makapasakop si Ange Kouame bangud sa iya nga injury– ang meniscal sprain kag partial ACL tear.
english: This is despite the fact that Ange Kouame will not be able to participate due to his injury – a meniscal sprain and partial ACL tear.

text: Sanday Kiefer Ravena kag Dwight Ramos ang magapanguna sa Gilas kaupod sanday RJ Abarrientos, SJ Belangel, Geo Chiu, Dave Ildefonso, LeBron Lopez, William Navarro, Carl Tamayo, Rhenz Abando, kag Kevin Quiambao.
english: Kiefer Ravena and Dwight Ramos will lead the Gilas alongside RJ Abarrientos, SJ Belangel, Geo Chiu, Dave Ildefonso, LeBron Lopez, William Navarro, Carl Tamayo, Rhenz Abando, and Kevin Quiambao.

text: Makasambuwa sang Gilas ang New Zealand (3-0) sa Auckland sa Hunyo 30 antes atubangon ang India (0-3) sa Mall of Asia Arena sa Hulyo 3.
english: The Gilas will play New Zealand (3-0) in Auckland on June 30 before facing India (0-3) at the Mall of Asia Arena on July 3.

text: Kun madumduman, may 1-1 record ang Gilas sa Pool A matapos nga ginlutos ang India apang napierde naman batok sa New Zealand sang Pebrero.
english: The Gilas have a 1-1 record in Pool A after beating India but losing to New Zealand in February.

text: Ang South Korea nga amo ang isa pa ka team sa Group A ang nadisqualify bangud wala ini naka-send sang team sa second window bangud sa COVID-19 issues.
english: South Korea, the other team in Group A, was disqualified because it did not send a team in the second window due to COVID-19 issues.

text: Posible ng ipasaka ang storm surge sa mga coatal area sa Northern Luzon, bangud sa mabaskog nga hangin dala sang bagyo nga Nando.
english: The storm surge is likely to rise in the coatal areas of Northern Luzon, due to strong winds brought by Typhoon Nando.

text: Suno kay Engr.
english: According to Engr.

text: Chris Perez, Asst.
english: Chris Perez, Asst.

text: Weather Services Chief sang DOST-Pagasa possible nga bwas nga adlaw sa Setyembre 20 ang umpisa nga maeksperyensyaha ang storm surge sa mga baybayon sa Northern Luzon.
english: Weather Services Chief of DOST-Pagasa said it is possible that tomorrow, September 20, the storm surge will begin to be experienced in the coasts of Northern Luzon.

text: Posible man nga buwas nga adlaw, magpagguwa na ang weather bureau sang storm surge warning bangud sa amo nga bagyo.
english: It is also possible that tomorrow, the weather bureau will issue a storm surge warning due to the typhoon.

text: Mabatyagan man ang tubtob 14 metros nga kataason sang balod sa northeastern seaboard sang pungsod.
english: Waves up to 14 meters high will also be felt in the country's northeastern seaboard.

text: Apisar ginapahanagutan pa subong nga makabyahe ang mga magagmay nga bangka para sa pagpangisda sa amo nga baybayon, ginapanugyan ni Perez ang ini nga likawan anay nga magpalawod umpisa buwas tubtod nga ipasaka na mismo ang storm surge warning.
english: Although small boats are still allowed to sail for fishing on the beach, Perez advised them to avoid sailing starting tomorrow until the storm surge warning is lifted.

text: Masobra sa 250 ka National Guard personnel ang nagasuporta sa 15 ka states sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika kadungan sang Election Day.
english: More than 250 National Guard personnel are supporting 15 states in the United States of America during Election Day.

text: Gin-mobilize ang mga personnel sa mga estado sang Alabama, Arizona, Delaware, Hawaii, Illinois, Iowa, New Mexico, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, Washington, Wisconsin kag West Virginia.
english: Personnel were mobilized in the states of Alabama, Arizona, Delaware, Hawaii, Illinois, Iowa, New Mexico, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, Washington, Wisconsin and West Virginia.

text: Masobra katunga sini nga mga personnel ang nagabulig sa cybersecurity missions, samtang ang iban naman ang nagahatag sang suporta base sa local requests.
english: More than half of these personnel assist in cybersecurity missions, while others provide support based on local requests.

text: Dugang diri, ang National Guard Bureau ang nagsiling nga may yara sang 85 members nga naka-standby sa Colorado; Washington, DC; Florida kag Nevada.
english: In addition, the National Guard Bureau said there are 85 members on standby in Colorado; Washington, DC; Florida and Nevada.

text: Sang weekend, una na nga ginsiling sang National Guard nga naka-standby ini bilang precaution sa pila ka states lakip na sa Washington kag Oregon kun sa diin may ginpangsunog anay nga ballot drop boxes.
english: Over the weekend, the National Guard earlier said it was on standby as a precaution in several states including Washington and Oregon where ballot drop boxes were burned.

text:
MANILA – “This is it, ladies!”

Ini ang mensahe ni Miss Universe Philippines 2019 Gazini Ganados para sa mga kandidata sang Miss Universe Philippines 2020.
english:
MANILA – “This is it, ladies!”

This is the message of Miss Universe Philippines 2019 Gazini Ganados for the Miss Universe Philippines 2020 contestants.

text: Antes ang coronation 9:00 AM, Oktubre 25, ginpaagi ni Gazini sa pag-post sang throwback photo ang iya nga pagpalab-ot sang mensahe.
english: Before the coronation at 9:00 AM, October 25, Gazini posted a throwback photo to convey his message.

text: Suno kay Gazini, dapat nga ipakita sang 46 ka kandidata ang ila matuod nga kaugalingon agud ipakita nga sila ang nagakadapat nga koronahan.
english: According to Gazini, the 46 contestants must show their true selves to show that they deserve to be crowned.

text: Nakapyansa na ang maritime police nga nag-tuga sang ginamo sa isa ka resto bar sa Poblacion Zone 1, Estancia sang Enero 28.
english: The maritime policeman who caused a riot at a resto bar in Poblacion Zone 1, Estancia on January 28 has been released on bail.

text: Ini amo si Patrolman Derick Salarzon Zamora, 27-anyos, residente sang Barangay Sabang, Cabugao, Ilocos Sur, kag na-assign sa Philippine National Police (PNP) Maritime Station sa Estancia.
english: This is Patrolman Derick Salarzon Zamora, 27, resident of Barangay Sabang, Cabugao, Ilocos Sur, and assigned to the Philippine National Police (PNP) Maritime Station in Estancia.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PMaj.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PMaj.

text: Marvin Buenavista, Hepe sang Estancia Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nagpangatubang ini sang kaso nga alarm and scandal apang gilayon man nga nakapyansa.
english: Marvin Buenavista, chief of the Estancia Municipal Police Station, said he faced a case of alarm and scandal but was immediately released on bail.

text: Suno kay Buenavista, bangud sa kahubog, nagmaoy ang pulis kag nanawag pa sang kaupod niya nga maritime police, kag sang makaabot, ginpangsumbag man niya ang mga ini.
english: According to Buenavista, due to drunkenness, the policeman became angry and called his fellow maritime police, and when he arrived, he also punched them.

text: Didto kag gin-aresto nalang nila ini agud indi na makatuga pa sang gamo.
english: They arrested him there so that he would not cause any more trouble.

text: Nagpahanumdom man si Buenavista sa kapareho nga uniformed personnel nga nga mangin responsable ilabi na gid kun nakainom sang makahulubog nga ilimnon kag mangin maayo nga ehemplo sa pumuluyo.
english: Buenavista also reminded fellow uniformed personnel to be responsible especially when drinking alcoholic beverages and to be a good example to the public.

text: Nag-warning ang Department of Science and Technology (DOST) sa publiko batok sa posible nga epekto sang Bagyong Nando sa madamo nga bahin sang Luzon.
english: The Department of Science and Technology (DOST) has warned the public against the possible impact of Typhoon Nando in many parts of Luzon.

text: Suno kay DOST-PAGASA Assistant Weather Services Chief Chris Perez, may dako nga posibilidad nga magadala ini sang mabaskog nga mga ulan kag hangin, bangud sa padayon nga pagbaskog sang bagyo samtang yara pa ini sa sidlangan nga bahin sang baybayon sang Pilipinas.
english: According to DOST-PAGASA Assistant Weather Services Chief Chris Perez, there is a high possibility that it will bring strong rains and winds, due to the continued strengthening of the typhoon while it is still in the eastern part of the Philippine coast.

text: Ginpahayag ni Perez nga posible nga maglab-ot na ini sa typhoon category buwas, kag padayon pa nga magbaskog samtang nagasulod sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR).
english: Perez said it is likely to reach the typhoon category tomorrow, and continue to strengthen as it enters the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR).

text: Pag-abot sang Lunes, may posibilidad nga mangin isa ini ka supertyphoon kun mapadayon ang iya pagbaskog nga amo ang una nga supertyphoon nga mabatyagan sang Pilipinas sa sining tuig.
english: By Monday, it is likely to become a supertyphoon if it continues to strengthen, the first supertyphoon to be felt by the Philippines this year.

text: Dakop sa ginkasa nga buy-bust operation ang isa ka dismissed police sa Barangay Maribong, Lambunao, Iloilo.
english: A dismissed police officer was arrested in a buy-bust operation in Barangay Maribong, Lambunao, Iloilo.

text: Ang subject amo si Jonathan Digno Limas, 54-anyos, residente sang Barangay Cubay, Lambunao, Iloilo.
english: The subject was identified as Jonathan Digno Limas, 54, resident of Barangay Cubay, Lambunao, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Dadje Delima, head sang Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit (PDEU), iya ginpahayag nga na-dismissed ang subject bilang isa ka pulis kasunod sang matukiban nga ginpeke sini ang iya nga eligibility sang Civil Service.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Dadje Delima, head of the Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit (PDEU), said the suspect was dismissed as a policeman after it was discovered that he had faked his eligibility for the Civil Service.

text: Suno kay Delima, nakuha sa posisyon sang anay pulis ang 120 gramos nga ginapahayag shabu nga may standard drug price nga P816,000.00.
english: According to Delima, 120 grams of suspected shabu with a standard drug price of P816,000.00 were recovered from the former policeman's possession.

text: Nakuha man sa suspek ang isa ka sachet sang buy-bust item, duha ka heat-sealed plastic sachets nga naga-unod sang suspected shabu, P6,000 buy-bust money, kag mga non-drug items.
english: Also recovered from the suspect were one sachet of buy-bust item, two heat-sealed plastic sachets containing suspected shabu, P6,000 buy-bust money, and non-drug items.

text: Nahibaluan nga anay naman nga ginserbehan sang warrant of arrest sang Lambunao Municipal Police Station ang subject sa paglapas sini sa Republic Act 10591 ukon ang Comprehensive Firearms and Ammunition Act.
english: It was learned that the Lambunao Municipal Police Station had earlier served a warrant of arrest on the suspect for violating Republic Act 10591 or the Comprehensive Firearms and Ammunition Act.

text: ILOILO – Indi pabor si Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor, Jr.
english: ILOILO – Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor, Jr.

text: nga i-suspend ang excise tax sa fuel products kag i-review ang de-regulation law sang pungsod agud nga ma-address ang nagalala nga epekto sang nagataas nga presyo sang gatong sa pungsod.
english: to suspend the excise tax on fuel products and review the country's de-regulation law in order to address the worsening impact of rising fuel prices in the country.

text: Nag-request si Presidente Rodrigo Duterte sa kongreso nga i-review ang de-regulation law kag madamo sang mga mamalidha kag mga opsiyal ang nagapahayag nga dapat i-suspend ang excise tax sa produktong petrolyo.
english: President Rodrigo Duterte has requested Congress to review the de-regulation law and many lawmakers and officials are saying that the excise tax on petroleum products should be suspended.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Defensor, iya ginpahayag nga nag-agi sa maid-id nga pagtuon ang pagpasar sang oil de-regulaton law kag kabahin sang tinutuyo sini amo nga mapanubo ang presyo sang gatong.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Defensor said the passage of the oil de-regulaton law went through a thorough study and part of its purpose is to reduce the price of fuel.

text: May yara sang mga kondisyon ang nasambit nga layi kag nagakadapat nga balikan kun ara pa bala ang mga ini.
english: The said law has conditions and should be reviewed to see if they still exist.

text: Samtang, ang pagpataw sang excise tax sa fuel products ang may yara man sang manami nga nadulot sa pungsod ilabi na sa mga social servcies sang mga ahensya.
english: Meanwhile, the imposition of excise tax on fuel products has also had a positive impact on the country especially on the social services of the agencies.

text: Kaangay sang oil de-regulation law, dapat man nga balikan ang rason kun ngaa ginpatuman ini.
english: Like the oil de-regulation law, the reason why it was implemented should be revisited.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Defensor ang kabahin sang technical working group sang ginbalay ang pagpataw sang excise tax sa fuel products.
english: Defensor was part of the technical working group that drafted the imposition of excise tax on fuel products.

english: The governor said that the provision of assistance to the affected is not yet able to be done by the local government units and therefore, the help of the national government is needed.
