text: MANILA – Gindayaw sang Miss Universe Philippines Organization ang kaisog sang duha ka kandidata nga nag-withdraw sa kompetisyon bangud sa COVID-19.
english: MANILA – The Miss Universe Philippines Organization has praised the courage of two contestants who withdrew from the competition due to COVID-19.

text: Santo sa statement sang nasambit nga organisasyon, isa ka masubo nga balita nga may mga kandidata nga indi na magpadayon sa kompetisyon apang dalayawon naman ang ila ginpakita nga “bravery” kag “courage” sa pagdesisyon.
english: According to the statement of the said organization, it is sad news that there are candidates who will not continue in the competition but they showed commendable “bravery” and “courage” in making the decision.

text: Ginpasalig man sang organisasyon nga hatagan sa gihapon sang suporta sanday Vincy Vacalares sang Cagayan de Oro kag Maria Isabela Galeria sang Sorsogon nga una na nga nagpositibo sa COVID-19.
english: The organization also assured that it will continue to support Vincy Vacalares of Cagayan de Oro and Maria Isabela Galeria of Sorsogon who have already tested positive for COVID-19.

text: Bangud sini, top priority sa subong ang health kag safety sang mga kandidata lakip na sang mga staff sang Miss Universe Philippines Organization.
english: Because of this, the health and safety of the candidates as well as the staff of the Miss Universe Philippines Organization is a top priority.

text: Ang coronation night sang Miss Universe Philippines 2020 ang patigayunon sa Oktubre 25 sa Baguio City.
english: The coronation night of Miss Universe Philippines 2020 will be held on October 25 in Baguio City.

text: Gina-imbestigaran sang United States intelligence officials ang email account nga nagagamit sang Russian internet domain bilang potensyal nga ginhalinan sang ginaalegar bomb threats kadungan sang election day sa state sang Georgia.
english: United States intelligence officials are investigating an email account using a Russian internet domain as a potential source of alleged bomb threats on election day in the state of Georgia.

text: Nagaguluwa subong ang inisyal nga impormasyon nga pila sini nga mga pamahog ang naghalin sa Moscow.
english: Initial information is now emerging that some of these threats are coming from Moscow.

text: Wala naman sang kumpirmasyon ang American officials kun halin gid man sa Russia ang ginpang-email nga threats.
english: American officials have not confirmed whether the emailed threats came from Russia.

text: Ginalantaw sang mga imbestigador ang history sang mga aktibidad sang email account agud matumod kun sin-o ang yara sa likod sini.
english: Investigators are looking at the email account's activity history to determine who is behind it.

text: Ini nga non-credible threats ang nag-resulta sa temporary closure sang polling places sa Union City sa guwa sang Atlanta suno sa Fulton County police.
english: These non-credible threats resulted in the temporary closure of polling places in Union City outside of Atlanta according to Fulton County police.

text: “We’ve heard some threats that were of Russian origin,” pahayag naman ni Georgia Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger.
english: “We’ve heard some threats that were of Russian origin,” Georgia Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger said in a statement.

text: Wala sini ginpatpat ang dugang nga mga detalye samtang nagapadayon ang imbestigasyon.
english: He did not specify further details as the investigation continues.

english:
****

Stay tuned to US election updates on Bombo Radyo Philippines brought by more than 150 Bombo International correspondents directly from various states in the United States of America.#

text: Nagtrending sa social media ang #DefendLizaSoberano matapos naglapta ang mga vlogs nga gina-angot ang aktres sa rebelde nga grupo.
english: #DefendLizaSoberano has been trending on social media after vlogs linking the actress to the rebel group circulated.

text: Nagtuga ang mga akusasyon batuk kay Liza matapos nga nagpartisipar ini sa webinar nga gin-organisa sang Gabriela Youth sa diin iya ginpanawagan nga mangin bukas kag maghambal tuhoy sa mga isyu nga nagaapekto sa mga kababaihan kag kabataan.
english: The accusations against Liza arose after she participated in a webinar organized by Gabriela Youth where she called for being open and talking about issues affecting women and children.

text: Isa ka twitter user ang nagpakigbahin sang screenshot sang isa ka vlog sa diin makit-an ang laragway ni Liza nga ginbutangan sang logo sang New People’s Army kag bandana.
english: A twitter user shared a screenshot of a vlog showing Liza's picture with the New People's Army logo and bandana.

text: Pahayag sang netizen, isa ini ka sahi sang redtagging.
english: According to the netizen, this is a form of redtagging.

text: Gindepensahan man ni Ogie Diaz ang aktres kag ginsabat ang alegasyon sang ginkilala nga si Maui Becker nga amo ang naghimo sang vlog.
english: Ogie Diaz also defended the actress and responded to the allegation of Maui Becker, who was identified as the creator of the vlog.

text: Panugyan ni Ogie kay Becker, antes mag redtag, dapat nga magpa check-up anay ini sang iya ubo kag pagpalangatol sang tuntunlan kag mag pa swab test na lamang.
english: Ogie advised Becker that before going redtag, he should get a check-up for his cough and sore throat and get a swab test.

text: Abanse nga nagapasalamat ang Barangay Divinagracia, La Paz, Iloilo City sa daku nga drainage project nga natalana nga suguran sa ila barangay nga ginalantaw nga makabulig sa problema sa baha.
english: Barangay Divinagracia, La Paz, Iloilo City is grateful in advance for the major drainage project that is scheduled to be launched in their barangay which is expected to help with the flood problem.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Punong Barangay Maria Beth Teves, iya ginpahayag nga malapad ang himuon nga kanal kag naka-koordinar naman ang kontraktor nga malapit na lang ini umpisahan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Punong Barangay Maria Beth Teves said the canal will be wide and the contractor has coordinated to start it soon.

text: Ini ang ginalantaw nga makabulig sa ila mga residente nga makaluluoy man ang sitwasyon sa tig-ululan.
english: This is expected to help their residents who are also in a miserable situation during the rainy season.

text: Dugang sini, subong nga wala pa nahimo ang daku nga kanal, gina-mentenar lang anay sang barangay ang pagpanglimpyo sa ila nga existing nga mga kanal rason nga naga-subside man ang tubig-baha kun matapos na ang ulan.
english: He added that since the big canal has not been built, the barangay is just maintaining the cleaning of their existing canals, which is why the flood water subsides after the rains.

text: Ang daku lang nga problema suno sa iya amo kun magdungan ang mamunog nga ulan sa taob.
english: The only big problem, he said, is when heavy rains coincide with floods.

text: Nahibaluan nga anum ka mga zona sa barangay ang ginasul-ob ang baha sa kada magbubo ang mabaskog nga ulan ilabi na ang Zone 6 kun sa diin tuman ka apektado ang mga estudyante sang La Paz National High School.
english: It is known that six zones in the barangay are flooded every time heavy rains fall especially Zone 6 where the students of La Paz National High School are severely affected.

text: Balantayan ang Gilas Girls sa Division B sang FIBA U16 Women’s Asian Championship sa Hunyo 24 tubtub 30 sa Amman, Jordan.
english: Watch Gilas Girls in Division B of the FIBA ​​U16 Women’s Asian Championship on June 24 to 30 in Amman, Jordan.

text: Ini ang una nga bes halin sang 2011 nga natigayon nga makapakita ang Pilipinas sa continental stage.
english: This is the first time since 2011 that the Philippines has been able to appear on the continental stage.

text: Upod sang team ang coach nga si Julie Amos.
english: With the team is coach Julie Amos.

text: Ang Gilas Girls ang ginapangunahan ni Ava Fajardo, ang manghod sang Gilas Women mainstay nga si Ella.
english: The Gilas Girls are led by Ava Fajardo, the younger sister of Gilas Women mainstay Ella.

text: Kaupod ni Fajardo sanday Emaleena Elson, Hannah Lopez, Samantha Medina, Ryan Kelly Nair, Camille Nolasco, Kailah Jade Oani, Naomi Panganiban, Sierra Jade Patricio, Gabriella Ramos, BJ Villarin, kag Kristan Yumul.
english: Fajardo was joined by Emaleena Elson, Hannah Lopez, Samantha Medina, Ryan Kelly Nair, Camille Nolasco, Kailah Jade Oani, Naomi Panganiban, Sierra Jade Patricio, Gabriella Ramos, BJ Villarin, and Kristan Yumul.

text: Filipino-Americans ang siyam sa nasambit nga players.
english: Nine of the players are Filipino-Americans.

text: Sa Byernes, makasumpong sang team ang Indonesia, sunod ang Syria sa Sabado, kag Samoa sa Domingo.
english: On Friday, the team will face Indonesia, followed by Syria on Saturday, and Samoa on Sunday.

text: Ang nagapanguna nga team sa amo nga pool amo ang maga-abanse sa semifinals.
english: The top team in that pool will advance to the semifinals.

text: Ginaalegar nga ginpulihan kastigo sang mag-amay ang isa ka barangay kagawad sa Brgy.
english: A barangay kagawad in Brgy.

text: Caw-i, Batad, Iloilo matapos nga nagsinggitan.
english: Caw-i, Batad, Iloilo after shouting.

text: Ang biktima amo si alyas Ramil, 49-anyos, kag isa ka barangay kagawad.
english: The victim was identified as Ramil, 49, a barangay kagawad.

text: Ang mga suspek amo ang mag-amay nga sanday Alyas Jun-jun, 44-anyos kag si Alyas Kyle, 20-anyos, lunsay residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The suspects were identified as Jun-jun, 44, and Kyle, 20, both residents of the said area.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Master Sergeant Ma.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Police Master Sergeant Ma.

text: Lota Barboza, imbestigador sang Batad Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nagpauli ang kagawad sa ila puluy-an matapos nga nag-inom-inom kon sa diin, naglabay ini sa balay sang mag-amay kag didto man nga nagsinggitan.
english: Lota Barboza, investigator of the Batad Municipal Police Station, said the kagawad returned home after drinking when he passed the father's house and shouted.

text: Gilayon naman nga naguwa ang asawa sang amay nga suspek agud nga sawayon ang barangay kagawad bangud intentional ang iya nga ginasinggitan.
english: The suspect's father's wife immediately went outside to reprimand the barangay kagawad for intentionally shouting.

text: Suno kay Barboza, nagkuha sang video ang asawa sang suspek rason nga gintapi ini sang biktima.
english: According to Barboza, the suspect's wife took a video and the victim taped it.

text: Didto na kag nagsugod ang pagkastigo sang mag-amay sa barangay kagawad.
english: That's when the father and son started beating the barangay kagawad.

text: Nag-agum ang biktima sang pilas sa nagkalain-lain nga parte sang iya lawas kag sa subong, ginahulat pa ang resulta sang x-ray.
english: The victim sustained injuries in various parts of his body and is currently awaiting the result of the x-ray.

text: Nakaguwa naman ang mag-amay sa presohan kasunod sang nag-lapse na ang reglementary period.
english: The father and daughter were released from jail after the reglementary period expired.

text: Nagaguwa naman sa imbestigasyon nga may daan na nga mga hiligut-anon ang duha ka kampo nga nag-trigger man sa natabo nga insidente.
english: Investigation revealed that the two camps had old quarrels that triggered the incident.

text: KINAHANGLAN seryosohon na gid ang pag-away sa Climate Change diri mismo sa Filipinas, kon ngaa ang aton gobyerno nagapamwersa gid nga ipatuman ang jeepney modernization program agud mapakunol ang pagbuga (emit) sang mahaliton nga greenhouse gas (GHG) sa aton kahanginan.
english: The fight against Climate Change must be taken seriously here in the Philippines, which is why our government is pushing to implement the jeepney modernization program to reduce the emission of harmful greenhouse gases (GHG) into our atmosphere.

text: Nga daan, sunu sa 2011 data sang Environmental Management Bureau (EMB), ginabuga sining mga jeepney ang 15,492 ka tonelada nga air pollution, nga laban sini ang GHG, nga naga-contribute sang 48% sa annual total sang air pollution.
english: Already, according to 2011 data from the Environmental Management Bureau (EMB), these jeepneys emit 15,492 tons of air pollution, most of which is GHG, contributing 48% to the annual total of air pollution.

text: Labi na gid kay ginakilala ang aton pungsod bilang “Most Vulnerable” sa “disastrous” nga epekto sang Climate Change, samtang halos wala man kita sing may mahimo agud malikawan ini ukon ma-mitigate man lang tungod sa aton kakulangan sa inhibalo technolohiya kag sang inuggasto.
english: Especially since our country is recognized as “Most Vulnerable” to the “disastrous” effects of Climate Change, while we can do almost nothing to prevent or mitigate it due to our lack of knowledge, technology and finances.

text: In fact, na-experyensyahan na naton sa Filipinas kon ano ka “disastrous” ang epekto sang Climate Change tungod sa sige nga pagsaka sang pag-init sang kalibutan (Global Warming) sa sige pagtipon sang greenhose gas (GHG) sa kahanginan nga nagapabudlay sang paggwa sang init sa ibabaw sang kalibutan.
english: In fact, we have already experienced in the Philippines how disastrous the effects of Climate Change are due to the continuous increase in global warming in the continuous accumulation of greenhouse gases (GHG) in the atmosphere that makes it difficult for heat to escape from the surface of the earth.

text: Sa sining mga “disastrous effect” sang Climate Change sa aton pungsod isa na dira ang “storm surge” nga nagkutol sang sobra 6,000 nga kabuhi kag minilyon ka pesos nga kahalitan sa pangabuhian kag mga infrastructura sang iguon ang Leyte sadtong Nob.
english: Among these disastrous effects of climate change in our country is the storm surge that claimed more than 6,000 lives and millions of pesos in damage to livelihoods and infrastructure when it hit Leyte in Nov.

text: 8, 2013 sang Category 5 nga Tropical Storm Yolanda, nga naglamita sang daku nga bahin sang northern Iloilo.
english: 8, 2013 of Category 5 Tropical Storm Yolanda, which devastated a large part of northern Iloilo.

text: Gin-igu man sang Tropical Storm Frank sadtong Hunyo 18, 2008 ang isla sang Panay, kon diin nagbundak ini sang mabunog nga ulan sa siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: Tropical Storm Frank also hit the island of Panay on June 18, 2008, where it dumped heavy rains in Iloilo City.

text: Nagtuga ini sang lapnagon kag masulog nga pagbaha sa sobra katunga sang kabarangayan sang siyudad nga nagdala sang indi lahog-lahog nga kahalitan sa kabuhi kag infrastructura.
english: This caused widespread and heavy flooding in more than half of the city's barangays, causing irreparable damage to life and infrastructure.

text: Ginakulbaan man naton ang mabaskug kag mahaliton nga mga linog sa kategoriya sang “The Big One” nga sobra sa magnitude 7.0 katulad sang nag-igu sa Bohol sadtong Oktubre 15, 2013, kag ang posible pagbalik sang magnitude 8.2 nga Lady Kaykay nga nag-igu sa Iloilo sadtong 1948 nga nagkuha sang madamo nga kabuhi, ngtuga sang tsunami, kag nagrusdak sang madamo nga infrastructura lakip na ang Jaro belfry.
english: We are also concerned about strong and devastating earthquakes in the category of “The Big One” that exceed magnitude 7.0 such as the one that struck Bohol on October 15, 2013, and the possible return of the magnitude 8.2 Lady Kaykay that struck Iloilo in 1948, causing many deaths, tsunamis and tsunamis. of many infrastructures including the Jaro belfry.

text:
***

Well, wala man nagapamatok ang mga drayber kag operator sang mga public utility vehicles (PUV), nga laban sini mga jeepney, ugaling kay ginareklamo sang madamo ang sobra kamahal nga pagtukod sang modern jeepney nga halos apat ka pilu ang bili sangsa jeepney kag ang dugang nga galastuhon nila kon islan ang ila makina sa electric engine kag Euro 4, nga indi na ila kuno masarangan abagahon.
english:
***

Well, drivers and operators of public utility vehicles (PUVs), most of which are jeepneys, do not object, but many complain about the exorbitant cost of building a modern jeepney that costs almost four times more than a jeepney and the additional cost of replacing their engine with an electric engine and 4 euros, which they cannot afford.

text: Ubol man ang deadline sa pag-phaseout sang sining mga jeepney, nga ginpaatras pa gani sang LTFRB sa Disyembre 31, 2023.
english: The deadline for the phaseout of these jeepneys is also looming, which the LTFRB has even postponed to December 31, 2023.

text: Matuod man, ano ang pulos ang pag-away naton sa Climate Change paagi sa pagpanubo sang GHG emission paagi sa jeepney modernization program kon mapatay man lang sa gutom ang mga apektdo nga mga drayber.
english: Indeed, what is the point of fighting Climate Change by reducing GHG emissions through the jeepney modernization program if the affected drivers will starve to death.

text: Tungod sini, indi katingalahan nga ipatuman  sang madamo ang Tigil Byahe nga natalana sa Marso 6 tubtub Marso 12 sa Metro Manila kag sa pila pa ka lugar sa pungsod.
english: Because of this, it is not surprising that many will implement the Tigil Byahe scheduled for March 6 to March 12 in Metro Manila and some other parts of the country.

text: Napatuman na gani ini sugod sang Marso 6 labi na gid sa MM.
english: It has been implemented since March 6 especially in MM.

text: Sa siyudad sang Iloilo wala ugaling ginasapak ini sang mga drayber diri.
english: In Iloilo City, however, drivers do not pay attention to this.

text: Daw comfortable man sila sa patakaran sang jeepney modernization diri sa siyudad.
english: They also seem comfortable with the policy of jeepney modernization here in the city.

text:
***

Sa pila ka negosyante sang petrolyo (fossil fuel) nga luyag papatihon ang ila kaugalingon nga indi pa gid man “disastrous” gid ang epekto sang Climate change, ini ang siling ni Professor Jim Skea, nga co-author sang report sa Climate Change Mitigation: “The evidence is irrefutable!”

Sunu sa iya, dapat sa 2025 pa lang gani mapauntat na ang sige dugang sang GHG sa kalibutan agud  mapanubo ang Global Warrming pag-abot sang 2030.
english:
***

To some fossil fuel entrepreneurs who want to convince themselves that the effects of climate change are not yet “disastrous,” says Professor Jim Skea, co-author of the report on Climate Change Mitigation: “The evidence is irrefutable!”

He said that by 2025, the increase in GHG emissions in the world should be stopped in order to reduce global warming by 2030.

text: Sa ina nga tion, dugang niya, dapat tubtub na lang ang dugang nga init sa 1.5% nga, sa karon, mga 1.2% na.
english: By then, he added, the additional heat should be limited to 1.5% which, currently, is already about 1.2%.

text: Sunu sa man sa mga siyentipiko sa “environment” ma-experyensyahan na naton ang “ulltimate disaster” kon magdangat na ini sa 2.0%.
english: According to environmental scientists, we will experience the ultimate disaster when it reaches 2.0%.

text: By that time, ma-experyensyahan na sang kalibutan ang “more intense” nga drought, “more devaststing” nga pagbaha (floods), lapnagon nga “wildfires”,  mas mabaskug nga mga bagyo, kag iban pa nga kalamidad.
english: By that time, the world will experience “more intense” droughts, “more devaststing” floods, widespread “wildfires”, stronger typhoons, and other disasters.

text: Tani mapatuman na sang Paris Agreement ang pagpanubo sang mga pungsod sang ila GHG emission, nga laban sini carbon dioxide CO2), sa 40% sugod karon tubtub pag-abot sang 2030 kag makalab-ot na sa zero emission./PN
english: Hopefully, the Paris Agreement will enable countries to reduce their GHG emissions, mostly carbon dioxide CO2), by 40% from now until 2030 and reach zero emissions./PN

text: Naghakot sang madamo nga medalya ang bugal sang Iloilo City nga si Maria Katarina Elia Gange Tanaleon sa Rhythmic Gymnastics sa Western Visayas Regional Athletic Association Meet 2026.
english: The pride of Iloilo City, Maria Katarina Elia Gange Tanaleon, won many medals in Rhythmic Gymnastics at the Western Visayas Regional Athletic Association Meet 2026.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo sa 9-anyos nga si Tanaleon, iya ginpahayag nga bangud sa bulig sang iya ginikanan kag mga coaches nangin possible para sa iya nga madala ang kadalag-an para sa Iloilo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, 9-year-old Tanaleon said that with the help of his parents and coaches, it was possible for him to win for Iloilo.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga apisar pa nagkalain-lain ang mga coaches nga naghanas sa iya gin-gamit gid sini ang mga laygay kag mga natun-an sini sa ila agud mangin kampeon sa nasambit nga kompetisyon.
english: He said that despite the different coaches who trained him, he used the advice and lessons he learned from them to become champion in the competition.

text: Bangud sa iya nga paghimakas, nadala sini pauli ang bulawan nga medalya sa Rope Routine kag Ball Routine amo man sa Team and Individual All-Around.
english: Because of her efforts, she brought home the gold medal in Rope Routine and Ball Routine as well as in Team and Individual All-Around.

text: Dugang pa diri, nakabaton man ini sang silver medal para sa Hoop Routine kag bronze medal naman sa Freehand Routine.
english: In addition, he also received a silver medal for the Hoop Routine and a bronze medal for the Freehand Routine.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Tanaleon ang bugal man sang Guimaras, proud Atenean kag ang magarepresentar sang Western Visayas sa Palarong Pambansa 2026 nga pagahiwaton sa Agusan del Sur.
english: Tanaleon is also the pride of Guimaras, proud Atenean and will represent Western Visayas in the Palarong Pambansa 2026 to be held in Agusan del Sur.

text: Nagpasalamat Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas sa tanan nga nagsuporta sa Team Uswag sang nagligad nga May 12, 2025 midterm elections.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas thanked everyone who supported Team Uswag in the last May 12, 2025 midterm elections.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga ang apisar sang pagkalutos ni Vice Mayor Jeffrey Ganzon sa pagpapili sini liwat sa pagka-bise alkalde sang syudad, makit-an sa gihapon ang kakusog sang Team Uswag.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Treñas said that despite the defeat of Vice Mayor Jeffrey Ganzon in his re-election as vice mayor of the city, the strength of Team Uswag can still be seen.

text: Suno sa alkalde, natapos na ang eleksyon kag tion na agud nga magtrabaho kag magserbisyo sa mga Ilonggo.
english: The mayor said the election is over and it is time to work and serve the Ilonggos.

text: Nagalaum man ang natungdan nga mangin matalunsay ang trabaho sang iya anak nga si Mayor Elect Raisa Treñas kaupod ang mga konsehal lakip na si Vice Mayor Elect Love-love Baronda.
english: He also hopes that his daughter, Mayor Elect Raisa Treñas, will work smoothly with the councilors including Vice Mayor Elect Love-love Baronda.

text: Dugang sini nga ini ang para sa kaayohan sang syudad kag indi ini matuman kon wala sang pagbinuligay sa isa kag isa.
english: He added that this is for the good of the city and it cannot be achieved without cooperation.

text: Handa naman ang alkalde nga magbulig sa pagpasanyog sang syudad apisar pa nga wala na siya sa pwesto.
english: The mayor is ready to help develop the city even though he is no longer in office.

text: Itinalaga si eight-division world champion Manny “Pacman” Pacquiao bilang bagong Vice President ng International Boxing Association (IBA).
english: Eight-division world champion Manny “Pacman” Pacquiao has been appointed as the new Vice President of the International Boxing Association (IBA).

text: Ito ang kauna-unahang boxing federation sa buong mundo, bago naglitawan ang iba pang mga samahan.
english: It was the first boxing federation in the world, before other organizations followed.

text:
Ginawa ang pormal na pagtatalaga sa Board of Directors meeting ng IBA na ginanap sa Maynila noong Oktubre 27, 2025, kasabay ng paggunita sa ika-50 anibersaryo ng “Thrilla in Manila.”

Bilang vice president, si Pacquiao ay inaasahang mangunguna sa pagbuo ng mga athlete-centered programs, pagpapalawak ng boxing sa rehiyon ng Asya, at pagtataguyod ng karapatan ng mga boksingero sa buong mundo.
english:
The formal appointment was made at the Board of Directors meeting of IBA held in Manila on October 27, 2025, in conjunction with the commemoration of the 50th anniversary of “Thrilla in Manila.”

As vice president, Pacquiao is expected to lead the development of athlete-centered programs, expand boxing in the Asian region, and advocate for the rights of boxers around the world.

text: Makakatrabaho niya si IBA President Umar Kremlev sa mga reporma at inisyatibong layong ibalik ang tiwala sa organisasyon matapos itong tanggalan ng karapatang mag-organisa ng Olympic boxing events ng International Olympic Committee (IOC) noong 2021 dahil sa mga isyu sa pamamahala at transparency.
english: He will work with IBA President Umar Kremlev on reforms and initiatives aimed at restoring confidence in the organization after it was stripped of the right to organize Olympic boxing events by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) in 2021 due to governance and transparency issues.

text: Ang IBA na dating kilala bilang Amateur International Boxing Association, ay minsang namamahala sa boxing sa Olympics.
english: The IBA, formerly known as the Amateur International Boxing Association, once governed boxing in the Olympics.

text: Ngunit sa darating na 2028 Los Angeles Olympics, ang World Boxing na ang mamamahala sa kompetisyon.
english: In the upcoming 2028 Los Angeles Olympics, World Boxing will host the competition.

text: Sa kabila nito, nananatiling aktibo ang IBA sa mga pandaigdigang programa para sa mga amateur at professional boxers.
english: Despite this, the IBA remains active in international programs for amateur and professional boxers.

text: Bilang isa sa pinakakilalang atleta sa kasaysayan ng boxing, inaasahang magiging inspirasyon si Pacquiao sa mga bagong henerasyon ng boksingero.
english: As one of the most famous athletes in the history of boxing, Pacquiao is expected to be an inspiration to the new generation of boxers.

text: Ang kanyang paglipat mula sa ring patungong boardroom ay simbolo ng kanyang patuloy na paglilingkod sa sports na nagbigay sa kanya ng pandaigdigang pagkilala.
english: His move from the ring to the boardroom is a symbol of his continued service to the sport that has given him international recognition.

text:
“Ako, as long as mutual yung nararamdaman namin, kahit sino ka pa, kahit ano ka pa, kung mutual at parehas tayong masaya, sige”

Posible nga mahulog ang buot ukon ma inlove ang aktor nga si Teejay Marquez sa kaangay man niya nga lalaki.
english:
"I, as long as our feelings are mutual, no matter who you are, no matter what you are, if it's mutual and we're both happy, okay"

It is possible that actor Teejay Marquez will fall in love with a man like him.

text: Ini ang ginbuyagyag ni Teejay sa diin iya ginpahayag nga wala sang may ginapili ang ‘love’.
english: This was revealed by Teejay where he said that ‘love’ does not discriminate.

text: Suno sa aktor, ang paghigugmaanay ang para sa tanan kag kun ‘mutual’ man ang nabatyagan nila sang isa ka lalaki, wala siya sang may nakita diri nga problema.
english: According to the actor, love is for everyone and if they feel mutual with a man, he doesn't see any problem.

text: Ang importante ang pahayag niya amo nga malipayon sila sa isa kag isa.
english: The important thing is that they are happy with each other.

text: Nahibaluan nga may yara si Teejay sang pelikula sa diin ka love team sini ang aktor nga si Jerome Ponce.
english: It is known that Teejay has a film in which he has a love team with actor Jerome Ponce.

text: Ginlaragway sang Iloilo City Legal Office ang City Legal Officer nga si Atty. Edgar Gil nga isa ka mentor kag maayo nga abyan sa ila.
english: The Iloilo City Legal Office described City Legal Officer Atty. Edgar Gil who was a mentor and good friend to them.

text: Ini matapos man nga ginkumpirma sang pamilya nga nagtaliwan na ini sa edad nga 91.
english: This was after the family confirmed that he had passed away at the age of 91.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. GV Eutiquio Cuñada, Assistant City Legal Officer sang amo nga opisina, iya ginpahayag nga antes siya magsulod kag magserbisyo sa Iloilo City Government, kilalahay na sila ni Atty. Gil.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. GV Eutiquio Cuñada, Assistant City Legal Officer of the said office, said that before he entered and served in the Iloilo City Government, he and Atty. Gil.

text: Suno sa iya, bilang head sang opisina, istrikto si Atty. Gil apang reasonable kag nagahatag sang importansya sa ginatawag nga presensya indi lang sa pisikal apang amo man sa mental.
english: He said that as head of the office, Atty. Gil however is reasonable and emphasizes the so-called presence not only physically but also mentally.

text: Masami man nga gina-remind ni Atty. Gil ang iya mga kaupdanan nga yara sila para mag serbisyo kag indi para sa personal nga interest.
english: He also often reminded Atty. Gil told his colleagues that they are there to serve and not for personal interest.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginakabig man sang siyudad si Gil nga one of the longest-serving councilors of Iloilo City kag longest-serving City Legal Officer.
english: The city also considers Gil as one of the longest-serving councilors of Iloilo City and longest-serving City Legal Officer.

text: Ginbuyagyag ni Senate Committee on Public Services Chairperson Senator Raffy Tulfo ang ginpabay-an kag palpak nga konstruksyon sang Aganan Flyover nga nagahatag sang perwisyo sa mga pumuluyo sang Iloilo.
english: Senate Committee on Public Services Chairperson Senator Raffy Tulfo exposed the neglected and failed construction of the Aganan Flyover that is causing damage to the people of Iloilo.

text: “Bakit po nagka-problema ito [Aganan Flyover]?,” pamangkot ni Tulfo kadungan sang hearing sa upper chamber kahapon, Septyembre 18.
english: “Why did this [Aganan Flyover] have problems?,” Tulfo asked during a hearing in the upper chamber yesterday, September 18.

text: “Ang isang concern po nila, nag-iingat po sila na baka mangyari po yung sa similar tulay which is the Ungka Flyover.
english: “One of their concerns is that they are being careful that it might happen to a similar bridge which is the Ungka Flyover.

english: So they were monitoring the settlement of the piers,” said Engr.

english: Lara Esquibil, Officer-in-Charge of the DPWH Central Office Bureau of Design.

text: Nag-ako ini nga indi siya pamilyar sa implementasyon sang regional office, apang naghando nga ang technical consultancy firm amo ang United Technology Consolidated Partnership (UTCP).
english: He admitted that he was not familiar with the implementation of the regional office, but wished that the technical consultancy firm was the United Technology Consolidated Partnership (UTCP).

text: Suno kay Esquibil, may yara sang discrepancy ukon sala nga pag-check sa kadalumon sang pundasyon nga ginpatigayon sang UTCP sa Aganan, nga wala gin-aprubahan sang ila ahensya.

text: Bangud sini, padayon nga na-delay ang proyekto bangud sa kakulangan sang hulag sang UTCP kag padayon man nga nagaresulta sa mabug-at nga trapiko sa mga motorista kag pasahero sa Iloilo.
english: As a result, the project continues to be delayed due to the lack of movement of the UTCP and continues to result in heavy traffic for motorists and passengers in Iloilo.

text: Nagsugod ang proyekto sang Hulyo 6, 2020 kag ginatarget nga matapos sa sulod sang 24 ka bulan ukon duha ka tuig, apang tubtub subong, wala ini matapos kag wala mabenepisyuhan sang mga Ilonggo.
english: The project started on July 6, 2020 and is targeted to be completed within 24 months or two years, but so far, it has not been completed and has not benefited the Ilonggos.

text: Ginbulgar man nga halin sa P802 milyon nga total contract price, P308 milyon na lang ang nabilin nga budget para sa flyover.
english: It was also revealed that out of the P802 million total contract price, only P308 million is left in the budget for the flyover.

text: May reports pa nga dugang nga ₱275-₱300 milyon pa ang kinahanglanon nga pondo bangud sang mga rebisyon sa Aganan Flyover nga ginkumpirma man ni Esquibil nga posible nga matabo bangud sang sala nga soil testing sang UTCP.
english: There are also reports that an additional ₱275-₱300 million is needed due to the revisions on the Aganan Flyover which Esquibil also confirmed that may happen due to the wrong soil testing of the UTCP.

english: Tulfo told Esquibil that before contractors and consultancy firms are awarded contracts, they must undergo a strict background check to ensure that they are qualified and can handle the project.

english: Raffy said the DPWH will compute the liquidated damages due to the delays and it should be paid to the UTCP.

text: Gin-ugyunan man ini ni Esquibil kag nagsiling nga ila ini himuon gilayon.
english: Esquibil also agreed and said they would do so immediately.

text: Bilang pagsiguro nga magahimo sang tikang si Esquibil sa mga rekomendasyon ni Sen.
english: To ensure that Esquibil will take action on the recommendations of Sen.

text: Tulfo, ginpasumite siya sang comprehensive investigation kag status report sang proyekto para sa masunod nga hearing sang committee.
english: Tulfo, he was asked to submit a comprehensive investigation and status report of the project for the next hearing of the committee.

text: Makabaton sang P3,000 nga fuel subsidy ang mga mangunguma kag manugpangisda bangud man sa epekto sang nagapadayon nga pagsaka sa presyo sang produktong petrolyo sa ila nga pangabuhian.
english: Farmers and fishermen will receive a P3,000 fuel subsidy due to the impact of the ongoing increase in the price of petroleum products on their livelihoods.

text: Suno kay Department of Agriculture (DA) Assistant Secretary Arnel de Mesa, nakig-angot na ang ahensya sa Development Bank of the Philippines (DBP) para sa pagpanagtag sang cash cards nga amo ang gamiton sang mga benepisyaryo.
english: Department of Agriculture (DA) Assistant Secretary Arnel de Mesa said the agency has already contacted the Development Bank of the Philippines (DBP) for the distribution of cash cards to be used by the beneficiaries.

text: Dugang pa ni De Mesa, magluwas sa P500 million nga pondo para sa subsidy, P600 million pa ang gindugang sa pondo sang fuel subsidy para sa agricultural works.
english: De Mesa added that besides the P500 million fund for the subsidy, P600 million was added to the fuel subsidy fund for agricultural works.

text: Sa P500-million nga pondo, 160,000 ka mga mangunguma kag manugpangisda ang makabenepisyo.
english: With the P500-million fund, 160,000 farmers and fishermen will benefit.

text: Ginalantaw man nga dugang pa nga P3,000 ang ipanagtag sa second tranche sang subsidy sa Abril.
english: An additional P3,000 is also expected to be distributed in the second tranche of the subsidy in April.

text: Importante gid para sa minilyon ka mga Amerikano nga makaboto sa 2024 presidential election.
english: It’s crucial for millions of Americans to be able to vote in the 2024 presidential election.

text: Bisan ano pa ina kalayo, nagapangita sila sang paagi nga ipain ini nga espesyal nga adlaw para makapili sang nagakabagay nga lider nga magapamuno sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika sa masunod nga apat ka tuig.
english: No matter how far away that is, they are looking for a way to set aside this special day to elect a worthy leader to lead the United States of America for the next four years.

text: Bisan sa guwa sang Earth, nagakapangitaan sang paagi agud nga makapasakop sila sa eleksyon.
english: Even outside Earth, ways are found to get them to participate in elections.

text: Subong nga 2024, ang American astronauts nga yara sa International Space Station ang nakaboto na sandig sa record sang Harris County Clerk of Court’s Office sa Texas.
english: As of 2024, American astronauts aboard the International Space Station will be able to vote, according to records from the Harris County Clerk of Court's Office in Texas.

text: Ini amo sanday Don Pettit, Nick Hague, Butch Wilmore, kag Suni Williams nga nag-post man sang ila pictures sa Instagram nga naga-suksok sang patriotic-colored socks kadungan sang Election Day.
english: These are Don Pettit, Nick Hague, Butch Wilmore, and Suni Williams who also posted pictures of themselves on Instagram wearing patriotic-colored socks in conjunction with Election Day.

text:
Ang medyas sang duha ka NASA astronauts ang may nakasulat nga “Proud to be American.”

Kabahin sila sang masobra 1.2 million ka mga tawo nga temprano nga nagboto sa Harris County sa state sang Texas.
english:
The socks of the two NASA astronauts read “Proud to be American.”

They were part of more than 1.2 million people who voted early in Harris County in the state of Texas.

text: “It’s a very important duty that we have as citizens and I’m looking forward to being able to vote from space, which is pretty cool,” suno kay Williams sa isa ka press interview sang Septyembre sang yara sila sa space station.
english: “It’s a very important duty that we have as citizens and I’m looking forward to being able to vote from space, which is pretty cool,” Williams said in a press interview in September when they were on the space station.

text: Apang paano bala nagaboto ang astronauts kun yara sila sa space station?
english: But how do astronauts vote when they're on the space station?

text: Ang astronauts nga nakahibalo nga wala sila sa Earth sa tion sang eleksyon ang mahimo maka-request sa Federal Post Card Applications nga magsumite sang absentee ballots ukon makaboto sang temprano nga may koordinasyon sa ila county clerk’s office.
english: Astronauts who know they will not be on Earth during the election can request Federal Post Card Applications to submit absentee ballots or vote early in coordination with their county clerk’s office.

text: Samtang, kun magboto sila samtang yara mismo sa space, mahimo ini mapadala sa USA kaangay sang data nga masami man nga gina-transmit sa tunga sang space station kag Mission Control Center sa Johnson Space Center sang NASA sa Houston, Texas.
english: Meanwhile, if they vote while in space, it can be sent to the USA like the data that is often transmitted between the space station and the Mission Control Center at NASA's Johnson Space Center in Houston, Texas.

text: Mabaton ang data paagi sa Near Space Network nga amo ang network sang antenna systems kag relay satellites.
english: Data will be received through the Near Space Network which is a network of antenna systems and relay satellites.

text: Kun ma-fill out na sang astronaut ang electronic ballot, magahulag ang document paagi sa “track and data relay satellite system” sang network pakadto sa ground antenna sa Las Cruces, New Mexico.
english: Once the astronaut fills out the electronic ballot, the document will move through the network’s “track and data relay satellite system” to the ground antenna in Las Cruces, New Mexico.

text: Halin sa amo nga facility, isaylo sang NASA ang balota sa Mission Control kag diretso sa county clerk nga amo ang may katungdanan sa casting sang balota.
english: From that facility, NASA will transfer the ballot to Mission Control and directly to the county clerk who will be responsible for casting the ballot.

text: Encrypted ang balota kag mahimo lamang ma-access sang astronaut kag sang clerk.
english: The ballot is encrypted and can only be accessed by the astronaut and the clerk.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagaboto na ang astronauts sa US elections sa sulod na sang halos tatlo ka dekada.
english: Astronauts have been voting in US elections for nearly three decades.

text: Si David Wolf amo ang una nga American nga nagboto sa space samtang sakay sa Mir Space Station sang Russia nga gin-operate halin sang 1986 tubtub sang 2001.
english: David Wolf was the first American to vote in space while aboard Russia's Mir Space Station, which operated from 1986 to 2001.

text: Nagapang-edaron 19 tubtob 25-anyos ang tatlo ka mga Indian National nga suspek sa pagtiro-patay sa isa ka pastor sa Brgy.
english: Three Indian nationals, aged 19 to 25, are suspected in the shooting death of a pastor in Brgy.

text: Anilao, Pavia, Iloilo.
english: Anilao, Pavia, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si Douglas Jover, 63-anyos kag residente sang Brgy.
english: The victim was identified as Douglas Jover, 63, resident of Brgy.

text: Quintin Salas, Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: Quintin Salas, Jaro, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Harold Rendora, Chief of Police sang Pavia Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga napasaka na ang kaso nga murder sa tatlo ka Indian National.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Harold Rendora, Chief of Police of the Pavia Municipal Police Station, said a case of murder has been filed against the three Indian nationals.

text: Suno kay Rendora, nagahulat na lang ang talatapan sang desisyon sang prosecutors office kag pananglitan nga makataan sang probable cause, gilayon ipaguwa man ang warrant of arrest batok sa mga suspek.
english: Rendora said the office is waiting for the decision of the prosecutors office and if probable cause is found, a warrant of arrest will be issued against the suspects immediately.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan nga may ginakaptan na sila nga mga ebidensya nga nagapapag-on man sa kaso.
english: He added that they already have evidence that strengthens the case.

text: Utang nga P300,000 sa online crypto currency ang isa sa motibo nga ginalantaw sang otoridad kon ngaa ginpatay ang pastor.
english: A debt of P300,000 in online crypto currency is one of the motives behind the murder of the pastor.

text: Aminado naman ang Pavia MPS nga wala pa sila sang mabug-at nga ebidensya nga nagatudlo sa mga Indian National sa paghimo sang amo nga krimen.
english: Pavia MPS admitted that they have no solid evidence pointing to the Indian Nationals in committing the crime.

text: Nahibaluan nga nag-agum ang pastor sang igo sang bala halin sa ulo kag naglapos sa sag-ang sini nga gintunaan man sang iya kamatayon.
english: It was learned that the pastor sustained a gunshot wound from the head and neck which also caused his death.

text: Subong nga adlaw, Nobyembre 5, ang presidential election sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: Today, November 5, is the presidential election in the United States of America.

text: Frontrunners sanday incumbent Vice President Kamala Harris nga magadalagan kaupod si Minnesota Governor Tim Walz, kag former president Donald Trump nga runningmate naman si Ohio Senator JD Vance.
english: Frontrunners are incumbent Vice President Kamala Harris who will run alongside Minnesota Governor Tim Walz, and former President Donald Trump who is runningmate Ohio Senator JD Vance.

text: Masandukot ang away sa tunga sang mga kandidato sang Democrats kag Republicans gani pati ang chart-topping musicians kag award-winning actors ang naga-upod man sa pag-endorso sa ila nahamut-an nga mga kandidato.
english: The fight between the Democrats and Republicans is so fierce that even chart-topping musicians and award-winning actors are joining in to endorse their favorite candidates.

text: Lakip sa mga dalagku nga pangalan nga naga-endorso kay Harris amo sanday Oprah Winfrey, Beyonce, Taylor Swift, Eminem, LeBron James, Bruce Springsteen, Kelly Rowland, Madonna, ang ‘Avengers’ sang Marvel nga sanday Robert Downey Jr., Scarlett Johansson, Mark Ruffalo, Don Cheadle, Chris Evans, Danai Gurira, kag Paul Bettany, Jennifer Garner, Jane Fonda, Jessica Alba, Jennifer Lopez, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Anne Hathaway, Octavia Spencer, Jamie Lee Curtis, kag Eminem.
english: Among the big names endorsing Harris are Oprah Winfrey, Beyonce, Taylor Swift, Eminem, LeBron James, Bruce Springsteen, Kelly Rowland, Madonna, Marvel’s ‘Avengers’ Robert Downey Jr., Scarlett Johansson, Mark Ruffalo, Don Cheadle, Chris Evans, Danny Bey, and Danny Bey Jennifer Garner, Jane Fonda, Jessica Alba, Jennifer Lopez, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Anne Hathaway, Octavia Spencer, Jamie Lee Curtis, and Eminem.

text: Yara man ang musicians nga sanday Marc Anthony, John Legend, siblings Billie Eilish kag Finneas, Cardi B, Usher, Lizzo, Cher, Stevie Nicks, kag James Taylor.
english: Musicians Marc Anthony, John Legend, siblings Billie Eilish and Finneas, Cardi B, Usher, Lizzo, Cher, Stevie Nicks, and James Taylor are also in attendance.

text: Magpadayon sa pagbantay sa US election updates sa Bombo Radyo Philippines nga dal-on sang masobra 150 ka Bombo International correspondents direkta halin sa nagkalain-lain nga states sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: Stay tuned to US election updates on Bombo Radyo Philippines brought by more than 150 Bombo International correspondents directly from various states in the United States of America.

text: Naghingyo ang manufacturers sang canned sardines sa Department of Trade and Industry nga pahanugutan sila nga magpasaka sang presyo agud nga makabawi-bawi man sa igu sang pagsaka sang presyo sang produktong petrolyo.
english: Manufacturers of canned sardines have asked the Department of Trade and Industry to allow them to raise prices in order to recover from the increase in the price of petroleum products.

text: Sa statement sang Canned Sardines Association of the Philippines (CSAP), ginhingyo sini sa ahensya nga talupangdon man gilayon ang ila nga hingyo bangud nagasuprer ang ila nga negosyo samtang nagalala man ang away sang Russia kag Ukraine nga amo ang direkta nga nagaapekto sa presyo sang fuel products.
english: In a statement, the Canned Sardines Association of the Philippines (CSAP) urged the agency to immediately address their request as their business is suffering while the conflict between Russia and Ukraine is escalating, which directly affects the price of fuel products.

text: Suno sa manufacturers, kuntani indi naman masulit ang natabo sang kasagsagan sang pandemya kun sa diin tinuig nga wala na-adjust ang SRP rason nga nagsuprer sang kapierdehan ang canned sardines industry.
english: According to the manufacturers, they hope that the canned sardines industry will not repeat what happened during the pandemic where the SRP was not adjusted for years, causing the canned sardines industry to suffer losses.

text: Una na nga nagpahayag ang DTI nga ginatun-an na nila ang mga petisyon kaangot sa pagpasaka sang presyo sa nagapanguna nga balaklon.
english: Earlier, the DTI said it was studying the petitions regarding the price increase of basic commodities.

text: Gin-revoke ni House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III ang travel clearance ni Rep.
english: House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III revoked the travel clearance of Rep.

text: Zaldy Co kasunod sang ginaalegar nga involvement sini sa budget insertions para subong nga 2025.
english: Zaldy Co following its alleged involvement in the budget insertions for 2025.

text: Ginmanduan man ini nga magbalik gilayon sa Pilipinas sa sulod sang 10 calendar days halin sa petsa nga mabaton sini ang notice para sa “pressing national matters” nga naga-require sang iya nga pisikal nga presensya.
english: He was also ordered to return to the Philippines immediately within 10 calendar days from the date he received the notice for “pressing national matters” requiring his physical presence.

text: Si Co nga anay chairman sang House appropriations committee ang una na nga na-report nga yara sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika para sa medical treatment.
english: Co, former chairman of the House appropriations committee, was earlier reported to be in the United States for medical treatment.

text: Una na ini nag-isyu sang statement nga nagapanginwala sang iya nga kahilabtanan sa anomaliya sa insertions kag sa flood control projects.
english: He earlier issued a statement denying his involvement in the anomaly in the insertions and flood control projects.

text: More on this shortly.
english: More on this shortly.

text: MANILA – Naga-enjoy sa single life si Reina Hispanoamericana 2017 Winwyn Marquez.
english: MANILA – Reina Hispanoamericana 2017 Winwyn Marquez is enjoying her single life.

text: Ini ang sabat sang 28 anyos nga Pinay beauty queen may kaangtanan sa isyu tuhoy sa iya soon-to-be-dad nga ex-boyfriend nga si Mark Herras.
english: This is the response of the 28-year-old Pinay beauty queen regarding the issue of her soon-to-be-dad ex-boyfriend Mark Herras.

text: Suno kay Winwyn, nalipay siya bangud mangin isa na ka amay si Mark sa ginadala nga baby boy sang iya partner nga si Nicole Donesa.
english: Winwyn said she is happy because Mark will be a father to her partner Nicole Donesa's baby boy.

text: Ginpahayag ni Winwyn nga luyag niya nga ipalab-ot ang iya pagpanginbulahan sa celebrity couple apang humalin sang ila break-up sang Pebrero, wala pa sila naka-istoryahanay ni Mark.
english: Winwyn said she wanted to convey her congratulations to the celebrity couple but since their break-up in February, she and Mark have not spoken.

text: Sa subong suno sa labing una nga Pinay Reina Hispanoamericana, naga-focus siya sa Basic Citizen’s Military Training bilang reserve force sang Philippine Navy.

text: Padayon subong ang ginahimo nga imbestigasyon, interbensyon, kag seguridad sa San Joaquin School of Fisheries matapos ang ‘stabbing incident’ sang duha ka estudyante sang Hulyo 2, base sa kumpirmasyon sang DepEd Schools Division of Iloilo.
english: Investigation, intervention, and security are ongoing at the San Joaquin School of Fisheries after the stabbing incident of two students on July 2, based on the confirmation of the DepEd Schools Division of Iloilo.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Leonil Salvilla, tagpamaba sang DepEd-Iloilo, nahatagan sila sang report halin sa eskwelahan sang nasambit nga petsa nga nagluntad ang away sa garden sang Grade 10 samtang gapaninlo ang mga estudyante kag sang nag-abot ang mga Grade 9 learners, natabo ang pagtapungulay tubtob nga ginbuno sang isa ang isa ka estudyante.

text: Gindala gilayon ang biktima sa ospital kag gin-refer sa Iloilo City para buligan mag-ayo, nag coordinate naman ang San Joaquin Municipal Police kag MSWDO sa nasambit nga insidente, kabahin sang pagpatuman sang child protection protocols sang DepEd.
english: The victim was immediately brought to the hospital and referred to Iloilo City for treatment. San Joaquin Municipal Police and MSWDO coordinated the incident, as part of the implementation of child protection protocols of the DepEd.

text: Ginpasiguro naman ni Schools Division Superintendent Dr. Ernesto Servillon nga ginasuportahan sang Division Office ang eskwelahan paagi sa pagdeploy sang psychosocial support, pagpabakod sang seguridad, kag pagpatuman sang Alternative Delivery Modes para sa padayon nga edukasyon.

text: Subong nga adlaw, nagpatawag sang general assembly ang eskwelahan upod ang PTA agud ipahanumdom ang school rules kag ipatuman ang strikto nga kampanya batuk sa ‘bullying’ kag bayolente nga pamatasan sa sulod sang eskwelahan.

text: MANILA – Malip-ot apang sweet nga birthday greeting ang gin-post sang singer nga si Sarah Geronimo kadungan sang kaadlawan sang iya amay nga si Delfin.
english: MANILA – Singer Sarah Geronimo posted a short but sweet birthday greeting on the occasion of her father Delfin's birthday.

text: Sa Instagram, isa ka throwback photo ang gin-post ni Sarah kun sa diin magka-upod sila sang iya amay nga nagakanta kadungan sang iya concert sang 2016.
english: On Instagram, Sarah posted a throwback photo of her and her father singing during his 2016 concert.

text: Sa caption, nakasaad ang mga tinaga nga “Ang aking habambuhay.
english: In the caption, the words “My life.

text:
Maligayang kaarawan po tatay Delfin ko.”

Ini ang labing una nga tion nga nag-post si Sarah tuhoy sa iya pamilya pagkatapos sang kontrobersiyal nga pagpakasal kay Matteo Guidicelli sang Pebrero 20.
english:
Happy birthday to my father Delfin.”

This is the first time Sarah has posted about her family since marrying Matteo Guidicelli controversially on February 20.

text: Tubtub sa subong, wala pa sang report tuhoy sa reconciliation sa tunga sang 32 anyos nga singer kag sang iya mga ginikanan.
english: To date, there have been no reports of a reconciliation between the 32-year-old singer and her parents.

text: Ginkwestyon ni Vice President Sara Duterte ang sinseridad sang administrasyon ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte questioned the sincerity of the administration of President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: sa pag-imbestigar sa mga iregularidad sa flood control projects.
english: to investigate irregularities in flood control projects.

text: Partikular nga gintumod sang bise-presidente kun ngaa wala gihapon nasilutan sanday former House Speaker Martin Romualdez kag former House Committee on Appropriations chairman kag Ako Bicol party-list Rep.
english: The vice-president specifically pointed out why former House Speaker Martin Romualdez and former House Committee on Appropriations chairman and Ako Bicol party-list Rep.

text: Zaldy Co.
english: Zaldy Co.

text: Nag-resign si Romualdez bilang lider sang Kamara sang Myerkules, Septyembre 17, samtang si Co naman ang gin-report nga yara sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika para sa medical treatment.
english: Romualdez resigned as House leader on Wednesday, September 17, while Co was reportedly in the United States of America for medical treatment.

text: Pahayag pa sang bise, ang pag-ilis sang liderato sa Kamara ang kabahin lamang sang “preparasyon” para sa 2028 presidential elections.
english: The vice said the change of leadership in the House is only part of the “preparation” for the 2028 presidential elections.

text: “Isa sa mga examples na masabi ko sa inyo na wala talaga silang sinseridad sa imbestigasyon sa flood control kasi tinuro na, pinangalanan na, hindi lang ako ang nagsabi, Zaldy Co at Martin Romualdez.
english: “One of the examples that I can tell you that they really have no sincerity in the investigation of flood control because it has been pointed out, named, not only I said, Zaldy Co and Martin Romualdez.

text: Si Zaldy Co, hinayaan nilang umalis ng bansa.
english: Zaldy Co, they let him leave the country.

text: Si Martin Romualdez, hinayaan nilang mag-resign.
english: Martin Romualdez, they let him resign.

text: Nag-resign naman na, so tapos na ang usapan,” suno kay Sara.
english: He resigned, so the conversation is over,” Sara said.

text: Ginsal-ot sini nga involved ang opisina ni Marcos sa “kidnapping” kay former President Rodrigo Duterte kag pagdala sa iya sa The Hague, apang suno sa iya, sang si Co na ang yara sa Amerika, wala man ini gin-“kidnap” sang administrasyon kag ginbalik sa Pilipinas.
english: He alleged that Marcos' office was involved in the kidnapping of former President Rodrigo Duterte and taking him to The Hague, but he said that when Co was in the United States, the administration did not kidnap him and return him to the Philippines.

text: Ginapamangkot man ni Sara kun ngaa indi mahimo sang administrasyon nga ma-preso si Romualdez sa detention unit sang Kamara.
english: Sara also questioned why the administration could not detain Romualdez in the detention unit of the House of Representatives.

text: “Ang Office of the President, involved sila sa kidnapping ni dating Pangulong Rodrigo Duterte.
english: “The Office of the President, they are involved in the kidnapping of former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Bakit ngayon, nawala si Zaldy Co at maalis si Martin Romualdez, hindi man lang nila magawa na kidnapin si Zaldy Co doon sa Amerika at ibalik dito sa atin sa Pilipinas?
english: Why now, Zaldy Co disappeared and Martin Romualdez was removed, they can't even kidnap Zaldy Co in America and bring him back to us in the Philippines?

text:
At hindi man lang nila magawa na ikulong si Martin Romualdez diyan sa detention unit ng House of Representatives?”

Nahibaluan nga ang mag-asawa nga Curlee kag Sarah Discaya ang naka-mensyonar sang pangalan nanday Romualdez kag Co kadungan sang hearing sang Senado sa flood control projects.
english:
And they can't even keep Martin Romualdez in the detention unit of the House of Representatives?”

Curlee and Sarah Discaya mentioned the names of Romualdez and Co. during the Senate hearing on flood control projects.

text: Pareho na ini nga gin-deny sang duha ka nasambit nga mga mamalidha.
english: Both the aforementioned lawmakers have denied this.

text: Ginlimitahan sang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) ang balor sang payouts ukon withdrawals sa kada transaksyon kada adlaw.
english: The Central Bank of the Philippines (BSP) has limited the value of payouts or withdrawals per transaction per day.

text: Suno sa central bank, mahimo lamang makakuha sang P500,000 sa kada transaksyon ilabi na subong nga padayon ang imbestigasyon sa ginaalegar nga mga anomaliya sa flood control projects.
english: According to the central bank, only P500,000 can be withdrawn per transaction especially now that the investigation into alleged anomalies in flood control projects is ongoing.

text: Sa Circular No.
english: In Circular No.

text: 1218, series of 2025 nga ginpaguwa ni BSP Governor Eli Remolona Jr., ginmanduan ang central bank-supervised financial institutions (BSFI) nga mag-implementar sang “enhanced due diligence” sa dalagku nga value cash-related payments kag transactions.
english: 1218, series of 2025 issued by BSP Governor Eli Remolona Jr., directed central bank-supervised financial institutions (BSFI) to implement “enhanced due diligence” on large value cash-related payments and transactions.

text: Pahayag sang bangko, ang withdrawals nga nagalapaw sa gin-set nga balor ang mahimo lamang himuon ukon ma-facilitate paagi sa check payment, fund transfer, direct credit to deposit accounts, kag iban pa nga paagi paagi sa digital payment platform sang BSFI.
english: According to the bank, withdrawals exceeding the set value can only be made or facilitated through check payment, fund transfer, direct credit to deposit accounts, and other means through BSFI’s digital payment platform.

text: Ginmanduan man ang bangko kag iban pa nga supervised financial institutions nga i-konsiderar ang alerts, red flags, kag makaduluda nga mga indikasyon kaangay sang typologies nga gin-report sang government agencies nga naga-involve sang large or unusual cash transactions sa pag-file sang suspicious transaction reports.
english: Banks and other supervised financial institutions were also directed to consider alerts, red flags, and suspicious indicators such as typologies reported by government agencies involving large or unusual cash transactions in filing suspicious transaction reports.

text: Ini nga direktiba ang natabo kasunod sang anunsyo sang Anti-Money Laundering Council nga gin-freeze sang Court of Appeals ang 135 bank accounts kag 27 insurance policies nga naangot sa mga persona nga involved sa iregularidad sa flood control projects.
english: The directive follows the announcement by the Anti-Money Laundering Council that the Court of Appeals has frozen 135 bank accounts and 27 insurance policies linked to persons involved in irregularities in flood control projects.

text: Nagsaka sa 58 porsyento ang kaso sang dengue sa probinsya sang Iloilo sa subong nga tuig, base sa datos sang Provincial Health Office (PHO), kun ipaanggid sa pareho nga period sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: Dengue cases in Iloilo province have increased by 58 percent this year, based on data from the Provincial Health Office (PHO), compared to the same period last year.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Maria Socorro Quiñon, PHO Head sang Iloilo, nagdangat na sa 2,511 ka kaso sang dengue ang narecord halin sang Enero tubtob Hunyo 20, 2025, upod ang napulo (10) ka napatay; ini mas mataas kumpara sa 1,586 ka kaso kag lima (5) ka patay nga narecord sa amo man nga period sang 2024.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Maria Socorro Quiñon, PHO Head of Iloilo, said 2,511 dengue cases have been recorded from January to June 20, 2025, with ten (10) deaths; this is higher compared to 1,586 cases and five (5) deaths recorded in the same period in 2024.

text: Ginpahayag ni Dr. Quiñon nga may mga kabaranggayan na sa probinsya ang may ginreport nga kaso, kag ang San Joaquin ang nangin pinakataas sa subong.
english: He said Dr. Quiñon said some barangays in the province have already reported cases, and San Joaquin has the highest number so far.

text: Ginasundan ini sang mga banwa sang Oton, Dumangas, Leon, Cabatuan, Pototan, Lambunao, Janiuay, Calinog, kag Pavia.
english: It is followed by the towns of Oton, Dumangas, Leon, Cabatuan, Pototan, Lambunao, Janiuay, Calinog, and Pavia.

text: Nagapanawagan ang PHO sa publiko nga maghalong kag maghimo sang mga preventive measures batok sa dengue, pareho sang regular nga pagpanglimpyo sa palibot, pagpanakop sang tubig sa bukas nga mga container, kag paglikaw sa kagat sang lamok.
english: The PHO calls on the public to be vigilant and take preventive measures against dengue, such as regular cleaning of the environment, collecting water from open containers, and avoiding mosquito bites.

text: ILOILO CITY- Halos wala sang direkta nga impact sa MORE Electric and Power Corporation (MORE Power) ang padayon nga pagtimbuok sang presyo sang produktong petrolyo sa world market bangud sa Russia- Ukraine crisis.
english: ILOILO CITY – The continuous rise in the price of petroleum products in the world market due to the Russia-Ukraine crisis has almost no direct impact on MORE Electric and Power Corporation (MORE Power).

text: Ini may kaangtanan sa ginapanan-aw sang Department of Energy nga pagtaas man sang presyo sang kuryente bangud sa oil price hike.
english: This is in connection with the Department of Energy's expectation of an increase in electricity prices due to the oil price hike.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Roel Castro, presidente kag Chief Operating Officer (COO) sang MORE Power, iya ginpahayag nga sa subong, konektado direkta sa National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) ang tanan nga substations sang MORE Power.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Roel Castro, president and Chief Operating Officer (COO) of MORE Power, he said that at present, all substations of MORE Power are connected directly to the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP).

text: Suno kay Castro, nagakahulugan ini nga 100 percent sang ginakinahanglan sini nga power supply ang nagahalin sa Power Sector Assets and Liabilities Management (Psalm) Corporation nga naga-operate sang geothermal plant sa Leyte nga naga-produce sang renewable energy.
english: According to Castro, this means that 100 percent of its power supply requirements come from the Power Sector Assets and Liabilities Management (Psalm) Corporation which operates a geothermal plant in Leyte that produces renewable energy.

text: Ginpahayag ni Castro nga subong nga tuig, wala man sang nakakontrata nga oil- based plant agud mag-supply sang kuryente sa MORE Power.
english: Castro said that this year, no oil-based plant has been contracted to supply electricity to MORE Power.

text: Kumpyansa si former President Donald Trump nga makabalik siya sa White House.
english: Former President Donald Trump is confident he will return to the White House.

text: Ginpahayag ini sang 78-anyos nga Republican presidential candidate matapos nagboto sa polling booth sa Florida, USA, Nobyembre 5.
english: The 78-year-old Republican presidential candidate said this after voting at a polling booth in Florida, USA, November 5.

text: “It won’t even be close,” suno kay Trump.
english: “It won’t even be close,” according to Trump.

text:
“I feel very confident… I hear we’re doing very well everywhere.”

Ginpahayag man sini nga sa iya tatlo ka presidential campaigns, amo ini ang iya matawag nga “the best” nga kampanya.
english:
“I feel very confident… I hear we’re doing very well everywhere.”

He also said that of his three presidential campaigns, this is what he can call “the best” campaign.

text: “I ran a great campaign.
english: “I ran a great campaign.

text: I think it was maybe the best of the three.
english: I think it was maybe the best of the three.

text: We did great in the first one.
english: We were great in the first one.

text: We did much better in the second one but something happened.
english: We were much better in the second one but something happened.

text: I would say this is the best campaign we’ve run,” pahayag sini samtang kaupod ang iya asawa nga si Melania Trump.
english: I would say this is the best campaign we’ve run,” he said while flanked by his wife, Melania Trump.

text: Nagpahayag man ini sang disgusto sa kadugayon sang pag-tally sang resulta sang eleksyon.
english: He also expressed displeasure over the time taken to tally the election results.

text: Antes pa man ang pagbukas sang polls sa US subong nga adlaw, may yara na nga daan sang 80 million Americans nga una na nakaboto base sa data sang Election Lab sa University of Florida.
english: Even before polls opened in the US today, there were already 80 million Americans who had already voted based on data from the Election Lab at the University of Florida.

text: Nalakip diri ang 45 million nga temprano nga nagboto sang personal, samtang ginabanta 38 million naman ang nagboto sang temprano paagi sa mail.
english: That includes 45 million who voted early in person, while an estimated 38 million voted early by mail.

text: Magpadayon sa pagbantay sa US election updates sa Bombo Radyo Philippines nga dal-on sang masobra 150 ka Bombo International correspondents direkta halin sa nagkalain-lain nga states sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: Stay tuned to US election updates on Bombo Radyo Philippines brought by more than 150 Bombo International correspondents directly from various states in the United States of America.

text: Ginapabaskug sang Department of Agriculture sa Western Visayas ang kampanya para mapaayo ang produksyon sang mais sa rehiyon, paagi sa pagpasanyog sang mekanisasyon kag paggamit sang mga teknolohiya nga base sa siyensya.
english: The Department of Agriculture in Western Visayas is intensifying its campaign to improve corn production in the region, by promoting mechanization and using science-based technologies.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Renan Palomo, Regional Focal Person sang Corn and Cassava Program sang Department of Agriculture-Western Visayas, ginpahayag niya nga may yara sang kabug-osan nga 47,111 ka ektarya nga corn area sa rehiyon kag 42,000 ka ektarya lang ginatanum sang yellow corn nga ginagamit bilang feeds para sa mga baboy kag manok.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Renan Palomo, Regional Focal Person of the Corn and Cassava Program of the Department of Agriculture-Western Visayas, said there is a total of 47,111 hectares of corn area in the region and only 42,000 hectares are planted with yellow corn used as feeds for pigs and chickens.

text: Ginpunto ni Palomo nga ang average yield subong sang yellow corn amo ang 4.66 metric tons kada ektarya, kag ang target sang ahensya amo nga maabot ang 6 metric tons para mas mapaayo ang sufficiency level sang mais sa Western Visayas.
english: Palomo pointed out that the current average yield of yellow corn is 4.66 metric tons per hectare, and the agency's target is to reach 6 metric tons to further improve the sufficiency level of corn in Western Visayas.

text: Ginpahayag man niya nga sa tuig 2024, ginatarget sang ahensya nga maabot ang projected sufficiency level nga 57.3%.
english: He also said that by 2024, the agency targets to reach the projected sufficiency level of 57.3%.

text: Gindugang pa ni Palomo nga isa sa mga tinutuyo sang ahensya amo ang pagpasangkad sang mechanization program kag pagduso sang paggamit sang mga teknolohiya nga ginbase sa siyensya para mabuligan ang mga mangunguma nga mangin mas epektibo kag mas produktibo.
english: Palomo added that one of the agency's goals is to expand the mechanization program and promote the use of science-based technologies to help farmers become more efficient and productive.

text: Gin-anunsyo man niya nga sa palaabuton nga Setyembre 22-26, pagahiwaton ang 18th Philippine National Corn Congress para sa Visayas cluster kag ini nga aktibidad isa ka national event nga pagatambongan sang mga resource persons halin sa nagkalain-lain nga bahin sang Pilipinas.
english: He also announced that on September 22-26, the 18th Philippine National Corn Congress for the Visayas cluster will be held and this activity is a national event that will be attended by resource persons from different parts of the Philippines.

text: Pagatalakayon diri ang mga direksyon kag estratehiya sang corn industry sa bilog nga pungsod, lakip na ang livestock industry, marketing opportunities, potential market, kag ang paggamit sang bio fertilizers bilang kabahin sang padayon nga pagbangon halin sa epekto sang African Swine Fever (ASF).
english: It will discuss directions and strategies of the corn industry nationwide, including the livestock industry, marketing opportunities, potential market, and the use of bio fertilizers as part of the continued recovery from the impact of African Swine Fever (ASF).

text: Arestado sa buybust operation ang isa ka miyembro sang LGBTQ+ sa Bgry.
english: An LGBTQ+ member was arrested in a buybust operation in Bgry.

text: Bakhaw, Mandurriao subong nga adlaw, Hulyo 2, 2025.
english: Bakhaw, Mandurriao today, July 2, 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PCPT Val Cambel, hepe sang Police Station 10 – Mandurriao, Iloilo, gin kilala ang arestado nga si alyas Thea, 24-anyos kag residente sang Brgy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PCPT Val Cambel, chief of Police Station 10 – Mandurriao, Iloilo, identified the arrested as Thea, 24, resident of Brgy.

text: Bakhaw Mandurriao kag ginakabig nga High Value Individual.
english: Bakhaw Mandurriao and is considered a High Value Individual.

text: Nakuha sa iya ang apat (4) ka heat-sealed nga transparent plastic sachets nga may sulod nga ginapatihan nga shabu, nga may kabug-aton nga 60 ka gramos nga may standard drug price (SDP) nga Php 408,000.00.
english: Recovered from him were four (4) heat-sealed transparent plastic sachets containing suspected shabu, weighing 60 grams with a standard drug price (SDP) of Php 408,000.00.

text: Suno kay Cambel, nakaagi naman nga daan preso ang suspect angot sa pareho nga kaso sang nag ligad nga tuig kag nakagwa.
english: According to Cambel, the suspect was previously imprisoned in connection with the same case last year and was released.

text: Sang nakagwa ini sa presohan, liwat ini nga nagbaligya sang illegal nga droga.
english: When he was released from prison, he again sold illegal drugs.

text: Dugang pa ni Cambel, nga may koneksyon ang arestado sa sulod sang presohan kung sa diin niya ginakuha ang supply kag gina-distribute sa gwa kung sa diin ang iya mga target ang mga kabataan kag mga kalalakinhan.
english: Cambel added that the arrested has a connection inside the jail where he gets the supply and distributes it outside where his targets are children and men.

text: Sa inisyal nga interview sang kapulisan sa suspect, may mga suki ini nga gina baligyaan sa nagkalain-lain nga distrito sa syudad sang Iloilo kag amo ang Arevalo, Molo, Lapaz kag Jaro.
english: In the initial interview of the police, the suspect said he has customers who sell in different districts of Iloilo City, namely Arevalo, Molo, Lapaz and Jaro.

text: May ara naman sang iban pa nga list of names ang mga kapulisan nga angot sa kaso ni alyas Thea kag padayon na ang ila nga imbestigasyon.
english: Police have other lists of names in connection with the case of alias Thea and their investigation is ongoing.

text: Sa subong, ara na sa kustodiya sang Ilioilo City Police Station 10 ang suspek kag kung mag-positibo sa drug test paga-atubangon niya ang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: The suspect is currently in the custody of Ilioilo City Police Station 10 and if he tests positive for drugs, he will face charges of violation of Republic Act 9165 or Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: Apisar sang nagapadayon nga pagsaka sa presyo sang produktong petrolyo, gin-anunsyo sang Petro Gazz gasoline station ang ila price rollback sa presyo sang diesel kag gasolina sa sumugod subong nga Marso 10 tubtob Marso 13.
english: Despite the continuous increase in the price of petroleum products, the Petro Gazz gasoline station announced its price rollback in the price of diesel and gasoline from March 10 to March 13.

text: Suno sa Petro Gazz, P5.85 kada litro ang kakason sa presyo sang diesel kag P3.60 naman kada litro sang gasolina sa tanan nila nga gasoline station sa bilog nga pungsod.
english: According to Petro Gazz, the price of diesel will be reduced by P5.85 per liter and gasoline by P3.60 per liter at all its gasoline stations nationwide.

text: Epektibo ang ila price adjustment las 6 subong nga aga sa Marso 10.
english: Their price adjustment is effective at 6 am this morning on March 10.

text: Tinutuyo sang price rollback suno sa Petro Gazz amu nga mahagan hagan ang impact sa mga motorista sa ginalantaw dugang pa gid nga pagsaka sa presyo sang gatong sa masunod nga semana.
english: The purpose of the price rollback, according to Petro Gazz, is to ease the impact on motorists of the expected further increase in fuel prices next week.

text: Nahibaluan nga subong lang nga martes ginpatuman ang P5.85 per liter na saka sa presyo sang diesel, kag P3.60 per liter sa gasolina.
english: The P5.85 per liter price increase for diesel and P3.60 per liter for gasoline was implemented on Tuesday.

text: Ang presyo sang diesel, ang posible nga madugangan sang P12.72 per liter samtang P8.28 per liter naman sa gasolina sa masunod nga semana.
english: The price of diesel is likely to increase by P12.72 per liter while that of gasoline by P8.28 per liter next week.

text: Ang nagapadayon nga kinagamo sa Ukraine kag Russia ang isa sa mga makabig rason sa pagtaas sa presyo sang krudo sa world market.
english: The ongoing conflict in Ukraine and Russia is one of the reasons for the increase in crude oil prices in the world market.

text: Sa Iloilo City makit-an sa Circumferencial Road saTagbak, Jaro, ang gasoline station sang Petro Gazz.
english: In Iloilo City, the Petro Gazz gasoline station is located on Circumferential Road in Tagbak, Jaro.

text: Pila naman ka mga banwa sa Probinsya ang may Petro Gazz kaangay nalang sa banwa sang Leganes, San Miguel.
english: Several towns in the province have Petro Gazz such as Leganes, San Miguel.

text: Nag-crash sa kahawaan sang Washington Patomac River sa Estados Unidos ang isa ka eroplano matapos nga nakabunggo sa isa ka military helicopter.
english: A plane crashed over the Washington Patomac River in the United States after colliding with a military helicopter.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Valerie May Baqueriza-Belleza, Bombo International Correspondent in USA, iya ginpahayag nga ang eroplano ang may dala nga 60 ka mga pasahero kon sa diin 18 ka mga lawas ang nakuha sa nasambit nga suba.
english: Valerie May Baqueriza-Belleza, Bombo International Correspondent in USA, said the plane was carrying 60 passengers and 18 bodies were recovered from the river.

text: Suno kay Belleza, ang eroplano ang naga-operate bilang Flight 5342 sang American Airlines nga naghalin sa Wichita, Kansas kag padulong kontani sa Reagan National Airport.
english: Belleza said the plane was operating as American Airlines Flight 5342 from Wichita, Kansas and was bound for Reagan National Airport.

text: Natumod naman ang helicopter nga US Army Sikorsky H-60 Black Hawk helicopter.
english: The helicopter was identified as a US Army Sikorsky H-60 ​​Black Hawk helicopter.

text: Ginkumpirma naman sang US Army nga may tatlo nila ka katapo ang sakay sang amo nga helicopter.
english: The US Army confirmed that three of its personnel were on board the helicopter.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang eroplano ang may sarang nga kapasidad nga 78 passengers samtang ang helicopter ang may kapasidad nga makasakay sang 15 ka mga indibidwal.
english: The plane has a capacity of 78 passengers while the helicopter has a capacity of 15 individuals.

text: Gin-athag naman sang Philippine Embassy in Washington DC nga wala sang Filipino ang nasamaran sa nagluntad nga insidente.
english: The Philippine Embassy in Washington DC clarified that no Filipinos were injured in the incident.

text: Nakaboto na sa 2024 US elections si former President kag subong Republican candidate Donald Trump.
english: Former President and current Republican candidate Donald Trump has already voted in the 2024 US elections.

text: Kaupod sang 78-anyos ang iya asawa nga si Melania sang nag-abot sa polling booth sa Florida.
english: The 78-year-old was accompanied by his wife Melania when he arrived at the polling booth in Florida.

text: Ini kasunod man sang bag-o lang ginpaguwa nga una nga resulta sa presidential elections — halin sa gamay nga lugar nga Dixville Notch sa New Hampshire kun sa diin tag-tatlo ka boto ang naangkon nanday Trump kag kasumpong sini nga si Democratic candidate Vice President Kamala Harris.
english: This follows the recently released preliminary results of the presidential elections — from the small area of ​​Dixville Notch in New Hampshire where Trump and his opponent, Democratic candidate Vice President Kamala Harris, received three votes each.

text: Si Trump, 78, amo ang labing-una nga former American president sa maragtas sang nasyon nga na-convict sa krimen nga felony.
english: Trump, 78, is the first former American president in the country’s history to be convicted of a felony.

text: Gindeklarar sang huwes nga guilty ini kasunod sang 34 charges bangud sa scheme nga iligal nga impluwensyahan ang 2016 election paagi sa hush money payment sa isa ka porn actress nga si Stormy Daniels.
english: The judge declared him guilty following 34 charges for a scheme to illegally influence the 2016 election through a hush money payment to a porn actress named Stormy Daniels.

text: Apisar na-anunsyo na direkta halin sa Manhattan, New York ang desisyon nga convicted si Trump sang Mayo, natalana nga ipaguwa ang sentensya sini sa Nobyembre 26.
english: Although the decision to convict Trump was announced directly from Manhattan, New York in May, his sentence is scheduled to be announced on November 26.

text: Sa idalom sang layi sa Florida, kun ang isa ka botante ang may yara sang out-of-state conviction, iga-defer sang Florida sa layi sang sina nga state kun paano makuha liwat sang felon ang iya nga kinamatarong sa pagboto.
english: Under Florida law, if a voter has an out-of-state conviction, Florida will defer to that state's law on how the felon regains his or her right to vote.

text: Para sa kaso ni Trump, buot silingon sini, nakabenepisyo siya sa 2021 law sang New York nga nagapahanugot sa mga tawo nga may felony convictions nga magboto sa kondisyon nga wala sila nagaserbe sang term of incarceration sa tion sang eleksyon.
