english: For Trump’s case, that means he benefited from New York’s 2021 law that allows people with felony convictions to vote provided they are not serving a term of incarceration at the time of the election.

text: Antes kay Trump, nakaboto naman ang iya runningmate nga si Ohio Senator JD Vance sa Cincinnati, Ohio.
english: Before Trump, his running mate, Ohio Senator JD Vance in Cincinnati, Ohio, voted.

text: Magpadayon sa pagbantay sa US election updates sa Bombo Radyo Philippines nga dal-on sang masobra 150 ka Bombo International correspondents direkta halin sa nagkalain-lain nga states sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: Stay tuned to US election updates on Bombo Radyo Philippines brought by more than 150 Bombo International correspondents directly from various states in the United States of America.

text: MANILA – Malipayon nga gin-anunsyo sang veteran actress nga si Carmi Martin nga isa siya ka coronavirus survivor.
english: MANILA – Veteran actress Carmi Martin happily announced that she is a coronavirus survivor.

text: Sa Facebook post, ginpakigbahin ni Carmi nga nagpa-idalom siya sa COVID-19 test sang Setyembre 13 bilang requirement sa iya upcoming project.
english: In a Facebook post, Carmi shared that he underwent a COVID-19 test on September 13 as a requirement for his upcoming project.

text:
Sa wala ginlauman, nagpositibo sa COVID-19 test ang 57 anyos nga aktres kag nagpaidalom sa two-week quarantine nga ginakabig naman niya nga “honeymoon with God.”

Ang pagka-relihiyoso suno kay Carmi ang nakabulig sa iya agud maka-angkon sang positive attitude sa pihak sang pagtilaw sa iya kabuhi.
english:
Unexpectedly, the 57-year-old actress tested positive for COVID-19 and underwent a two-week quarantine which she considers a “honeymoon with God.”

Carmi said being religious has helped her to have a positive attitude despite the trials in her life.

text: Magluwas sa pagpangamuyo, ginpahayag sang natungdan nga nakabulig man ang pag-exercise kag pagkaon sang healthy food.
english: Besides praying, he said exercising and eating healthy food also helped.

text: Kadungan sini, ginpasalamatan man niya ang tanan nga nagbulig sa iya agud nga maka-recover.
english: At the same time, he also thanked everyone who helped him to recover.

text: Nagalaum ang Swiss tennis star nga si Roger Federer nga maka-recover na sa iya nga latest knee surgery kag makabalik sa ATP circuit sa masunod nga season.
english: Swiss tennis star Roger Federer hopes to recover from his latest knee surgery and return to the ATP circuit next season.

text: Wala na nakahampang ang nasambit nga 20-time Grand Slam title winner kag former world number one halin sang napyerde ini sa quarterfinals sa Wimbledon kapin isa ka tuig na ang nagligad.
english: The 20-time Grand Slam title winner and former world number one has not played since losing in the quarterfinals at Wimbledon more than a year ago.

text: Ang iya latest nga operasyon sa tuhod amo na ang iya ikatatlo nga surgery sa sulod lang sang 18 ka bulan.
english: His latest knee surgery is now his third surgery in just 18 months.

text: Importante para sa iya ang masunod nga tatlo tubtub apat ka bulan gani ginpahayag sini nga tuman subong ang iya nga pag-focus sa iya nga physical condition.
english: The next three to four months are important for him so he said he is focusing on his physical condition.

text: Tuyo sini nga makabalik sa hampang sa Laver Cup sa London halin sa September 23 tubtub sa 25 kag sunod amo ang iya nga hometown tournament sa Basel halin sa October 24-30.
english: He aims to return to play in the Laver Cup in London from September 23 to 25 and next is his hometown tournament in Basel from October 24-30.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa bug-os nga 2021, 13 lang ka kumpetisyon ang naintrahan ni Federer kag anum lang sa 2020.
english: It is known that in the whole of 2021, Federer only participated in 13 competitions and only six in 2020.

text: Pang-50 siya subong sa current nga ATP standings, ang pinakanubo nga rank nga iya nga nakuha sa sulod sang 22 ka tuig sa iya nga tennis career.
english: He is currently ranked 50th in the current ATP standings, the lowest rank he has achieved in his 22-year tennis career.

text: MANILA – Liwat nga nabuhi ang isyu tuhoy sa pagpakasal sang real life couple nga sanday Kathryn Bernado kag Daniel Padilla.
english: MANILA – The issue of the marriage of real life couple Kathryn Bernado and Daniel Padilla has been revived.

text: Ini ang kasunod sang cryptic post sa Instagram sang iloy nanday Kathryn kag Daniel.
english: This follows a cryptic post on Instagram by Kathryn and Daniel’s mother.

text: Nagpost si Min Bernardo sang wedding gown kag may caption nga “K-ring emoji-N” nga initials sang love team sang duha.
english: Min Bernardo posted a wedding gown with the caption “K-ring emoji-N” with the initials of the love team of the two.

text: Nag-post man sang laragway ang iloy ni Daniel nga si Karla Estrada kun sa diin makita ang elegante nga envelope kag may kasubong man nga caption.
english: Daniel's mother, Karla Estrada, also posted a picture of the elegant envelope with a similar caption.

text: Ang nasambit nga mga post ang nag-angkon sang nanari-sari nga reaksyon gikan sa netizens ilabi na sa fans kag sa mga abyan sang magkahagugma.
english: The posts received mixed reactions from netizens especially fans and friends of the couple.

text: Apisar sini, may iban naman nga nagapati nga teaser lamang ini sang upcoming project nanday Kathryn kag Daniel nga siyam na ka tuig nga magkarelasyon.
english: However, others believe that this is just a teaser of the upcoming project of Kathryn and Daniel who have been in a relationship for nine years.

text: Nagkalalipong ang mga estudyante sa duha ka mga eskwelahan sa  Sibalom, Antique matapos nakahaklo sang kemikal.
english: Students in two schools in Sibalom, Antique fainted after inhaling chemicals.

text: Ang mga biktima ang halin sa Pis-anan National High School kag Pis-anan Central School.
english: The victims are from Pis-anan National High School and Pis-anan Central School.

text: Natabo ang 5.6 magnitude nga linog sa Luna, La Union 3:52 subong nga kaagahon.
english: A 5.6 magnitude earthquake struck Luna, La Union at 3:52 this morning.

text: Suno sa Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology, ang epicenter sini ang nahamtang 49 km northwest sang Luna, La Union sa kadalumon nga 17 km.
english: According to the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology, its epicenter was located 49 km northwest of Luna, La Union at a depth of 17 km.

text:
‘Botante sa Amerika yarn?’, ‘Ok, ano labot namon?’ , ‘Manubo ni ang presyo sang bugas?’ , ‘Tani ang aton lang diri aton nga pahilabtan.’

Amo ini ang mga komento sang mga Pinoy nga masami makit-an kun gina-istoryahan ang mga dalagku nga aktibidad sa iban nga pungsod — kaangay sang presidential elections sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english:
'Voters in America yarn?', 'Ok, what do we care?' , 'Is the price of rice low?'

These are the comments of Filipinos that are often seen when discussing major activities in other countries — such as presidential elections in the United States of America.

text: Nobyembre 5 ukon subong nga adlaw ang petsa nga maga-desisyon ang minilyon nga rehistrado nga mga botante sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika ang magapungko sa White House: si Vice President Kamala Harris sang Democrats ukon si former President Donald Trump sang Republicans.
english: November 5 or today is the date that millions of registered voters in the United States of America will decide who will sit in the White House: Vice President Kamala Harris of the Democrats or former President Donald Trump of the Republicans.

text: Masandukot ang karera kag wala pa gid sang klaro tubtub subong kun sin-o ang magadaog sa tunga sang duha ka presidential candidates.
english: The race is tight and it is not yet clear who will win between the two presidential candidates.

text: Apisar minilya-milya ang kalayuon sang Amerika sa Pilipinas, ngaa bala importante nga talupangdon sang mga Pinoy ang US political system kag ngaa dapat i-monitor ang resulta sang eleksyon?
english: Although America is miles away from the Philippines, why is it important for Filipinos to pay attention to the US political system and why should the election results be monitored?

text:
PINAKADAKU NGA KAALYADO

Isa ang Estados Unidos sa mga kaalyado — kun indi man nagapanguna kag pinakadaku nga kaalyado — sang Pilipinas sa pagpakig-away sang soberanya sa West Philippine Sea.
english:
GREATEST ALLIES

The United States is one of the allies — if not the leading and largest ally — of the Philippines in the struggle for sovereignty in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Sa sunod-sunod nga mga pagpang-harass sang China Coast Guard batok sa pwersa sang Pilipinas sa amo nga teritoryo sa kadagatan, may mga nagaduso nga i-invoke na ang Mutual Defense Treaty (MDT) sa tunga sang Manila kag Washington.
english: With the China Coast Guard's series of harassments against Philippine forces in the maritime territory, there are proposals to invoke the Mutual Defense Treaty (MDT) between Manila and Washington.

text: Ini nga kasugtanan sang militar ang naga-edad na sang 73-anyos.
english: This military agreement is 73 years old.

text: Diri nakasaad ang pag-apinay/pagdepensahanay sang duha ka pungsod pananglitan may matabo nga armed attack lakip na sa West Philippine Sea.
english: It states that the two countries will defend each other in the event of an armed attack including in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Dugang pa diri, sa sulod lamang sang duha ka tuig kag tunga, ang Manila kag Washington ang nagsugtanay sa apat ka sites sa idalom sang Enhanced Defense Cooperation Agreement (EDCA), guidelines para sa MDT, pagtukod sang trilateral arrangement kaupod sa Japan, paglunsar sang joint air and sea exercises sa West Philippine Sea (ginatawag nga Maritime Cooperative Activity), kag pagplano sang mas daku nga mga Balikatan.
english: In addition, in just two and a half years, Manila and Washington have agreed on four sites under the Enhanced Defense Cooperation Agreement (EDCA), guidelines for MDT, establishment of a trilateral arrangement with Japan, launch of joint air and sea exercises in the West Philippine Sea (called Active Maritime Cooperation), greater planning of Maritime Cooperation and shoulders.

text: Sang ginpatigayon diri sa Manila ang 2+2 bilateral meeting sa tunga sang foreign affairs kag defense chiefs, nag-anunsyo man ang United States sang $500 million sa foreign military financing sa lima tubtub 10 ka tuig.
english: During the 2+2 bilateral meeting between foreign affairs and defense chiefs held here in Manila, the United States also announced $500 million in foreign military financing over five to 10 years.

text: Suno sa analysts, daku ang mangin impact sang US elections sa geopolitical fate sang duha ka nasyon kun paano atubangon ang mga isyu kaangay sa seguridad sa Indo-Pacific region.
english: According to analysts, the US elections will have a major impact on the geopolitical fate of the two countries on how to deal with issues such as security in the Indo-Pacific region.

text: Sa idalom sang EDCA, natugutan ang US nga magpadala sang ila tropa sa Pilipinas, makatinir, kag makatukod pa sang facilities sa Philippine bases para sa American kag Philippine forces.
english: Under the EDCA, the US is allowed to send troops to the Philippines, stay, and even build facilities at Philippine bases for American and Philippine forces.

text: Lakip sa ginabantayan amo kun tumanon sang US ang treaty obligations sini sa Manila bangud pareho na nga ginpasangkad sang duha ka pungsod ang naval and aerial bases sa northern kag western parts sang Pilipinas.
english: Among the concerns is whether the US will fulfill its treaty obligations in Manila as both countries have expanded naval and aerial bases in the northern and western parts of the Philippines.

text:
MINILYON NGA MGA PILIPINO SA AMERIKA

Matuod nga indi direkta nga maapektuhan sang US elections ang mga Pilipino diri sa Pilipinas, apang lain naman ang sitwasyon sang mga Pinoy nga didto naga-istar kag nagatrabaho sa Estados Unidos.
english:
MILLIONS OF FILIPINOS IN AMERICA

It is true that the US elections will not directly affect Filipinos here in the Philippines, but the situation of Filipinos living and working in the United States is different.

text: As of 2022, may yara sang 4.1 million Filipino-Americans nga nagapuyo sa US suno sa data sang US Census Bureau.
english: As of 2022, there are 4.1 million Filipino-Americans living in the US according to US Census Bureau data.

text: Kag nakahibalo ka bala?
english: And did you know?

text: Isa ang immigration sa pinakamainit nga mga isyu nga nagapalibot sa US presidential elections.
english: Immigration is one of the hottest issues surrounding the US presidential elections.

text:
Pananglitan iduso ni Trump ang iya campaign promise, umpisahan gid sini ang iya ginatawag nga “biggest domestic deportation operation in US history.”

Ini nga proposal ang magaapekto sa minilyon nga undocumented individuals sa US lakip na ang undocumented Filipinos.
english:
If Trump follows through on his campaign promise, he will begin what he calls the “biggest domestic deportation operation in US history.”

This proposal will affect millions of undocumented individuals in the US including undocumented Filipinos.

text: Kun madumduman, sang 2017, nagpreparar na ang Philippine government sa deportation sang 10,000 Filipinos nga mahimo mapalayas sa US matapos gin-untat sang Trump administration ang programa nga nagatugot sa undocumented immigrant children nga mag-istar sang legal sa amo nga pungsod.
english: In 2017, the Philippine government prepared for the deportation of 10,000 Filipinos who could be deported to the US after the Trump administration suspended the program that allows undocumented immigrant children to live legally in the country.

text: Sa bahin ni Harris, ginaduso sini ang comprehensive immigration reforms kaangay sang paghatag-ligwa sa citizenship sa undocumented immigrants.
english: For Harris' part, she is pushing for comprehensive immigration reforms such as relaxing citizenship for undocumented immigrants.

text:
TRADE AND INVESTMENTS

May yara anay sang 23 American Nobel prize winners for economics nga nag-endorso sa economic agenda ni Harris nga ginapahayag mas superior ipaanggid sa iya ni Trump.
english:
TRADE AND INVESTMENTS

There were 23 American Nobel prize winners for economics who endorsed Harris' economic agenda, which is said to be superior to Trump's.

text: Apang, para sa mga Pilipino diri sa Manila, ang pamangkot: maga-invest ayhan ang Trump ukon ang Harris administration sa Pilipinas?
english: However, for Filipinos here in Manila, the question is: will the Trump or the Harris administration invest in the Philippines?

text: Ukon bisan paghaylo na lang sa pribado nga sector nga mag-invest sa Manila — himuon ayhan nila ini?
english: Or even just persuading the private sector to invest in Manila — will they do it?

text: Ang US (kaangay sa Japan) ang nagplastar nga ang Luzon Economic Corridor ang nalakip sa major investments sini sa Pilipinas.
english: The US (like Japan) has placed the Luzon Economic Corridor among its major investments in the Philippines.

text: Sa idalom ni current president Joe Biden, may yara sang ginpadala subong nga tuig nga high-level delegation sa pagpanguna mismo ni Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo kag nagbisita sa Pilipinas.
english: Under current president Joe Biden, a high-level delegation led by Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo visited the Philippines this year.

text: May amo man sini ayhan nga lebel sang interes ukon lihok sa negosyo sa idalom sang masunod nga administrasyon sa Amerika?
english: Will there be the same level of interest or trade movement under the next administration in America?

text:
US, CHINA, KAG PILIPINAS

Bisan sin-o ang magadaog sa eleksyon, nagapabilin ang kamatuoran nga may ‘power struggle’ sa tunga sang China kag Estados Unidos.
english:
US, CHINA, AND THE PHILIPPINES

No matter who wins the election, the fact remains that there is a ‘power struggle’ between China and the United States.

text: Isa sa naipit sa tunga amo ang Pilipinas.
english: One of those stuck in the middle is the Philippines.

text: Sang nagligad nga Septyembre, nag-deliver sang speech si President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: Last September, President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr. delivered a speech.

text: nga naga-address sa sini nga isyu partikular sa kaangtanan sini sa West Philippine Sea.
english: addressing this issue specifically as it relates to the West Philippine Sea.

text: “The Philippines firmly rejects misleading narratives that frame the disputes in the South China Sea solely through the lens of strategic competition between two powerful countries.
english: “The Philippines firmly rejects misleading narratives that frame the disputes in the South China Sea solely through the lens of strategic competition between two powerful countries.

text: This not only denies us our independence and our agency, but it also disregards our own legitimate interests,” pahayag sini sa atubang sang world leaders sa Indonesia.
english: This not only denies us our independence and our agency, but it also disregards our own legitimate interests,” he said before world leaders in Indonesia.

text: Wala sini ginhingadlan ang “powerful countries” nga naangot sa away sa strategic waterway apang ang superpowers nga United States kag China ang masami involved sa word war kaangot sa isyu.
english: It did not name the “powerful countries” involved in the dispute over the strategic waterway but superpowers the United States and China are often involved in a word war over the issue.

text: Ginalantaw man nga ang eleksyon sa bag-o nga US leader ang makaapekto man sa global geopolitics kag ekonomiya, kag magaapekto man sa pagpabilin sang US sa ila nga superpower role sa kalibutan ilabi na bangud ginalantaw na nga pamahog sa ila ang China.
english: The election of the new US leader is also expected to affect global geopolitics and the economy, and will also affect the US's maintenance of its superpower role in the world especially since China is already seen as a threat to them.

text:
*****

Ini kag madamo pa nga mga isyu ang lakip sa mga rason kun ngaa ginabantayan gid ang dalagan sang sambuwa nanday Harris kag Trump.
english:
*****

These and many other issues are among the reasons why the Harris-Trump race is being closely watched.

text: Subong nga adlaw, Nobyembre 5, nabutang sa kamot sang minilyon ka mga botante sang Amerika ang mangin potensyal nga sabat sa sini nga mga pamangkot.
english: Today, November 5th, in the hands of millions of American voters will be the potential answer to these questions.

text: Magpadayon sa pagbantay sa US election updates sa Bombo Radyo Philippines nga dal-on sang masobra 150 ka Bombo International correspondents direkta halin sa nagkalain-lain nga states sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: Stay tuned to US election updates on Bombo Radyo Philippines brought by more than 150 Bombo International correspondents directly from various states in the United States of America.

text: Magasirado na ang kilala nga landmark sa Iloilo City.
english: The famous landmark in Iloilo City will be closed.

text: Ini amo ang Socorro Drug nga nahamtang sa Plazoleta Gay nga sentro sang Iloilo City Proper.
english: This is Socorro Drug located in Plazoleta Gay, the center of Iloilo City Proper.

text: Matapos ang 78 ka tuig nga operasyon kag pagserbisyo sa mga Ilonggo, magasirado na ini sa Hulyo 15, 2025.
english: After 78 years of operation and service to Ilonggos, it will close on July 15, 2025.

text: Nakigsapol si Vice President Sara Duterte kay Senador Rodante Marcoleta sa opisina sini sa Senado.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte met with Senator Rodante Marcoleta at her office in the Senate.

text: Pasado ala-1:30 sang hapon nag-abot si VP Saea kun sa diin ginsugata siya ni Sen.
english: Around 1:30 pm, VP Saea arrived where he was met by Sen.

text: Bong Go.
english: Bong Go.

text: Naglab-ot sa halos isa ka oras ang ila estoryahanay.
english: Their conversation lasted for almost an hour.

text: Nagpamalibad naman si Duterte nga maghatag sang pahayag matapos ang iya pagbisita kag suno sa iya nagadali ini bangid may byahe pa ini padulong sang Sultan Kudarat.
english: Duterte declined to comment after his visit and said he was in a hurry because he had a flight to Sultan Kudarat.

text: Nagpamalibad man ini nga maghatag sang reaksyon angot sa pagbuya sa puwesto ni anay Speaker Martin Romualdez.
english: He also declined to comment on the resignation of former Speaker Martin Romualdez.

text: Wala sang nakit-an nga mga pagpamahog kag mga potensyal nga risgo sa election infrastructure sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika samtang nagapadayon ang piniliay subong nga adlaw.
english: No threats and potential risks to election infrastructure were detected in the United States of America as the election continued today.

text: Apisar sini suno sa U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), wala sila nagakumpyansa kag padayon nga naga-monitor sa tanan nga posible nga “national-level significant incidents” nga may epekto sa seguridad sang piniliay.
english: Despite this, according to the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), they are not complacent and continue to monitor all possible “national-level significant incidents” that have an impact on election security.

text: “We are not currently tracking any national-level significant incidents impacting the security of our election infrastructure,” suno kay Cait Conley, ang senior election adviser sang ahensya.
english: “We are not currently tracking any national-level significant incidents impacting the security of our election infrastructure,” according to Cait Conley, the agency’s senior election adviser.

text: Nagpaandam ini nga may mga pungsod kaangay sang Russia kag Iran nga potensyal nga magpadayon sa pagpalapta sang mga sala-sala nga impormasyon kaangot sa election fraud.
english: He warned that there are countries like Russia and Iran that potentially continue to spread misinformation about election fraud.

text: “We may see more of this activity today and in the coming weeks, with a particular focus on influence narratives impacting swing states,” suno sa natungdan.
english: “We may see more of this activity today and in the coming weeks, with a particular focus on influence narratives impacting swing states,” he said.

text: 6 am ET (Nov 5 sa US) sang nagsugod sa pagbukas ang polling places agud makaboto sang personal ang minilyon nga mga Amerikano kun sin-o kanday Vice President Kamala Harris kag former President Donald Trump ang papungkuon sa White House.
english: 6 am ET (Nov 5 in the US) when polling places began opening for millions of Americans to vote in person on who among Vice President Kamala Harris and former President Donald Trump will sit in the White House.

text: Magpadayon sa pagbantay sa US election updates sa Bombo Radyo Philippines nga dal-on sang masobra 150 ka Bombo International correspondents direkta halin sa nagkalain-lain nga states sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: Stay tuned to US election updates on Bombo Radyo Philippines brought by more than 150 Bombo International correspondents directly from various states in the United States of America.

text: Ginpaidalum na sa autopsy subong nga adlaw, Hulyo 1, 2025, ang bangkay ni Robert Garcia, 45 anyos, residente sang Brgy.
english: The body of Robert Garcia, 45, resident of Brgy.

text: Danao, Tigbauan, Iloilo, nga nasapwan nga wala na sang kabuhi sa Brgy.
english: Danao, Tigbauan, Iloilo, who was found dead in Brgy.

text: Bugasongan sa amo man nga banwa kahapon, Hunyo 30.
english: Bugasongan in the same town yesterday, June 30.

text: Base sa inisyal nga imbestigasyon sang mga kapulisan, nag-agum ini sang lagob sa liog tubtob sa dughan, nga ginapatihan nga ginkastigo rason sang iya kamatayon.
english: Based on the initial investigation of the police, he sustained multiple gunshot wounds from the neck to the chest, believed to have been beaten causing his death.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PCpt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PCpt.

text: Alfred Mansoy, hepe sang Tigbauan Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga may 8 ka ‘persons of interest’ sa kaso, kag tatlo na sa ila ang yara na subong sa kustodiya sang otoridad.
english: Alfred Mansoy, chief of the Tigbauan Municipal Police Station, said there are eight persons of interest in the case, and three of them are now in police custody.

text: Sa imbestigasyon sang mga kapulisan, may yara sang duha ka bersyon sang istorya nga naguwa halin sa mga saksi.
english: In the investigation of the police, there are two versions of the story that came out from the witnesses.

text: Ang una nga bersiyon amo ang iya ni Rodgie Garcia nga pakaisa sang biktima, kun sa diin ginsiling niya nga ginkastigo ang biktima sang pila ka mga persona sa namatyan kung sa diin sila nagkadto nga duwa.
english: The first version is that of Rodgie Garcia, the victim's cousin, where he said that the victim was beaten by several persons at the funeral home where they went together.

text: Sang pauli na sila kag ginaagubay niya ang iya pakaisa, ginbilin niya ang biktima bangud indi na niya ini masarangan nga buligan.
english: When they were on their way home and he was accompanying his cousin, he left the victim because he could not help him.

text: Pagkaaga, nasapwan ang biktima nga wala na sang kabuhi sa lugar kun sa diin niy ini ginbilin.
english: The next morning, the victim was found dead in the place where he left her.

text: Apang sa bersyon naman ni Alyas Nonoy, bata sang ginahaya sa namatyan, iya ginpahayag nga ang biktima kag iya upod ang yara sa impluwensya sang makahulubog nga ilimnon sang sila nagkadto sa namatyan kag nagpanghangkat sang away ang biktima nga may ginnataklos pa nga kutsilyo.
english: However, in the version of Alyas Nonoy, son of the deceased, he said that the victim and his companion were under the influence of alcohol when they went to the deceased and the victim challenged a fight with a knife.

text: Dugang pa niya, matawhay nila nga gin-istorya kag ginpapauli ang biktima para malikawan ang gamo.
english: He added that they calmly talked to the victim and sent him home to avoid trouble.

text: Samtang, ginpahayag naman ni Mansoy nga kun mapamatud-an nga ginpatay ang biktima, magapasaka sang kaso ang pamilya.
english: Meanwhile, Mansoy said that if it is proven that the victim was killed, the family will file a case.

text: Sa subong, ginahulat na lang ang resulta sang autopsy agud mahibaluan ang matuod nga rason sang kamatayon sang biktima.
english: The result of the autopsy is awaited to determine the true cause of death of the victim.

text: Balantayan subong nga adlaw, Hunyo 7, ang bantamweight unification rematch sa tunga ni four-division champion Nonito Donaire Jr.
english: Watch today, June 7, the bantamweight unification rematch between four-division champion Nonito Donaire Jr.

text: kag WBA kag IBF world bantamweight champion nga si Naoya Inoue.
english: and WBA and IBF world bantamweight champion Naoya Inoue.

text: Patigayunon ang hampang sa tunga sang “The Filipino Flash” kag “The Monster” sa Super Arena sa Saitama, Japan, venue kun sa diin man ginpatigayon ang ila una nga sambuwa sang 2019.
english: The match between “The Filipino Flash” and “The Monster” will be held at the Super Arena in Saitama, Japan, venue where their first fight was held in 2019.

text: Ginpatigayon ang weigh-in kahapon — nagabug-at ang 39-anyos nga si Donaire sang 117.8 pounds samtang 118 pounds naman ang 29-anyos nga undefeated Japanese nga si Inoue.Gintawag ni Donaire nga ini ang “biggest fight” sang iya nga boxing career, kag kumpyansa siya nga tapuson ang undefeated run ni Inoue subong nga tuig.
english: The weigh-in was held yesterday — 39-year-old Donaire weighed 117.8 pounds while 29-year-old undefeated Japanese Inoue weighed 118 pounds.

text: Si Donaire amo subong ang nagauyat sang WBC world bantamweight title, kag ginakilala man nga oldest world champion sa 118 pounds.
english: Donaire currently holds the WBC world bantamweight title, and is also recognized as the oldest world champion at 118 pounds.

text: Sang 2019, nalutos ni Inoue si Donaire paagi sa unanimous decision sa isa ka bout nga ginkabig bilang Fight of the Year.
english: In 2019, Inoue defeated Donaire via unanimous decision in a bout that was regarded as Fight of the Year.

text: Ang Pinoy nga boksidor ang may yara sang 42-6 nga rekord nga may 28 ka knockouts, apang nagapabilin nga underdog sa rematch batok sa nasambit nga Japanese star.
english: The Filipino boxer has a 42-6 record with 28 knockouts, but remains the underdog in the rematch against the Japanese star.

text: Una na nga nagsiling si Donaire nga si Inoue ang best fighter sa 118-pound division, apang pahayag sini, nabatyagan niya nga wala siya sa 100 percent sa iya nga pwersa sang napierde siya sa 12-round clash batok sa IBF-WBA bantam king nga Japanese star sang 2019.
english: Donaire has previously said that Inoue is the best fighter in the 118-pound division, but he said he felt he was not at 100 percent of his strength when he lost a 12-round clash against the IBF-WBA bantam king Japanese star in 2019.

text: Kumpyansa siya nga lain na ang resulta sa subong nga adlaw, ilabi na bangud sa iya kadalag-an batok sa duha ka undefeated fighters nga sanday Moroccan boxer Nordine Oubaali sang Mayo 2021 kag Pinoy nga si Reymart Gaballo sang Disyembre sa amo man nga tuig.
english: He is confident that the outcome would be different today, especially given his wins over two undefeated fighters Moroccan boxer Nordine Oubaali in May 2021 and Filipino Reymart Gaballo in December of the same year.

text: Isa ka 4-division champion si Donaire kag nagatuyo nga mangin una nga Pinoy undisputed champion.
english: Donaire is a 4-division champion and aims to become the first Filipino undisputed champion.

text: Kun sin-o man ang magdaog sa tunga ni Donaire kag Inoue, posible nga mag-atubang kay Paul Butler nga amo ang bag-o nga ginkoronahan nga WBO bantamweight champion.
english: Whoever wins between Donaire and Inoue will likely face Paul Butler who is the newly crowned WBO bantamweight champion.

text:
MANILA – ‘A new journey from home!’

Ini ang pahayag sang aktres nga si Julia Montes kadungan sang pagbuyagyag nga nagpa-enroll siya sa isa ka private, non-sectarian school agud padayunon ang pagtuon apisar nga may Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.
english:
MANILA – ‘A new journey from home!’

This is the statement of actress Julia Montes while revealing that she enrolled in a private, non-sectarian school to continue her studies despite the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.

text: Ang maayo nga balita ang ginpaagi ni Julia sa Instagram kun sa diin makita ang laragway nga naga-atubang ini sa laptop.
english: The good news was shared by Julia on Instagram where she was seen facing a laptop.

text: Wala lang gindetalye ni Julia kun ano nga programa ang iya ginkuha.
english: Julia did not elaborate on what program she took.

text: Nahibalu-an nga sang 2015, nagtapos ang 25 anyos nga aktres sa kurso nga culinary arts.
english: In 2015, the 25-year-old actress graduated from a culinary arts course.

text: ILOILO CITY-Gindula sang Philippine Nuclear Research Institute-Department of Science and Technology (PNRI-DOST) ang kahangawa sang publiko sa tion nga madayon ang pag-revive sang Bataan Nuclear Power Plant (BNPP).
english: ILOILO CITY-The Philippine Nuclear Research Institute-Department of Science and Technology (PNRI-DOST) has dispelled public concerns about the revival of the Bataan Nuclear Power Plant (BNPP).

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Carlo Arcilla, director sang Philippine Nuclear Research Institute-Department of Science and Technology (PNRI-DOST), iya ginpahayag nga mapag-on sa gihapon ang istruktura sang amo nga planta apisar nga masobra apat ka dekada na ini nga wala ginagamit.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Carlo Arcilla, director of the Philippine Nuclear Research Institute-Department of Science and Technology (PNRI-DOST), said the structure of the plant is still strong despite being out of use for more than four decades.

text: Suno kay Arcilla, indi man magtanyag ang South Korea sang $1 billion agud i-rehabilitate ang planta kun wala sila sang salig sang integridad sang power plant.
english: Arcilla said South Korea would not offer $1 billion to rehabilitate the plant if they did not trust the integrity of the power plant.

text: Dugang pa niya, kinahanglan man nga panumduman sang maayo sang gobyerno ang proposal sang Seoul bangud sa ila kredibilidad sa rason ngakalabanan sang nuclear power plants sang South Korea ang pareho lang ang edad sa BNPP kag ila nabawi ang construction expenses sa sulod lang sang anom ka tuig.
english: He added that the government should also remember Seoul's proposal because of their credibility on the grounds that most of South Korea's nuclear power plants are the same age as BNPP and they have recovered construction expenses in just six years.

text: Ginpasiguro man sang PNRI director nga sa tion nga maghatag ang gobyerno sang green light agud mag- operate ang BNPP, magasunod ini sa international standards kag magapaidalom sa maid-id nga inspection agud makalikaw sa posible pagluntad sang nuclear disasters.
english: The PNRI director also assured that once the government gives the green light for the BNPP to operate, it will comply with international standards and undergo strict inspection to avoid possible nuclear disasters.

text: Suno pa kay Arcilla,ang BNPP sarang lang nga mag-generate sang masobra sa 600 megawatts sang kuryente kag indi ini bastante gani kinahanglan nga suguran ang paggamit sang nuclear energy bangud nga malapit na lang maubusan sang gas ang main sources sang fuel sang pungsod nga amo ang Malampaya field.
english: According to Arcilla, the BNPP can only generate more than 600 megawatts of electricity and this is not enough so it is necessary to start using nuclear energy because the country's main sources of fuel, the Malampaya field, are about to run out of gas.

text: Ang tanyag sang South Korea kasunod man sang pag-isyu ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte sang Executive Order 164 nga naga-establisar sang nuclear energy program agud mag- expand sang power sources ang pungsod.
english: South Korea's offer also follows President Rodrigo Duterte's issuance of Executive Order 164 establishing a nuclear energy program to expand the country's power sources.

text: Indi na magpakita sa polling places si US President Joe Biden subong nga adlaw kundi maga-monitor na lamang sa White House kun ano ang mangin dalagan sang piniliay sa tunga nanday Vice President Kamala Harris kag former President Donald Trump.
english: US President Joe Biden will not appear at the polls today but will monitor the White House for the election between Vice President Kamala Harris and former President Donald Trump.

text: Suno sa iya long-time aides kag senior White House staff, kaupod ni Biden nga magabantay sa election results ang iya asawa nga si First Lady Jill Biden.
english: According to his long-time aides and senior White House staff, Biden will be watching the election results with his wife, First Lady Jill Biden.

text: Wala man sila sang iban nga kadtuan nga public events subong nga Nobyembre 5 (petsa sa US).
english: They also have no other public events to attend this November 5 (date in the US).

text: Matandaan nga isa ka semana na ang nagligad, nagkadto ang 81-anyos nga current president sa Wilmington, Delaware kag nag-upod sa grupo sang first-time voters sa isa ka early voting location.
english: It can be recalled that a week ago, the 81-year-old current president went to Wilmington, Delaware and joined a group of first-time voters at an early voting location.

text: Si Biden amo kuntani ang orihinal nga magaatubang kay Trump sa eleksyon sa pagka-presidente subong nga tuig — isa ka maragtason nga rematch nga wala nadayon matapos nag-atras si Biden sang Hulyo 21 kag gin-endorso si Harris nga magapanguna sa Democrats.
english: Biden was originally supposed to face Trump in this year’s presidential election — a historic rematch that fell through after Biden withdrew on July 21 and endorsed Harris to lead the Democrats.

text: Ang withdrawal ni Biden sa reelection campaign ang kasunod man sa iya pigado nga performance sa una nga presidential debate batok kay Trump.
english: Biden's withdrawal from the reelection campaign also follows his poor performance in the first presidential debate against Trump.

text: Nag-ulan ang malain nga reaksyon sa amo nga debate bangud madamo na sang bal-ot sa ginapanghambal ni Biden kag nagakalipat sang isugpon — bagay nga ginaangot sa iya edad kag ginasiling nga makaapekto man sa iya liderato.
english: The debate was met with negative reactions because Biden's speech was too much and he forgot what to say — something that is linked to his age and is said to affect his leadership.

text: Samtang yara sa White House ang current president, mataas ang seguridad nga ginahatag sang Secret Service kaangay sang pagtukod sang walo ka tapak nga metal fences.#
english: While the current president is in the White House, the Secret Service is providing high security such as building eight-foot metal fences.

text: Gindayaw sang singer-actor Matteo Guidecelli ang iya asawa nga si Sarah Geronimo bangud sa pagka-talented sini indi lamang sa pagkanta kag pagsaot kundi mangin sa patawag sang baking.
english: Singer-actor Matteo Guidecelli praised his wife Sarah Geronimo for her talent not only in singing and dancing but also in baking.

text: Sa instagram post ni Matteo, iya ginpakigbahin ang picture sang dessert nga ginhimo sang singer-actress.
english: In Matteo's Instagram post, he shared a picture of the dessert made by the singer-actress.

text: Sa caption sang aktor, ang gin-bake nga lemon blueberry buttermilk cake sang iya asawa ang wala sang kapareho kag tuman ka namit.
english: In the actor's caption, his wife's baked lemon blueberry buttermilk cake was unique and extremely delicious.

text: Gingamit man sang 30 anyos nga aktor ang #shesthebest sa pag-describe sa iya asawa.
english: The 30-year-old actor also used #shesthebest to describe his wife.

text: Nahibaluan nga 2016 sang nagtuon si Sarah sa pagluto sa diin nag enroll pa ini sa Center for Asian Cullinary Studies.
english: It was learned that in 2016, Sarah learned to cook and enrolled in the Center for Asian Culinary Studies.

text: Ginsaysay sang kapitan sang barko nga MV Hirman Star ang ila eksperyensya matapos nga ma-stranded ang cargo vessel sa Iloilo-Guimaras Strait sa sulod sang tatlo ka bulan.
english: The captain of the MV Hirman Star narrated their experience after the cargo vessel was stranded in the Iloilo-Guimaras Strait for three months.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo sa kapitan nga taga-Bacolod City apang sa Cavite nagapuyo sa iya pamilya, nagsiling siya nga nag-abot ang barko sang Agosto 2024 kag gindeklarar nga unseaworthy pa sang Setyembre.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, the captain, who is from Bacolod City but lives with his family in Cavite, said the ship arrived in August 2024 and was declared unseaworthy in September.

text: Suno sa iya, Abril pa sila nagsakay apang guba na ang gyrocompass sang barko kag ginpilit sila nga maggamit sang magnetic compass.
english: He said they boarded in April but the ship's gyrocompass was broken and they were forced to use a magnetic compass.

text: Wala sila ginapadal-an sang supply kag suporta halin sa tag-iya, lakip na ang pagkaon kag sweldo.
english: They are not sent supplies and support from the owner, including food and salary.

text: Nagapangayo pa sila sang bulig sa mga mangingisda para lang may makaon.
english: They even ask for help from fishermen just to have something to eat.

text: Bangud sini, nag-antos sila sa kalisod tubtob nga kahapon, Lunes, narescue sila sang Department of Migrant Workers, OWWA, Bureau of Immigration kag Philippine Coast Guard, sa bulig man ni Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne JamJam Baronda.
english: As a result, they suffered until yesterday, Monday, they were rescued by the Department of Migrant Workers, OWWA, Bureau of Immigration and Philippine Coast Guard, with the help of Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne JamJam Baronda.

text: May 13 tanan ang sakay sang barko — 7 ka Indian Nationals kag 6 ka Filipino nga halin sa Batangas, Cebu, Bacolod City, Estancia, San Joaquin, kag Tigbauan.
english: There were 13 people on board — 7 Indian Nationals and 6 Filipinos from Batangas, Cebu, Bacolod City, Estancia, San Joaquin, and Tigbauan.

text: Gintuad sang San Jose de Buenavista, Antique Municipal Police Station nga anay tokhang surrenderee ang lalaki nga nasapwan nga nakasulod sa sako sa Parola Wharf sa tion sang Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english: The San Jose de Buenavista, Antique Municipal Police Station admitted that the man who was found in a sack at Parola Wharf during the Dinagyang Festival 2025 was a former tokhang surrenderee.

text: Ang nasapwan amo si Angelo Brandon Salazar, may live-in partner, may duha ka mga kabataan kag residente sang Barangay 2, San Jose, Antique.
english: The victim was identified as Angelo Brandon Salazar, a live-in partner, two children and a resident of Barangay 2, San Jose, Antique.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Renato Monreal II, Chief of Police sang San Jose de Buenavista, Antique Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nagsungka sa ila talatapan si Salazar sang Hulyo 14, 2016 sa tion man sang war on drugs ni Former Pres.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Renato Monreal II, Chief of Police of San Jose de Buenavista, Antique Municipal Police Station, said Salazar surrendered to their office on July 14, 2016 during the war on drugs of Former Pres.

text: Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Suno kay Monreal, sa tion sa pagkahunong ni Salazar sa presohan, nakagradwar ini sa Community Base Rehabilitation Program sang 2018.
english: According to Monreal, during Salazar's stay in jail, he graduated from the Community Base Rehabilitation Program in 2018.

text: Kasunod sini, wala naman sang may nabalhag ang otoridad sa pagka-angot sini sa iligal nga druga.
english: Subsequently, the authorities have not registered anything related to illegal drugs.

text: Kon balikan, naghalin ang biktima sa ila nga puluy-an sang Enero 22, 2025 apang wala matul-id kun ano ang transaksyon sini.
english: The victim left their home on January 22, 2025 but the transaction was not clear.

text: Base sa inisyal na imbestigasyon, nakaagum ini sang pilas sa iya ulo, patimaan nga ginlampusan ini sang matig-a nga bagay.
english: Based on initial investigation, he sustained injuries to his head, indicating that he was hit with a hard object.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Salazar ang anay anak sang former Vice Mayor kag subong incumbent punong barangay sang Barangay 2, San Jose, Antique nga si Nestor Angel O. Salazar.
english: Salazar is the son of former Vice Mayor and incumbent barangay captain of Barangay 2, San Jose, Antique, Nestor Angel O. Salazar.

text: 17 ka tuig matapos una nga nadag-an ang French Open title sang 2005, ginapamatud-an sa gihapon sang 36-anyos nga Spanish tennis player nga si Rafael Nadal nga siya ang naga-dominar sa iya paborito nga tennis tournament.
english: 17 years after first winning the French Open title in 2005, 36-year-old Spanish tennis player Rafael Nadal is still proving that he dominates his favorite tennis tournament.

text: Ginpierde ni Nadal sa 14th French Open ang 23-anyos nga si Casper Ruud sang Norway sa score nga 6-3, 6-3, 6-0 sa sulod sang duha ka oras kag 18 minutos.
english: Nadal defeated 23-year-old Casper Ruud of Norway 6-3, 6-3, 6-0 in two hours and 18 minutes in the 14th French Open.

text: Si Nadal ang pinakatigulang nga player nga nakadaog sa French Open.
english: Nadal is the oldest player to win the French Open.

text: Ini naman ang iya nga ika-22 nga Grand Slam title.
english: This is his 22nd Grand Slam title.

text: Matandaan nga daog man si Nadal sa Australian Open sang Enero.
english: Nadal also won the Australian Open in January.

text: Abanse na siya sang duha ka Slam titles sa iya rivals nga sanday Novak Djokovic kag Roger Federer nga lunsay may 20.
english: He is two Slam titles ahead of rivals Novak Djokovic and Roger Federer, who both have 20.

text: Makaboto gihapon ang Republican presidential candidate nga si former United States President Donald Trump sa state sang Florida subong nga adlaw apisar nga na-convict ini sa felony crimes.
english: Republican presidential candidate former United States President Donald Trump will still be able to vote in the state of Florida today despite being convicted of felony crimes.

text: Si Trump, 78, amo ang labing-una nga former American president sa maragtas sang nasyon nga nadeklarar sang huwes nga guilty kasunod sang 34 charges bangud sa scheme nga iligal nga impluwensyahan ang 2016 election paagi sa hush money payment sa isa ka porn actress nga si Stormy Daniels.
english: Trump, 78, is the first former American president in the country’s history to be found guilty by a judge following 34 charges over a scheme to illegally influence the 2016 election through a hush money payment to a porn actress Stormy Daniels.

text: Apisar na-anunsyo na direkta halin sa Manhattan, New York ang desisyon nga convicted si Trump sang Mayo, natalana nga ipaguwa ang sentensya sini sa Nobyembre 26.
english: Although the decision to convict Trump was announced directly from Manhattan, New York in May, his sentence is scheduled to be announced on November 26.

text: Sa idalom sang layi sa Florida, kun ang isa ka botante ang may yara sang out-of-state conviction, iga-defer sang Florida sa layi sang sina nga state kun paano makuha liwat sang felon ang iya nga kinamatarong sa pagboto.
english: Under Florida law, if a voter has an out-of-state conviction, Florida will defer to that state's law on how the felon regains his or her right to vote.

text: Para sa kaso ni Trump, buot silingon sini, makabenepisyo siya sa 2021 law sang New York nga nagapahanugot sa mga tawo nga may felony convictions nga magboto sa kondisyon nga wala sila nagaserbe sang term of incarceration sa tion sang eleksyon.
english: For Trump’s case, that means he will benefit from New York’s 2021 law that allows people with felony convictions to vote provided they are not serving a term of incarceration at the time of the election.

text: Kaangot diri, sa Palm Beach, Florida magaabot si Trump subong nga adlaw para nga magboto.
english: Meanwhile, in Palm Beach, Florida, Trump will arrive today to vote.

text: Ini na ang ikatatlo nga tion nga magaboto ang 78-anyos para sa iya kaugalingon sa General Election presidential race.
english: This will be the third time the 78-year-old will vote for himself in the General Election presidential race.

text: Sang 2020, nagboto siya sa Palm Beach County Library System Main Library kag sang amo nga tion, siya ang first incumbent US president nga nagboto sang personal bilang isa na ka Florida resident.
english: In 2020, he voted at the Palm Beach County Library System Main Library and at the time, he was the first incumbent US president to vote in person as already a Florida resident.

text: Na-rescue na ang 13 ka seafarers nga duha ka bulan nga na-stranded sa isa ka international cargo vessel nga MV Hirman Star nga naka-angkorahe sa Loboc Port, Lapuz, Iloilo City.
english: Thirteen seafarers who were stranded for two months on an international cargo vessel MV Hirman Star anchored in Loboc Port, Lapuz, Iloilo City have been rescued.

text: Ini nga seafarers ginalakipan sang anum ka mga Pinoy kag pito ka Indian nationals.
english: The seafarers include six Filipinos and seven Indian nationals.

text: Sa anum nga Filipino crew members, tatlo ang taga-Iloilo nga naghalin sa mga banwa sang Tigbauan, San Joaquin, kag Estancia; samtang ang tatlo ka iban pa ang naghalin sa Batangas, Cebu, kag Manila.
english: Of the six Filipino crew members, three are from Iloilo from the towns of Tigbauan, San Joaquin, and Estancia; while the other three are from Batangas, Cebu, and Manila.

text: Natabo ang rescue operation matapos nga nagpangayo sang assistance ang crew paagi sa pagsulat kay Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne “Jam” Baronda sang Hunyo 28.
english: The rescue operation took place after the crew requested assistance by writing to Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne “Jam” Baronda on June 28.

text: Ginsiling nga nag-abot ang barko halin sa Vietnam nga may karga nga mga bugas sang Agusto 2024, apang nagpabilin ini nga naka-angkorahe sa Loboc bangud nakit-an sa inspeksyon sang Philippine Coast Guard kag Port State Control nga expired na ang trading certificate kag indi pa maayo ang kondisyon sang foreign vessel.
english: The ship reportedly arrived from Vietnam with a load of rice in August 2024, but it remained anchored in Loboc because inspections by the Philippine Coast Guard and Port State Control found that the trading certificate had expired and the condition of the foreign vessel was not good.

text: Abril sang gin-lift ang detention order kag may port clearance nga gin-isyu sang May 7, apang sa pre-departure check, na-diskubrehan sang crew nga non-functional sa gihapon ang gyro compass.
english: The detention order was lifted in April and a port clearance was issued on May 7, but during the pre-departure check, the crew discovered that the gyro compass was still non-functional.

text: Suno sa crew, wala sila nakabaton sang food and water supplies halin sang May 12 kag wala man nabayaran ang Indian seafarers sa sulod na sang tatlo ka bulan.
english: According to the crew, they have not received food and water supplies since May 12 and the Indian seafarers have not been paid for three months.

text: Bangud sini, nag-request sang assistance si Baronda sa Department of Migrant Workers (DMW), Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA), Philippine Coast Guard, Bureau of Customs, Bureau of Immigration, Maritime Industry Authority, kag crewing agency agud nga mapatigayon ang rescue.
english: Baronda requested assistance from the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW), Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA), Philippine Coast Guard, Bureau of Customs, Bureau of Immigration, Maritime Industry Authority, and crewing agency to facilitate the rescue.

text: Naghatag ang DMW kag ang OWWA sang P100,000 nga financial aid para sa na-rescue nga crew members.
english: The DMW and the OWWA provided P100,000 in financial aid for the rescued crew members.

text: Suno kay Baronda, natalana man nga magpaidalom sa debriefing and medical assessments ang seafarers subong nga adlaw.
english: Baronda said the seafarers are also scheduled to undergo debriefing and medical assessments today.

text:
Gina-facilitate man nga makapauli na ang mga Indian nationals sa ila pungsod.#

*Photo: Jamjam Baronda/FB
english:
Indian nationals are also being facilitated to return to their country.

*Photo: Jamjam Baronda/FB

text: Gintawag ni Senior Deputy Majority Leader Lorenz Defensor nga pinakamataas nga sahi sang plunder ang flood control scandal nga nagguba sa reputasyon sang Kamara.
english: Senior Deputy Majority Leader Lorenz Defensor called the flood control scandal that tarnished the reputation of the House of Representatives the highest form of plunder.

text: Ini ang rason nga nagpanawagan man siya sang pagbag-o sa pamunuan sang House.
english: This is why he also called for a change in the leadership of the House.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Defensor nga bug-os ang iya suporta sa bag-o nga liderato kag nangako nga mangalagad sa idalom ni Deputy Speaker Bojie Dy nga magabulos kay Speaker Martin Romualdez subong nga adlaw.
english: Defensor also expressed his full support for the new leadership and promised to serve under Deputy Speaker Bojie Dy who will replace Speaker Martin Romualdez today.

text: Dugang pa ni Defensor, kinahanglan nga matukod lang kamara ang reputasyon sini kag mabawi ang iya integridad.
english: Defensor added that the chamber needs to rebuild its reputation and regain its integrity.

text: Suno pa sa iya, dapat may manabat gid kag mapreso sa sini nga anomaliya.
english: Suno pa sa iya, dapat may manabat gid kag mapreso sa sini nga anomaliya.

text: Liwat nga nag upod ang mga veteran singers nga sanday Jim Paredes kag Boboy Garovillo sang APO Hiking Society para sa isa ka orihinal nga ambahanon tuhoy sa lockdown subong nga pandemya.
english: Veteran singers Jim Paredes and Boboy Garovillo of APO Hiking Society once again joined forces for an original song about the lockdown during this pandemic.

text: Ang tigulo sang ambahanon amo ang “Quarantine Baby” nga nagatumod sa nabatyagan sang tawo nga separado sa iya pinalangga sa kabuhi subong nga may COVID-19 pandemic.
english: The title of the song is “Quarantine Baby” which refers to the feeling of being separated from his loved one in life during the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Ini ang panibag-o nga collaboration nanday Jim kag Boboy nga amo ang mga myembro sang APO Hiking Society nga nagapabilin nga aktibo sa gihapon sa showbiz.
english: This is the new collaboration of Jim and Boboy who are members of APO Hiking Society who remain active in showbiz.

text: Mismo si Jim ang nagbalay sang ambahanon nga “Quarantine Baby”.
english: Jim himself composed the song “Quarantine Baby”.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginkonsidera ang APO Hiking Society bilang OPM legends sa diin may yara ini sang masobra 22 ka mga albums antes ang ila pag retiro sang 2010.
english: It is known that APO Hiking Society is considered as OPM legends where it has more than 22 albums before their retirement in 2010.

text: Gintapos na sang Wales ang 64 ka tuig nga paghulat agud nga maka-sulod sa World Cup.
english: Wales have ended a 64-year wait to qualify for the World Cup.

text: Ginpierde sini ang Ukraine, 1-0, sa play-off final sa Cardiff City Stadium sa Cardiff, Wales.
english: It defeated Ukraine, 1-0, in the play-off final at the Cardiff City Stadium in Cardiff, Wales.

text: Sulod ang Wales sa Group B kag atubangon ang England, United States kag Iran sa FIFA World Cup 2022 sa Qatar sa Nobyembre.
english: Wales enter Group B and face England, United States and Iran at the FIFA World Cup 2022 in Qatar in November.

text: Pareho nga tuman ka importante para sa Ukraine kag Wales ang amo nga hampang.
english: Both Ukraine and Wales were extremely important for that match.

text: Gutom ang Wales sa kadalag-an bangud 1958 pa sang katapusan nga nakit-an sa World Cup ang Welsh football team.
english: Wales are hungry for success as the Welsh football team last appeared in the World Cup in 1958.

text: Sunod sini, asud-asud na nga kapaslawan ang natabo sa team.
english: After that, the team suffered a series of failures.

text: Nag-qualify ang team sa Euro 2016 — ang tion nga natapos ang 58-anyos nga paghulat sa major tournament kag sunod nga nakalab-ot sa first semi-final sa France.
english: The team qualified for Euro 2016 — the moment that ended a 58-year wait for the major tournament and subsequently reached the first semi-final in France.

text: Sunod sini amo ang pag-qualify sa Euro 2020, apang lain nga lebel ang pag-qualify sini sa World Cup.
english: Next up is qualifying for Euro 2020, but it’s a different level qualifying for the World Cup.

text: Sa bahin sang Ukraine, ini man kuntani ang tion agud nga mapakita ang pwersa kag mahatagan dungog kag kusog ang pungsod nga subong gina-atake sang Russia.
english: On the Ukrainian side, this was also supposed to be a moment in order to show force and give prestige and strength to the country that is currently under attack by Russia.

text: Sang play-off semi-finals, nangin emosyonal man ang Ukrainian football fans sang ginpierde sang Ukraine ang Scotland, 3-1, sa Hampden Park sa Glasgow, Scotland.
english: During the play-off semi-finals, Ukrainian football fans also became emotional when Ukraine defeated Scotland, 3-1, at Hampden Park in Glasgow, Scotland.

text: Apang sa hampang batok sa Wales, ngkabos ang Ukraine sa tuyo sini nga makalab-ot sa ikaduha nga World Cup sa maragtas sang team.
english: But in the game against Wales, Ukraine fell short in its bid to reach the second World Cup in the team's history.

text: Samtang nagahampang sa Cardiff, todo-cheer ang supporters sang Ukraine lakip na ang 100 ka refugees nga ginhatagan sang Football Association of Wales sang free tickets.
english: While playing in Cardiff, Ukraine supporters were in full cheer, including 100 refugees who were given free tickets by the Football Association of Wales.

text: Mangin ang home fans ukon ang fans sang Wales ang nagpakita man sang ila nga official “warm Welsh welcome” sa mga taga-Ukraine bilang suporta sa pungsod nga naipit subong sa pagpang-atake sang kaiping nga pungsod Russia.
english: Both the home fans and the fans of Wales also showed their official “warm Welsh welcome” to the Ukrainians in support of the country that is now trapped in the attack of neighboring Russia.

text: Nakaboto na sa Cincinnati, Ohio ang Republican vice-presidential candidate nga si JD Vance.
english: Republican vice-presidential candidate JD Vance has already voted in Cincinnati, Ohio.

text: Kaupod sini nga nagkadto sa polling place kag sa St.
english: He was accompanied by those who went to the polling place and St.

text: Anthony of Padua Church ang iya asawa nga si Usha kag ila mga kabataan.
english: Anthony of Padua Church his wife Usha and their children.

text: Matapos nagboto para sa Trump-Vance ticket, nagpasalamat si Vance sa tanan nga mga nagguwa agud nga magpili sang kandidato nga magapungko sa White House.
english: After voting for the Trump-Vance ticket, Vance thanked everyone who came out to elect a candidate to sit in the White House.

text: Si Vance nga runningmate ni former US President Donald Trump ang nagapadalagan batok kay Minnesota Governor Tim Walz nga vice presidential pick naman sang Democrats.
english: Vance, a runningmate of former US President Donald Trump, is running against Minnesota Governor Tim Walz, the Democrats' vice presidential pick.

text: “I feel good, you never know until you know, but I feel good about this race,” pahayag sini.
english: “I feel good, you never know until you know, but I feel good about this race,” he said.

text: “I felt good about my own race a couple years ago when I voted in this exact same spot.
english: “I felt good about my own race a couple years ago when I voted in this exact same spot.

text:
Hopefully it goes as well for President Trump and me as it went for me a couple years ago in the state of Ohio.”

Antes ang election day, gintakpan sang Ohio senator ang iya nga vice-presidential campaign sa Bucks County sa Pennsylvania.
english:
Hopefully it goes as well for President Trump and me as it went for me a couple years ago in the state of Ohio.”

Before election day, the Ohio senator closed his vice-presidential campaign in Bucks County in Pennsylvania.

text: Isa ini ka critical battleground state kag state man kun sa diin nalutos si Trump sa 80,000 votes sang 2020 elections batok kay current President Joe Biden.
english: It is a critical battleground state and also the state where Trump lost by 80,000 votes in the 2020 elections against current President Joe Biden.

text: “We’ve got to serve our veterans better, we’ve got to serve our parents better.
english: “We’ve got to serve our veterans better, we’ve got to serve our parents better.

text: We’ve got to make sure the American dream is accessible again, but the only way we are going to do it, is to fix the one thing that’s broken about this country, and that is Kamala Harris’ failed leadership in Washington.
english: We’ve got to make sure the American dream is accessible again, but the only way we are going to do it, is to fix the one thing that’s broken about this country, and that is Kamala Harris’ failed leadership in Washington.

text: Let’s make Donald J. Trump the next president of the United States,” kabahin sang mensahe ni Vance sa iya final campaign.
english: Let’s make Donald J. Trump the next president of the United States,” was part of Vance’s final campaign message.

text: Sigurado na nga indi magbiyahe buwas nga adlaw Lunes, Marso 23 ang masobra 400 ka public utility vehicles nga sakop sang 11 ka mga transport cooperatives sa Western Visayas bangod sa ila patigayunon nga transport strike.
english: More than 400 public utility vehicles belonging to 11 transport cooperatives in Western Visayas will not travel tomorrow Monday, March 23 due to their transport strike.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Halley Alcarde, Vice President sang Western Visayas Alliance of Transport Cooperatives and Corporations Inc.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Halley Alcarde, Vice President of the Western Visayas Alliance of Transport Cooperatives and Corporations Inc.

text: (WVATCC), iya ginphayag nga mabug-at man sa ila buot ang ila patigayunon nga transport strike apang kinahanglan nila ini nga himuon.
english: (WVATCC), he said that they are also worried about their transport strike but they have to do it.

text: Lakip sa mga kooperatiba nga maga-upod amo ang WVTC (Western Visayas Transport Cooperative), CITSCO (City Iloilo Transport Service Cooperative), kag ICAODTC (Iloilo City Alliance of Operators and Drivers Transport Cooperative) nga naga-operate sa nagkalain-lain nga distrito sa Iloilo.
english: Among the cooperatives that will participate are WVTC (Western Visayas Transport Cooperative), CITSCO (City Iloilo Transport Service Cooperative), and ICAODTC (Iloilo City Alliance of Operators and Drivers Transport Cooperative) operating in various districts in Iloilo.

text: Ginpahayag man sang grupo nga apisar may ara sang binilyon nga budget ang gobyerno para sa mga proyekto sa imprastruktura, apang wala gid sila natutukan ukon nahatagan man lang sang importansya direkta sa sector sang transportasyon nga suno pa sa ila mas madamo kuntani nga pumuluyo ang mabuligan.
english: The group also said that although the government has billions of dollars in budget for infrastructure projects, they have not been focused or given importance directly to the transportation sector which they say could have helped more people.

text: Nagapanawagan man ang mga ini nga kuntani mahatagan man sila sang igtalupangod bangud kaangay sang iban nabudlayan man sila sa ila pagakuhaan sang ila pangabuhian ilabi na sa subong nga ginapangatubang nga kabudlayan sa ila sector.
english: They also called for attention because like others they are also struggling with their livelihood especially in the current difficulties in their sector.

text: Nasapwan na lang sang isa ka amay ang tatlo niya ka kabataan nga nagapaligo sa kaugalingon nga dugo sa sulod sang ila balay sa Hacienda Badiang, Barangay E-Lopez, Silay City, Negros Occidental.
english: A father found his three children bathing in their own blood inside their house in Hacienda Badiang, Barangay E-Lopez, Silay City, Negros Occidental.

text: Sa malain nga palad, isa ka gid sa ila ang napatay samtang kritikal naman ang duha nga ginabulong subong sa ospital.
english: Unfortunately, one of them died while the other two are in critical condition and are being treated at the hospital.

text: Ang napatay amo ang siyam ka tuig nga babaye samtang ang mga pilason amo ang 14-anyos nga babaye kag apat ka tuig nga lalaki.
english: The deceased was a nine-year-old girl while the injured were a 14-year-old girl and a four-year-old boy.

text: Ang mga biktima, ginpanglampusan sang bato sang wala pa makilal-an nga mga suspek.
english: The victims were stoned by unidentified suspects.

text: Wala sang iban nga kaupod ang mga biktima sa ila balay bangud nagatrabaho sa Bacolod City ang ila amay nga si Edmon Bornales kag kun weekend lamang ini nagapauli.
english: The victims had no one else in their house because their father, Edmon Bornales, works in Bacolod City and only comes home on weekends.

text: Sa Saudi Arabia naman nagatrabaho ang ila iloy.
english: Their mother works in Saudi Arabia.

text: Sa imbestigasyon sang kapulisan, wala nakapauli sang Biyernes sang gab-i ang amay bangud nagaulan gani sang Sabado sang aga na ini nakapauli sa ila balay.
english: According to police investigation, the father did not return home on Friday night because it was raining and he returned home on Saturday morning.

text: Didto na kag naabtan niya ang makakuluoy nga sitwasyon sang iya kabataan.
english: It was there that she came across the plight of her children.

text: Nakit-an man sa sulod ang mga bato nga posible gin-gamit sa krimen.
english: Stones that may have been used in the crime were also found inside.

text: May ginasundan na subong nga person of interest ang mga otoridad samtang nagapadayon ang imbestigasyon.
english: Authorities are now pursuing a person of interest as the investigation continues.

text: Napilian ang pelikula nga “Green Bones” bilang opisyal nga entry sang Pilipinas para sa 2026 Oscars ukon ang prestihiyoso nga 98th Academy Awards sa kategorya nga International Feature Film.
english: The film “Green Bones” has been selected as the Philippines’ official entry for the 2026 Oscars or the prestigious 98th Academy Awards in the International Feature Film category.

text: Bida sa sini nga multi-awarded film sanday Dennis Trillo kag Ruru Madrid.
english: This multi-awarded film stars Dennis Trillo and Ruru Madrid.

text: “A story worth sharing with the world — reminding us that even in the darkest places, humanity endures.
english: “A story worth sharing with the world — reminding us that even in the darkest places, humanity endures.

text: ‘Green Bones’ challenges us to look deeper and question our ideas of justice and redemption,” base sa social media post sang GMA Pictures.
english: ‘Green Bones’ challenges us to look deeper and question our ideas of justice and redemption,” based on GMA Pictures’ social media post.

text:
Antes napili ang Green Bones, nangin contender man ang “Food Delivery,” “Sunshine,” “Hello Love Again,” “Magellan,” “Song of the Fireflies,” kag “Some Nights I feel Like Walking.”

Sa Metro Manila Film Festival 2024, naghakot ang Green Bones sang anum ka awards lakip na ang Best Actor para kay Dennis; Best Supporting Actor para kay Ruru; kag ang ang Best Picture.
english:
Before Green Bones was selected, “Food Delivery,” “Sunshine,” “Hello Love Again,” “Magellan,” “Song of the Fireflies,” and “Some Nights I feel Like Walking” were also contenders.

At the Metro Manila Film Festival 2024, Green Bones picked up six awards including Best Actor for Dennis; Best Supporting Actor for Ruru; and the the Best Picture.

text: Sa Disyembre mahibaluan kun sulod sa shortlist ini nga Filipino film.
english: In December, we will know if this Filipino film is on the shortlist.

text: Hiwaton naman ang seremonya sa March 15, 2026.
english: The ceremony will be held on March 15, 2026.

text: Nahibaluan nga may 34 cumulative submissions na ang Pilipinas sa sini nga category, apang wala pa gid sang na-nominate sa Oscar.
english: The Philippines has 34 cumulative submissions in this category, but has not yet been nominated for an Oscar.

text: Ang 2024 submission amo ang And So It Begins.#
english: The 2024 submission is And So It Begins.#

text: Nagtakop ang tuig 2025 nga may 1.7% nga average inflation rate ang Pilipinas, suno sa Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA).
english: The Philippines will end 2025 with an average inflation rate of 1.7%, according to the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA).

text: Ini nga porsyento ang sulod sa target sang gobyerno nga 2% tubtob 4%.
english: This percentage is within the government’s target of 2% to 4%.

text: Suno kay National Statistician kag PSA chief Claire Dennis Mapa, ang kabug-osan nga inflation rate sang Disyembre 2025 ang naglab-ot sa 1.8% , mas mataas kumpara sa 1.5% nga na-record sa bulan sang Nobyembre.
english: According to National Statistician and PSA chief Claire Dennis Mapa, the overall inflation rate in December 2025 reached 1.8% , higher than the 1.5% recorded in November.

text: Bangud sini naka-record sang 1.7% nga national average inflation rate para sa tuig 2025, nga nagakahulugan nga ang presyo sang mga balaklon sa Pilipinas stable kag kontrolado.
english: As a result, it has recorded a 1.7% national average inflation rate for the year 2025, which means that the prices of goods in the Philippines are stable and controlled.

text: Ginkumpiskar sang otoridad sang Japan ang barko nga ginagamit sa pagpangisda nga nagikan sa China.
english: Japanese authorities confiscated a fishing vessel from China.

text: Gin-aresto man sini ang kapitan sini matapos nagpalagyo sa inspeksyon sa sulod sang exclusive economic zone sang Japan.
english: It also arrested its captain after he fled an inspection inside Japan's exclusive economic zone.

text: May 10 ka sakay ang nasambit nga barko sang natabo ang insidente.
english: The ship was carrying 10 people when the incident occurred.

text: Apisar nakakumpiskar na ang Japan sang mga barko nga pangisdaan halin sa South Korea kag Taiwan sang mga nagligad nga tinuig, ini naman ang labing una nga ginakaulamiran sang sakayan-pandagat nagikan sa China humalin tuig 2022.
english: Although Japan has confiscated fishing vessels from South Korea and Taiwan in recent years, this is the first known seizure of a vessel from China since 2022.

text: Natabo ini sa tunga sang nagalala nga diplomatiko nga relasyon sa tunga sang duwa ka pungsod.
english: This comes amid worsening diplomatic relations between the two countries.

text: Suno sa Chief Cabinet Secretary sang Japan nga si Minoru Kihara magapadayon ang mga ini sang hugot kag determinado nga pagpatuman sang layi agud malikawan kag mapa-untat ang illegal nga pagpangisda sang mga foreign vessel sa ila nga pungsod.
english: Japanese Chief Cabinet Secretary Minoru Kihara said they will continue to strictly and determinedly enforce the law to prevent and stop illegal fishing by foreign vessels in their country.

text: Wala naman sang sabat ang foreign ministry ng China sa nasambit nga pahayag sang Japan.
english: China's foreign ministry did not respond to Japan's statement.

text: Mahimo nga mangin epidemic ang Marburg virus disease (MVD) suno sa World Health Organization (WHO) kag madasig nga maglapta kun indi gilayon matapna.
english: Marburg virus disease (MVD) can become an epidemic according to the World Health Organization (WHO) and spread quickly if not stopped immediately.

text: Agusto sang nagligad nga tuig sang nag-report ang Ministry of Health of Guinea nga kumpirmado nga kaso sini nga balatian — lalaki nga may hilanat, may sakit sa ulo, may fatigue, kag abdominal pain kag gingival hemorrhage.
english: It was August last year when the Ministry of Health of Guinea reported a confirmed case of the disease — male with fever, headache, fatigue, and abdominal pain and gingival hemorrhage.

text: Napatay ang amo nga pasyente sang Agusto 2 — eksakto isa ka semana matapos ini nagpakita sang sintomas nga amo naman ang nagtulod sa public health care facility nga hingyuon sa Guéckédou’s prefectorial health department nga mag-imbestigar.
english: The patient died on August 2 — exactly a week after he showed symptoms that prompted the public health care facility to ask Guéckédou’s prefectural health department to investigate.

text: Sunod nga nagtipon ang Ministry of Health sang post-mortem oral swab sample, ginpatigayon ang real-time PCR, kag nakumpirma nga positibo ang pasyente sa MVD kag negative sa Ebola virus disease (EVD).
english: The Ministry of Health subsequently collected a post-mortem oral swab sample, conducted real-time PCR, and confirmed that the patient was positive for MVD and negative for Ebola virus disease (EVD).

text: Bangud sini, naghimo sang tikang ang Guinean Ministry of Health, WHO, United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (US CDC), Alima, Red Cross, kag United Nations Children’s Fund agud nga mapunggan ang outbreak.
english: As a result, the Guinean Ministry of Health, WHO, United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (US CDC), Alima, Red Cross, and United Nations Children’s Fund have taken steps to contain the outbreak.

text: Suno naman sa Department of Health (DOH) sa Pilipinas, sa subong, manubo pa kun kabigon nga pamahog ukon risgo sa pungsod ini nga balatian, apang posible gihapon ini nga makalab-ot sa Pilipinas rason nga dapat bantayan ang borders sang pungsod kag dapat nga maghalong.
english: According to the Department of Health (DOH) in the Philippines, at present, the disease is still low enough to be considered a threat or risk to the country, but it is still possible to reach the Philippines so the country's borders should be monitored and caution should be exercised.

text: Ini bangud ginakabig nga severe disease ang MVD (kilala anay bilang Marburg Hemorrhagic Fever) kag makamamatay bangud nagatuga ini sang malala nga viral hemorrhagic fever kun ma-infect ang isa ka tawo.
english: This is because MVD (formerly known as Marburg Hemorrhagic Fever) is considered a severe disease and is fatal because it causes severe viral hemorrhagic fever if a person is infected.

text:
NEW OUTBREAK

Halos isa ka tuig matapos nga nakumpirma sa Guinea ang una nga MVD case, nagkumpirma man ang Ghana nga may duha ka kaso sang amo nga balatian sa pungsod kag pareho man nga napatay.
english:
NEW OUTBREAK

Almost a year after the first MVD case was confirmed in Guinea, Ghana also confirmed two cases of the disease in the country and both died.

text: Suno sa WHO, nagikan ang mga pasyente sa Ashanti region, kag pareho nga may sintomas kaangay sang diarrhea, fever, nausea kag pagsuka antes sila napatay sa ospital.
english: According to the WHO, the patients were from the Ashanti region, and both had symptoms such as diarrhea, fever, nausea and vomiting before they died in hospital.

text: Suno sa Ghana Health Service (GHS), nagahimo na ini sang nagakaigu nga mga tikang agud nga matapna ang balatian.
english: According to the Ghana Health Service (GHS), it is already taking appropriate measures to contain the disease.

text: Naka-isolate subong ang 98 ka identified contacts sang duha ka MVD patients.
english: A total of 98 identified contacts of the two MVD patients are currently in isolation.

text: Wala pa sang bisan isa sa ila ang nakitaan sang sintomas.
english: None of them have shown any symptoms.

text: Antes sini, may na-report man nga outbreak sa Angola, Democratic Republic of Congo, Kenya, South Africa, kag Uganda.
english: Previously, outbreaks were also reported in Angola, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Kenya, South Africa, and Uganda.

text: Ang outbreak sa Angola sang 2004 tubtub sang 2005 ang nangin rason sang kamatayon sang 227 ka mga tawo.
english: The outbreak in Angola from 2004 to 2005 killed 227 people.

text: ANO INI NGA BALATIAN?
english: WHAT IS THIS DISEASE?

text: Makabig nga “highly virulent disease” ang MVD nga nagatuga sang hemorrhagic fever.
english: MVD is considered a highly virulent disease that causes hemorrhagic fever.

text: Suno sa WHO, nalakip ini nga virus sa family sang virus nga nagatuga sang Ebola.
english: According to the WHO, the virus belongs to the family of viruses that cause Ebola.

text: Yara sa 24 tubtub 88% ang fatality rate, kag nagadepende ini sa virus strain kag sa case management.
english: The fatality rate ranges from 24 to 88%, depending on the virus strain and case management.

text: Una nga naangot ini nga outbreak sa laboratory work nga nagagamit sang African green monkey (Cercopithecus aethiops) nga na-import halin sa Uganda.
english: This outbreak was first linked to laboratory work using an African green monkey (Cercopithecus aethiops) imported from Uganda.

text: Sang 2008, na-detect ini nga virus sa duha ka travelers nga nagbisita sa kweba kun sa diin nagaistar ang Rousettus bat colonies sa Uganda.
english: In 2008, the virus was detected in two travelers who visited a cave where Rousettus bat colonies live in Uganda.

text:
Kun ma-expose ang tawo sa mines ukon sa mga kweba kun sa diin may Rousettus bat colonies kag kun ma-infect na ini sang virus, mahimo nga maglapta ang MVD kun may direct contact sa mga masunod:

– Dugo sang infected nga tawo

– Secretions sang infected nga tawo

– Organs ukon iban pa nga bodily fluids sang infected nga tawo

– Materials kangay sang bedding kag bayo nga contaminated sang bodily fluids sang infected nga tawo

Ang Rousettus aegyptiacus, fruit bats sang Pteropodidae family, amo ang ginakabig nga natural hosts sang virus nga nagalaton sa tawo

Ang health workers amo ang masami nga nagaka-infect kun ginabulong ang pasyente nga gina-suspetsuhan ukon kumpirmado nga may MVD.
english:
If a person is exposed to mines or caves where there are Rousettus bat colonies and if they are infected with the virus, MVD can spread through direct contact with the following:

– Infected person’s blood

– Secretions of an infected person

– Organs or other bodily fluids of an infected person

– Materials such as bedding and clothing contaminated with bodily fluids of an infected person

Rousettus aegyptiacus, fruit bats of the Pteropodidae family, are considered natural hosts of the virus that infects humans

Health workers are most likely to become infected when treating patients suspected or confirmed to have MVD.

text: Matabo ini kun naga-close contact sa pasyente kag kun wala ginasunod ang infection control precautions.
english: This can happen if you are in close contact with the patient and if infection control precautions are not followed.

text: Ang sintomas amo ang hilanat, pagpalanglamig, kag muscle pains.
english: Symptoms include fever, chills, and muscle pains.

text: Kun makaumpisa na sa pagpakita ang sintomas, mahimo naman nga magsunod ang rashes sa dughan, likod, kag sa tiyan.
english: Once symptoms begin to appear, rashes on the chest, back, and abdomen may follow.

text: Base sa data sang Center for Disease Control and Prevention, halin sang 1967 to 2021, may 417 confirmed MVD cases kag 377 deaths sa kalibutan.
english: Based on data from the Center for Disease Control and Prevention, from 1967 to 2021, there were 417 confirmed MVD cases and 377 deaths in the world.

text: Sa Angola, out of 252 cases, 227 ang napatay.
english: In Angola, out of 252 cases, 227 have died.

text:
Yari ang data:

1967, Germany and Yugoslavia: 31 cases, 7 deaths

1975, South Africa: 3 cases, 1 death

1980, Kenya: 2 cases, 1 death

1987, Kenya: 1 case, 1 death

1990, Russia: 1 case, 1 death

1998 to 2000, Democratic Republic of Congo: 154 cases, 128 deaths

2004 to 2005, Angola: 252 cases, 227 deaths

2007, Uganda: 4 cases, 1 death

2008, US (traveler from Uganda): 1 case, 0 death

2008, Netherlands (traveler from Uganda): 1 case, 1 death

2012, Uganda: 15 cases, 4 deaths

2014, Uganda: 1 case, 1 death

2017, Uganda: 4 cases, 1 death

2021, Guinea: 1 case, 1 death

2022, Ghana: 2 cases, 2 deaths
