Ginpahayag man sang WHO nga mabudlay nga i-clinically distinguish ang MVD halin sa iban nga infectious diseases kaangay sang malaria, typhoid fever, shigellosis, meningitis, kag iban pa nga viral hemorrhagic fevers.
english:
Here is the data:

1967, Germany and Yugoslavia: 31 cases, 7 deaths

1975, South Africa: 3 cases, 1 death

1980, Kenya: 2 cases, 1 death

1987, Kenya: 1 case, 1 death

1990, Russia: 1 case, 1 death

1998 to 2000, Democratic Republic of Congo: 154 cases, 128 deaths

2004 to 2005, Angola: 252 cases, 227 deaths

2007, Uganda: 4 cases, 1 death

2008, US (traveler from Uganda): 1 case, 0 death

2008, Netherlands (traveler from Uganda): 1 case, 1 death

2012, Uganda: 15 cases, 4 deaths

2014, Uganda: 1 case, 1 death

2017, Uganda: 4 cases, 1 death

2021, Guinea: 1 case, 1 death

2022, Ghana: 2 cases, 2 deaths

The WHO also stated that it is difficult to clinically distinguish MVD from other infectious diseases such as malaria, typhoid fever, shigellosis, meningitis, and other viral hemorrhagic fevers.

text: MABULONG BALA INI?
english: CAN IT HEAL?

text: Wala pa sang bakuna ukon antiviral treatments nga naaprubahan para sa MVD suno sa WHO.
english: There are no vaccines or antiviral treatments approved for MVD, according to the WHO.

text: Apang pahayag sang WHO, “Early supportive care with rehydration, and symptomatic treatment improves survival.
english: But the WHO said, “Early supportive care with rehydration, and symptomatic treatment improves survival.

text: There is as yet no licensed treatment proven to neutralize the virus, but a range of blood products, immune therapies and drug therapies are currently under development.” ##
english: There is as yet no licensed treatment proven to neutralize the virus, but a range of blood products, immune therapies and drug therapies are currently under development.” ##

text: Masarangan ayhan sang tawo nga lutuson ang robot?
english: Can a human beat a robot?

text: Ukon masarangan ayhan sang robot nga himuon ang mga masarangan sang tawo?
english: Or will a robot be able to do what humans can do?

text: Sa China, may ara sang isa ka interesante nga kumpetisyon nga ginabantayan sa capital city sa Beijing kun sa diin magatipon ang linibo ka mga tawo nga runners nga magapa-indis-indis batok sa bipedal robots.
english: In China, there is an interesting competition being watched in the capital city of Beijing where thousands of human runners will gather to compete against bipedal robots.

text: Indi lang ini basta-basta nga mga robot bangud produkto sila sang nagapanguna nga robotics companies sa kalibutan kaangay sang Tesla, Boston Dynamics kag 1X.
english: These are not just any robots as they are products of the world’s leading robotics companies such as Tesla, Boston Dynamics and 1X.

text: Matabo ang kumpetisyon sa Abril kun sa diin ang host amo ang Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area (E-Town).
english: The competition will take place in April with the host Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area (E-Town).

text: 12,000 ka mga tawo ang ginalauman nga magapasakop kag dinosena nga bipedal robots sa amo nga half-marathon.
english: 12,000 people are expected to participate and dozens of bipedal robots in that half-marathon.

text: Para nga makapasakop ang robot, dapat nga may yara ini sang human-inspired appearance kag dapat nga ang kataason sini ang limitado lamang sa 0.5 tubtub sa 2 metros.
english: To be eligible, the robot must have a human-inspired appearance and must be limited to 0.5 to 2 meters in height.

text: Ang winner sa kumpetisyon — tawo man ukon robot — ang makabaton sang padya nga kuwarta depende sa ila nga performance.
english: The winner of the competition — whether human or robot — will receive a cash prize depending on their performance.

text: May mga eksperto nga nagasiling nga ang seasoned human runners ang may yara sang edge batok sa bipedal robots.
english: Some experts say that seasoned human runners will have the edge against bipedal robots.

text: Ginapahayag nga ang range sang robot ang yara lamang sa 8 to 12 km/h, magluwas pa nga isa pa ka factor ang battery autonomy.
english: The range of the robot is said to be only 8 to 12 km/h, besides another factor is battery autonomy.

text: Antes sini, nag-anunsyo naman ang organizers nga tugutan nila ang pag-ilis sang baterya samtang padayon ang karera.
english: Earlier, the organizers announced that they would allow battery replacement while the race continues.

text: May yara man anay sang robot sa South Korea nga nag-compete sa official running event sang 2024, apang indi ini maka-intra sa half-marathon sa China sa Abril bangud bukas lamang ang kumpetisyon sa Beijing para sa bipedal robots.
english: There was also a previous robot in South Korea that competed in the official running event in 2024, but it will not be able to participate in the half-marathon in China in April because the competition in Beijing is only open for bipedal robots.

text: INDI dapat katingalahan ang pag-upod sang isa ka lalake kag isa ka babaye sa pangabuhi nga may kapinasahe nga pagkatuhay ang ila sitwasyon.
english: IT should not be surprising that a man and a woman whose circumstances are very different live together.

text: Ina tungod sa madamo na nga kasubong nga mga kaso nga nagakatabo sa aton palibut, nga indi na naton dapat libakon kag iyumo-yumo lang kag kaluy-an pa gani ang iban.
english: That's because there are so many such cases happening around us, that we shouldn't just ridicule and smile and even pity others.

text: Samtang ang iban ginakuhaan pa naton sang modelo sing maayo nga pag-upod nga indi mahimo sang kadam-an sa aton.
english: While others we are still deprived of modeling good company that most of us cannot.

text: Lakip diri ang pagkakas ni King Edward VIII sang Britanya  sang iya korona agud pakaslan ang diborsyada nga Amerikana tungod sa indi matakos nga gugma.
english: This includes King Edward VIII of Britain removing his crown to marry a divorced American woman because of unworthy love.

text: Apang indi lang si King Edward VIII ang nag-give up sang iya corona sa ngalan sang gugma.
english: But King Edward VIII wasn’t the only one to give up his crown in the name of love.

text: Ang chief sang Bamangwato (Botswana, sa karon) napilitan man sa pagtalikud sa iya katungdanan sang ginpakaslan niya ang isa ka British woman, si Ruth Williams sadtong 1948.
english: The chief of Bamangwato (Botswana, today) was also forced to abdicate when he married a British woman, Ruth Williams in 1948.

text: Sa ina nga panahon sa ila lugar taboo ang bisan makita lang ang isa ka puti nga babaye nga kaupod ang isa ka black man.
english: At that time in their area it was taboo to even see a white woman with a black man.

text: Indi man seguro dapat pakalainon sang manggaranon nga pamilya nga ang ila pamatan-on magtanyag sing pagpangasawa sa isa ka matahum nga lin-ay halin sa kubos nga pamilya.
english: Nor should a wealthy family be offended if their young man offers to marry a beautiful cousin from a poor family.

text: In fact, as always, ang matahum nga bagay “is a joy forever”.
english: In fact, as always, a beautiful thing “is a joy forever”.

text: Sa panahon gani sang Medieval Chivalry ginakuhaan sing inspirasyon sang mga knight sa ila horseback tournament ang nagatalambong nga matahum nga mga lin-ay.
english: Even in the days of Medieval Chivalry, knights in their horseback tournament drew inspiration from the beautiful young women in attendance.

text: Katulad ini sila, sa subong, sang mga “muse” nga ang presensya nagahatag inspirasyon sa athletic teams sa ila  pagparada kag pagtambong sa paindis-indis.
english: They are, for now, like “muses” whose presence inspires athletic teams in their parades and attendance at competitions.

text: Labi na gid kon kandidata ini nga nagdaug sa isa ka international beauty pageant.
english: Especially if it's a contestant who won an international beauty pageant.

text: Take it halin sa pagpangasawa sang milyonaryo nga Filipino nga si Virgilio Hilario kay Armi Kuusela, nga ordinaryo lang nga lin-ay sang Finland sang wala pa magdaug, nga sa iya pagdaug bilang una nga Miss Universe naghatag daku nga dungog sa ila mga pungsod.
english: Take it from the marriage of Filipino millionaire Virgilio Hilario to Armi Kuusela, who was an ordinary Finnish cousin before she won, whose victory as the first Miss Universe brought great honor to their countries.

text:
***

Partikular naman sa kaso sang daku nga agwat sang ila edad, indi man gani ini problema gid.
english:
***

Particularly in the case of a large age gap, this is not even a problem.

text: Kon may problema gid man seguro, ina ang angot sa sex life sa tunga sang linghod kag gahingurusgan nga asawa kag iya bana nga basi nangin mahina na ang pagka-barako.
english: If there is a problem, it is the sex life between a young and energetic wife and her husband who may have become weak.

text: Pero, sa experyensya sang kasubong nga pag-upod, indi man gani matuod ini.
english: But, in the experience of such a partnership, this is not even true.

text: Pangkuta bala si lolo?
english: Did grandpa ask?

text: Nagahina matuod ang gana sa sex sang tawo, babaye man ukon lalake, samtang nagatigulang na.
english: It is true that a person's sex drive, whether male or female, decreases with age.

text: Apang indi man pareho ang naturalisa sang babaye kag sang lalake sa ina nga bagay.
english: But the naturalization of women and men is not the same in that respect.

text: Bataon man si asawahon kag mahina na ang paningkay-singkay ni lalake, matumbasan gihapon ini sa “compensating differences” nila.
english: Even if the wife is young and the husband's relationship is weak, it can still be compensated for by their compensating differences.

text: Ina tungod ina, sunu sa mga experto, kay padayon ga-producir sang semilya si lalake “until the day he lives” nga nagabulig sa padayon nga pagbaskug sang iya pagkalalake nga, sa masami, tubtub sa edad 70 anyos basta maamligan lang niya ang iya ikaayong lawas.
english: That's because, according to experts, a man continues to produce sperm "until the day he lives" which helps to continue to strengthen his manhood, often until the age of 70 years as long as he can protect his health.

text: Sa isa ka survey gani sang mga may edad-edad na sadtong 2021 sa US, 35% gid ang nagsiling nga mas nangin mahuyog pa sila karon sa sex sangsa linghod pa sila.
english: In a survey of middle-aged people in the US in 2021, 35% said that they are more sexually active now than they were when they were younger.

text: On the other hand, sa bahin sang babaye, mauntat na ang pag-producir sini sang itlog sang kabuhi sa paglab-ut sang iya menopausal period nga, sa masami, gaabot sa edad nga 40-50 anyos.
english: On the other hand, on the part of the woman, she stops producing the egg of life when she reaches her menopausal period which, usually, comes at the age of 40-50 years.

text: Sa tion sang iya menopausal period, amat-amat na galikaw si asawahon sa sex kay sa ina nga panahon “mala” na siya kag masakit na sa iya ang magbaton sang pagsulod ni banahon.
english: During her menopausal period, the wife gradually avoids sex because at that time she is “dry” and it hurts her to accept the penetration of her husband.

text: Indi naman siya makabata.
english: She can't have children.

text: Ugaling basi indi ini ma-intiendihan ni banahon kag magloko sa iban.
english: But the husband may not understand this and cheat on others.

text: Well, may medyos man si asawahon agud mapasugtan ang palangga nga bana.
english: Well, the wife has a way to get her beloved husband to agree.

text: May mga padanlog man nga mabakal sa botika.
english: There are also padanlogs available at the pharmacy.

text: Kon si asawahon magana gihapon kag paloypaloy na si banahon, may mga bulong man para mapaakig si manoy.
english: If the wife is still strong and the husband is weak, there are also medicines to make the brother angry.

text: Of course, may exception man sa kalabanan nga nanghina na.
english: Of course, there are exceptions to most who have weakened.

text: Ang bantog nga comedian nga si Charlie Chaplin nakapangasawa sang 18 anyos nga dalaga.
english: The famous comedian Charlie Chaplin married an 18 year old girl.

text: Si Ooana O’neil, kon diin nakahimo pa sila sing 8 ka kabataan bag-o siya nagtaliwan sa edad nga 87 anyos.
english: Ooana O'neil, where they had 8 more children before she died at the age of 87 years.

text: Ang ginsiling nga “oldest dad” nga Indiano gin-report nga sa edad nga 96 nakapabata pa siya kag luyag pa sundan ini.
english: The so-called “oldest dad” Indian is reported to have given birth at the age of 96 and wants to follow suit.

text: Sa bahin ni lola sa isa ka lugar sa Filipinas, ginbalita nga nagbusong ini sa edad nga 63 anyos upod ang iya 25 anyos nga bana./PN
english: As for a grandmother in a place in the Philippines, she reportedly became pregnant at the age of 63 with her 25-year-old husband./PN

text: Pagtuo kag sinsero nga katuyuan sa kabuhi ang gin-uyatan sang Ilonggo nga ginpasidunggan bilang Most Outstanding Graduate of Batch 2025 sang John B. Lacson Foundation Maritime University-Arevalo.
english: Faith and sincere purpose in life are held by the Ilonggo who was honored as the Most Outstanding Graduate of Batch 2025 of the John B. Lacson Foundation Maritime University-Arevalo.

text: Ini amo si Deck Cadet John Michael Peñolbo, tumandok sang San Dionisio, Iloilo kag nakatapos sang degree program nga Bachelor of Science in Marine Transporation.
english: This is Deck Cadet John Michael Peñolbo, a native of San Dionisio, Iloilo and a graduate of the Bachelor of Science in Marine Transporation degree program.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Peñolbo, iya ginpahayag nga wala man ginbugayan sang maayo nga pangabuhi ang iya pamilya, manggaranon man ini sang kapisan kag paghimakas kag mayo nga relasyon sa Diyos.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Peñolbo said that although his family is not blessed with a good life, it is also rich in hard work and struggle and a good relationship with God.

text: Suno kay Peñolbo, ang iya hugot nga pagtuo nga gin-updan sang dedikasyon ang rason kun nga madamo siya sang nalab-ot sa kabuhi sa iya bataon nga edad.
english: According to Peñolbo, his strong faith coupled with dedication is the reason why he achieved so much in life at a young age.

text: Gin-ako man sini nga madamo man siya sang kapaslawan apang wala niya ini ginakabig nga negatibo nga butang bangud kahigayunan ini agud mas mangin maayo pa kag mas mangin determinado.
english: He also admitted that he has many failures but he does not consider them as negative things because they are opportunities to be better and more determined.

text: Isa man sa may dako nga papel sa iya kabuhi amo pagka-malapit sang iya pamilya sa simbahan kun sa diin isa ka katekista ang iya lola.
english: Another important factor in his life was his family's proximity to the church where his grandmother was a catechist.

text: Sa pagkamatuod, naimpluwensiyahan siya sang iya lola kun ngaa maayo ang iya relasyon sa Diyos.
english: In fact, his grandmother influenced him to have a good relationship with God.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Peñolbo ang kalakip sa grupo kaupod ang iya iloy nga nagapangamuyo sang Santo Rosaryo sa Bombo Radyo.
english: Peñolbo was among the group with his mother who prayed the Holy Rosary on Bombo Radyo.

text: Ginpauntat sang COMELEC ang  pagpanghanda para sa 1st BARMM Parliamentary Election sa October 13.
english: The COMELEC has suspended preparations for the 1st BARMM Parliamentary Election on October 13.

text: Suno kay COMELEC Chairman George Garcia, ini kasunod sang pag-isyu sang Supreme Court sang temporary restraining order sa  COMELEC kag Bangsamoro Transition Authority  nga magpatuman sang layi nga naga-redistribute sang pito ka seats nga orihinal nga gin- allocate sa Sulu.
english: According to COMELEC Chairman George Garcia, this follows the Supreme Court's issuance of a temporary restraining order to the COMELEC and the Bangsamoro Transition Authority to implement the law that redistributes the seven seats originally allocated to Sulu.

text: Sa subong suno kay Garcia, indi pa mapat-ud kun ang eleksyon sa October 13 ang madayon sa tunga sang suspensyon sang mga preparasyon.
english: Garcia said it is not yet clear whether the October 13 election will be held amid the suspension of preparations.

text: Naghalad sang pangamuyo ang isa ka gamay nga lugar sa India nga ginhalinan sang pamilya ni Vice President Kamala Harris para sa kadalag-an sang Democrat candidate sa US presidential elections.
english: A small place in India where the family of Vice President Kamala Harris comes from has offered a prayer for the victory of the Democrat candidate in the US presidential elections.

text: Diri sa Thulasendrapuram sa state sang Tamil Nadu nagapuyo ang Lolo ni Harris nga si P.V. Gopalan antes ini nag-migrate sa state sang Chennai.
english: Here in Thulasendrapuram in the state of Tamil Nadu lives Harris’s Grandfather P.V. Gopalan before it migrated to the state of Chennai.

text: Sang tion nga nag-retiro ini, isa ini ka high-ranking government official.
english: At the time he retired, he was a high-ranking government official.

text: Lakip sa ginhimo sa temple ceremony amo ang ritwal, pagbagting sang lingganay, kag paghalad sang mga bulak bilang pangabay nga paboran si Harris sa sini nga piniliay.
english: The temple ceremony included a ritual, the ringing of a bell, and the offering of flowers as a request to favor Harris in this election.

text: Sa tempo, may nakaukit man nga pangalan sang Democrat sa bato kag may lista man sang public donations.
english: In the tempo, there is also a Democrat's name engraved on the stone and a list of public donations.

text: Gintawag sang local officials si Harris nga “the daughter of the land”.
english: Local officials called Harris “the daughter of the land”.

text: Ini man nga lugar ang nakilala apat ka tuig na ang nagligad sang nagpangamuyo man ang mga residente para sa kadalag-an sang Democratic Party sang nagpadalagan si Harris bilang bise-presidente.
english: This same area was recognized four years ago when residents also prayed for the victory of the Democratic Party when Harris ran for vice-president.

text: Ginselebrar man nila ang kadalag-an sini paagi sa pagpalupok sang firecrackers kag pagpanagtag sang mga pagkaon.
english: They also celebrated its success by bursting firecrackers and distributing food items.

text: Nahibaluan nga Indian ang iloy ni Harris kag Jamaican naman ang iya amay.
english: Harris' mother is Indian and his father is Jamaican.

text: Siya ang una nga woman vice president sang US, una nga African-American vice president, kag una man nga Asian-American vice president.
english: She was the first woman vice president of the US, first African-American vice president, and also the first Asian-American vice president.

text: Gin-surprise sang vlogger nga si Ivana Alawi ang iya utod nga lalaki sa isa ka titulo sang duta.
english: Vlogger Ivana Alawi surprised her brother with a land title.

text: Sa latest vlog ni Ivana, nag pa kuno-kuno ini nga ang iya duta lang ang iya bisitahon kaupod ang iya iloy kag ang iya utod nga si Hash.
english: In Ivana's latest vlog, she pretended to only visit her land with her mother and her brother Hash.

text: Suno kay Ivana, wala sang hilig si Hash sa mga materyal nga butang ukon mga malahalon nga gamit rason nga ginbaklan niya ini sang duta agud indi na makapamalibad pa ang iya utod.
english: According to Ivana, Hash has no interest in material things or expensive things, so she bought him land so that her brother would not be able to refuse.

text: Pahayag pa niya, ang duta nga iya ginregalo kay Hash ang para sa iya mangin pamilya.
english: He said the land he gave to Hash was for his family.

text: Wala naman napunggan ni Hash nga mangin emosyonal sa regalo nga iya nabaton.
english: Hash couldn't help but be emotional about the gift he received.

text: Ginpasalig man ni Ivana nga ang masunod niya nga baklan sang duta amo ang iya manghod nga si Mona sa amo man nga subdivision agud nga makakitaay man sila sa gihapon apisar nga sa ulihe may tagsa-tagsa na sila nga pamilya.
english: Ivana also assured that the next land she will buy is her sister Mona in the same subdivision so that they can still see each other even though they will eventually have their own families.

text: Gin-ako sang first-time mommy nga si Coleen Garcia nga ginaagyan man niya ang baby blues ukon kasubo kag lain-lain nga modo nga natural nga ginaeksperyensya sang mga iloy nga bag-o gid lamang makabun-ag.
english: First-time mommy Coleen Garcia admits that she also goes through the baby blues or sadness and different moods that are naturally experienced by mothers who have just given birth.

text: Sa iya Instagram Stories, ginpakigbahin ni Coleen kun ano kabudlay ang postpartum recovery kag ang pagpasuso sa iya anak nga si Amari.
english: On her Instagram Stories, Coleen shared how difficult postpartum recovery and breastfeeding her daughter Amari was.

text: Apisar sang kabudlay, “incredibly rewarding” ini suno sa aktres ilabi na bangud may nagapadala man sa iya sang mga mensahe kag regalo.
english: Despite the difficulty, the actress said it was “incredibly rewarding” especially since someone was sending her messages and gifts.

text: Ginpasalamatan man ni Coleen ang iya bana nga si Billy Crawford bangud sang pagtatap sini sa iya kag sa iya anak.
english: Coleen also thanked her husband, Billy Crawford, for taking care of her and her son.

text: Samtang suno naman kay Billy, ini ang iya “biggest life-changing experience” nga iya naagyan sa bug-os niya nga kabuhi.
english: Meanwhile, Billy said it was his “biggest life-changing experience” in his entire life.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginbun-ag ni Coleen si Baby Amari sang Hwebes, Setyembre 10.
english: Coleen gave birth to Baby Amari on Thursday, September 10.

text: Nagsugod na sa pagboto ang mga Amerikano para sa masunod nga presidente nga magapungko sa White House.
english: Americans have begun voting for the next president to occupy the White House.

text: Kinahanglan nanday Vice President Kamala Harris sang Democrats kag former President Donald Trump sang Republicans ang at least 270 electoral votes para nga magdaog sa sini nga eleksyon.
english: Vice President Kamala Harris of the Democrats and former President Donald Trump of the Republicans need at least 270 electoral votes to win this election.

text: Ang battleground states sang Arizona, Georgia, Michigan, Nevada, North Carolina, Pennsylvania kag Wisconsin amo ang ginalantaw nga mangin lyabe para matumod kun sin-o sa tunga sang duha ka mga kandidato ang magapangibabaw subong nga tuig.
english: The battleground states of Arizona, Georgia, Michigan, Nevada, North Carolina, Pennsylvania and Wisconsin are expected to be key to determining which of the two candidates will prevail this year.

text: As of 6 a.m. Eastern Time, ang polling locations nga nagbukas ang nagalakip sa Connecticut, New Jersey, New York, New Hampshire, Virginia, Indiana, Kentucky, kag Maine.
english: As of 6 a.m. Eastern Time, polling locations that have opened include Connecticut, New Jersey, New York, New Hampshire, Virginia, Indiana, Kentucky, and Maine.

text: Sang 7 a.m. ET, nadugangan ang nagbukas nga polling centers nga amo ang Alabama, Delaware, Washington DC, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kansas, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Missouri, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, kag Tennessee.
english: As of 7 a.m. ET, more open polling centers were Alabama, Delaware, Washington DC, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kansas, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Missouri, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, and Tennessee.

text: Sang 8 a.m. ET, nagbukas man ang centers sa Arizona, Iowa, Louisiana, Minnesota, South Dakota, North Dakota, Oklahoma, kag Wisconsin.
english: As of 8 a.m. ET, centers also opened in Arizona, Iowa, Louisiana, Minnesota, South Dakota, North Dakota, Oklahoma, and Wisconsin.

text:
Antes sini, ginhiwat sang duha ka presidential candidates ang ila final campaign events sa battleground states sang nagligad nga gab-i.

Gintakpan ni Harris ang iya 107-day campaign sa Pennsylvania samtang sa Michigan naman nagtapos si Trump nga amo man ang state nga iya ginpili nga pinal nga kadtuan sa nagligad nga duha sini ka presidential campaigns.
english:
Earlier, the two presidential candidates held their final campaign events in battleground states last night.

Harris closed her 107-day campaign in Pennsylvania while Trump finished in Michigan, the same state he chose as his final destination in his past two presidential campaigns.

text: Magpadayon sa pagbantay sa US election updates sa Bombo Radyo Philippines nga dal-on sang masobra 150 ka Bombo International correspondents direkta halin sa nagkalain-lain nga states sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: Stay tuned to US election updates on Bombo Radyo Philippines brought by more than 150 Bombo International correspondents directly from various states in the United States of America.

text: Tatlo ka linemen ang magaatubang sang sampaw-sampaw nga kaso matapos nga madakpan sang MORE Power nga nagabaligya sa isa ka junk shop sang ila ginkawat nga kable sang kuryente.
english: Three linemen will face multiple charges after they were caught by MORE Power selling their stolen electrical cables in a junk shop.

text: Ang mga arestado amo sanday Leo Dela Cruz, Mark Xyrone Cabansay, kag Joseph Mobe, lunsay mga empleyado sang FVE Electrical Services and Supply Corporation nga kontratista sang MORE Power.
english: Those arrested were identified as Leo Dela Cruz, Mark Xyrone Cabansay, and Joseph Mobe, both employees of FVE Electrical Services and Supply Corporation, a contractor of MORE Power.

text: Suno sa mga suspek, ila ginkarga ang tatlo ka rolyo sang mga kable sang kuryente halin sa ila nga barracks sa Buntatala, Jaro, sa ila nga service truck sang Sabado sang aga (Enero 25) kag gindala sa junk shop sa Brgy.
english: According to the suspects, they loaded three rolls of electrical cables from their barracks in Buntatala, Jaro, into their service truck on Saturday morning (January 25) and took them to a junk shop in Brgy.

text: Cagamutan Norte, Leganes, para ibaligya.
english: Cagamutan Norte, Leganes, for sale.

text: Mismo ang mga gwardya sang MORE Power ang nagdakop sa mga suspek kag ginturn-over sa Leganes PNP antes gindala sa Jaro Police Station.
english: MORE Power guards themselves arrested the suspects and turned them over to Leganes PNP before taking them to the Jaro Police Station.

text: Ginabanta nga indi magnubo sa P50,000 ang balor sang ila ginkawat nga kable.
english: The value of the stolen cable is estimated at P50,000.

text: Nagpasaka sang panumubong nga qualified theft ang MORE Power batok sa mga suspek nga gin-detain na subong.
english: MORE Power filed a charge of qualified theft against the suspects who are now detained.

text: Dugang nga panumbungon nga paglapas sa Anti-fencing law kag posible nga paglapas sa Anti-Pilferage law ang ipasaka man batok sa mga suspek.
english: Additional charges of violation of the Anti-fencing law and possible violation of the Anti-Pilferage law will also be filed against the suspects.

text: Ginpanugyanan sang World Bank ang gobyerno sang Pilipinas nga magpatigayon sang digital government-to-person (G2P) payments, pinaagi sa pag-tap sa iban pa nga financial services providers kaangay sang e-wallets agud mapadasig ang pagpanagtag sang ayuda ukon cash assistance sa tion sang krisis.
english: The World Bank has advised the Philippine government to implement digital government-to-person (G2P) payments, by tapping into other financial services providers such as e-wallets to speed up the distribution of cash assistance during the crisis.

text: Nagakadapat man suno sa World Bank nga may yara sang foundational ID system agud mangin mahapos ang pag-identify kag pag-verify sang mga data nga ginapasa sang mga beneficiaries.
english: The World Bank also said it is necessary to have a foundational ID system to facilitate the identification and verification of data submitted by beneficiaries.

text: Sa ila report nga may tigulo “Toward more Accessible and Inclusive Social Assistance Delivery: A Geospatial Analysis in the Philippines,” ginpahayag sang Government-to-Person Initiative sang World Bank nga sang tion sang hugot nga pagpatuman sang lockdown bangud sa coronavirus pandemic sang 2020, ang pagpatuman sang social amelioration program (SAP) ang nag-angkon sang problema bangud sa kakulang sang digital payments infrastructure para sa mga recipients.
english: In its report titled “Toward more Accessible and Inclusive Social Assistance Delivery: A Geospatial Analysis in the Philippines,” the World Bank’s Government-to-Person Initiative stated that during the strict implementation of the lockdown due to the coronavirus pandemic in 2020, the implementation of social amelioration programs (SAP) suffered from a lack of digital payments infrastructure for recipients.

text: Dugang pa, ang kakulang sa national ID system kag ang manubo nga bank account ownership ang nakaupang man sa pagpanagtag sang financial assistance.
english: In addition, the lack of a national ID system and low bank account ownership have also hampered the distribution of financial assistance.

text: Suno sa Washington-based multilateral lender, sa tion sang pandemya nga naeksperyensyahan sa nagkalain-lain nga bahin sang kalibutan, ang mga pungsod ang makahatag sang insakto nga cash transfers sa tion nga may yara ang mga ini sang foundational ID systems nga makatumod kag maka-verify sang data sa mga benefeciaries.
english: According to the Washington-based multilateral lender, during the pandemic experienced in various parts of the world, countries can provide accurate cash transfers once they have foundational ID systems that can identify and verify data on beneficiaries.

text: Ini man ang isa sa mga rason sa pagmando ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte kay National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) chief Karl Kendrick Chua nga padasigon ang pagpatuman sang Philippine Identification System (PhilSys).
english: This is also one of the reasons for President Rodrigo Duterte's order to National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) chief Karl Kendrick Chua to accelerate the implementation of the Philippine Identification System (PhilSys).

text: Ang Philippine Statistics Authority, amo ang in-charge sa PhilSys sa idalom sang pagdumala sang NEDA.
english: The Philippine Statistics Authority, is in-charge of PhilSys under the supervision of NEDA.

text: Sa subong, nagdangat na sa 57 million ka mga Filipino ang naka-sign up para sa national ID program.
english: So far, 57 million Filipinos have signed up for the national ID program.

text: Nagtaas sa 3% ang Inflation ukon ang rate sa pagsaka sa presyo sang mga produkto kag serbisyo sa bulan sang Pebrero suno sa Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA).
english: Inflation rose to 3% in February, according to the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA).

text: Suno kay PSA chief kag National Statistician Claire Dennis Mapa, ang inflation rate sang pebrero ang kaangay man sa lebel sang rate sa bulan sang Enero.
english: According to PSA chief and National Statistician Claire Dennis Mapa, the inflation rate in February was similar to the level of the rate in January.

text: Suno naman kay Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) Governor Benjamin Diokno, nagapabilin sa gihapon ang risgo sa dugang pa nga pagtaas sang inflation sa pungsod subong nga tuig 2022.
english: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) Governor Benjamin Diokno said there is still a risk of further inflation in the country in 2022.

text: Ginalantaw man sang Monetary Board sang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas nga posible magdangat sa 3.7% ang inflation subong nga tuig, mas mataas sa nauna nga 3.4% expected inflation rate.
english: The Monetary Board of the Central Bank of the Philippines also expects inflation to reach 3.7% this year, higher than the previous 3.4% expected inflation rate.

text: Ginbuyagyag ni National Bureau of Investigation Director Jaime B. Santiago nga mangin ang ginapatindog nga bag-o nga building sang ila ahensya sa Maynila, ang mga Discaya man ang contractor.
english: National Bureau of Investigation Director Jaime B. Santiago revealed that even the new building being constructed by their agency in Manila, the Discayas are also the contractors.

text: Apang gin-athag niya nga gin-award sa mga Discaya ang kontrata antes pa man siya nagpungko sa pwesto.
english: However, he explained that the contract was awarded to the Discayas before he took office.

text:
Nagabalor ang proyekto sang yara sa P2.4-B.

Ginpat-ud naman niya nga ilakip ini sa ila imbestigasyon.
english:
The project is worth P2.4-B.

He assured that this will be included in their investigation.

text: Gin-ulan sang congratulatory messages ang hunk actor nga si Carlo Aquino matapos nga nag post ini sang picture sang iya nga cute baby.
english: Hunk actor Carlo Aquino was showered with congratulatory messages after he posted a picture of his cute baby.

text: Nakabutang sa caption ang pangalan sang iya nga anak nga si Enola Mithi Aquino kag naka tag naman ang iya girlfriend nga si Trina Candaza.
english: The caption included the name of his daughter, Enola Mithi Aquino, and his girlfriend, Trina Candaza.

text: Pila sa mga nag congratulate sa actor amo sanday Sylvia Sanchez, Ria Atayde, Sue Ramirez, Zanjoe Marudo, Dionne Monsanto, Ejay Falcon, Rocco Nacino, Rodjun Cruz, Chie Filomeno, Jason Abalos kag Mika dela Cruz.
english: Among those who congratulated the actor were Sylvia Sanchez, Ria Atayde, Sue Ramirez, Zanjoe Marudo, Dionne Monsanto, Ejay Falcon, Rocco Nacino, Rodjun Cruz, Chie Filomeno, Jason Abalos and Mika dela Cruz.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang Hulyo 2019, ginkumpirma ni Carlo nga malipayon ini sa iya gilfriend nga si Trina kag sang Setyembre sa amo man nga tuig, nag post ini sang picture kaupod ang babaye sa labing una nga kahigayunan.
english: In July 2019, Carlo confirmed that he was happy with his girlfriend Trina and in September of the same year, he posted a picture with the woman for the first time.

text: Ginmando na sang alkalde sang Zamboanga City ang gilayon nga pagpangita kag pagdakop sa mga responsable sa pagtiro-patay sa isa ka mag-asawa sa Brgy.
english: The mayor of Zamboanga City has ordered the immediate search and arrest of those responsible for the shooting death of a couple in Brgy.

text: Boalan, Zamboanga City.
english: Boalan, Zamboanga City.

text: Ang mga biktima nga napatay amo sanday Fathie Bara Loong kag asawa nga si Bai Rivalia.
english: The victims were identified as Fathie Bara Loong and wife Bai Rivalia.

text: Base sa report sang pulis, hinali lang nga ginpalapitan sang gunman ang biktima nga si Loong kag gintiro nga sang amo nga tion, ginalantaw ang konstruksyon sang ila nga tindahan sa lugar.
english: According to police reports, the gunman suddenly approached the victim, Loong, and shot him while he was watching the construction of their shop in the area.

text: Sunod naman nga gintiro ang asawa nga nagapungk sa sulod sang ila nga van tupad ang ila apat ka tuig nga bata nga babaye nga wala gintandog sang suspek.
english: The suspect next shot the wife who was sitting inside their van next to their four-year-old daughter who was not touched by the suspect.

text: Gilayon nga ginmando ni Mayor John Dalipe ang paghugot sang seguridad sa lugar kasunod man sang ginapatuman nga gun ban bangud sa nagahilapit nga midterm elections.
english: Mayor John Dalipe immediately ordered the tightening of security in the area following the implementation of the gun ban due to the upcoming midterm elections.

text: Nagpaandam ang National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) nga makatuga sang dugang nga problema sa pagsaka sang presyo sang mga balaklon ang kakulangan sang suplay sang kalamay sa pungsod.
english: The National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) has warned that the shortage of sugarcane supply in the country will cause further problems in rising commodity prices.

text: Suno kay NEDA Undersecretary Rosemarie Edillon, ang kakulang sa suplay sang local sugar amo ang nagtulod sa gobyerno nga mag-import sang 200,000 metric tons sang kalamay.
english: According to NEDA Undersecretary Rosemarie Edillon, the shortage of local sugar supply prompted the government to import 200,000 metric tons of sugarcane.

text: Apang wala ini napadayon matapos nag-isyu ang regional trial court sa Negros Occidental sang writ of prelimiary injunction sa Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA).
english: However, it was not continued after the regional trial court in Negros Occidental issued a writ of prelimiary injunction to the Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA).

text: Buot silingon, ginmanduan ang SRA nga untaton anay ang importation tubtub nga ma-lift sang korte ang injunction.
english: In other words, the SRA was ordered to stop the importation until the court lifts the injunction.

text: Kun wala ini sang solusyon suno sa NEDA, may epekto ini sa inflation.
english: If there is no solution, NEDA said, it will have an impact on inflation.

text: Antes sini, nagasuprer na nga daan ang Pilipinas sa mataas nga presyo sang gatong nga naglala bangud sa away sang Ukraine kag Russia.
english: Earlier, the Philippines was already suffering from high fuel prices that were exacerbated by the conflict between Ukraine and Russia.

text: Sang nagligad lang nga semana, may mga food manufacturers nga nagsuporta sa gobyerno kag nagpahayag nga tuman na ka kinahanglanon nga mag-import sang kalamay kag may mga reports man nga ang inventory sang refined sugar ang magakulang na sa bulan sang Marso.
english: Just last week, some food manufacturers supported the government and said it was too necessary to import sugar and there were reports that the inventory of refined sugar would run out in March.

text: Madamo sang mga factors nga ginakonsiderar ang mga botante sa United States (US) Presidential elections.
english: There are many factors that voters consider in the United States (US) Presidential elections.

text: Nahibaluan nga magabunggu-anay sa eleksyon sanday former President Donald Trump nga tiglawas sang Republican Party kag si Vice President Kamala Harris nga nagatiglawas naman sang Democratic Party.
english: It is known that former President Donald Trump, who represents the Republican Party, and Vice President Kamala Harris, who represents the Democratic Party, will face each other in the election.

text: Suno kay Bombo Dee Donasco Thompson, international corresopondent sa Tennessee, USA, lakip sa mga ginakonsiderar sa pagboto sang masunod nga president amo ang ekonomiya, job martket, immigration status, medical care, women’s right kag abortion.
english: According to Bombo Dee Donasco Thompson, international correspondent in Tennessee, USA, among the issues considered in voting for the next president are the economy, job market, immigration status, medical care, women's right and abortion.

text: Suno kay Thompson, may yara na sang mga nagpatigayon sang early voting humalin pa sang nagligad nga semana.
english: According to Thompson, there have been those who have conducted early voting since last week.

text: Sa subong, lakip sa mga ginabantayan amo ang resulta sang pito ka mga swing states.
english: In the meantime, among those under scrutiny are the outcomes of the seven swing states.

text: Ini amo ang Arizona, Georgia, Michigan, Nevada, North Carolina, Pennsylvania kag Wisconsin.
english: These are Arizona, Georgia, Michigan, Nevada, North Carolina, Pennsylvania and Wisconsin.

text: Gindakop sang mga katapo sang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) ang isa ka self-proclaimed nga obispo kag iya asawa nga ginapahayag nga naga-operate sang simbahan sang isa ka religious sect sa Baras, Rizal apang ginapatihan nga ginagamit lamang ini nga front sa pagpatigayon sang illegal job recruitment.
english: Members of the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) arrested a self-proclaimed bishop and his wife who allegedly operate a church of a religious sect in Baras, Rizal but are believed to be using it as a front to conduct illegal job recruitment.

text: Ang mga suspek amo sanday Reynaldo Basalio, nga ginatudlo nga pinuno sang Faithful Promise Foundation Philippines Inc., kag iya asawa nga si Esclarmonde.
english: The suspects were identified as Reynaldo Basalio, alleged head of the Faithful Promise Foundation Philippines Inc., and his wife, Esclarmonde.

text: Ginhimo sang otoridad ang raid kasunod sang reklamo sang mga nagapangita sang trabaho nga may yara sang illegal recruitment agency nga nagapromisa sang trabaho bilang factory workers, mechanical engineers, kag iban pa nga ubra sa Japan, South Korea, kag Papua New Guinea.
english: Authorities conducted the raid following complaints from job seekers that there was an illegal recruitment agency promising jobs as factory workers, mechanical engineers, and other jobs in Japan, South Korea, and Papua New Guinea.

text: Sila ang ginapromisahan sang sweldo nga yara sa P36,000 tubtob P120,000.
english: They are promised salaries ranging from P36,000 to P120,000.

text: Ang mga biktima ginapahayag nga ginahatagan sang tourist visas kag ginatudluan nga ipresentar ang ila kaugalingon sa Immigration bilang mga misyonaryo.
english: Victims are allegedly given tourist visas and instructed to present themselves to Immigration as missionaries.

text: Apang suno sa ila, ang iban sa ila ang gin-offload, may yara man sang gin-deploy apang ang iban nagahulat gihapon.
english: However, they said some of them have been offloaded, some have been deployed but others are still waiting.

text: Sila ang ginasukot man sang indi magnubo sa P50,000 kada isa bilang bayad sa pagproseso sang ila mga travel documents kag employment.
english: They are also charged at least P50,000 each as a fee for processing their travel documents and employment.

text: Nagapangatubang subong ang mag-asawa sang kaso nga large-scale illegal recruitment nga isa ka opensa nga wala sang piyansa sa idalom sang Republic Act 8042 ukon ang Migrant Workers and Overseas Filipinos Act.
english: The couple is now facing charges of large-scale illegal recruitment, a non-bailable offense under Republic Act 8042 or the Migrant Workers and Overseas Filipinos Act.

text: Patay ang 36-anyos nga siklista sang mabungguan sang sports utility vehicle (SUV) matapos nga natumba ini sang naigo sang pwertahan sang isa ka delivery van nga naga-park sa bicycle lane sa Pasig City.
english: A 36-year-old cyclist was killed when he was hit by a sports utility vehicle (SUV) after he fell when he was hit by the door of a delivery van parked in a bicycle lane in Pasig City.

text: Ang bikima mapauli na kuntani sa Cainta, Rizal halin a sa trabaho.
english: The victim was on his way home from work in Cainta, Rizal.

text: Gin-aresto sang mga pulis ang driver sang SUV kag ang driver sang delivery van nga mangatubang sa kaso nga reckless imprudence resulting in homicide.
english: Police arrested the driver of the SUV and the driver of the delivery van who will face charges of reckless imprudence resulting in homicide.

text: Suno sa pamilya sang biktima, dalon sa Iloilo City ang bangkay sang siklista matapos ang duha ka adlaw nga haya sa Cainta.
english: According to the victim's family, the body of the cyclist was brought to Iloilo City after two days of burial in Cainta.

text: Gin-freeze sang Court of Appeals (CA) ang assets sang mga opisyal sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) kag mga kontraktor nga involved sa ma-anomaliya nga flood control projects.
english: The Court of Appeals (CA) has frozen the assets of Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) officials and contractors involved in anomalous flood control projects.

text: Suno kay Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) Executive Director Matthew David, ini nga freeze order nagasakop sang 135 bank accounts kag 27 insurance policies.
english: According to Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) Executive Director Matthew David, this freeze order covers 135 bank accounts and 27 insurance policies.

text: Wala sini ginhingadlan kun sanday sin-o ang tag-iya sang sini nga bank accounts.
english: It did not name the owners of these bank accounts.

text: Apang ginkumpirma ni DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon nga ini nga accounts ang ginapanag-iyahan sang mga ginpangkasuhan sang ahensya sa Ombudsman.
english: However, DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon confirmed that these accounts are owned by those who were sued by the agency to the Ombudsman.

text: Kun amo sini ang basehan, buot silingon, nalakip diri sanday Sarah Discaya, Pacifico “Curlee” Discaya, kag Roma Angeline Rimando sang St.
english: If this is the basis, it means that Sarah Discaya, Pacifico “Curlee” Discaya, and Roma Angeline Rimando of St.

text: Timothy Construction, kag ang Wawao Builders general manager nga si Mark Allan Arevalo.
english: Timothy Construction, and Wawao Builders general manager Mark Allan Arevalo.

text:
Sa bahin sang DPWH, nalakip sanday former assistant regional director Henry Alcantara, former district engineer Brice Hernandez, kag former assistant district engineer Jaypee Mendoza nga ginatudlo nga parte sang Bulacan Group of Contractors ukon “BGC Boys.”

Sa petisyon sang AMLC sa CA, ginsiling nga ini nga bank accounts ang posible nga gingamit sa pagkomiter sang graft kag kurapsyon.
english:
On the DPWH side, former assistant regional director Henry Alcantara, former district engineer Brice Hernandez, and former assistant district engineer Jaypee Mendoza are allegedly part of the Bulacan Group of Contractors or “BGC Boys.”

In the AMLC’s petition to the CA, it was stated that these bank accounts were likely used to commit graft and corruption.

text: Ini pa lang ang una nga batch sang freeze order requests kag posible nga madugangan pa samtang padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sa kurapsyon.#
english: This is the first batch of freeze order requests and it is possible that more will be added as the investigation into corruption continues.

text: Malab-ot 204,000 pesos ka balor sang shabu ang nakumpiskar sang Station Drug Enforcement Team sang Pototan Municipal Police Station subong nga adlaw Hunyo 25, pasado alas 6:44 sang aga.
english: A total of 204,000 pesos worth of shabu was seized by the Station Drug Enforcement Team of the Pototan Municipal Police Station today, June 25, around 6:44 am.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Adrian Baligod, deputy chief of Pototan Police Station and kag team leader sang nasambit nga buy-bust operation, iya gin pahayag nga tatlo ka semana nga ila ginabantayan ang suspek antes ini madakpan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Adrian Baligod, deputy chief of Pototan Police Station and team leader of the buy-bust operation, said they were monitoring the suspect for three weeks before he was arrested.

text: Ginhiwat ang operasyon sa Brgy.
english: The operation was conducted in Brgy.

text: Zarrague, Pototan, Iloilo kag ang nadakpan nga suspek ginakilala nga si alyas “Sadam,” 34 anyos, lalaki, pamilyado kag residente man sang amo nga barangay.
english: Zarrague, Pototan, Iloilo and the arrested suspect was identified as alias “Sadam,” 34 years old, male, married and resident of the same barangay.

text: Nakuha sa iya ang pito (7) ka heat-sealed nga transparent plastic sachets nga may sulod nga ginapatihan nga shabu, nga may kabug-aton nga masobra 30 ka gramos kag ginabana-bana nagakantidad sang PHP204,000 kag may street value nga PHP6,800 kada gramo.
english: Recovered from him were seven (7) heat-sealed transparent plastic sachets containing suspected shabu, weighing more than 30 grams and estimated to be worth PHP204,000 and with a street value of PHP6,800 per gram.

text: Suno sa imbestigasyon sang mga kapulisan, nabutyagan nga halin pa sa Iloilo City ang ginasuplay niya nga illegal nga droga kag ginapanagtag ini sa Pototan, Iloilo.
english: According to the investigation of the police, it was revealed that he was supplying illegal drugs from Iloilo City and distributing them in Pototan, Iloilo.

text: Subong, yara na sa kustodiya sang Pototan Police Station ang suspek kag atubangon niya ang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: The suspect is now in the custody of the Pototan Police Station and will face charges of violation of Republic Act 9165 or Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: Text by: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑲𝒓𝒚𝒍𝒍𝒆 𝑴𝒆𝒍𝒍𝒊𝒛𝒂
english: Text by: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑲𝒓𝒚𝒍𝒍𝒆 𝑴𝒆𝒍𝒍𝒊𝒛𝒂

text: MANILA – Gin-ako na sang aktres nga si Janella Salvador kag sang Filipino-British actor kag model nga si Markus Paterson nga may yara sila sang relasyon.
english: MANILA – Actress Janella Salvador and Filipino-British actor and model Markus Paterson have admitted that they are in a relationship.

text: Una nga nag-post sang video sa Instagram si Markus kun sa diin makita nga tuman sa ila ka sweet kag may caption pa ini nga “My World”.
english: Markus first posted a video on Instagram showing them being very sweet and with the caption “My World”.

text: Pila ka oras ang nakaligad, nag-post man sang laragway nila nga duha sa Instagram si Janella kun sa diin sa comment section, madamo ang nagpalab-ot sang congratulatory message.
english: A few hours later, Janella also posted a picture of the two of them on Instagram where in the comment section, many conveyed congratulatory messages.

text: Nahibalu-an nga Oktubre sang nakaligad nga tuig sang na-link ang duha apang nagpamalibad sila nga maghatag sang pahayag tuhoy sa nasambit nga isyu.
english: The two were linked in October last year but declined to comment on the issue.

text: Patay ang Peruvian local league soccer player halin sa Familia Chocca team matapos na-igo sang kilat kadungan sang ila hampang sa Huancayo.
english: A Peruvian local league soccer player from the Familia Chocca team was killed after being struck by lightning during their match in Huancayo.

text: Suno sa Peruvian state news agency nga Andina, gin-suspend ang hampang bangud sa kilat.
english: According to Peruvian state news agency Andina, the match was suspended due to lightning.

text: Apang samtang nagapagwa na ang mga ini sa field, na-igo sang kilat ang player nga si  Hugo de la Cruz Meza, 39.
english: But as they were leaving the field, player Hugo de la Cruz Meza, 39, was struck by lightning.

text: Magluwas diri, napilasan man ang iban pa gid nga mga players.
english: In addition, other players were also injured.

text: Gilayon naman ang mga ini nga gindala sa malapit nga ospital sa diin isa ang kritikal bangud sa paso nga naangkon.
english: They were rushed to a nearby hospital where one is critical due to burns.

text: Nalapawan sang Bureau of Customs (BOC) ang ila collection target sa Pebrero nga nagdangat sa P8.734 billion.
english: The Bureau of Customs (BOC) exceeded its collection target in February of P8.734 billion.

text: Suno sa BOC, nakolekta sang Enero ang P59.036 billion, 17.4% nga mas mataas sa ila target nga P50.302 billion.
english: According to the BOC, it collected P59.036 billion in January, 17.4% higher than its target of P50.302 billion.

text: Base sa report sang Financial Service sang amu nga ahensya, 14 sa 17 ka collection districts ang nalapawan ang ila target subong nga bulan.
english: According to the Financial Service report of the agency, 14 out of 17 collection districts exceeded their target this month.

text: Ini amu ang ports of San Fernando, Manila, Manila International Container Port, Batangas, Iloilo, Cebu, Tacloban, Cagayan de Oro, Zamboanga, Davao, Subic, Clark, Aparri, kag Limay.
english: These are the ports of San Fernando, Manila, Manila International Container Port, Batangas, Iloilo, Cebu, Tacloban, Cagayan de Oro, Zamboanga, Davao, Subic, Clark, Aparri, and Limay.

text: Sa isa ka tuig, nagadangat sa P117.524 billion ang collections sang BOC.
english: In one year, the BOC's collections amounted to P117.524 billion.

text: Ginahatag na nanday former President Donald Trump kag Vice President Kamala Harris ang bug-os sang ila masarangan sa ulihi nga mga inoras antes ang ginakalangkagan nga November 5 US elections.
english: Former President Donald Trump and Vice President Kamala Harris are already giving it their all in the final hours before the much-anticipated November 5 US elections.

text: Hingalitan sang duha ini nga tyempo para mag-deliver sang closing messages nga nagatuyo nga makumbinse ang minilyon nga mga Americano sa ila ihatag ang boto.
english: The two will use this time to deliver closing messages aimed at convincing millions of Americans to vote for them.

text: Nakalinya ang aktibidad sang Democratic presidential candidate sa Pennsylvania nga may 19 ka electoral votes nga amo ang lalagson kag ginalauman nga magatumod sang Electoral College outcome.
english: The Democratic presidential candidate's activity in Pennsylvania is in line with 19 electoral votes, which is the rare and expected to determine the Electoral College outcome.

text: Bisitahon ni Harris ang working-class areas lakip na ang Allentown.
english: Harris will visit working-class areas including Allentown.

text: Pagasundan ini sang star-studded rally sa Philadelphia karon sa gab-i nga maga-feature sang music superstars nga sanday Lady Gaga kag Oprah Winfrey.
english: This will be followed by a star-studded rally in Philadelphia tonight featuring music superstars Lady Gaga and Oprah Winfrey.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, may mga rally naman si Trump sa North Carolina kag Pennsylvania.
english: Meanwhile, Trump held rallies in North Carolina and Pennsylvania.

text: Opisyal nga takpan sini ang iya kampanya sa Grand Rapids, Michigan.
english: It will officially cap its campaign in Grand Rapids, Michigan.

text: Sa iya kampanya sa North Carolina sa bisperas sang eleksyon, gindeklarar na ni Trump nga nagapanguna siya sa piniliay kag ang ginahulat na lamang nila amo ang opisyal nga pagtakop sini.
english: During his campaign in North Carolina on the eve of the election, Trump declared that he was leading the election and that all they were waiting for was the official closing.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, sa iya rally naman sa Michigan, nag-apelar man si Harris sa Arab American and Muslim American population sa state kag nagpasalig nga gamiton niya ang kutob sang iya gahum agud tapuson ang gyera sa Gaza.
english: Meanwhile, at his rally in Michigan, Harris also appealed to the Arab American and Muslim American population in the state and promised to use all his power to end the war in Gaza.

text: Ang Michigan puluy-an sang 240,000 registered Muslim voters nga mayorya nagboto sa Democrat nga si current President Joe Biden sang 2020.
english: Michigan is home to 240,000 registered Muslim voters who majority voted for Democrat current President Joe Biden in 2020.

text: Apang ini nga Arab Americans kag Muslim Americans ang una na nakapahayag nga diskumpyado sila sa panindugan ni Harris sa Gaza war gani ginatinguhaan sang Democrat presidential candidate nga makabawi.
english: But these Arab Americans and Muslim Americans have already expressed their dissatisfaction with Harris' stance on the Gaza war so the Democrat presidential candidate is trying to recover.

text: Ang ginalantaw sang bug-os nga US nga naga-uyat sang lyabe sa kadalag-an nanday Harris kag Trump amo ang natumod nga battleground states nga amo ang Arizona, Georgia, Michigan, Nevada, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, kag Wisconsin nga mahimo mag-swing sa Democrats ukon sa Republicans subong nga 2024.
english: What the entire US sees as holding the key to Harris and Trump’s victory are the designated battleground states namely Arizona, Georgia, Michigan, Nevada, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin that could swing either to the Democrats or to the Republicans as of 2024.

text: Magahatag ang Bombo Radyo Philippines sang latest updates sa “The American Vote 2024.
english: Bombo Radyo Philippines will provide the latest updates on “The American Vote 2024.

text: Gindumdom sang mag-asawa nga sanday Jinkee kag Manny Pacquiao ang ila 21st wedding anniversary.
english: Jinkee and Manny Pacquiao celebrated their 21st wedding anniversary.

text: Ginbalikan ni Jinkee ang simple nga kasal nila sadto ni Senator Manny nga una nakilala bilang Pambansang Kamao.
english: Jinkee recalled her simple marriage to Senator Manny, formerly known as Pambansang Kamao.

text: Ginkasal ang duha sa isa ka civil ceremony sadtong 1999.
english: The two were married in a civil ceremony in 1999.

text: Base sa instagram post ni Jinkee iya ginpahayag nga sa sulod sang 21 ka tuig bilang mag-asawa, madamo sila sang ginpangatubang nga problema apang indi gid magguba ang ila relasyon.
english: Based on Jinkee's Instagram post, she said that during their 21 years as a couple, they faced many problems but their relationship will never be broken.

text: Nagbutang man si Jinkee sang Bible verse tuhoy sa pag-isa sang Diyos sa mga mag-asawa kaangay nila ni Manny.
english: Jinkee also posted a Bible verse about God uniting couples like Manny.

text: Nahibaluan nga sadto, indi boto si Mommy Dionisia kay Jinkee para sa iya anak sa diin naglab-ot pa sa punto nga wala ini nagtambong sa kasal sang duha.
english: It is known that at that time, Mommy Dionisia did not vote for Jinkee for her daughter and went so far as to not attend the wedding of the two.

text: Pilason ang pila ka mga indibidwal matapos magbungguanay ang tricyle kag motorsiklo sa national road sang Barangay East Valencia, Buenavista, Guimaras.
english: Several individuals were injured after a tricycle and motorcycle collided on the national road of Barangay East Valencia, Buenavista, Guimaras.

text: Ginkilala ang mga sakay sang tricycle nga sanday Nema Seva, 63 anyos, isa ka fish vendor, kag si Pepito Seva, 72 anyos, isa ka mangunguma, upod ang ila kapid nga mga kabataan nga naga-edad sang apat ka tuig.
english: The tricycle riders were identified as Nema Seva, 63, a fish vendor, and Pepito Seva, 72, a farmer, along with their twin children aged four.

text: Samtang, ang driver sang motorsiklo amo si Ian Loyd Acebedo, 28 anyos, residente sang Brgy.
english: Meanwhile, the driver of the motorcycle was identified as Ian Loyd Acebedo, 28, resident of Brgy.

text: Tanza Bonifacio, Iloilo City, kag may mga upod ini nga duha ka menor de edad nga lalaki, naga-edad 13 kag 14 anyos.
english: Tanza Bonifacio, Iloilo City, and was accompanied by two minor boys, aged 13 and 14 years old.

text: Suno sa report nga nabaton sang Buenavista Municipal Police Station (BMPS) sang alas 6:08 sa amo man nga adlaw, ang insidente nagluntad malapit sa Kei Gazz Gasoline Station, sa nasambit nga banwa.
english: According to a report received by the Buenavista Municipal Police Station (BMPS) at 6:08 am on the same day, the incident occurred near Kei Gazz Gasoline Station, in the said town.

text: Base sa imbistigasyon, wala sang lisensya ang driver sang motorsiklo kag wala man sang may ginasuksok nga helmet.
english: Based on the investigation, the driver of the motorcycle did not have a license and was not wearing a helmet.

text: Padulong kuntani ang motorsiklo sa tindahan agud nga magbakal sang sorbetes, sang hinali lang nga nabungguan sini ang nalikod nga bahin sang tricyle sa kurbada nga parte sang karsada.
english: The motorcycle was heading to the store to buy ice cream, when it suddenly hit the back of the tricyle on the curved part of the road.

text: Nakaangkon sang pilas sa ulo ang driver sang motorsiklo, samtang ang iya duha ka backrider may gamay man nga pilas sa ulo.
english: The driver of the motorcycle sustained head injuries, while his two backriders also sustained minor head injuries.

text: Si Nema Seva naman ang nakaangkon sang pilas sa wala nga tuhod, tuo nga siko, kag ulo, kag maswerte nga wala nasamaran ang duha ka mga kabataan.
english: Nema Seva, on the other hand, sustained injuries to her left knee, right elbow, and head, and luckily the two children were not injured.

text: Gilayon man ini gindala sa hospital sang first responder nga grupo nanday PLT.
english: He was immediately taken to the hospital by the first responder team of PLT.

text: Col.
english: Col.

text: Sheila Marie S. Sardoma kag C, PCADU, Guimaras Provincial Office ang mga biktima para sa nagakaigo nga pagbulong.
english: Sheila Marie S. Sardoma and C, PCADU, Guimaras Provincial Office the victims for proper treatment.

text: Ang tricycle kag motorsiklo ang yara na sa kustodiya sang estasyon para sa dugang nga verification, documentation, kag insakto nga disposisyon.
english: The tricycle and motorcycle are now in the custody of the station for further verification, documentation, and proper disposition.

text: Nagbun-ag na sang healthy babies sanday Dianne Medina kag Coleen Garcia kag lunsay lalaki ang ila nga anak.
english: Dianne Medina and Coleen Garcia have given birth to healthy babies, both boys.

text: Ginpangalanan nanday Dianne kag mister sini nga si Rodjun Cruz ang ila nga baby nga si Rodolfo Joaquin Diego III.
english: Dianne and her husband Rodjun Cruz named their baby Rodolfo Joaquin Diego III.

text: Samtang pinaagi naman sa water birth ginbun-ag ni Coleen ang ila anak sang host-actor nga si Billy Crawford.
english: Meanwhile, Coleen gave birth to their son by host-actor Billy Crawford through a water birth.

text: Ginpangalanan ni Coleen ang iya baby boy nga si Amari.
english: Coleen named her baby boy Amari.

text: Nagsabat na si International rock star Arnel Pineda tuhoy sa alegasyon nga pagpanakit sini sa iya anay asawa.
english: Nagsabat na si International rock star Arnel Pineda tuhoy sa alegasyon nga pagpanakit sini sa iya anay asawa.

text: Ginsiling sang iya manager nga si Yul Session nga ang kaso ang bilang balos lamang sang asawa sang singer.
english: His manager, Yul Session, said the case was only in retaliation for the singer's wife.

text: Luyag niya pagguwaon nga mahigko ang reputasyon sang Journey frontman.
english: He wanted to expose the Journey frontman’s reputation as dirty.

text: Ini bangud nga ginkasuhan ni Arnel ang asawa sini nga adultery duha na ka tuig nga nakaligad sa Bagiuo City kag sa Quezon City.
english: This is because Arnel charged his wife with adultery two years ago in Baguio City and Quezon City.

text: Suno pa sa abogado nga apisar nga may kaso nga gin-file si Arnel sa asawa wala gid niya ginpatup-an sang iya kamot.
english: The lawyer said that although Arnel filed a case against his wife, he never raised his hand.

text: Padayon man nga nagahatag sang sustento si Arnel ila mga anak.
english: Arnel also continues to provide for their children.

text: Matandaan nga nagpagguwa ang korte sa Quezon City sang bench warrant bangud sa indi pagtambong sang singer sa mga natalanan nga hearing.
english: It can be recalled that the court in Quezon City issued a bench warrant for the singer's failure to attend the scheduled hearings.

text: Indi mag-untat ang Ilongga boxer kag Olympian nga si Irish Magno tubtub nga indi sini makuha ang bulawan nga medalya sa boksing.
english: Ilongga boxer and Olympian Irish Magno will not stop until he wins the gold medal in boxing.

text: Silver medalist si Magno sa bag-o lang nagtakop nga 31st Southeast Asian Games matapos nga napierde sa women’s flyweight final.
english: Magno was a silver medalist at the recently concluded 31st Southeast Asian Games after losing in the women’s flyweight final.

text: Ang nagpierde sa Ilongga boxer amo si Thi Tam Nguyen, ang Vietnamese nga naglutos man sa iya sa amo man nga event sang 2019 edition sang SEA Games diri sa Pilipinas.
english: The Ilongga boxer was defeated by Thi Tam Nguyen, the Vietnamese who also defeated him in the same event of the 2019 edition of the SEA Games here in the Philippines.

text: Ini na ang ikaduha nga sunod-sunod nga tuig nga silver medal ang iya nga gindala pauli.
english: This is the second year in a row that he has brought home a silver medal.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Magno nga tumandok gid sang banwa sang Janiuay, iya ginpahayag nga ginhatagan anay ang boxing team sang Pilipinas sang duha ka semana nga pahuway antes magbalik sa Baguio para liwat sa training.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Magno, a native of Janiuay, said the Philippine boxing team was given a two-week break before returning to Baguio for training.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga magatinir siya kaupod ang iya pamilya diri sa Iloilo bangud antes pa man ang biennal meet sa Vietnam, duha ka bulan man siya kag ang iban nga Pinoy boxers nga nagtinir sa Thailand para sa ila nga training.
english: He said he will stay with his family here in Iloilo because before the biennial meet in Vietnam, he and other Filipino boxers stayed in Thailand for two months for their training.

text: Ginpasalamatan ni Magno ang Ilonggo fans nga padayon nga nagasuporta sa iya nga mga hampang kag ginpasalig man nga padayunon pa gid ang pag-ensayo para sa sunod nga mga kumpetisyon.
english: Magno thanked the Ilonggo fans for their continued support in his games and assured that he will continue to train for the next competitions.

text: Matandaan nga sang Domingo, Mayo 22, isa si Magno sa nagsabak sa gold medal match sa boksing sa SEA Games.
english: On Sunday, May 22, Magno was one of the winners of the gold medal match in boxing at the SEA Games.

text: Ang iya kaupod nga sanday Rogen Ladon, Ian Clark Bautista kag Eumir Marcial ang lunsay nakadaog sang gold medals sa ila tagsa ka kumpetisyon.
english: His teammates Rogen Ladon, Ian Clark Bautista and Eumir Marcial all won gold medals in their respective competitions.

text: Ginahulat na lang sang Zarraga Municipal Police Station ang pag-file sang kaso sang pamilya sang duha ka mga babaye nga nabungguan-patay sang isa ka van Brgy.
english: The Zarraga Municipal Police Station is waiting for the filing of a case by the families of the two women who were hit and killed by a van in Brgy.

text: Tubigan, Zarraga, Iloilo.
english: Tubigan, Zarraga, Iloilo.

text: Ang driver amo si Mary Grace Condino Mandate, 30-anyos, kag residente sang Brgy.
english: The driver was identified as Mary Grace Condino Mandate, 30, resident of Brgy.

text: Bolilao, Mandurriao, Iloilo City, samtang, ang backrider naman amo si Mara Heradora Cordova, 31-anyos, residente sang Brgy.
english: Bolilao, Mandurriao, Iloilo City, while the backrider was identified as Mara Heradora Cordova, 31, resident of Brgy.

text: Poblacion, Bago City, Negros Occidental.
english: Population, Bago City, Negros Occidental.

text: Ang driver sang van naman amo si Jerry Tolentino Gonzales, 53-anyos, kag residente sang Ledesma St.
english: The driver of the van was identified as Jerry Tolentino Gonzales, 53, resident of Ledesma St.

text: Pototan, Iloilo.
english: Pototan, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PCapt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PCapt.

text: Dandy Ilalto, Hepe sang Zarraga Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga may nagpadulong na sa ila talatapan ang pamilya sang isa ka babaye nga biktima.
english: Dandy Ilalto, Chief of Zarraga Municipal Police Station, said the family of a female victim has already approached their office.

text: Suno kay Ilalto, posible nga ipasaka sa suspek amo ang reckless imprudence resulting to multiple homicide.
english: According to Ilalto, the suspect may be charged with reckless imprudence resulting to multiple homicide.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga indi hubog ang suspek kag wala makitaan sang ano man nga makahulubog nga ilimnon.
english: He also clarified that the suspect was not drunk and was not found with any alcoholic beverages.

text: Kon balikan, naghalin sa Dumangas Port ang motorskilo kag padulong kuntani sa syudad sang Iloilo, samtang ang van naman padulong sa Banwa sang Dumangas.
english: The motorcycle was heading to Iloilo City from Dumangas Port, while the van was heading to Dumangas.

text: Base sa inisyal nga imbestigasyon, madasig ang pagpadalagan sang duha ka salakyan.
english: Based on initial investigation, the two vehicles were driving fast.

text: Matapos magluntad ang insidente, gilayon nga nanaog sa van ang driver kag nagsakay sa tricycle agud magpadulong sa Leganes Municipal Police Station kag didto magsungka, gilayon naman ini nga ginturn-over sa Leganes MPS sa Zarraga MPS.
english: After the incident, the driver immediately got out of the van and boarded a tricycle to go to the Leganes Municipal Police Station and surrender there.

text: Kumpyansa si Philippine Ambassador to the US Jose Manuel Romualdez nga magapabilin nga mabakod ang relasyon sang Pilipinas kag Estados Unidos bisan sin-o pa nga presidential candidate ang magadaog sa US elections sa Nobyembre 5.
english: Philippine Ambassador to the US Jose Manuel Romualdez is confident that relations between the Philippines and the United States will remain strong no matter which presidential candidate wins the US elections on November 5.

text: Kalmado ang Pilipinas suno kay Romualdez bangud wala man sang ginapanan-aw nga daku nga pagbag-o sa polisa sa tunga sang duha ka mga pungsod kun alyansa ang pagahambalan.
english: Romualdez said the Philippines is calm because there is no major change in policy between the two countries when it comes to alliances.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga naka-istorya siya sa kampo nanday Republican presidential candidate kag former US President Donald Trump kag Democratic presidential candidate kag US Vice President Kamala Harris kag ginpasalig sa iya nga wala sang mangin pagbag-o sa foreign policy.
english: He said he had talked to the camp of Republican presidential candidate and former US President Donald Trump and Democratic presidential candidate and US Vice President Kamala Harris and assured him that there would be no change in foreign policy.

text: Importante suno kay Romualdez nga mapabilin ang mabaskog nga economic ties sa Estados Unidos bangud mas nagasaka pa subong ang foreign investments sa Pilipinas.
english: Romualdez said it is important to maintain strong economic ties with the United States as foreign investments in the Philippines are increasing.

text: Wala naman sang dapat kahangaw-an suno sa iya kun ano ang mangin panindugan sang US president sa isyu sa West Philippine Sea bangud ang gina-istorya man sangf Pilipinas amo ang military ukon Pentagon kag nakahibalo sila nga para ini sa mutual interest ukon interes sang duha ka nasyon.
english: He said there is nothing to worry about the US president's position on the West Philippine Sea issue because the Philippines is also talking to the military or the Pentagon and they know that it is for the mutual interest of the two countries.

text: Nahibaluan nga sige pa subong ang pagpangampanya nanday Harris kag Trump ilabi na sa key battleground states apisar nga sa Nobyembre 5 na ang eleksyon.
english: Harris and Trump are still campaigning in key battleground states despite the November 5 election.

text: Ini nga states amo ang Nevada, Michigan, Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Arizona, Georgia, kag North Carolina.
english: These states are Nevada, Michigan, Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Arizona, Georgia, and North Carolina.

text: Ulihi nagkadto si Harris sa Atlanta, Georgia kag nagtambong sa event sa Charlotte, North Carolina samtang nagkampanya naman si Trump sa Gastonia, North Carolina kag sunod nga nagbyahe sa Salem, Virginia antes nagbalik sa Greensboro, North Carolina.
english: Harris later went to Atlanta, Georgia and attended an event in Charlotte, North Carolina while Trump campaigned in Gastonia, North Carolina and then traveled to Salem, Virginia before returning to Greensboro, North Carolina.

text: Antes pa man ang Nobyembre 5, nagsaka na sa 75.09-million Americans ang nakaboto sang temprano base sa data nga ginpaguwa sang Election Lab tracker sang University of Florida.
english: Even before Nov. 5, 75.09-million Americans had already voted early based on data released by the University of Florida's Election Lab tracker.

text: Nagtuga sang kakulba sa mga pumuluyo sa Bacolod City ang isa ka tinuga nga nga may malaba nga buhok, nakasuksok sang puti nga bestida, kag nagalagaw sa dalanon sa tion sang kaagahon.
english: A creature with long hair, wearing a white dress, and walking on the streets in the morning has caused panic among residents in Bacolod City.

text: Siya ang naaktuhan mismo sang Bombo News Team pasado alas-3:00 kaina sang kaagahon nga nagalakat sa dalan Lacson, Barangay Mandalagan.
english: He was caught by the Bombo News Team around 3:00 this morning walking on Lacson Street, Barangay Mandalan.

text: Sa pag-check sang Bombo News Team, nakumpirma nga isa ini ka lalaki nga ginapatihan may deperensya sa paminsaron nga nagatiniil lamang kag nakatabon ang buhok sa iya nawong.
english: When the Bombo News Team checked, it was confirmed that it was a man believed to have a mental disorder who was walking with his hair covering his face.

text: Siya ang naga-akto man nga kaangay nga ini ang nagapamahog.
english: He is also acting like it is threatening.

text: Gilayon naman nga ginresponderan sang Bacolod City Police Station 3 ang area.
english: Bacolod City Police Station 3 immediately responded to the area.

text: Pahayag sang mga ini nga ginasundan-sundan lamang nila ang lalaki, agud gilayon nga mabantayan hinali nga ini ang magpanakit.
english: They said they were just following the man, so that they could immediately watch him suddenly hurt him.

text: Ginpangkuha na ang mga kagamitan halin sa opisina ni House Speaker Martin Romualdez subong nga gab-i, Septyembre 16.
english: The equipment was removed from the office of House Speaker Martin Romualdez tonight, September 16.

text: Lakip sa nakit-an nga ginkakas amo ang iya nga desk nameplate.
english: Among the items found removed was his desk nameplate.

text: Ginhimo ini sa tunga sang matunog nga huring-huring nga may matabo nga pag-ilis sang liderato sa Kamara buwas, Septyembre 17.
english: This was done amid loud rumors that there will be a leadership reshuffle in the House tomorrow, September 17.

text: Base sa pila ka House sources, magasapol ang ruling party nga Lakas 2:00 sa hapon buwas kun sa diin ginalantaw nga magapaguwa sang formal announcement si Romualdez kaangot sa iya nga resignation.
english: According to some House sources, the ruling party Lakas will meet at 2:00 pm tomorrow where Romualdez is expected to issue a formal announcement regarding his resignation.

text: May mga impormasyon naman nga si Deputy Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III nga halin sa Isabela amo ang magabulos sa posisyon.
english: There are reports that Deputy Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III from Isabela will take over the position.

text: Antes sa 20th Congress, nakaserbe siya anay sa Kamara halin sang 2001 tubtub sang 2010; nakapungko bilang gobernador sang Isabela sang 2010 tubtub 2019, kag nangin vice governor sang 2019 tubtub sini nga 2025 antes ini nagbalik sa lower chamber.
english: Before the 20th Congress, he served in the House of Representatives from 2001 to 2010; served as governor of Isabela from 2010 to 2019, and became vice governor from 2019 to 2025 before returning to the lower chamber.

text: Myembro siya subong sang Partido Federal ng Pilipinas (PFP) ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.
english: He is currently a member of the Federal Party of the Philippines (PFP) of President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.

text: Magluwas sa iya, nagtuhaw man ang pangalan sang apat ka iban pa nga mga kongresista nga magabulos sa pagka-House Speaker nga amo sanday Deputy Speaker Rand Antipolo Rep.
english: Besides him, the names of four other congressmen who will succeed him as House Speaker also emerged, namely Deputy Speaker Rand Antipolo Rep.

text: Ronaldo Puno, Cebu Rep.
english: Ronaldo Puno, Cebu Rep.

text: Duke Frasco, Navotas Rep.
english: Duke Frasco, Navotas Rep.

text: Toby Tiangco, kag Bacolod Rep.
english: Toby Tiangco, and Bacolod Rep.

text: Albee Benitez.#
english: Albee Benitez.#

text: Isa ang Pilipinas sa mga pungsod sa Asya nga ginapanan-aw nga tuman nga maapektuhan bangud sang gulpyada nga pagsaka sa presyo sang gatong kag iban pa nga pagkaon nga gintuga sang ginamo sa Ukraine.
english: The Philippines is one of the Asian countries expected to be severely affected by the sudden increase in fuel and other food prices caused by the conflict in Ukraine.

text: Sandig ini sa report nga ginpaguwa sang global investment firm nga Nomura nga naka-base sa Japan.
english: This is according to a report released by Japan-based global investment firm Nomura.

text: Hwebes subong nga semana sang nagsalakay ang Russia sa Ukraine, apang suno sa Nomura, mabatyagan na ang epekto sini sa presyo sang mga pagkaon.
english: Russia invaded Ukraine on Thursday of this week, but Nomura says its impact on food prices is already being felt.

text: Ini bangud isa ang Russia sa pinakadaku nga producers sang wheat and corn.
english: This is because Russia is one of the largest producers of wheat and corn.

text: Magluwas diri, naapektuhan naman ang presyo sa gatong, abono, kag biofuel substitution.
english: In addition, the price of fuel, fertilizer, and biofuel substitution was affected.

text: Ini nga mga epekto ang mabatyagan gid sa bilog nga Asya kun sa diin kalabanan sa mga pungsod ang naga-import sang oil, kag halos katunga gid sang gasto sa market consumption amo ang pagkaon kag energy.
english: These effects will be felt throughout Asia where most countries import oil, and almost half of market consumption is food and energy.

text: Sa Asya suno sa Nomura, makabig nga ‘biggest losers’ ang India,Thailand, kag Pilipinas.
english: In Asia, according to Nomura, India, Thailand, and the Philippines are the biggest losers.

text: Malayo ang gintabog sang korona sang reigning champion nga Pilipinas sa Southeast Asian Games (SEA Games) matapos nga nagpang-apat lang sa medal tally sa 31st SEA Games sa Hanoi, Vietnam.
english: The crown was thrown far away by the reigning champion Philippines at the Southeast Asian Games (SEA Games) after finishing fourth in the medal tally at the 31st SEA Games in Hanoi, Vietnam.

text: Magatakop na subong nga adlaw, Mayo 23, ang nasambit nga hinampang.
english: The game will end today, May 23.

text: Nakatipon ang Pilipinas sang kabug-usan nga 223 ka medalya — 52 diri ang gold medals, 70 ang silver medals, kag 101 ang bronze medals.
english: The Philippines collected a total of 223 medals — 52 of which were gold medals, 70 were silver medals, and 101 were bronze medals.

text: Sa katapusan nga adlaw sang makahalawat-hawat nga hampang kahapon sang mga atleta, lima ka gold medals ang natipon para sa pungsod.
english: On the last day of the spectacular games yesterday of the athletes, five gold medals were collected for the country.

text: Nakuha ini sang boxers nga sanday Eumir Marcial (daog sa Men’s Middleweight), Rogen Ladon (daog sa men’s under-52kgs division paagi sa split decision), kag Ian Clark Bautista (daog paagi sa 5-0 unanimous decision sa men’s -57kg).
english: It was won by boxers Eumir Marcial (win in Men’s Middleweight), Rogen Ladon (win in men’s under-52kgs division by split decision), and Ian Clark Bautista (win by 5-0 unanimous decision in men’s -57kg).
