text: Na-depensahan naman sang Gilas Pilipinas Women ang gold medal women’s basketball apisar nga napierde ini sa ila katapusan nga hampang batok sa Malaysia sa score nga 96-93.
english: Gilas Pilipinas Women defended their gold medal in women's basketball despite losing their last game against Malaysia with a score of 96-93.

text: Nagtapos ang SEA Games campaign sang Gilas women sa 4-1 record.
english: The Gilas women ended their SEA Games campaign with a 4-1 record.

text: Ang nasambit nga basketball tournament ang may yara sang single-round format kun sa diin ang team nga may best record amo ang makakuha sang kampyeonato.
english: The basketball tournament will have a single-round format where the team with the best record will win the championship.

text: Ang ika-lima nga gold medal kagab-i ang nagikan kay Philip Delarmino matapos ginpaboran ang iya nga protesta.
english: The fifth gold medal last night went to Philip Delarmino after his protest was approved.

text: Ginhatag ang gold medal kay Delarmino sa men’s muay 57kg event.
english: Delarmino was awarded the gold medal in the men’s muay 57kg event.

text:
Inisyal nga gindeklarar nga silver medalist si Delarmino, apang ginbaliskad ang desisyon kagab-i.

Ginhatag kay Delarmino ang gold medal, samtang ang iya naman nga kasumpong nga Vietnamese nga si Nguyen Doan Long amo ang ginhimo nga silver medalist.
english:
Delarmino was initially declared a silver medalist, but the decision was overturned last night.

Delarmino was awarded the gold medal, while his Vietnamese opponent Nguyen Doan Long was named the silver medalist.

text:
MASSIVE UPSET

Nabuy-an naman sang Pilipinas ang isa sa pinaka-importante nga medalya sa SEA Games — isa sa ginakabig pinakadaku nga upset subong nga edition sang biennal meet.
english:
MASSIVE UPSET

The Philippines, meanwhile, lost one of the most important medals in the SEA Games — one of the biggest upsets of this edition of the biennial meet.

text: Huyhuy ang abaga sang Gilas Pilipinas bangud sa labing-una nga tion sa masobra tatlo ka dekada, napaslawan ini nga madala-pauli ang gold medal halin sa SEA Games.
english: Gilas Pilipinas' shoulders are shaking because for the first time in more than three decades, it failed to bring home the gold medal from the SEA Games.

text: Indonesia ang nagpatilaw sang mapait nga kapaslawan sa basketball team sang Pilipinas matapos nga nagtakop ang hampang sa score nga 85-81.
english: Indonesia tasted a bitter disappointment to the Philippine basketball team after the game ended with a score of 85-81.

text: Ini na kuntani ang ika-14 nga sunod-sunod nga gold medal sang Gilas Pilipinas sa SEA Games kun nasarangan sini ang pwersa sang Indonesia.
english: This would have been the 14th consecutive gold medal for Gilas Pilipinas in the SEA Games if it had beaten the Indonesian force.

text: Ang gin-stage sang Indonesia nga monumental upset amo ang naghatag sang labing-una nga gold medal para men’s basketball team sang ila nga pungsod sa SEA Games.
english: Indonesia's staged monumental upset gave its country's men's basketball team its first gold medal at the SEA Games.

text: Katapusan nga wala nakadaog sang gold medal ang Pilipinas sa basketball sa SEA Games ang natabo pa sang 1989 sang nakuha sang Malaysia ang kampyeonato.
english: The last time the Philippines failed to win a gold medal in basketball at the SEA Games was in 1989 when Malaysia won the championship.

text: Ang kadalag-an naman sang Indonesia ang magaserbe nga daku nga confidence-booster sa ila pag-tinguha nga maka-qualify sa FIBA World Cup sa masunod nga tuig.
english: Indonesia's victory will serve as a big confidence-booster in their quest to qualify for next year's FIBA ​​World Cup.

english: SEAG TallyHere is the latest medal tally.

text: Magapadala ang Estados Unidos sang Amerika sang B-52 bombers, fighter jets, refueling aircraft kag Navy destroyers sa Middle East.
english: The United States of America will send B-52 bombers, fighter jets, refueling aircraft and Navy destroyers to the Middle East.

text: Ini nga readjustment sang military assets ang ginhimo bangud magabiya naman ang una ginpadala nga Abraham Lincoln carrier strike group sa amo nga rehiyon.
english: This readjustment of military assets was made because the first Abraham Lincoln carrier strike group sent to the region will leave.

text: Suno sa Pentagon, matabo ini nga deployment sa masunod nga binulan kag isa ka pagpakita sang flexibility sang U.S. military movements sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: The Pentagon said the deployment will take place next month and is a demonstration of the flexibility of U.S. military movements around the world.

text: Nagpaandam man ini nga pananglitan himuon nga target sang Iran kag ila mga kaalyado ang bisan sin-o man nga American personnel o interests sa rehiyon, himuon sang Estados Unidos ang mga nagakaigu nga tikang para depensahan ang ila mga tawo.
english: He also warned that if Iran and its allies target any American personnel or interests in the region, the United States will take appropriate measures to defend its people.

text: Nahibaluan nga antes sini, may yara na sang duha ka aircraft carriers ang US sa Middle East halin sang nagsugod ang Israel-Hamas war sang Oct.
english: The US has previously deployed two aircraft carriers in the Middle East since the Israel-Hamas war began on Oct.

text: Ang latest adjustment sa U.S. forces ang kasunod sang latest nga tension sa tunga sang Israel kag Iran, magluwas pa sa away sang Israel batok sa Hamas sa Gaza kag batok sa Hezbollah sa Lebanon.
english: The latest adjustment in U.S. forces follows the latest tensions between Israel and Iran, in addition to Israel's fight against Hamas in Gaza and against Hezbollah in Lebanon.

text: Magluwas pa gid ini sa Houthi fighters nga naka-base naman sa Yemen.
english: This is in addition to Houthi fighters based in Yemen.

text: Una na nga ginpromisa sang Estados Unidos nga depensahan sini ang Israel sa anuman nga atake kag protektahan sini ang US forces sa Middle East nga gina-atake sang mga grupo nga kaalyado sang Iran sa Syria, Iraq, Jordan kag sa Yemen.
english: The United States has previously promised to defend Israel from any attack and to protect US forces in the Middle East under attack by Iranian-allied groups in Syria, Iraq, Jordan and Yemen.

text: Ginhabuyan sang lunang kag ginsinggitan sang akig nga mga tawo ang hari kag reyna sang Espanya kadungan sang ila pagbisita sa Paiporta sa Valencia region nga isa sa pinakaapektado sang lapnagon nga baha sang nagligad nga semana.
english: Angry mobs threw mud and shouted at the Spanish king and queen during a visit to Paiporta in the Valencia region which was one of the worst affected by last week's widespread flooding.

text: Mabatian ang mga tawo nga nagasinggit sang “murderer” kay King Felipe VI amo man kanday Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez kag regional governor Carlos Mazon.
english: People can be heard shouting “murderer” at King Felipe VI as well as Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez and regional governor Carlos Mazon.

text: Makit-an sa videos kag pictures nga ginprotektahan lamang sang security guards ang hari gamit ang ila dala nga payong samtang ang iban naman nga police officers ang nagasakay na sa kabayo kag nakaalerto samtang may gina-uyatan na ang iban nga mga residente nga pala kag tubo.
english: Videos and pictures show that the security guards protected the king with their umbrellas while other police officers were already riding on horseback and alert while other residents were holding shovels and pipes.

text: Nakit-an man pati si Queen Letizia nga may mga lunang man sa iya nga nawong kag bayo kag ginpalapitan pa ini kag ginkumpronta sang akig mga residente.
english: Queen Letizia was also seen with mud on her face and clothes and was approached and confronted by angry residents.

text: Apisar sang insidente, makit-an nga nagpabilin nga kalmado ang royals samtang nagapamati sa atubang sang mga residente.
english: Despite the incident, the royals remained calm while listening in front of the residents.

text: Makit-an nga binudlayan naman ang mga pulis nga makontrol ang pagdinaguso sang mga tawo.
english: Police found it difficult to control the crowd.

text: Kasunod sang amo nga hitabo, ginsuspinde na ang pagpadulong sang hari kag rayna sa Chiva nga isa man ka lugar nga nabahaan sa amo nga rehiyon.
english: Following the incident, the king and queen's visit to Chiva, another flooded area in the region, has been suspended.

text: Gin-evacuate naman ang prime minister halin sa Paiporta bangud sa kahangawa sa seguridad sini.
english: The prime minister was evacuated from Paiporta due to security concerns.

text: Nag-ugat ang kaakig sang mga tawo sa ginaalegar nga ulihi na katama nga text warnings sa ila kaangot sa baha kag sa atrasado kag kulang nga responde sang Spanish government sa mga biktima sang kalamidad.
english: The anger of the people stemmed from the allegedly too late text warnings regarding the floods and the delayed and insufficient response of the Spanish government to the victims of the disaster.

text: Nagsaka na sa masobra 210 ang patay sa amo nga baha sa Valencia, Castilla La Mancha kag Andalusia, kag ginakahangaw-an nga magtaas pa ang death toll bangud sa indi pa matumod nga numero sang missing nga mga tawo.
english: The death toll from the floods in Valencia, Castile, La Mancha and Andalusia has risen to more than 210, and the death toll is feared to rise due to the unspecified number of missing people.

text: Sa sini lang nga mga inoras, may yara naman sang red weather alert nga gin-isyu sa mga parte sang southern Valencia nga naga-cover sa syudad sang Alzira, Cullera kag Gandia.
english: In recent hours, a red weather alert has been issued in parts of southern Valencia covering the cities of Alzira, Cullera and Gandia.

text: Ginhaboy sang mga protesters ang mga pulis sang bato kag bomba sa Portland sa Estados Unidos sa diin 50 ang gin-aresto kadungan sang ika-100 nga adlaw sa pagpatigayon sang hublag protesta batuk sa racism kag police brutality.
english: Protesters threw stones and bombs at police in Portland in the United States where 50 people were arrested on the occasion of the 100th day of protests against racism and police brutality.

text: Suno sa isa ka pulis, may yara sila sang kaupod nga isa ka sergeant ang nalukpan sang bomba kag na-igo gid ang kamot.
english: According to a police officer, they had a sergeant with him who was hit by a bomb and was badly hit in the hand.

text: Dugang pa niya, naggamit man ang kapulisan sang tear gas agud nga matapna ang pagtililipon sang mga protesters nga ginabanta yara sa 400.
english: He added that police also used tear gas to disperse the gathering of protesters estimated at 400.

text: Nahibaluan nga kada gab-i na lang sa Portland may yara sang ginapatigayon nga hublag protesta sa sulod na sang masobra tatlo ka bulan.
english: It is known that every night in Portland there is a protest movement for more than three months.

text: Samtang sa bahin sang Luiseville, ang mga armed police supporters kag anti-racism demonstrators ang nagginamo man sang damlag lang sa diin naggamit man ang mga pulis sang tear gas.
english: Meanwhile, in Louisville, armed police supporters and anti-racism demonstrators also rioted recently where police also used tear gas.

text: Nag-umpisa ang hublag protesta kasunod sang kamatayon sang Black-American nga si George Floyd sa kamot sang isa ka pulis.
english: The protest movement began following the death of Black-American George Floyd at the hands of a police officer.

text: Posible nga magsaka ang presyo sang noodles, karne, kag manok sa tunga sang nagakatabo nga kinagamo sa Ukraine, suno kay anay socioeconomic planning secretary Ernesto Pernia.
english: Prices of noodles, meat, and chicken are likely to rise amid the ongoing unrest in Ukraine, according to former socioeconomic planning secretary Ernesto Pernia.

text: Ini ang kasunod man sang pagsaka sang presyo sang trigo, nga gina-import pa sang Pilipinas.
english: This also follows the increase in the price of wheat, which the Philippines still imports.

text: Suno kay Pernia, ginagamit man ang trigo sa animal feeds.
english: According to Pernia, wheat is also used in animal feeds.

text:
“There are many other things that will be disrupted, because trade will be disrupted and as you know we import a lot, we are not sufficient in many things.”

Suno naman kay Presidential Adviser for Entrepreneurship Joey Concepcion, dako ini nga problema bangud posible nga indi masarangan sang publiko ang pagsaka sang presyo sang mga balaklon.
english:
“There are many other things that will be disrupted, because trade will be disrupted and as you know we import a lot, we are not sufficient in many things.”

According to Presidential Adviser for Entrepreneurship Joey Concepcion, this is a big problem because the public may not be able to afford the increase in prices of goods.

text: Pahayag niya dako man ini nga rason agud pahalugan anay sang gobyerno ang alert levels agud indi magsarurot ang ekonomiya.
english: He said this is also a good reason for the government to lower the alert levels to prevent the economy from collapsing.

text:
“Ang importante dito, as we open the economy to Alert Level 1, more businesses can resume so at least they can start earning money and better prepare themselves for whatever may happen dito sa giyera na ito.”

Una na ginpahayag sang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) nga ginatun-an pa nila ang pagsaka sang presyo sang pila ka mga produkto sa merkado.
english:
“The important thing here is, as we open the economy to Alert Level 1, more businesses can resume so at least they can start earning money and better prepare themselves for whatever may happen here in this war.”

Earlier, the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) said it is still studying the increase in prices of some products in the market.

text: MANILA – Proud nga ginpakita sang singer nga si Angeline Quinto ang iya bag-o nga negosyo subong nga may yara sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: MANILA – Singer Angeline Quinto proudly showed off her new business during the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Makita sa Instagram post ni Angeline ang mga laragway sang bag-o lang nagbukas nga flavored chicken wings business nga ginpangalan gikan sa iya initials kag sa iya paborito nga ambahanon.
english: Angeline's Instagram post shows pictures of the newly opened flavored chicken wings business named after her initials and her favorite song.

text: Sang nakaligad nga semana, nangin sentro sang balita ang 30 anyos nga singer matapos ginkumpirma nga may yara ini sang kahagugma.
english: Last week, the 30-year-old singer made headlines after confirming that she had a boyfriend.

text: Apisar sini, wala na naghatag pa sang dugang nga detalye ang natungdan tuhoy sa iya bag-o nga inspirasyon.
english: However, he did not give any further details about his new inspiration.

text: Patay ang angkas nga 9-anyos nga bata nga babaye samtang pilason ang 15-anyos nga rider sa bungguanay sang motorsiklo kag military vehicle sa Barangay Carusikis, Pasuquin, Ilocos Norte.
english: A 9-year-old girl was killed while a 15-year-old rider was injured in a collision between a motorcycle and a military vehicle in Barangay Carusikis, Pasuquin, Ilocos Norte.

text: Sa imbestigasyon, naggwa nga nadulaan sang kontrol ang rider sa kurbadahon nga parte sang dalan ka nagkadto sa pihak ng linya tubot nga nabunggo sa sugata nga military vehicle.
english: Investigation revealed that the rider lost control of the curved part of the road and went to the other side of the lane and collided with an oncoming military vehicle.

text: Bangud sa impact, nagtabog gid ang duha ka menor de edad.
english: Due to the impact, the two minors fled the scene.

text: Dead on arrival ang backrider samtang ginabulong sa ospital ang driver.
english: The backrider was dead on arrival while the driver was being treated at the hospital.

text: Pareho nga wala sang suksok nga helmet ang duha.
english: Both were not wearing helmets.

text: Dugang nga pwersa ang kinahanglanon sang team sang Pilipinas agud mahakwat ang bilog nga pungsod kag mapasaka sa ikatatlo nga puwesto sa overall medal tally sa 31st Southeast Asian (SEA) Games sa Hanoi, Vietnam.
english: The Philippine team needs more strength to lift the entire country and move up to third place in the overall medal tally at the 31st Southeast Asian (SEA) Games in Hanoi, Vietnam.

text: Kritikal ang papel nga ginauyatan subong sang national weightlifters, kag isa diri ang Olympic champion nga si Hidilyn Diaz nga maga-compete na sa women’s 55-kilogram class ‘la una karon sa hapon (PST).
english: The role played by national weightlifters is critical, and one of them is Olympic champion Hidilyn Diaz who will compete in the women's 55-kilogram class early this afternoon (PST).

text: Heavy favorite si Diaz nga madepensahan ang SEA Games crown sa amo nga division apang indi ini mangin mahapos.
english: Diaz is a heavy favorite to defend the SEA Games crown in that division but it won't be easy.

text: Mangin si Diaz ang nagapreparar man kun hinali nga maka-produce sang upset ang iya mga kasumpong.
english: Even Diaz is preparing if his opponents suddenly produce an upset.

text: Isa sa ginabantayan nga kasumpong amo si Tanasan Sanikun sang Thailand nga nakadaog sang gold sa women’s 48kg division sa 2016 Rio Olympics.
english: One of the closely watched opponents is Tanasan Sanikun of Thailand who won gold in the women’s 48kg division at the 2016 Rio Olympics.

text: Napierde na sini si Diaz sa 53kg category sang 2017 World Championships sa Anaheim, California.
english: He had already defeated Diaz in the 53kg category at the 2017 World Championships in Anaheim, California.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Samahang Weightlifting sa Pilipinas president Monico Puentevella, iya ginpahayag nga ‘preparado kag dugay ang practice’ ni Diaz para sa sini nga kumpetisyon nga amo ang una niya nga intrahan matapos nakakuha sang gold medal sa Tokyo Olympics.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Samahang Weightlifting in the Philippines president Monico Puentevella said Diaz is 'prepared and has been practicing for a long time' for this competition which is his first participation after winning a gold medal at the Tokyo Olympics.

text: “Pareho ni sila ni Pacquiao kag ni Jordan.
english: “They are like Pacquiao and Jordan.

text: Indi lang pag-hangkata, kay kun hangkaton mo, baw matilaw gid.
english: Don't just challenge it, because if you challenge it, it'll taste good.

text: Mga kampyeon ni sila nga indi mo dapat paghangkaton,” suno kay Puentevella.
english: They are champions that you should not challenge,” Puentevella said.

text: Ginpakigbahin man ni Puentevella nga tuyo gid ni Diaz nga maka-compete pa sa isa ka Olympiada — ang Paris 2024.
english: Puentevella also shared that Diaz always intends to compete in one more Olympiada — Paris 2024.

text: “Gusto ko tani nga mapakasal na ni siya, pero matilaw gid.
english: “I wish she could get married, but it's going to be difficult.

text: Indi magpasupil kay maintra pa sa Paris Olympics.
english: Don't give up because you're going to participate in the Paris Olympics.

text: Silver medal (Rio Olympics) kag Gold medal (Tokyo Olympics) na siya kag siling ko gani wala na sang tawo kag Pilipino nga makahimo sina.
english: He's already a Silver medal (Rio Olympics) and a Gold medal (Tokyo Olympics) and I said so there's no human and Filipino who can do that.

text: Budlay na na nga silver tapos gold,” suno kay Puentevella.
english: It's hard to be silver and then gold,” Puentevella said.

text: Target sang weightlifting team nga makakuha sang tatlo ka gold medals, apang “kun duha lang, okay na gid”, suno pa sa anay kongresista.
english: The weightlifting team targets to win three gold medals, but “if only two, it's okay”, the former congressman said.

text:
Sa weightlifting, yari ang iban pa nga Pinoy nga balantayan:

Si Nestor Colonia (67kg) nga maga-compete subong nga Byernes upod kay Rowel Garcia (61kg) kag Margaret Colonia (59kg).
english:
In weightlifting, here are some other Filipinos to watch:

Nestor Colonia (67kg) competing this Friday alongside Rowel Garcia (61kg) and Margaret Colonia (59kg).

text: Balantayan man si Elreen Ando (64kg) sa Sabado kag si Kristel Macrohon (+71kg) sa Domingo.
english: Also watch for Elreen Ando (64kg) on ​​Saturday and Kristel Macrohon (+71kg) on ​​Sunday.

text: Ang Pilipinas ang reigning champion sa SEA Games apang nadagdag sa ikalima nga puwesto sa latest medal tally.
english: The Philippines is the reigning champion at the SEA Games but dropped to fifth place in the latest medal tally.

text: Ginalantaw sang sports officials ang weightlifting kag boxing nga amo ang makadugang sang gold medals para sa pungsod.
english: Sports officials are looking at weightlifting and boxing to add gold medals for the country.

text: Sa 8:00 pm weather update sang Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA),  ginkumpirma nga nag-develop na sa Low Pressure Area (LPA) ang cloud cluster nga yara sa nasidlangan sang Southeastern Luzon nga yara pa sa guwa sang Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR).
english: In the 8:00 pm weather update of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), it was confirmed that the cloud cluster east of Southeastern Luzon, which is still outside the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR), has developed into a Low Pressure Area (LPA).

text: Sandig sa ahensya, may “medium chance” ini nga mahimo nga bagyo sa masunod nga 24 oras.
english: According to the agency, there is a “medium chance” that it will become a typhoon in the next 24 hours.

text: Ini nga weather disturbance ang magluwas pa sa Tropical Depression Mirasol nga gina-monitor man sang weather bureau.
english: This weather disturbance is in addition to Tropical Depression Mirasol which is also being monitored by the weather bureau.

text: Nag-develop ini nga bagyo 2:00 kaina sang hapon.
english: The typhoon developed at 2:00 pm yesterday.

text: Ipa-guwa ang masunod nga Tropical Cyclone Bulletin 11:00 subong nga gab-i.
english: The next Tropical Cyclone Bulletin will be released at 11:00 tonight.

text: Malapit na lang nga ipa-guwa sang gobyerno ang P2.5-billion nga fuel subsidies para sa mga driver agud nga mabuligan ang mga ini sa tunga sang problema sang pagsaka sa presyo sang gatong nga ilabi pa nga ginpalala bangud sang away sa Ukraine.
english: The government is about to release P2.5-billion fuel subsidies for drivers to help them amid the problem of rising fuel prices that have been exacerbated by the war in Ukraine.

text: Ang Pilipinas ang makabig nga isa ka net oil importer ukon pungsod nga mas madamo pa ang ginabakal nga gatong halin sa iban nga pungsod ipaanggid sa sarang sini nga ma-export.
english: The Philippines is considered a net oil importer or a country that buys more fuel from other countries than it can export.

text: Suno pa sa statement sang cabinet-level Development Budget Coordination Committee (DBCC), ang P2.5 billion ang nagikan sa fuel subsidy program sang Department of Transportation (DOTr).
english: According to the statement of the cabinet-level Development Budget Coordination Committee (DBCC), the P2.5 billion came from the fuel subsidy program of the Department of Transportation (DOTr).

text:
Igapanagtag ini sa 377,000 “qualified PUV drivers” nga naga-operate sang jeep, UV Express vans, taxis, tricycles kag iban pa nga “full-time ride-hailing and delivery services nationwide.”

Magluwas diri, ang Department of Agriculture ang magahatag man sang P500-million budget para sa affected farmers kag fisherfolk.
english:
It will be distributed to 377,000 “qualified PUV drivers” who operate jeeps, UV Express vans, taxis, tricycles and other “full-time ride-hailing and delivery services nationwide.”

In addition, the Department of Agriculture will also provide a P500-million budget for affected farmers and fisherfolk.

text: Sang nagligad nga semana, nagpahayag si Finance Secretary Carlos Dominguez III nga kun magdangat sa $100 ukon masobra P5,000 kada bariles ang presyo sang gatong sa global market, “concerning” na ini para sa Pilipinas apang “ready” man ang pungsod.
english: Last week, Finance Secretary Carlos Dominguez III said that if the price of fuel reaches $100 or more than P5,000 per barrel in the global market, it is “concerning” for the Philippines but the country is also “ready”.

text: Antes ang pag-atake sang Russia sa Ukraine, walo na nga daan ka asud-asud nga semana nga nagsaka ang presyo sang gatong sa Pilipinas.
english: Before Russia's invasion of Ukraine, fuel prices in the Philippines had been rising for eight consecutive weeks.

text: SEGURADO naton nga igakalipay gid sang aton mga pumuluyo ang ining ulihi nga development sa siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: We are sure that our residents will be very happy with this latest development in Iloilo City.

text: Amo ini ang pagpatuman na sang plano sang siyudad, sa pagpanguna ni Mayor Jerry Trenas, ang pagtukod sang “modernized” nga mga merkado publiko.
english: This is the implementation of the city's plan, led by Mayor Jerry Trenas, to build “modernized” public markets.

text: Makita na gani sang publiko ang pagsugod na sang pagtrabaho sa sining mga proyekto.
english: The public can even see the beginning of work on these projects.

text: Kabahin na ini seguro sang pagpauswag pa gid sang siyudad padulong sa isa ka Smart City nga nabatyagan na naton sa padayon nga pagpadasig sang operational efficiency sang siyudad paagi sa mas malawak na nga pagpatuman sang Information kag Communication Technology (ICT).
english: This is probably part of the city's further development towards a Smart City that we have already felt in the continuous acceleration of the city's operational efficiency through the wider implementation of Information and Communication Technology (ICT).

text: Naunahan na gani ini sa Southeast Asia sa Singapore.
english: It has even been pioneered in Southeast Asia in Singapore.

text:
***

Kalakip sa pag-“modernize” sang mga merkado ang pagpaseguro nga “flood-free” man ang mga ini, nga indi katulad sadto nga pirme ginabaha-baha sa gwa kag sa sulod bisan pila lang ka minuto nga pag-ulan.
english:
***

The modernization of the markets includes ensuring that they are also flood-free, unlike in the past when they were always flooded outside and inside even after a few minutes of rain.

text: Mangin masulhay naman ang panghulag sang mga manugbakal dira sa sulod kay mas orderly na ang pagpahamtang sang mga pwesto, kag ma-improbar man ang trapiko sa palibut sini.
english: The movement of shoppers inside will be easier because the stalls will be more orderly, and the traffic around it will also be improved.

text: Tungod sini, maka-kumpetensya na ang mga ini sa dalagku nga mga privately-owned supermarket kag mapauswag man ang pangabuhi sang mga vendors sa pagdamo pa gid sang manugbakal dira.
english: As a result, they will be able to compete with the large privately-owned supermarkets and improve the livelihood of the vendors by increasing the number of customers there.

text:
***

Angot sa sining pag-“modernize” sang mga merkado amo man ang pagpaseguro nga “flood-free” na ini sila.
english:
***

In connection with this modernization of markets is also ensuring that they are flood-free.

text: In fact, isa ini nga sabat sa aton problema sa Climate Change diri sa siyudad nga masami ginabahaan sa panahon sang tag-ulan.
english: In fact, this is a response to our problem of Climate Change here in the city that is often flooded during the rainy season.

text: Kilala ang aton pungsod sa kalibutan nga “most vulnerable” sa Climate Change, ukon makatulublag na nga pagbag-o sang klima.
english: Our country is known in the world as the “most vulnerable” to Climate Change.

text: In fact, nangin biktima na kita sang makahaladlok nga resulta sini sa siyudad sa dala sini nga mas mabaskug nga mga bagyo, malaparon kag madalom nga pagbinaha-baha, padayon nga pagsaka sang temperatura nga nagapamala (drought) sang aton mga talamnan, ang sige pagsaka sang taob nga nagapakitid sang baybayon, paglala sang pag-inulan nga nagapangrumpag (landslide) sang kabukiran, kag iban pa nga kahalitan.
english: In fact, we have already become victims of the terrible consequences of this in the city with its stronger typhoons, widespread and deep flooding, continuous rise in temperature that dries our fields, rising tide that narrows the coast, increased rainfall that causes landslides, and other disasters. damage.

text: Kon matandaan ta pa, gin-igu kita sang Tropical Storm Frank sadtong 2008 nga nagdulot sang malaparon, madalom, kag masulog nga pagbaha (flashflood) sa sobra katunga sang 180 naton ka kabarangayan, nga wala pa matabo diri sa aton halin sadto.
english: If we remember, we were hit by Tropical Storm Frank in 2008 which caused widespread, deep, and flashflooding in more than half of our 180 barangays, which has not happened here in our country since.

text:
***

Well, may ginahimo man ang aton gobyerno upod sa mga pumuluyo sa ila man pagkabalaka.
english:
***

Well, our government is doing something with the people in their concerns.

text: Nasolbar na naton ang mahaliton kag masulog nga pag-binaha nga dala sadto sang Typhoon Storm Frank sang 2008.
english: We have resolved the devastating and torrential flooding caused by Typhoon Storm Frank in 2008.

text: May ara na kita nga  floodway nga nagasagang sang nagasulod nga baha halin sa probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: We already have a floodway that blocks the incoming flood from the province of Iloilo.

text: May comprehensive naman nga pagtuon sa problema sang siyudad sa Climate Change  nga nahimo paagi sa First Iloilo City Environmental Summit sadtong Jan.
english: A comprehensive study of the city's Climate Change problem was conducted through the First Iloilo City Environmental Summit on Jan.

text: 6-7, 2010 nga ang action plan napalab-ot na sa gobyerno nasyonal.
english: 6-7, 2010 that the action plan has been submitted to the national government.

text: Ginapatuman ta man sa siyudad ang mga programa sa “risk reduction” kag “disaster mitigation”.
english: We are also implementing risk reduction and disaster mitigation programs in the city.

text: Ginapatuman man ang  mga  environmental laws, katulad sang Clean Air Act kag environmental code sang siyudad.
english: Environmental laws, such as the Clean Air Act and the city's environmental code, are also being enforced.

text: Sa kalibutan, ginapatuman naman ang mga hulag environmental katulad sang Kyoto Protocol kag Paris Agrement.
english: Globally, environmental movements such as the Kyoto Protocol and the Paris Agreement are being implemented.

text: Nahibal-an naman sang Cenro ang matuod nga kahimtangan sang environment sang siyudad, sa report sini sadtong 2010.
english: Cenro, on the other hand, knows the true state of the city's environment, in its 2010 report.

text: Kag kinahanglan na gid lang aktuhan ang dapat himuon sang siyudad sa pagbulig man sang gobyerno nasyonal.
english: And the city needs to do what it can to help the national government.

text: Sunu sa data sang Cenro sadtong 2010, nakita nga  58 sang 180 ka barangay ang “susceptible” sa flashflood; 10 coastal barangays ang “susceptible” sa storm surges; 9 beaches ang “susceptible” sa tsunami; vegetation  sa agricultural areas sa siyudad 9% na lang; kag open spaces 7% na lang.
english: According to Cenro data in 2010, 58 of the 180 barangays were found to be “susceptible” to flashfloods; 10 coastal barangays are “susceptible” to storm surges; 9 beaches are “susceptible” to tsunami; vegetation in agricultural areas in the city is only 9%; and open spaces are down to 7%.

text: Makatulublag man ang nagakatabo sa aton mga suba kag estuary (Iloilo River) nga nagadangat sa 44 kms ang kalabaon, kon diin madamo pa ang nagapuyo sa kilid sini kag ang indi pa matapna nga paghaboy sang basura diri; kag ang mangrove nga 39.5 hectares na lang.
english: Also worrying is what is happening in our rivers and estuary (Iloilo River) which is 44 kms long, where many people still live along it and the unstoppable dumping of garbage here; and the mangrove which is only 39.5 hectares.

text: Ang emission sa kahanginan naglab-ut sa 10 kilos organic gases; 80 kilos ang carbon dioxide; kag 5 kilos ang nitrogen oxide.
english: Air emissions amounted to 10 kilos of organic gases; 80 kilos of carbon dioxide; and 5 kilos of nitrogen oxide.

text: Padayon man ang pagbuga sang “pollutants” halin sa mga salakyan; water pollution 64% for swimming; 2/3 sang suba indi na bagay (not fit) para sa public water supply gani 25 gid ang nagakapatay adlaw-adlaw halin sa water-borne diseases.
english: Pollutants from vehicles continue to be emitted; water pollution 64% for swimming; 2/3 of the river is not fit for public water supply so 25 people die every day from water-borne diseases.

text: Tungod sini luyag gid sang aton pumuluyo kamustahon na ang kahimtangan sang aton palibut (environment) sa karon agud mahibal-an man naton kon ano na ang nadangtan sini halin sa report sadto sang Cenro sang 2010./PN
english: Therefore, our people would like to see the current state of our environment so that we can know what has happened to it since the Cenro report in 2010./PN

text: Nagatalangison nga ginsugata sang pamilya sa Pilipinas ang pag-abot sang bangkay sang Filipina caregiver nga si Mary Ann De Vera.
english: Families in the Philippines greeted the arrival of the body of Filipina caregiver Mary Ann De Vera in tears.

text: Nag-upod man sa pagpauli ang bana ni De Vera nga si Bernie Lavarias nga naga-trabaho man sa Israel.
english: De Vera's husband, Bernie Lavarias, who also works in Israel, also returned home.

text: Sang nagligad nga adlaw, matandaan nga personal nga nagpakigkita si Israeli President Isaac Herzog kay Lavarias agud nga makig-simpatiya sa kasubo sini nga nabatyagan bangud sa kamatayon sang iya asawa.
english: Last day, Israeli President Isaac Herzog personally met with Lavarias to express his condolences over the death of his wife.

text: “Dasal, pakikiramay at buong suporta naman ang ipinahatid ng mga opisyal ng Department of Migrant Workers (DMW), Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA), H.E. english: “Prayers, condolences and full support were extended by officials of the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW), Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA), H.E. Dana Kursh, and several members of Congress and Senate to meet the lips of OFW Mary Ann, in recognition of her courage and sacrifice while fulfilling her duties,” in the DMW post.

text: Matandaan nga napatay ang 32-anyos nga caregiver sang naigo ini sang debris sang missile samtang ginabuligan sini ang iya alaga nga makasaylo sa bomb shelter sa kasagsagan ang pagpamomba sang Iran bilang balos man sa nauna nga atake sang US kag Israel sa Tehran.
english: The 32-year-old caregiver was killed when she was hit by missile debris while helping her dog move to a bomb shelter amid Iranian bombing in response to earlier US and Israeli attacks on Tehran.

text: Tumandok siya sang Pangasinan kag naga-trabaho sa Tel Aviv halin sang 2019.
english: She is a native of Pangasinan and has been working in Tel Aviv since 2019.

text: Una na nga ginpakigbahin sang previous employers ni De Vera nga nagabusong pa ini sang iya subang nga bata sang natabo ang gyera sa Middle East.#
english: Earlier, De Vera's previous employers shared that she was pregnant with her youngest child when the war in the Middle East broke out.

text: Nagpaidalom si Kris Aquino sa surgical procedures nga kabahin sang mas agresibo nga phase sang medical treatment sa iya autoimmune diseases.
english: Kris Aquino underwent surgical procedures as part of a more aggressive phase of medical treatment for her autoimmune diseases.

text: Suno sa Queen of All Media, nag-umpisa sang procedures sang Agusto 20 kag sang ulihi ginsaylo siya sa cardiac operating room para sa pagbutang sang port-a-cath ukon ang gamay nga device nga gina-implant para nga mas mahapos ang access sa veins sang pasyente.
english: According to the Queen of All Media, the procedures began on August 20 and she was later transferred to the cardiac operating room for the placement of a port-a-cath or a small device that is implanted to facilitate access to the patient's veins.

text: Sa Instagram, ginpakigbahin ni Kris nga nadumduman sini ang iya iloy nga ginbutangan man anay sang port-a-cath, apang wala gid nagreklamo suno sa iya bisan nga wala ini gani sang pain management doctor.
english: On Instagram, Kris shared that she remembers her mother who was also fitted with a port-a-cath, but never complained even though she didn't even have a pain management doctor.

text: “While writing this, happy tears are flowing because I’m remembering how much our mom endured for us, she also had a port-a-cath surgically inplanted, yet we never heard her complain, and she didn’t have a pain management doctor,” pahayag sini.
english: “While writing this, happy tears are flowing because I’m remembering how much our mom endured for us, she also had a port-a-cath surgically implanted, yet we never heard her complain, and she didn’t have a pain management doctor,” stated sini.

text:
Para kay Kris, sanday Bimby kag Josh ang rason kun ngaa padayon siya nga nagabato sa iya nga kondisyon: “If I wasn’t their mama, matagal na po akong sumuko.”

Nahangpan man sini nga pamuno pa lang ini sang mas aggressive treatment para nga mabuhi siya.
english:
For Kris, Bimby and Josh are the reason why she continues to fight her condition: “If I wasn’t their mom, I would have given up a long time ago.”

He also understood that this was just the beginning of more aggressive treatment to keep him alive.

text: Una na nga naghatag ang mga doctor sang anum ka bulan agud nga mag-isolate ang aktres kag agud maghimo sang optimal treatment plan.
english: Earlier, doctors gave the actress six months to isolate and to develop an optimal treatment plan.

text: “I have a new hashtag to remind myself how much I owe all of you who continue praying for me.
english: “I have a new hashtag to remind myself how much I owe all of you who continue praying for me.

text: Thank you for your patience, support, and much appreciated LOVE.
english: Thank you for your patience, support, and much appreciated LOVE.

text: #labankris,” post pa sini sa Instagram.
english: #labankris,” he posted on Instagram.

text: Sang Abril matandaan nga ginpahayag sini nga may siyam na siya ka ginasuprer nga autoimmune diseases, kag nagpaidalom man sa medical procedure sang amo nga bulan.#
english: In April, he announced that he was suffering from nine autoimmune diseases, and also underwent a medical procedure that month.

text: “Mr. Christmas” ang masami nga tawag sang mga Pilipino sa singer nga si Jose Mari Chan bangud sa iya mga Christmas songs nga ginapatukar sa mga radyo kada Setyembre 1.
english: “Mr. Christmas” is what Filipinos often call singer Jose Mari Chan because of his Christmas songs that are played on the radio every September 1.

text: Apisar nga nalipay ang singer bangud ginakilala kag ginadumdom siya sang mga Pinoy, pahayag niya, naga-isahanon lang ang matuod nga Mr. Christmas kag ini amo si Baby Jesus.
english: Although the singer is happy because he is recognized and remembered by Filipinos, he said the true Mr. Christmas and this is Baby Jesus.

text: Isa si Jose Mari sa mga simbolo sang Paskwa sa Pilipinas nga may pinakamalawig nga tion sa pagselebrar sa kaadlawan ni Hesu Kristo.
english: Jose Mari is one of the symbols of Christmas in the Philippines with the longest time to celebrate the birth of Jesus Christ.

text: Apang kun siya ang pamangkuton, indi niya kuntani luyag nga tawgon bilang Mr. Christmas bangud naga-isahaon lang ang matuod nga King of Christmas.
english: But if he were asked, he would not have wanted to be called as Mr. Christmas because there is only one true King of Christmas.

text: Mas luyag pa niya nga tawgon siya bilang Little Drummer Boy.
english: He preferred to be referred to as Little Drummer Boy.

text: Wala naman sang plano pa si Jose Mari nga magpaguwa sang panibag-o nga Christmas album.
english: Jose Mari has no plans to release a new Christmas album.

text: Yari pamatian ang isa sa christmas song ni Jose Mari Chan nga A Perfect Christmas.
english: Here's a listen to one of Jose Mari Chan's christmas songs A Perfect Christmas.

text: ILOILO CITY – Sigurado na nga makakuha sang bronze medal ang tanan nga siyam ka mga boksidor nagikan sa Pilipinas sa nagapadayon nga 31st Southeast Asian Games sa Hanoi, Vietnam.
english: ILOILO CITY – All nine boxers from the Philippines are sure to win bronze medals in the ongoing 31st Southeast Asian Games in Hanoi, Vietnam.

text: Ini bangud nga tanan sila ang lunsay nga nakalab-ot na sa semifinals sa ila tagsa ka division.
english: This is because they have all reached the semifinals in their respective divisions.

text: Nagdaog si Tokyo Olympics silver medalist Nesthy Petecio batuk sa kontra sini sa women’s 60kg ukon sa lightweight division.
english: Tokyo Olympics silver medalist Nesthy Petecio won against her opponent in the women’s 60kg or lightweight division.

text: Ang isa pa ka Olympian nga si Irish Magno sang Janiuay, Iloilo ang nagdaog man sa women’s 51kg ukon flyweight category quarterfinals.
english: Another Olympian, Irish Magno of Janiuay, Iloilo, also won the women’s 51kg or flyweight category quarterfinals.

text: Ang Tokyo Olympics bronze medalist nga si Eumir Marcial ang magasambuwa na sa finals sa 75kg ukon middleweight division.
english: Tokyo Olympics bronze medalist Eumir Marcial will compete in the finals in the 75kg or middleweight division.

text: Samtang, si 2016 Rio Olympian Rogen Ladon ang maga-advance naman para sa finals sa men’s 52kg ukon flyweight category.
english: Meanwhile, 2016 Rio Olympian Rogen Ladon will advance to the finals in the men’s 52kg or flyweight category.

text: Kabahin man sang mga sigurado na nga makakuha sang bronze medals amo si Ian Clark Bautista kag Marjon Piañar.
english: Ian Clark Bautista and Marjon Piañar are also among those who are sure to win bronze medals.

text: Samtang, nalutos naman sanday James Palicte, Riza Pasuit kag Josie Gabuco apang sigurado na ang bronze medal.
english: Meanwhile, James Palicte, Riza Pasuit and Josie Gabuco lost but the bronze medal is certain.

text: Nahibaluan nga pulo ang ginpadala sang Pilipinas sa boxing event apang ang women’s 75kg ukon ang middleweight division tournament ang ginkanselar bangud duha gid lamang ang nagpasakop kun sa diin, isa diri ang Filipina boxer nga si Hergie Bacyadan
english: It is known that the Philippines sent ten boxers to the boxing event but the women's 75kg or the middleweight division tournament was canceled because only two participated where, one of them is Filipina boxer Hergie Bacyadan

text: Naglab-ot sa P7.4 million ang nagasto sang Office of the Vice President (OVP) para sa security kag personnel nga gin-upod sa mga byahe sa luwas sang pungsod ni Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: The Office of the Vice President (OVP) spent P7.4 million on security and personnel accompanying Vice President Sara Duterte on foreign trips.

text: Ini ang ginpahayag sang Bise Presidente sa ginpatigayon nga budget hearing sang House appropriations committee para sa ginaduso nga 2026 budget sang OVP.
english: The Vice President said this during the budget hearing of the House appropriations committee for the proposed 2026 budget of the OVP.

text: Ang pamangkot ang naghalin kay House Assistant Minority Leader kag Kabataan party-list Representative, Renee Co.
english: The question came from House Assistant Minority Leader and Kabataan party-list Representative, Renee Co.

text: Suno kay Duterte, apisar indi gin-charge sa pondo sang OVP ang iya personal nga gasto sa mga byahe sa abroad, kaangay sang pamasahe kag akomodasyon, ang gasto para sa iya security detail kag OVP staff amo ang ginbayaran halin sa opisina.
english: According to Duterte, although his personal expenses for trips abroad, such as fare and accommodation, were not charged to the OVP fund, the expenses for his security detail and OVP staff were paid from the office.

text: Ginpasiguro man sang bise presidente nga ini nga mga gasto ang kabahin sang seguridad kag epektibo nga pagserbisyo sa iya katungdanan bilang ikaduha nga pinakataas nga opisyal sang pungsod.
english: The vice president also assured that these expenses are part of the security and effective service of his duties as the second highest official of the country.

text: Padayon pa ang deliberasyon sang Kongreso sa ginaproponer nga budget para sa OVP sa 2026.
english: Congress is still deliberating on the proposed budget for the OVP in 2026.

text: Ginbuksan na ang convention center sa Espanya bilang panibag-o nga temporaryo nga morgue para nga matatapan ang numero sang mga patay sa flash floods nga subong naglab-ot na sa masobra 200.
english: A convention center in Spain has been opened as a new temporary morgue to accommodate the death toll from the flash floods, which has now reached more than 200.

text: 202 sa sini nga mga napatay ang naghalin sa eastern region sang Valencia kag ang tatlo ka iban pa ang nagikan naman sa Castilla La Mancha kag Andalusia.
english: 202 of these deaths were from the eastern region of Valencia and the other three were from Castile La Mancha and Andalusia.

text: Madamo pa ang missing kag may areas pa sa Valencia nga wala pa nasulod sang otoridad gani ginalantaw nga mas magasaka pa ini nga death toll.
english: There are still many missing and there are still areas in Valencia that the authorities have not yet entered so the death toll is expected to rise.

text: Ini nga numero sang patay ang halos nagatupong na sa 209 nga napatay sa Romania sang 1970 kag ginakahangaw-an nga basi kun maglebel pa sa natabo sa flash floods incident sa Portugal sang 1967 nga nagpatay sang malapit 500 ka mga tawo.
english: The death toll is almost equal to the 209 killed in Romania in 1970 and is feared to be on par with the flash floods incident in Portugal in 1967 that killed nearly 500 people.

text: Yara man sa lima ka gatos ka mga soldado ang todo-pangita sa mga missing samtang nagabuligay naman ang mga residente sa pagpangpala sa ila palibot para matinluan ang mga higko nga ginbilin sang lapnagon nga baha.
english: About 500 soldiers are also searching for the missing while residents are helping to clean up the debris left by the widespread floods.

text: 75,000 pa subong ka mga balay sa amo nga rehiyon ang wala pa gihapon nabalikan sang suplay sang kuryente.
english: Another 75,000 households in the region have not yet been restored to electricity supply.

text: Matandaan nga katumbas sang isa ka tuig nga ulan ang nagbubo sa sulod lamang sang walo ka oras sang Martes sang gab-i sa amo nga rehiyon sa Espanya nga nagpangguba sang mga taytay, dalan, naglapaw ang tubig sa mga suba, kag naglulutaw kag nagsalampaw ang mga salakyan.
english: It can be recalled that a year's worth of rain fell in just eight hours on Tuesday night in the region of Spain, destroying bridges, roads, flooding rivers, and floating and overturning vehicles.

text: Duha ang patay kag pito ang napilasan sa duha ka magkasunod nga insidente sang pagpangluthang nga kahimuan sang isa lamang ka gunman sa Halloween street celebration sa downtown Orlando, Florida sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: Two people were killed and seven others injured in two consecutive shooting incidents by a single gunman at a Halloween street celebration in downtown Orlando, Florida in the United States of America.

text: Una natabo ang insidente pasado ala una sang kaagahon sang Byernes oras sa amo nga state samtang yara ang costumed celebrants sa downtown bar kag restaurant district.
english: The incident first occurred around 1:00 am Friday state time while costumed celebrants were in the downtown bar and restaurant district.

text: Minutos ang nakaligad, ginsundan ini sang isa pa ka shooting incident sa malapit lamang nga area kun sa diin nadakpan na ang 17-anyos nga suspek.
english: Minutes later, this was followed by another shooting incident in a nearby area where the 17-year-old suspect was arrested.

text: Naga-edad 19-39 anyos ang edad sang mga pilason kag subong yara na sa estable nga kondisyon.
english: The injured are aged 19-39 years old and are now in stable condition.

text: Na-recover man sa suspek ang handgun nga gingamit sini kag ginkumpirma sang otoridad nga wala na sang iban pa nga mga suspek.
english: The handgun he used was also recovered from the suspect and police confirmed that there were no other suspects.

text: Ginahibalo pa subong ang motibo sang solterito sa pagpangluthang kag ang mga kaso nga atubangon sini.
english: The motive of the young man in the shooting and the charges he will face are still unknown.

text: Gina-assess man sang police department ang pagkinahanglan sang mas madamo nga mga pulis nga magapatrolya sa amo nga area subong nga weekend.
english: The police department is also assessing the need for more police officers to patrol the area this weekend.

text: Patay ang nobya nga backrider matapos nabunggu-an sang nagasunod nga salakyan nga ginamaheno sang amay sang iya nga nobyo sa national highway sang Brgy.
english: A backrider girlfriend was killed after being hit by a following vehicle driven by her boyfriend's father on the national highway in Brgy.

text: Tabuan Pani-an, Estancia, Iloilo.
english: Tabuan Pani-an, Estancia, Iloilo.

text: Ang driver sang salakyan nagaedad sang 42-anyos, negosyante, samtang ang naga-maneho naman sang motorsiklo amo ang iya anak nga si alias Dave, 22.
english: The driver of the vehicle was a 42-year-old businessman, while the driver of the motorcycle was his son alias Dave, 22.

text: Sila ang lunsay residente sang amo man nga banwa.
english: They are both residents of the same town.

text: Ang backrider naman sa motorsiklo amo ang nobya ni alias Dave kag residente man sang amo nga banwa.
english: The backrider of the motorcycle was the girlfriend of alias Dave and a resident of the same town.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Patrolman Cesar Medina, imbestigador sang Estancia Municipal Police Station, iya ginapahayag nga lunsay halin sa banwa sang Carles ang duha ka salakyan kun sa diin, nag-serbe nga convoy ang Nissan Navarra nga ginamaneho sang amay kag papauli na kuntani sa banwa sang Estancia.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Patrolman Cesar Medina, investigator of the Estancia Municipal Police Station, said the two vehicles were both from Carles town.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, hinali lang nga naghinay ang pagpadalagan sang motorsiklo kag nalab-ot ini sang nagasunod nga salakyan.
english: According to the investigation, the motorcycle suddenly slowed down and was hit by a following vehicle.

text: Bangud sa impact, nakaagum sang menor nga kapilasan ang driver sang motorsiklo samtang gindeklara nga dead on arrival ang nobya nga backrider sini.
english: Due to the impact, the driver of the motorcycle sustained minor injuries while his girlfriend, the backrider, was declared dead on arrival.

text: Ginahibalo pa kun magapasaka sang kaso ang pamilya sang backrider batok sa driver sang salakyan.
english: It is not yet known whether the family of the backrider will file a case against the driver of the vehicle.

text: Kritikal ang kondisyon sang isa ka lalaki matapos siya nga ginbuntog sang cobra sa Lake Sebu, South Cotabato.
english: A man is in critical condition after he was bitten by a cobra in Lake Sebu, South Cotabato.

text: Suno sa impormasyon, wala natalupangdan sang lalaki kag sang iya hinablos nga may nakasulod nga cobra sa ila balay.
english: According to reports, the man and his nephew did not notice that a cobra had entered their house.

text: Una nga ginbuntog sang cobra ang menor de edad nga hinablos gani nangayo ini sang bulig kag sang ginpangita sang tiyo, didto na ini natukob sang man-og sa iya batiis.
english: The cobra first bit the minor nephew so he called for help and when the uncle looked for him, he was bitten by the snake in his leg.

text: Gindala man gilayon sa ospital ang biktima kag yara sa Intensive Care Unit samtang ang hinablos ang gintublukan na sang anti-venom.
english: The victim was rushed to the hospital and is in the Intensive Care Unit while the nephew was given anti-venom.

text: Napatay naman sang mga residente ang man-og.
english: The residents killed the snake.

text: MANILA – Ginkibot sang 19 anyos nga singer-songwriter nga si Juan Karlos Labajo ang fans paagi sa iya indefinite hiatus announcement.
english: MANILA – 19-year-old singer-songwriter Juan Karlos Labajo surprised fans with his indefinite hiatus announcement.

text: Sa Instagram post ni JK, nakasaad ang caption nga “Matagal akong mawawala” antes niya gin-delete ang mga nauna nga post kag gin-ilisan sang black image ang iya profile picture.
english: In JK's Instagram post, the caption read, "I'll be gone for a long time" before he deleted the previous posts and replaced his profile picture with a black image.

text: Kasubong man nga mensahe ang ginshare ni JK sa iya Facebook page kag iya man nga gin-ilisan sang black image ang profile lakip na ang cover photo.
english: JK shared a similar message on his Facebook page and changed the profile to a black image including the cover photo.

text: Wala lang gin-athag sang “Buwan” singer kun nalakip sa indefinite social media hiatus ang iya music career.
english: The “Buwan” singer did not clarify whether his music career is included in the indefinite social media hiatus.

text: Nahibalu-an nga sang nagligad lang nga bulan sang nagpirma ang banda sang natungdan sa isa ka music label nga local subsidiary sang kilala nga UK music label.
english: It was learned that last month, the band signed with a music label that is a local subsidiary of a well-known UK music label.

text: Nagdangat sa 34.8 billion dollars ukon P1.7 trillion ang personal remittances sang Overseas Filipinos sa bilog nga 2021.
english: Personal remittances of Overseas Filipinos amounted to 34.8 billion dollars or P1.7 trillion in 2021.

text: Suno sa Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP), all-time high ini nga rekord kun ipaanggid sa pre-pandemic figure nga $33.4 billion sang 2019.
english: According to the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP), this is an all-time high record compared to the pre-pandemic figure of $33.4 billion in 2019.

text: Ang nasambit nga kantidad ang may katumbas nga 8.9% nga Gross Domestic Product (GDP).
english: This amount is equivalent to 8.9% of the Gross Domestic Product (GDP).

text: Pahayag sang BSP, ang pagbukas liwat sang ekonomiya sang madamo nga pungsod sang nagligad nga tuig kag ang liwat nga pagsanyog sang OFW deployment kag dako nga demand sa Filipino workers ang rason sang pagsaka sang personal remittance figures.
english: The BSP said the reopening of the economies of many countries last year and the resumption of OFW deployment and high demand for Filipino workers were the reasons for the increase in personal remittance figures.

text: Ginapan-aw nga ‘very unpredictable’ pa sa subong ang posible mangin resulta sang US presidential election sa tunga nanday Kamala Harris kag Donald Trump.
english: The possible outcome of the US presidential election between Kamala Harris and Donald Trump is still expected to be 'very unpredictable'.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Alex Vidal, Bombo International Correspondent in USA, iya ginpahayag nga dapat tutokan ang mga boto nga posible makuha sang mga presidentiables halin sa 7 battleground states.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Alex Vidal, Bombo International Correspondent in USA, said the focus should be on the votes that the presidentiables are likely to get from the seven battleground states.

text: Lakip diri ang Georgia, Arizona, Michigan, Nevada, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, kag Wisconsin.
english: These include Georgia, Arizona, Michigan, Nevada, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin.

text: Suno kay Vidal, ang Pennsylvania ang may pinakadako nga sakop sang boto sa nasambit nga pito ka mga estado.
english: Vidal said Pennsylvania has the largest vote coverage of those seven states.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga sa Pennsylvania, may neck-to-neck race si Trump kag Harris kon sa diin, nagapabilin nga wala sang maathag nga nagapanguna ukon frontrunner sa ila.
english: He also said that in Pennsylvania, Trump and Harris have a neck-to-neck race where there remains no clear leader or frontrunner.

text: Nahibaluan nga posible magdaog sa eleksyon ang isa sa mga presidentiables kon makuha ang majority sang Pennsylvania kag sang 19 ka electoral votes sini, nga amo ang pinakamadamo sa mga battle ground states.
english: It is known that one of the presidentials is likely to win the election if he gets a majority of Pennsylvania and its 19 electoral votes, which is the most among the battle ground states.

text: Si Kamala Harris kag si Donald Trump ang naghiwat sang mga dueling rally nga pila lamang ka milya ang kalayuon sa isa kag isa sa swing state kag pinakadaku nga syudad sang Wisconsin, nga amo ang Milwaukee.
english: Kamala Harris and Donald Trump have held dueling rallies just miles apart in the swing state and largest city of Wisconsin, which is Milwaukee.

text: Nagtambong si Vice President Sara Duterte sa deliberasyon sang House appropriations committee sa proposed P889 million budget para sa 2026 sang iya opisina.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte attended the deliberation of the House appropriations committee on the proposed P889 million budget for 2026 of her office.

text: Nagaisahanon si Duterte kag siya mismo ang nagpresentar sang budget proposal.
english: Duterte is alone and he himself presented the budget proposal.

text: Diri giin-athag ni Vice President Sara Duterte nga wala sang tickets kag iban nga expenses tuhoy sa mga byahe sa luwas sang pungsod ang gin-charge sa public funds.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte clarified that no tickets and other expenses related to foreign trips were charged to public funds.

text: Naabtan sang isa ka iloy nga wala na sang kabuhi ang iya duha ka kabataan sa sulod sang ila nasunog nga balay sa Barangay Poblacion, Sinacaban, Misamis Occidental.
english: A mother found her two children dead inside their burned house in Barangay Poblacion, Sinacaban, Misamis Occidental.

text: Suno sa impormasyon, nabilin ang mag-utod sa ila balay apang ginkandaduhan ini sang mga ginikanan antes sila naglakat agud mag-ubra.
english: According to reports, the brothers stayed in their house but the parents locked it before they left to work.

text: Bangud, nakadenahan ang pwertahan, wala nakagwa ang mag-utod sang nag-ibwal ang kalayo tubtob nga ginlamon na ang mga ini.
english: Because the door was chained, the brothers could not get out when the fire broke out until they were engulfed.

text: Suno kay Fire Officer 1 June Beejay Villacorta, Arson Investigator sang Sinacaban Fire Station, nakit-an nga nagakup-anay ang mga -utod nga kaangay nga ginaprotektahan sang magulang ang iya manghod.
english: According to Fire Officer 1 June Beejay Villacorta, Arson Investigator of Sinacaban Fire Station, the brothers were seen hugging each other as if the elder brother was protecting his younger brother.

text: Ginahibalo pa ang kabangdanan sang sunog.
english: The cause of the fire is still unknown.

text: Nalakip sa labing una nga Short Film Competition sang Bangkok ASEAN Film Festival ang tatlo ka mga entries sang Pilipinas.
english: Three Philippine entries were included in the first ever Short Film Competition of the Bangkok ASEAN Film Festival.

text: Ini ang ginalakipan sang “Tokwifi,” ukon “Star,” ni Carla Pulido Ocampo, “Excuse Me, Miss, Miss, Miss” ni Sonny Calvento, kag “To Calm the Pig Inside” ni Joanna Vasquez Arong.
english: These include Carla Pulido Ocampo’s “Tokwifi,” or “Star,” Sonny Calvento’s “Excuse Me, Miss, Miss, Miss,” and Joanna Vasquez Arong’s “To Calm the Pig Inside.”

text: Ang tatlo ka mga short films ang maga-compete sa 12 ka iban pa gikan sa Singapore, Myanmar, Thailand, Cambodia, Vietnam kag Malaysia.
english: The three short films will compete against 12 others from Singapore, Myanmar, Thailand, Cambodia, Vietnam and Malaysia.

text: Ang magadaog sa ASEAN Short Film competition ang magabaton sang cash prize balor $2,000 ukon P97,000 kag ini ang i-anunsyar sa Setyembre 6.
english: The winner of the ASEAN Short Film competition will receive a cash prize worth $2,000 or P97,000 and will be announced on September 6.

text: Indi na madayon ang biyahe ni Presidente Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.'s trip canceled

text: sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika sa masunod nga semana.
english: in the United States of America next week.

text: Matambong kuntani si ­Marcos sa 80th United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) nga patigayunon sa New York sa Sept­yembre 22-30.
english: Marcos was scheduled to attend the 80th United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) to be held in New York on September 22-30.

text: Wala pa sang ginhatag nga rason ang Malacanang tuhoy sa nakanselar nga biyahe.
english: Malacanang has not yet given a reason for the canceled trip.

text: Ipadala naman ni Marcos ang tiglikom sang Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) para amo ang magtiglawas sang Pilipinas sa kahiwatan.
english: Marcos will send the secretary of the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) to represent the Philippines at the event.

text: Nagdangat sa P300-billion ang kabug-usan nga market capitalization sang real estate investment trust (REIT) sang pungsod.
english: The total market capitalization of the country's real estate investment trust (REIT) has reached P300-billion.

text: Ini ang 1.4 percent sa gross domestic product (GDP) sang Pilipinas.
english: This is 1.4 percent of the Philippines' gross domestic product (GDP).

text: Suno kay Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) president kag CEO Ramon Monzon, ang share sang real estate investment trust ang nalakip man sa 50 most actively traded stocks in value halin sang Enero 3 tubtob Pebrero 17, 2022.
english: According to Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) president and CEO Ramon Monzon, the real estate investment trust’s share was also among the 50 most actively traded stocks in value from January 3 to February 17, 2022.

text: Ang REIT ang makabig nga investment instrument nga nagapahanugot sa mga investors, lakip na ang magagmay nga Filipino investors, nga magpartisipar sa real estate market.
english: The REIT is considered an investment instrument that allows investors, including small Filipino investors, to participate in the real estate market.

text: ILOILO CITY – Duha ka adlaw antes ang pormal nga opening sang 31st Southeast Asian Games sa Hanoi, Vietnam, naka-secure na sang apat ka medals ang Pilipinas sa sports nga kurash.
english: ILOILO CITY – Two days before the formal opening of the 31st Southeast Asian Games in Hanoi, Vietnam, the Philippines has secured four medals in the sport of kurash.

text: Suno kay national team playing head coach Al Llamas, apat sa mga athletes ang nakakuha sang duha ka silver kag duha man ka bronze medals sa una nga adlaw sang 31st SEA Games kurash competition.
english: According to national team playing head coach Al Llamas, four of the athletes won two silver and two bronze medals on the first day of the 31st SEA Games kurash competition.

text: Ang kurash ang isa ka sport nga nagapakita sang tradisyunal nga wrestling style nga masami nga gina-perform sa Central Asia.
english: Kurash is a sport that features a traditional wrestling style that is often performed in Central Asia.

text: Isa naman ka kadalag-an ang nalab-ot sang Bombo Radyo Philippines matapos napilian ang siyam (9) ka mga programa sang network bilang mga finalist sa ika-28 nga Kapisanan ng mga Brodkaster ng Pilipinas (KBP) Golden Dove Awards.
english: Bombo Radyo Philippines has achieved another victory after selecting nine (9) programs of the network as finalists in the 28th Kapisanan ng mga Brodkaster ng Pilipinas (KBP) Golden Dove Awards.

text: Isa ini ka prestihiyoso nga pagkilala nga ginahatag sang KBP sa mga pinakamaayo nga programa sa radyo kag sa broadcast industry sa bug-os nga pungsod.
english: It is a prestigious recognition given by KBP to the best programs in radio and the broadcast industry across the country.

text:
Yari ang mga finalist halin sa Bombo Radyo Philippines:

Best Newscast – National: Bombo Network News (BNN)Best AM Station – Provincial: Bombo Radyo IloiloBest Newscast – Provincial: Bombo Radyo IloiloBest FM Station – Metro Manila: Star FM ManilaBest Special Program: Star FM Manila kag Bombo Radyo CauayanBest Culture and the Arts Program: Bombo Radyo IloiloBest Science and Technology Program: Bombo Radyo IloiloBest Sports Program: Star FM Baguio

Ang pagpili bilang finalist sa sini nga mga kategorya amo ang ebidensya sang matuod-tuod kag tampad nga panindugan sang Bombo Radyo Philippines sa paghatag sang dekalidad kag mabaskog nga mga programa sa mga Pilipino.
english:
Here are the finalists from Bombo Radyo Philippines:

Best Newscast – National: Bombo Network News (BNN)Best AM Station – Provincial: Bombo Radyo IloiloBest Newscast – Provincial: Bombo Radyo IloiloBest FM Station – Metro Manila: Star FM ManilaBest Special Program: Star FM Manila and Bombo Radyo CauayanBest Culture and the Arts Program: Bombo Radyo Iloilo Science and Technology Program: Bombo Radyo IloiloBest Sports Program: Star FM Baguio

The selection as a finalist in these categories is evidence of Bombo Radyo Philippines' genuine and honest commitment to providing quality and strong programs to Filipinos.

text: Ini nga pagkilala indi lamang bunga sang kabudlay kag dedikasyon sang mga tawo sa likod sang mikropono, kundi halad man sa amon mga pinalangga nga mga tagpamalamati kag tumalan-aw sa bug-os nga Pilipinas kag bisan diin nga bahin sang kalibutan.
english: This recognition is not only the fruit of the hard work and dedication of the people behind the microphone, but also an offering to our beloved listeners and viewers across the Philippines and anywhere in the world.

text: Basta Radyo, Bombo!
english: Just Radio, Bombo!

text: Aprubado na sa committee level sa Kamara ang hagna nga may katuyuan nga protektahan ang entertainment industry workers kasunod sang pagtaliwan sang beterano nga aktor nga si Eddie Garcia.
english: A bill aimed at protecting entertainment industry workers following the death of veteran actor Eddie Garcia has been approved at the committee level in the House of Representatives.

text: Suno kay Film Development Council of the Philippines chairperson Liza Diño-Seguerra, ang Actors Occupational Safety and Health Standard Bill ukon “Eddie Garcia Bill” ang pasado na sa labor and employment panel.
english: According to Film Development Council of the Philippines chairperson Liza Diño-Seguerra, the Actors Occupational Safety and Health Standard Bill or “Eddie Garcia Bill” has already passed the labor and employment panel.

text: Sa idalom sang House Bill 1941, may yara dapat sang safety kag medical personnel nga naka-deploy sa tanan nga lugar nga ginatrabahu-an sang mga artista.
english: Under House Bill 1941, there must be safety and medical personnel deployed in all places where artists work.

text: Magluwas sini, dapat nga may yara man sang mandatory personnel kag production insurance coverage.
english: In addition to this, there should also be mandatory personnel and production insurance coverage.

text: Sa tion nga may yara sang aksidente sa set, kinahanglan nga ang korporasyon ukon producer ang magabayad sang full hospital bill sang employee.
english: In the event of an accident on set, the corporation or producer is required to pay the full hospital bill of the employee.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang 90-anyos nga aktor ang nagtaliwan sang Hunyo 2019 matapos nga ini ang nasandad kag natumba samtang yara siya sa set.
english: The 90-year-old actor passed away in June 2019 after he tripped and fell while he was on set.

text: Ginbalik na sa kustodiya sang Senado ang ginkakas nga si Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Bulacan Assistant District Engineer nga si Brice Hernandez.
english: The Senate has returned to the custody of dismissed Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Bulacan Assistant District Engineer Brice Hernandez.

text: Ang pagbalik kay Hernandez ang kasunod sang hearing sa iya nga Writ of Amparo petition sa Pasay Regional Trial Court Branch 112.
english: Hernandez's return follows the hearing of his Writ of Amparo petition at the Pasay Regional Trial Court Branch 112.

text: Ang kampo ni Hernandez ang nagsulat kanday Senate President Vicente Sotto III kag Blue Ribbon Committee Chair Panfilo Lacson para hingyuon ang pagbalik sa iya sa Senate Detention Center bangud sa ila pagsalig kanday Sotto kag Lacson.
english: Hernandez's camp wrote to Senate President Vicente Sotto III and Blue Ribbon Committee Chair Panfilo Lacson to request his return to the Senate Detention Center because of their trust in Sotto and Lacson.

text: Matandaan nga gin-cite in contempt sa Senado sang Setyembre 8 si Hernandez matapos ginpahayag nga nagbinutig ini kag gin-detain sa Senate Detention Facility.
english: Hernandez was cited in contempt of the Senate on September 8 after he allegedly lied and was detained at the Senate Detention Facility.

text: Ginsaylo siya sa PNP Custodial Center matapos ginbuyagyag sa Kamara ang duwa ka senador nga ginaalegar involved sa maanomalya nga flood control projects sa Bulacan.
english: He was transferred to the PNP Custodial Center after two senators allegedly involved in anomalous flood control projects in Bulacan were exposed in the House.

text: Nagsaka na sa 158 ang naisip nga patay bangud sa flash floods sa Espanya partikular sa rehiyon sang Valencia.
english: The death toll from flash floods in Spain, particularly in the Valencia region, has risen to 158.

text: 155 sa sini nga death toll ang naghalin mismo sa Valencia samtang ang tatlo naman ang narekord sa Castilla-La Mancha kag Andalusia.
english: 155 of these death tolls came from Valencia itself while three were recorded in Castile-La Mancha and Andalusia.

text: Padayon pa ang paghulag sang emergency teams para makit-an ang mga missing kag ginatos man nga mga soldado ang ginpadala sa rehiyon para mag-assist sa mga operasyon.
english: Emergency teams are still moving to find the missing and hundreds of soldiers have been sent to the region to assist in the operations.

text: Wala ginsapubliko sang otoridad kun pila pa ka mga tawo ang ginapangita apang una na nakapahayag ang defense minister nga posible magsaka pa gid ang numero sang patay bangud indi pa subong maagyan sang rescuers ang iban nga mga dalan.
english: Authorities did not disclose how many people are still being sought but the defense minister said earlier that the death toll could rise as rescuers cannot pass through other roads.

text: Akig man ang mga tawo sa apektado nga mga lugar bangud ginapahayag nga wala sang ginpadala nga mobile phone alerts kag nabaton lamang nila ini sang mataas na ang lebel sang tubig-baha kag pila ka oras pa matapos nga nag-isyu ang national weather service sang red alert bangud sa indi kinaandan nga mamunog nga pag-ulan.
english: People in the affected areas are also angry because they said no mobile phone alerts were sent and they received them only when the flood water level was high and a few hours after the national weather service issued a red alert due to unusually heavy rains.

text: Nag-umpisa naman ang pag-half mast sang mga hayahay sa government buildings kag isa ka minuto nga paghipos sa bilog nga nasyon bilang kabahin sang gindeklarar nga three days of mourning kasunod sang nasambit nga kalamidad.
english: Half mast flags in government buildings and a minute of silence began nationwide as part of the declared three days of mourning following the disaster.

text: ILOILO CITY – Tinguha-an sang Ukraine national team nga magdaog sa World Cup playoff semi-finals kadungan sang pagpakig-away man sang Ukrainian soldiers batuk sa Russian forces.
english: ILOILO CITY – The Ukrainian national team will try to win the World Cup playoff semi-finals while Ukrainian soldiers are also fighting against Russian forces.

text: Ang Ukraine ang ginlutos sang Bosnia kag Herzegovina sa 2-0 victory sang Nobyembre kag pangatubangon naman ang Scotland sa Hunyo 1.
english: Ukraine were beaten by Bosnia and Herzegovina in a 2-0 victory in November and will face Scotland on June 1.

text: Kun magdaog ang Ukraine, pangatubangon nila ang Wales agud nga maka-secure sang lugar sa finals nga hiwaton sa Qatar.
english: If Ukraine win, they will face Wales to secure a place in the finals to be held in Qatar.

text: Antes ang semi-finals, ang Ukraine ang may yara sang friendly match batuk sa Bundesliga sa Mayo 11.
english: Before the semi-finals, Ukraine will have a friendly match against the Bundesliga on May 11.

text: Suno kay Ukrainian football midfielder Taras Stepanenko, adlaw-adlaw, makabaton sila sang mensahe nagikan sa mga suldado nga nagapangabay nga himuon ang tanan agud nga makasulod sa World Cup.
english: According to Ukrainian football midfielder Taras Stepanenko, every day, they receive messages from soldiers asking them to do everything to qualify for the World Cup.

text: Ang Ukranian ang mahilig man sa football.
english: The Ukrainian is also a football fan.

text: Kun makasulod sila sa finals, kabigon ini nga “moment of hope” kag daw kaangay nga selebrasyon para sa pungsod gani kinahanglan nga maghampang sila nga may tagipusuon.
english: If they make it to the finals, it will be considered a “moment of hope” and a kind of celebration for the country so they need to play with heart.

text: Ginaduso nanday Senador Manny Pacquiao kag Senador Sherwin Gatchalian ang resolution nga magahimo kay anay Senador Ramon Revilla Sr.
english: Senator Manny Pacquiao and Senator Sherwin Gatchalian are pushing a resolution that would make former Senator Ramon Revilla Sr.

text: bilang National Artist for Film.
english: as National Artist for Film.

text: Sa Senate Resolution No.
english: In Senate Resolution No.

text: 477 nga gin-file ni Pacquiao, nakasaad nga si Revilla ang isa ka ehemplo sang talento, kaalam, kag artistry kag ini ang ginpakita sa tinuig niya nga pagpakigbahin sa mga pelikula nga nagapakita sang kultura sang mga Filipino.
english: 477 filed by Pacquiao, states that Revilla is an example of talent, intelligence, and artistry and this is shown in his years of participation in films that showcase Filipino culture.

text: Ang Senate Resolution No.
english: Senate Resolution No.
